do
    local RIVALS_GAME_ID = 6035872082
    local RIVALS_PLACES = {
        ["17625359962"] = true,
        ["129604661913557"] = true,
        ["117398147513099"] = true,
    }
    local ok = false
    for _ = 1, 80 do
        local gid = tonumber(game.GameId) or 0
        local pid = tostring(game.PlaceId or "")
        if (gid ~= 0 and gid == RIVALS_GAME_ID) or RIVALS_PLACES[pid] == true then
            ok = true
            break
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    if not ok then
        return
    end
end

function jahvex_cloneref(x)
    if type(cloneref) == "function" then
        local ok, r = pcall(cloneref, x)
        if ok and r ~= nil then
            return r
        end
    end
    return x
end
function jahvex_svc(name)
    return jahvex_cloneref(game:GetService(name))
end
function jahvex_hui()
    if type(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and typeof(h) == "Instance" then
            return h
        end
    end
    local ok, cg = pcall(function()
        return jahvex_cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
    end)
    if ok and typeof(cg) == "Instance" then
        return cg
    end
    local lp = jahvex_svc("Players").LocalPlayer
    return lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
end
function jahvex_guiParent(gui)
    if typeof(gui) ~= "Instance" then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        gui.Parent = jahvex_hui()
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 80 do
        local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            local data = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            data = data and data:FindFirstChild("Data")
            if not data then
                return
            end
            for _, name in ipairs({ "EquipCosmetic", "FavoriteCosmetic" }) do
                local real = data:FindFirstChild(name)
                if real and real:IsA("RemoteEvent") and real:GetAttribute("_jxDecoy") ~= true then
                    real.Name = name .. "_jx"
                    local decoy = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
                    decoy.Name = name
                    decoy:SetAttribute("_jxDecoy", true)
                    decoy.Parent = data
                    getgenv()["_jxDecoyOn_" .. name] = true
                    ok = true
                elseif real and real:GetAttribute("_jxDecoy") == true then
                    getgenv()["_jxDecoyOn_" .. name] = true
                    ok = true
                end
            end
        end)
        if getgenv()._jxDecoyOn_EquipCosmetic then
            break
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

do
    local _ac_cloneref = cloneref or function(obj) return obj end
    local _ac_newcclosure = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
    local _ac_earlyConnections = {}


    task.spawn(function()
        local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
        local LocalPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer
        while not LocalPlayer do task.wait() LocalPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer end
        task.wait(1.0)
        pcall(function()
            assert(getgc, "getgc missing")
            assert(debug and debug.info, "debug.info missing")
            assert(hookfunction, "hookfunction missing")
            assert(getconnections, "getconnections missing")
            local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
            local ScriptContext = game:GetService("ScriptContext")

            task.spawn(function()
                for _, conn in pairs(getconnections(LogService.MessageOut)) do
                    if conn and conn.Function then
                        pcall(function() hookfunction(conn.Function, _ac_newcclosure(function(...) end)) end)
                    end
                end
            end)

            task.spawn(function()
                for _, conn in pairs(getconnections(ScriptContext.Error)) do
                    pcall(function() conn:Disable() end)
                end
                pcall(function() hookfunction(ScriptContext.Error.Connect, _ac_newcclosure(function(...) return nil end)) end)
            end)

            task.spawn(function()
                for _, name in ipairs({"Kick", "kick"}) do
                    local fn = LocalPlayer[name]
                    if type(fn) == "function" then
                        local oldkick
                        oldkick = hookfunction(fn, _ac_newcclosure(function(self, ...)
                            if self == LocalPlayer then return end
                            return oldkick(self, ...)
                        end))
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end)


    task.spawn(function()
        local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
        local LocalPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer
        while not LocalPlayer do task.wait() LocalPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer end
        task.wait(1.5)
        pcall(function()
            local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
            local hookfunction = hookfunction or function() end
            local function patchTable(tbl)
                if type(tbl) ~= "table" then return end
                if rawget(tbl, "IsWithinOOBPart") or rawget(tbl, "OOB_DEFAULT_WARN_DELAY") then
                    tbl.IsWithinOOBPart = function() return nil end
                    tbl.GetOOBWarnDelay = function() return math.huge end
                    tbl.GetOOBKillDelay = function() return math.huge end
                    tbl.OOB_DEFAULT_WARN_DELAY = math.huge
                    tbl.OOB_DEFAULT_KILL_DELAY = math.huge
                end
                if rawget(tbl, "IsWithinTaggedParts") and not rawget(tbl, "_patchedOOB") then
                    local orig = tbl.IsWithinTaggedParts
                    tbl.IsWithinTaggedParts = function(self, tag, ...)
                        if tag == "OutOfBoundsPart" then return {} end
                        if tag == "OutOfBoundsSafePart" then return true end
                        return orig(self, tag, ...)
                    end
                    tbl._patchedOOB = true
                end
                if rawget(tbl, "IsOutOfBounds") and rawget(tbl, "_CheckKill") then
                    tbl.IsOutOfBounds = function() return nil end
                    tbl.Update = function() end
                    tbl._CheckKill = function() return false end
                end
            end
            pcall(function() patchTable(require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)) end)
            pcall(function() patchTable(require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GameplayUtility)) end)
            pcall(function()
                local oobMod = ReplicatedStorage.Modules:FindFirstChild("OutOfBoundsMachine")
                if oobMod then patchTable(require(oobMod)) end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                for _, p in pairs(CS:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsPart")) do CS:RemoveTag(p, "OutOfBoundsPart") end
                for _, p in pairs(CS:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsSafePart")) do CS:RemoveTag(p, "OutOfBoundsSafePart") end
                CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("OutOfBoundsPart"):Connect(function(p) pcall(CS.RemoveTag, CS, p, "OutOfBoundsPart") end)
                CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("OutOfBoundsSafePart"):Connect(function(p) pcall(CS.RemoveTag, CS, p, "OutOfBoundsSafePart") end)
            end)
        end)
    end)
end

do
local newcc = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
local _hf = hookfunction

local function safeHook(fn, rep)
    if type(_hf) ~= "function" or type(fn) ~= "function" then return fn end
    local old
    pcall(function() old = _hf(fn, newcc(rep)) end)
    return old or fn
end


pcall(function()
    if type(_hf) ~= "function" then return end
    local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if not LocalPlayer then return end
    for _, kname in ipairs({"Kick", "kick"}) do
        local fn = rawget(LocalPlayer, kname) or LocalPlayer[kname]
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            safeHook(fn, function(self, ...)
                if self == LocalPlayer then return end
                return fn(self, ...)
            end)
        end
    end
end)


pcall(function()
    if type(_hf) ~= "function" or type(getfenv) ~= "function" then return end
    local _hide = {
        hookfunction=true, newcclosure=true, getgc=true, getrawmetatable=true,
        setreadonly=true, getrenv=true, checkcaller=true, getconnections=true,
        setthreadidentity=true, getthreadidentity=true, getgenv=true,
        iscclosure=true, islclosure=true, isexecutorclosure=true,
        cloneref=true, compareinstances=true, identifyexecutor=true,
        getexecutorname=true, filtergc=true, hookmetamethod=true,
        getnamecallmethod=true, getsenv=true, getcallingscript=true,
        getscripts=true, getloadedmodules=true, dumpstring=true,
        getscriptbytecode=true, decompile=true, Drawing=true,
        WebSocket=true, syn=true, crypt=true, fluxus=true,
        getidentity=true, setidentity=true, getthreadcontext=true,
        setthreadcontext=true, isrbxactive=true, mouse1click=true,
        firetouchinterest=true, fireclickdetector=true, gethui=true,
        gethiddenproperty=true, sethiddenproperty=true, setfflag=true,
        getreg=true, getmenv=true, getrunningscripts=true,
        iscclosure=true, checkclosure=true, isnewcclosure=true,
    }
    local _proxy = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, k)
            if _hide[k] then return nil end
            local ok, val = pcall(function() return getrenv()[k] end)
            return ok and val or nil
        end,
        __newindex = function() end,
        __len = function() return 0 end,
    })
    local real_gf
    real_gf = safeHook(getfenv, function(target)
        if target == nil or target == 0 or target == 1 then return _proxy end
        if type(target) == "number" then return _proxy end
        local ok, env = pcall(real_gf, target)
        if not ok then return _proxy end
        if type(env) == "table" and (
            rawget(env, "hookfunction") ~= nil or
            rawget(env, "getgc") ~= nil or
            rawget(env, "newcclosure") ~= nil
        ) then
            return _proxy
        end
        return env
    end)
end)


pcall(function()
    if type(_hf) ~= "function" then return end
    if type(debug) ~= "table" or type(debug.info) ~= "function" then return end
    local real_di
    real_di = safeHook(debug.info, function(target, fmt, ...)
        if type(target) == "function" and fmt == "n" then
            local ok, name = pcall(real_di, target, fmt, ...)
            local _expNames = {hookfunction=1,newcclosure=1,getgc=1,checkcaller=1,
                               getrawmetatable=1,setreadonly=1,getrenv=1,getgenv=1}
            if ok and type(name) == "string" and _expNames[name] then return "" end
            return ok and name or ""
        end
        return real_di(target, fmt, ...)
    end)
end)

    if type(_hf) ~= "function" or type(getrenv) ~= "function" then return end
    local renv = getrenv()
    if not renv or type(renv.setmetatable) ~= "function" then return end
    local real_smt
    local in_smt_hook = false
    real_smt = safeHook(renv.setmetatable, function(t, mt)
        if in_smt_hook then return t end
        in_smt_hook = true
        local spoofed = false
        pcall(function()
            if type(mt) == "table" then
                local mode = rawget(mt, "__mode")
                if mode == "kv" or mode == "v" or mode == "k" then
                    local st = debug.traceback()
                    if st:find("MiscellaneousController", 1, true)
                        or st:find("CameraSecurity", 1, true)
                        or st:find("LocalScript3", 1, true)
                        or st:find("AnalyticsPipelineController", 1, true)
                        or st:find("ReplicatedController", 1, true) then
                        spoofed = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        local res
        if spoofed then
            res = real_smt({1, 2, 3}, {})
        else
            res = real_smt(t, mt)
        end
        in_smt_hook = false
        return res
    end)
    getgenv().__jx_camsec_hooked = true
end)

            if mt then

end)

do
    local type = type
    local string = string
    local rawget = rawget
    local rawset = rawset
    local pairs = pairs
    local getmetatable = getmetatable
    local setmetatable = setmetatable
    local getgenv = getgenv
    local pcall = pcall

    local function detox(env)
        if type(env) ~= "table" then return end
        pcall(function()
            local mt = getmetatable(env)
            if type(mt) == "table" and (mt.__c == true or mt.__jx_cloaked == true) then
                setmetatable(env, nil)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local kill = {}
            for k, _ in pairs(env) do
                if type(k) == "string" then
                    if string.sub(k, 1, 7) == "__mbus_" or string.sub(k, 1, 4) == "_cs"
                    or k == "_jxcs" or k == "_jxct" or k == "_jxrw"
                    or k == "_jx_ac1" or k == "_jx_ac2" then
                        kill[#kill + 1] = k
                    end
                end
            end
            for i = 1, #kill do
                rawset(env, kill[i], nil)
            end
        end)
    end

    local g = getgenv()
    detox(g)
    if type(_G) == "table" and _G ~= g then
        detox(_G)
    end
end

JAHVEX_BUILD = 202609020254
function _jxN(_msg)
end

pcall(function()
    if getgenv().jahvex_from_autoexec == true then
        return
    end
    local want = "JAHVEX_BUILD = " .. tostring(JAHVEX_BUILD)
    local function good(s)
        return type(s) == "string" and #s > 40000 and string.find(s, "JAHVEX_BUILD", 1, true) ~= nil
    end
    local function score(s)
        if not good(s) then return 0 end
        local b = tonumber(string.match(s, "JAHVEX_BUILD%s*=%s*(%d+)")) or 0
        local cur = tonumber(JAHVEX_BUILD) or 0
        if cur > 0 and b < cur then
            return 0
        end
        local n = b * 10000 + math.min(#s, 9999)
        if string.find(s, want, 1, true) then
            n = n + 1000000000
        end
        return n
    end
    local best, bestScore = nil, 0
    local function take(s)
        local sc = score(s)
        if sc > bestScore then
            best, bestScore = s, sc
        end
    end
    take(rawget(getgenv(), "jahvex_src"))
    local function rd(p)
        if type(p) ~= "string" or p == "" then
            return
        end
        if good(p) then
            take(p)
            return
        end
        if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        p = string.gsub(p, "^@", "")
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            if isfile(p) then
                return readfile(p)
            end
        end)
        if ok then
            take(data)
        end
    end
    for i = 1, 8 do
        pcall(function()
            rd(debug.info(i, "s"))
        end)
    end
    rd("jhvxneeww.txt")
    rd("jx/jahvex.lua")
    if good(best) then
        getgenv().jahvex_src = best
    end
end)


do
    local jid = tostring(game.JobId or "")
    local pid = tostring(game.PlaceId or "")
    if getgenv().jahvex_ae_job ~= jid or getgenv().jahvex_ae_place ~= pid then
        getgenv().jahvex_ae_job = jid
        getgenv().jahvex_ae_place = pid
        if getgenv().jahvex_from_autoexec == true then
            getgenv().jahvex_loaded = false
            getgenv().jahvex_booting_lock = false
        end
    end
    local fromAe = getgenv().jahvex_from_autoexec == true
    local lockOn = getgenv().jahvex_booting_lock == true
    local t0 = tonumber(getgenv().jahvex_boot_t) or 0
    local age = tick() - t0
    if lockOn and fromAe and age < 4 then
        _jxN("jahvex | already booting — skip autoexec")
        return
    end
    if lockOn or getgenv().jahvex_loaded then
        pcall(function()
            getgenv().jahvex_alive = false
            local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if pg then
                for _, child in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
                    local n = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))
                    if n:find("jahvex", 1, true) or n == "crosshairgui" or n == "jahvexboot"
                        or n == "insetoverlayhost" or n == "contentloadprobe"
                        or n == "hitfeedbackgui" or n == "worldmarkers"
                        or n == "overlayroot" or n == "axiscrossgui" then
                        pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        getgenv().jahvex_unload = nil
        getgenv().jahvex_loaded = false
        getgenv().jahvex_booting_lock = nil
        getgenv().jahvex_unloading = nil
        task.wait()
    end
end

getgenv().jahvex_stealth_depth = getgenv().jahvex_stealth_depth or 0
function jahvex_installStealthHook()
    if getgenv().__jx_stealth_hooked then return true end
    if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" or type(checkcaller) ~= "function" or type(newcclosure) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end
    local okInstall = false
    pcall(function()
        local oldCheck
        oldCheck = hookfunction(checkcaller, newcclosure(function(...)
            local d = getgenv().jahvex_stealth_depth
            if type(d) == "number" and d > 0 then
                return false
            end
            return oldCheck(...)
        end))
        getgenv().__jx_old_checkcaller = oldCheck
        getgenv().__jx_stealth_hooked = true
        okInstall = true
    end)
    return okInstall
end

function jahvex_stealthFireServer(remote, ...)
    if typeof(remote) ~= "Instance" then return false end
    if type(jahvex_swallowCheatRemote) == "function" then
        local swallowed = jahvex_swallowCheatRemote(remote, "FireServer", ...)
        if swallowed then return true end
    end
    local args = table.pack(jahvex_coverUnpack(...))
    local g = getgenv()
    local alreadyStealth = (tonumber(g.jahvex_stealth_depth) or 0) > 0
    if not alreadyStealth then
        jahvex_installStealthHook()
    end
    g.jahvex_stealth_depth = (tonumber(g.jahvex_stealth_depth) or 0) + 1
    local oldId = nil
    if not alreadyStealth and type(getthreadidentity) == "function" then
        pcall(function() oldId = getthreadidentity() end)
        if type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then
            pcall(function() setthreadidentity(2) end)
        end
    end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        remote:FireServer(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
    end)
    if oldId ~= nil and type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then
        pcall(function() setthreadidentity(oldId) end)
    end
    g.jahvex_stealth_depth = math.max(0, (tonumber(g.jahvex_stealth_depth) or 1) - 1)
    return ok
end

function jahvex_hideFromGame()
    if (tonumber(getgenv().jahvex_stealth_depth) or 0) > 0 then
        return false
    end
    if type(checkcaller) == "function" then
        local ok, caller = pcall(checkcaller)
        if ok and caller then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function jahvex_hiddenTable()
    local t = rawget(getgenv(), "__jx_hid")
    if type(t) ~= "table" then
        t = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        getgenv().__jx_hid = t
    end
    return t
end

function jahvex_isHidden(inst)
    if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then
        return false
    end
    local t = rawget(getgenv(), "__jx_hid")
    return type(t) == "table" and t[inst] == true
end

function jahvex_markHidden(inst)
    if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then
        return
    end
    jahvex_installHiddenScanHook()
    local t = jahvex_hiddenTable()
    local function rec(x)
        t[x] = true
        pcall(function()
            x.Archivable = false
        end)
        if x:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                x.CanCollide = false
                x.CanQuery = false
                x.CanTouch = false
                x.CastShadow = false
                x.Massless = true
            end)
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(x:GetChildren()) do
            rec(c)
        end
    end
    rec(inst)
    pcall(function()
        inst.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            t[d] = true
            pcall(function()
                d.Archivable = false
            end)
        end)
    end)
end

function jahvex_coverLtm(part, gameValue)
    if typeof(part) ~= "Instance" then
        return
    end
    local t = rawget(getgenv(), "__jx_ltmCover")
    if type(t) ~= "table" then
        t = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        getgenv().__jx_ltmCover = t
    end
    t[part] = gameValue
end

function jahvex_uncoverLtm(part)
    local t = rawget(getgenv(), "__jx_ltmCover")
    if type(t) == "table" then
        t[part] = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_filterHiddenList(list)
    if not jahvex_hideFromGame() then
        return list
    end
    if type(list) ~= "table" then
        return list
    end
    local t = rawget(getgenv(), "__jx_hid")
    if type(t) ~= "table" then
        return list
    end
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #list do
        local v = list[i]
        if not (typeof(v) == "Instance" and t[v] == true) then
            n = n + 1
            out[n] = v
        end
    end
    return out
end

function jahvex_stealthCall(fn)
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    jahvex_installStealthHook()
    local g = getgenv()
    g.jahvex_stealth_depth = (tonumber(g.jahvex_stealth_depth) or 0) + 1
    local oldId = nil
    if type(getthreadidentity) == "function" and type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            oldId = getthreadidentity()
            setthreadidentity(2)
        end)
    end
    local ok, a, b, c, d = pcall(fn)
    if oldId ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            setthreadidentity(oldId)
        end)
    end
    g.jahvex_stealth_depth = math.max(0, (tonumber(g.jahvex_stealth_depth) or 1) - 1)
    if ok then
        return a, b, c, d
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_cloakTree(inst)
    if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then
        return
    end
    local t = jahvex_hiddenTable()
    local function seal(x)
        t[x] = true
        pcall(function()
            x.Archivable = false
        end)
        if x:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                x.CanCollide = false
                x.CanQuery = false
                x.CanTouch = false
                x.CastShadow = false
                x.Massless = true
            end)
        end
    end
    local function rec(x)
        seal(x)
        for _, c in ipairs(x:GetChildren()) do
            rec(c)
        end
    end
    rec(inst)
    pcall(function()
        inst.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            seal(d)
        end)
    end)
end

function jahvex_installHiddenScanHook()
    return false
end


function jahvex_installCombatAcBypass(force)
    local newcc = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
    local g = getgenv()
    if not force and g.__jx_combat_ac_cam and g.__jx_combat_ac_oob and g.__jx_combat_ac_fs then
        return true
    end


    pcall(function()
        if g.__jx_combat_ac_cam and not force then return end
        if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" or type(getrenv) ~= "function" then return end
        local renv = getrenv()
        if not renv or type(renv.setmetatable) ~= "function" then return end
        if g.__jx_camsec_hooked then
            g.__jx_combat_ac_cam = true
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            if type(getgc) ~= "function" then return end
            for _, t in pairs(getgc(true)) do
                if type(t) == "table" then
                    local fn = rawget(t, "GetCameraData")
                    if type(fn) == "function" then
                        getgenv().__jx_camsec_tbl = t
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        g.__jx_combat_ac_cam = true
    end)


    pcall(function()
        local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")

        local function patchTable(tbl)
            if type(tbl) ~= "table" then return end
            if rawget(tbl, "IsWithinOOBPart") or rawget(tbl, "OOB_DEFAULT_WARN_DELAY") then
                tbl.IsWithinOOBPart = function() return nil end
                tbl.GetOOBWarnDelay = function() return math.huge end
                tbl.GetOOBKillDelay = function() return math.huge end
                tbl.OOB_DEFAULT_WARN_DELAY = math.huge
                tbl.OOB_DEFAULT_KILL_DELAY = math.huge
            end
            if rawget(tbl, "IsWithinTaggedParts") and not rawget(tbl, "_jxPatchedOOB") then
                local orig = tbl.IsWithinTaggedParts
                tbl.IsWithinTaggedParts = function(self, tag, ...)
                    if tag == "OutOfBoundsPart" then return {} end
                    if tag == "OutOfBoundsSafePart" then return true end
                    return orig(self, tag, ...)
                end
                tbl._jxPatchedOOB = true
            end
            if rawget(tbl, "IsOutOfBounds") and rawget(tbl, "_CheckKill") then
                tbl.IsOutOfBounds = function() return nil end
                tbl.Update = function() end
                tbl._CheckKill = function() return false end
            end
        end

        local patchedMod = false
        pcall(function()
            local Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
            if Utility then
                patchTable(Utility)
                patchedMod = true
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local GameplayUtility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GameplayUtility)
            if GameplayUtility then
                patchTable(GameplayUtility)
                patchedMod = true
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local oobMod = ReplicatedStorage.Modules:FindFirstChild("OutOfBoundsMachine")
            if oobMod then
                patchTable(require(oobMod))
                patchedMod = true
            end
        end)


        pcall(function()
            if type(getgc) ~= "function" then return end
            for _, tbl in pairs(getgc(true)) do
                if type(tbl) == "table" then
                    if rawget(tbl, "IsWithinOOBPart")
                        or rawget(tbl, "IsWithinTaggedParts")
                        or (rawget(tbl, "IsOutOfBounds") and rawget(tbl, "_CheckKill")) then
                        pcall(patchTable, tbl)
                        patchedMod = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if g.__jx_oob_tag_hooked then return end
            for _, p in pairs(CS:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsPart")) do
                pcall(CS.RemoveTag, CS, p, "OutOfBoundsPart")
            end
            for _, p in pairs(CS:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsSafePart")) do
                pcall(CS.RemoveTag, CS, p, "OutOfBoundsSafePart")
            end
            local c1 = CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("OutOfBoundsPart"):Connect(function(p)
                pcall(CS.RemoveTag, CS, p, "OutOfBoundsPart")
            end)
            local c2 = CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("OutOfBoundsSafePart"):Connect(function(p)
                pcall(CS.RemoveTag, CS, p, "OutOfBoundsSafePart")
            end)
            if type(jahvex_track) == "function" then
                pcall(jahvex_track, c1)
                pcall(jahvex_track, c2)
            end
            g.__jx_oob_tag_hooked = true
        end)

        if patchedMod or g.__jx_oob_tag_hooked then
            g.__jx_oob_patched = true
            g.__jx_combat_ac_oob = true
        end
    end)


    pcall(function()
        -- khook: do not hookfunction(FireServer). Namecall already blocks OutOfBounds.
        g.__jx_oob_fs_hooked = true
        g.__jx_combat_ac_fs = true
    end)

    local ok = g.__jx_combat_ac_cam == true and g.__jx_combat_ac_oob == true and g.__jx_combat_ac_fs == true
    if ok then
        g.__jx_combat_ac_ok = true
    end
    return ok
end


function jahvex_ensureCombatAcBypass()
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_installCombatAcBypass(false)
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.2)
        if type(jahvex_isCurrent) == "function" and not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_installCombatAcBypass(false)
        end)
    end)
end


function jahvex_realStat(key)
    if key == "Level" then return originalLevelValue end
    if key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreak" or key == "WinStreak" then return originalStreakValue end
    if key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreakHighest" then
        if _originalStats and _originalStats.StatisticDuelsWinStreakHighest ~= nil then
            return _originalStats.StatisticDuelsWinStreakHighest
        end
        return originalStreakValue
    end
    if key == "DisplayELO" or key == "RankedCurrentELO" then return originalEloValue end
    if key == "DisplayName" or key == "Display Name" or key == "Nickname" then
        return realDisplayName or realName
    end
    if key == "CosmeticInventory" then return originalCosmeticInventory end
    if key == "EquippedEmotes" then return originalEquippedEmotes end
    if key == "WeaponInventory" then return originalWeaponInventory end
    if key == "WeaponKeys" then return _originalWeaponKeys end
    if key == "UnclaimedRewards" then return originalUnclaimedRewards end
    if key == "Glory" then return _originalCurrencies and _originalCurrencies.Glory end
    if key == "EventCurrency" then return _originalCurrencies and _originalCurrencies.EventCurrency end
    if key == "SkinTickets" then return _originalCurrencies and _originalCurrencies.SkinTickets end
    if key == "UnlockTokens" then return _originalCurrencies and _originalCurrencies.UnlockTokens end
    if type(key) == "string" and string.sub(key, 1, 9) == "Statistic" then
        if _originalStats and _originalStats[key] ~= nil then
            return _originalStats[key]
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_coverValue(v, depth)
    depth = tonumber(depth) or 0
    if depth > 5 or type(v) ~= "table" then return v end
    local out = v
    local cloned = false
    local function ensure()
        if cloned then return end
        cloned = true
        out = {}
        for k, val in pairs(v) do
            out[k] = val
        end
    end
    for k, val in pairs(v) do
        if type(k) == "string" then
            local real = jahvex_realStat(k)
            if real ~= nil then
                ensure()
                out[k] = real
            elseif type(val) == "table" then
                local nested = jahvex_coverValue(val, depth + 1)
                if nested ~= val then
                    ensure()
                    out[k] = nested
                end
            end
        elseif type(val) == "table" then
            local nested = jahvex_coverValue(val, depth + 1)
            if nested ~= val then
                ensure()
                out[k] = nested
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

function jahvex_coverUnpack(...)
    local n = select("#", ...)
    local need = false
    for i = 1, n do
        if type(select(i, ...)) == "table" then
            need = true
            break
        end
    end
    if not need then
        return ...
    end
    local a = table.pack(...)
    for i = 1, n do
        a[i] = jahvex_coverValue(a[i])
    end
    return table.unpack(a, 1, n)
end


function jahvex_cheatNotifyName(self)
    if typeof(self) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
    local cached = rawget(_G, "_jxRnCache")
    if type(cached) ~= "table" then
        cached = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        _G._jxRnCache = cached
    end
    local n = cached[self]
    if type(n) == "string" then return n end
    local ok, got = pcall(function()
        return self.Name
    end)
    if not ok or type(got) ~= "string" then return nil end
    cached[self] = got
    return got
end

function jahvex_ownsRealCosmetic(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or name == "None" then return false end
    local inv = originalCosmeticInventory
    if type(inv) ~= "table" then
        pcall(function()
            inv = DataController and DataController.CurrentData
                and DataController.CurrentData.Data
                and DataController.CurrentData.Data.CosmeticInventory
        end)
    end
    return type(inv) == "table" and rawget(inv, name) ~= nil
end

function jahvex_isWeaponCosmeticEquip(weaponName, cosmeticType)
    if type(weaponName) ~= "string" or weaponName == "" then return false end
    if ItemLibrary then
        local items = rawget(ItemLibrary, "Items") or rawget(ItemLibrary, "Weapons")
        if type(items) == "table" and items[weaponName] then return true end
    end
    if type(ALL_GUNS) == "table" then
        for i = 1, #ALL_GUNS do
            if ALL_GUNS[i] == weaponName then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_isCombatRemote(self, n)
    if type(n) ~= "string" then return false end
    if JX_COMBAT_REMOTE[n] then return true end
    local ok, p = pcall(function()
        return self.Parent
    end)
    if ok and p then
        local pn = p.Name
        if pn == "Fighter" then
            if n ~= "UseEmoteByName" and n ~= "PlayEmote" and n ~= "EquipEmote" then
                return true
            end
        end
        if pn == "Camera" or pn == "Movement" or pn == "Character" or pn == "Input" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end


function jahvex_realDeviceControls()
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local last = UIS:GetLastInputType()
    if UIS.VREnabled then return "VR" end
    if last == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return "Touch" end
    if last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
        or last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3 or last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4 then
        return "Gamepad"
    end
    return "MouseKeyboard"
end

function jahvex_deviceVisualMapped()
    local g = getgenv()
    local map = (g and g.deviceControlMap) or deviceControlMap
    local typ = (g and g.currentDeviceType) or currentDeviceType
    if type(map) == "table" and typ ~= nil and map[typ] then
        return map[typ]
    end
    return "Touch"
end

function jahvex_deviceVisualOn()
    local g = getgenv()
    if g and g.jahvex_deviceSpoofVisual then return true end
    return deviceSpoofEnabled and true or false
end

function jahvex_deviceInCombat()
    local yes = false
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController or FighterController2
        local f = FC and FC.LocalFighter
        if not f then return end
        if type(f.Get) == "function" then
            if f:Get("IsInDuel") or f:Get("IsInShootingRange") then
                yes = true
                return
            end
        end
        local d = f.Data
        if type(d) == "table" and (d.IsInDuel or d.IsInShootingRange) then
            yes = true
        end
    end)
    return yes
end

function jahvex_coverRemoteName(n)
    if type(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then return false end
    if JX_SWALLOW_REMOTE[n] then return true end
    local l = string.lower(n)
    if l:find("useitem", 1, true) or l:find("shoot", 1, true) or l:find("reload", 1, true)
        or l:find("camera", 1, true) or l:find("look", 1, true) or l:find("walk", 1, true)
        or l:find("move", 1, true) or l:find("input", 1, true) then
        return false
    end
    local needles = {
        "lootbox", "unclaimed", "useemote", "playemote", "equipemote",
        "equipcosmetic", "favoritecosmetic", "unlockweapon",
        "levelupweapon",
    }
    for i = 1, #needles do
        if l:find(needles[i], 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_isDataRemote(self)
    local inst = self
    for _ = 1, 8 do
        if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then return false end
        if inst.Name == "Data" then
            local p = inst.Parent
            if p and p.Name == "Remotes" then return true end
        end
        inst = inst.Parent
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_coverDataKey(key)
    if type(key) ~= "string" then return false end
    if key == "CosmeticInventory" or key == "EquippedEmotes" or key == "FavoritedCosmetics"
        or key == "UnclaimedRewards" or key == "WeaponInventory" or key == "WeaponKeys"
        or key == "Glory" or key == "EventCurrency" or key == "SkinTickets" or key == "UnlockTokens"
        or key == "Level" or key == "DisplayELO" or key == "RankedCurrentELO"
        or key == "DisplayName" or key == "Nickname" or key == "CosmeticNotifications"
        or key == "PlayerStatus" or key == "WinStreak" or key == "CurrentControls"
        or key == "GroupRank" or key == "IsInfluencer" or key == "IsRobloxEmployee"
        or key == "IsAdministrator" or key == "IsPremium" then
        return true
    end
    if string.sub(key, 1, 9) == "Statistic" then return true end
    return false
end

function jahvex_hookDataReplicate()
    local cd = DataController and DataController.CurrentData
    if type(cd) ~= "table" or rawget(cd, "_jxRepHook") then return end
    rawset(cd, "_jxRepHook", true)
    if type(cd.Replicate) == "function" then
        local orig = cd.Replicate
        cd.Replicate = function(self, key, ...)
            if jahvex_coverDataKey(key) then
                jahvex_localDataTouch(key)
                return
            end
            return orig(self, key, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(cd.SetReplicate) == "function" then
        local origS = cd.SetReplicate
        cd.SetReplicate = function(self, key, val, ...)
            if jahvex_coverDataKey(key) then
                jahvex_localDataTouch(key)
                return
            end
            return origS(self, key, val, ...)
        end
    end
end


function jahvex_swallowCheatRemote(self, method, ...)
    local n = jahvex_cheatNotifyName(self)
    if not n then return false end
    if JX_SWALLOW_REMOTE[n] or (type(n) == "string" and jahvex_coverRemoteName(n)) then
        if n == "UseUnclaimedReward" then
            local fn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_dispatchCaseOpen")
            if fn then return true, fn(...) end
            return true, "Fail"
        end
        if n == "EquipCosmetic" and type(jahvex_localApplyEquipCosmetic) == "function" then
            pcall(jahvex_localApplyEquipCosmetic, ...)
        end
        if n == "FavoriteCosmetic" and type(jahvex_localApplyFavoriteCosmetic) == "function" then
            pcall(jahvex_localApplyFavoriteCosmetic, ...)
        end
        return true, nil
    end
    if jahvex_isCombatRemote(self, n) then
        return false
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_installCheatRemoteFireHook()
    -- khook: hookfunction(FireServer/InvokeServer) wraps the shared C method and
    -- drops vanilla shoot replication. Cosmetic swallow stays on namecall.
    getgenv().__jx_cheat_fs_swallow = true
    return true
end
pcall(jahvex_installCheatRemoteFireHook)

function jahvex_decoyDataRemote(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
        return false
    end
    if getgenv()["_jxDecoyOn_" .. name] then
        return true
    end
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local data = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Data")
    if not data then
        return false
    end
    local real = data:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not real or not real:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        return false
    end
    if real:GetAttribute("_jxDecoy") == true then
        getgenv()["_jxDecoyOn_" .. name] = true
        return true
    end
    pcall(function()
        real.Name = name .. "_jx"
        local decoy = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        decoy.Name = name
        decoy:SetAttribute("_jxDecoy", true)
        decoy.Parent = data
    end)
    getgenv()["_jxDecoyOn_" .. name] = true
    return true
end

function jahvex_decoySkinRemotes()
    pcall(jahvex_decoyDataRemote, "EquipCosmetic")
    pcall(jahvex_decoyDataRemote, "FavoriteCosmetic")
end

function jahvex_hookLiveSkinFireClosures()
    if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(hookfunction) ~= "function" or type(debug.getconstants) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    local bag = getgenv().__jx_skin_click_seen
    if type(bag) ~= "table" then
        bag = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        getgenv().__jx_skin_click_seen = bag
    end
    local okGc, gc = pcall(getgc, false)
    if not okGc or type(gc) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    local n = 0
    local scanned = 0
    for _, f in ipairs(gc) do
        scanned = scanned + 1
        if scanned > 12000 then
            break
        end
        if type(f) == "function" and not bag[f] then
            local okC, cs = pcall(debug.getconstants, f)
            if okC and type(cs) == "table" then
                local hasEq, hasFs, hasCombat = false, false, false
                for _, v in pairs(cs) do
                    if v == "EquipCosmetic" or v == "FavoriteCosmetic" then
                        hasEq = true
                    end
                    if v == "FireServer" then
                        hasFs = true
                    end
                    if v == "UseItem" or v == "SetControls" then
                        hasCombat = true
                    end
                end
                if hasEq and hasFs and not hasCombat then
                    local ups = {}
                    if type(debug.getupvalue) == "function" then
                        for i = 1, 32 do
                            local r = { pcall(debug.getupvalue, f, i) }
                            if not r[1] then
                                break
                            end
                            ups[i] = r[3] ~= nil and r[3] or r[2]
                        end
                    end
                    local okH = pcall(function()
                        hookfunction(f, function(...)
                            local nm, eq
                            for i = 1, #ups do
                                local v = ups[i]
                                if type(v) == "string" then
                                    if v == "NONE_COSMETIC" then
                                        nm = v
                                    elseif CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[v] then
                                        nm = v
                                    end
                                elseif type(v) == "table" then
                                    local okE, equipment = pcall(function()
                                        return v.Customize.Interface.Equipment
                                    end)
                                    if okE and type(equipment) == "table" and type(equipment.SelectCosmetic) == "function" then
                                        eq = equipment
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if eq and nm then
                                pcall(function()
                                    eq:SelectCosmetic(nm)
                                end)
                            end
                            if type(jahvex_localApplyEquipCosmetic) == "function" then
                                pcall(function()
                                    local w, t, c
                                    for i = 1, #ups do
                                        local v = ups[i]
                                        if type(v) == "string" then
                                            if ItemLibrary and ItemLibrary.Items and ItemLibrary.Items[v] then
                                                w = v
                                            elseif v == "Skin" or v == "Charm" or v == "Wrap" or v == "KillEffect" or v == "Finisher" then
                                                t = v
                                            elseif CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[v] then
                                                c = v
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if w and t then
                                        jahvex_localApplyEquipCosmetic(w, t, c, {})
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    if okH then
                        bag[f] = true
                        n = n + 1
                        if n >= 64 then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_killCosmeticEmoteFires()
    if type(debug) ~= "table" or type(debug.getconstants) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    local setc = debug.setconstant
    local function wrapSkinSelectClick(fn)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" or type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        local bag = getgenv().__jx_skin_click_seen
        if type(bag) ~= "table" then
            bag = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
            getgenv().__jx_skin_click_seen = bag
        end
        if bag[fn] then
            return true
        end
        local ups = {}
        if type(debug.getupvalue) == "function" then
            for i = 1, 32 do
                local r = { pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, i) }
                if not r[1] then
                    break
                end
                ups[i] = r[3] ~= nil and r[3] or r[2]
            end
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            hookfunction(fn, function(...)
                local nm, eq
                for i = 1, #ups do
                    local v = ups[i]
                    if type(v) == "string" then
                        if v == "NONE_COSMETIC" then
                            nm = v
                        elseif CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[v] then
                            nm = v
                        end
                    elseif type(v) == "table" then
                        local okE, equipment = pcall(function()
                            return v.Customize.Interface.Equipment
                        end)
                        if okE and type(equipment) == "table" and type(equipment.SelectCosmetic) == "function" then
                            eq = equipment
                        end
                    end
                end
                if eq and nm then
                    pcall(function()
                        eq:SelectCosmetic(nm)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if ok then
            bag[fn] = true
        end
        return ok
    end
    local function patchFireConstants(fn)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        local ok, cs = pcall(debug.getconstants, fn)
        if not ok or type(cs) ~= "table" then
            return false
        end
        local hasNeed, hasCombat, hasSelect = false, false, false
        local idxs = {}
        for k, v in pairs(cs) do
            if type(v) == "string" then
                if JX_SWALLOW_REMOTE[v] then
                    hasNeed = true
                end
                if v == "SelectCosmetic" then
                    hasSelect = true
                end
                if v == "UseItem" or v == "SetControls" or v == "Reload" or v == "UpdateState" then
                    hasCombat = true
                end
                if v == "FireServer" or v == "InvokeServer" then
                    idxs[#idxs + 1] = k
                end
            end
        end
        if hasCombat or not hasNeed then
            return false
        end
        if hasSelect then
            return wrapSkinSelectClick(fn)
        end
        if type(setc) ~= "function" or #idxs == 0 then
            return false
        end
        for i = 1, #idxs do
            pcall(setc, fn, idxs[i], "GetChildren")
        end
        return true
    end
    local function srcOk(src)
        if type(src) ~= "string" then
            return false
        end
        if string.find(src, "FighterController", 1, true) then
            return false
        end
        return string.find(src, "EmoteController", 1, true)
            or string.find(src, "MechanicsController", 1, true)
            or string.find(src, "InspectCosmetic", 1, true)
            or string.find(src, "Teleporting", 1, true)
            or string.find(src, "PickEmote", 1, true)
            or string.find(src, "Customize", 1, true)
            or string.find(src, "Cosmetics", 1, true)
    end
    local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local ps = lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local function req(path)
        local cur = ps
        if not cur then
            return nil
        end
        for part in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
            cur = cur:FindFirstChild(part)
            if not cur then
                return nil
            end
        end
        local ok, mod = pcall(require, cur)
        if ok then
            return mod
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function hookEmoteMod(mod)
        if type(mod) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        local orig = mod.UseEmoteByName
        if type(orig) == "function" then
            patchFireConstants(orig)
            if not getgenv().__jx_emote_hf then
                local okHf = pcall(function()
                    hookfunction(orig, function(self, emoteName)
                        pcall(function()
                            self._equipping_items_cooldown = tick() + 0.5
                        end)
                        if type(jahvex_playLocalEmote) == "function" then
                            jahvex_playLocalEmote(emoteName)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                if okHf then
                    getgenv().__jx_emote_hf = true
                end
            end
            mod.UseEmoteByName = function(self, emoteName)
                pcall(function()
                    self._equipping_items_cooldown = tick() + 0.5
                end)
                if type(jahvex_playLocalEmote) == "function" then
                    jahvex_playLocalEmote(emoteName)
                end
            end
        end
        local origEq = mod.EquipEmote
        if type(origEq) == "function" then
            patchFireConstants(origEq)
            if not getgenv().__jx_equipemote_hf then
                local okHf = pcall(function()
                    hookfunction(origEq, function(self, slot, emoteName)
                        if slot ~= nil and type(jahvex_setEquippedEmoteSlot) == "function" then
                            jahvex_setEquippedEmoteSlot(slot, emoteName)
                            pcall(saveConfig)
                        end
                        if type(jahvex_fireEmotesChanged) == "function" then
                            jahvex_fireEmotesChanged()
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                if okHf then
                    getgenv().__jx_equipemote_hf = true
                end
            end
            mod.EquipEmote = function(self, slot, emoteName)
                if slot ~= nil and type(jahvex_setEquippedEmoteSlot) == "function" then
                    jahvex_setEquippedEmoteSlot(slot, emoteName)
                    pcall(saveConfig)
                end
                if type(jahvex_fireEmotesChanged) == "function" then
                    jahvex_fireEmotesChanged()
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function walkProtos(fn, depth)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" or depth > 8 then
            return
        end
        patchFireConstants(fn)
        if type(debug.getproto) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        for i = 1, 24 do
            local okp, proto = pcall(debug.getproto, fn, i, true)
            if not okp or type(proto) ~= "table" then
                break
            end
            local inner = proto[1]
            if type(inner) == "function" then
                walkProtos(inner, depth + 1)
            end
        end
    end
    local function walkMod(mod)
        if type(mod) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        local seen = {}
        local function walkTable(t, d)
            if type(t) ~= "table" or d > 4 or seen[t] then
                return
            end
            seen[t] = true
            for _, v in pairs(t) do
                if type(v) == "function" then
                    walkProtos(v, 0)
                elseif type(v) == "table" then
                    walkTable(v, d + 1)
                end
            end
            local mt = getmetatable(t)
            if type(mt) == "table" then
                walkTable(mt, d + 1)
            end
        end
        walkTable(mod, 0)
    end
    hookEmoteMod(EmoteController)
    hookEmoteMod(req("Controllers.EmoteController"))
    hookEmoteMod(req("Controllers.MechanicsController"))
    pcall(function()
        local Cosmetics = req("Modules.UserInterface.Equipment.Interface.Customize.Cosmetics")
        if type(Cosmetics) == "table" and type(Cosmetics._Generate) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_cosmetics_gen_hf then
            local oldGen
            oldGen = hookfunction(Cosmetics._Generate, function(...)
                local r = oldGen(...)
                -- no delayed getgc skin FireServer rewrite
                return r
            end)
            getgenv().__jx_cosmetics_gen_hf = true
        end
    end)
    pcall(jahvex_decoySkinRemotes)
    pcall(jahvex_hookLiveSkinFireClosures)
    getgenv().__jx_kill_ce = true
end
pcall(jahvex_killCosmeticEmoteFires)


function jahvex_localDataTouch(key)
    pcall(function()
        if not DataController or type(key) ~= "string" then return end
        local sig = DataController.GetDataChangedSignal and DataController:GetDataChangedSignal(key)
        if sig and type(sig.Fire) == "function" then
            sig:Fire()
        end
    end)
end


function jahvex_fireSignal(sig)
    if sig == nil then return end
    local fired = false
    pcall(function()
        if firesignal then
            firesignal(sig)
            fired = true
        end
    end)
    if fired then return end
    pcall(function()
        if not getconnections then return end
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(sig) or {}) do
            pcall(function()
                if c and c.Function then
                    c.Function()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_fireLocalAttr(inst, key)
    if not (inst and type(key) == "string") then return end
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_fireSignal(inst:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key))
    end)
end

function jahvex_fireLocalProp(inst, prop)
    if not (inst and type(prop) == "string") then return end
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_fireSignal(inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop))
    end)
end

function jahvex_refreshBadgeVisuals()
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_fireLocalAttr(lp, "GroupRank")
        jahvex_fireLocalAttr(lp, "IsRobloxEmployee")
        jahvex_fireLocalAttr(lp, "IsInfluencer")
        jahvex_fireLocalAttr(lp, "IsAdministrator")
        jahvex_fireLocalAttr(lp, "IsPremium")
        jahvex_fireLocalProp(lp, "MembershipType")
        jahvex_fireLocalProp(lp, "HasVerifiedBadge")
        jahvex_fireLocalProp(lp, "HasRobloxSubscription")
        if DataController then
            jahvex_localDataTouch("GroupRank")
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_getInGameRemote()
    local cached = getgenv()["__jx_ingame_remote"]
    if typeof(cached) == "Instance" and cached.Parent then
        return cached
    end
    local found
    pcall(function()
        local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or rs
        local names = { "Ping", "Heartbeat", "Handshake", "Ready", "Loaded", "Analytics", "GetPing" }
        for _, n in ipairs(names) do
            local x = remotes:FindFirstChild(n)
            if not x then
                local data = remotes:FindFirstChild("Data")
                x = data and data:FindFirstChild(n)
            end
            if x and (x:IsA("RemoteEvent") or x:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") or x:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
                found = x
                return
            end
        end
    end)
    getgenv().__jx_ingame_remote = found
    return found
end

JAHVEX_CONFIG_EPOCH = 4
if type(getgenv) ~= "function" then
    getgenv = function() return _G end

function jahvex_sanitizeId(s)
    s = tostring(s or ""):gsub("[^%w%-_]", "_"):lower()
    s = s:gsub("_+", "_"):gsub("^_", ""):gsub("_$", "")
    if s == "" then s = "unknown" end
    return s
end
function jahvex_hashId(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    local h = 5381
    for i = 1, #s do
        h = (h * 33 + string.byte(s, i)) % 2147483647
    end
    return string.format("%07x", h)
end
function jahvex_executorCapsKey()
    local bits = {}
    local function bit(name, ok)
        if ok then table.insert(bits, name) end
    end
    bit("idex", type(identifyexecutor) == "function")
    bit("exname", type(getexecutorname) == "function")
    bit("qot", type(queue_on_teleport) == "function" or type(queueonteleport) == "function")
    bit("hf", type(hookfunction) == "function")
    bit("hmm", type(hookmetamethod) == "function")
    bit("gc", type(getgc) == "function")
    bit("fgc", type(filtergc) == "function")
    bit("cloneref", type(cloneref) == "function")
    bit("gethui", type(gethui) == "function")
    bit("isfile", type(isfile) == "function")
    bit("writefile", type(writefile) == "function")
    bit("makefolder", type(makefolder) == "function")
    bit("listfiles", type(listfiles) == "function")
    bit("setclip", type(setclipboard) == "function")
    bit("getrenv", type(getrenv) == "function")
    bit("getsenv", type(getsenv) == "function")
    bit("checkcaller", type(checkcaller) == "function")
    bit("islc", type(islclosure) == "function")
    bit("dump", type(dumpstring) == "function")
    bit("bytecode", type(getscriptbytecode) == "function")
    bit("http", type(request) == "function" or type(http_request) == "function" or type(http) == "table")
    bit("crypt", type(crypt) == "table")
    bit("drawing", type(Drawing) == "table")
    bit("ws", type(WebSocket) == "table" or (type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.websocket) == "table"))
    bit("getthread", type(getthreadidentity) == "function" or type(setthreadidentity) == "function")
    bit("decompile", type(decompile) == "function")
    bit("getcustom", type(getcustomasset) == "function")
    return table.concat(bits, ",")
end
function jahvex_detectExecutorEnv()
    local g = getgenv()
    if type(g) ~= "table" then g = _G end
    local function has(v)
        return v ~= nil and v ~= false
    end
    if has(g.POTASSIUM) or has(g.Potassium) or has(g.potassium) then return "potassium" end
    if type(syn) == "table" then return "synapse" end
    if has(KRNL_LOADED) or has(g.KRNL_LOADED) then return "krnl" end
    if has(is_sirhurt_closure) or has(SIRHURT_LOADED) then return "sirhurt" end
    if has(PROTOSMASHER_LOADED) then return "protosmasher" end
    if has(fluxus) or has(FLUXUS_LOADED) or has(g.FLUXUS_LOADED) then return "fluxus" end
    if has(g.XENO) or has(g.XENO_LOADED) then return "xeno" end
    if has(g.SOLARA) or has(g.SOLARA_LOADED) then return "solara" end
    if has(g.WAVE_LOADED) or has(g.Wave) then return "wave" end
    if has(g.ArceusX) or has(g.ARCEUS_LOADED) then return "arceus" end
    if has(g.Codex) or has(g.CODEX_LOADED) then return "codex" end
    if has(g.Hydrogen) or has(g.HYDROGEN_LOADED) then return "hydrogen" end
    if has(g.macsploit) or has(g.Macsploit) then return "macsploit" end
    if has(g.delta) or has(g.DELTA_LOADED) or has(g.Delta) then return "delta" end
    if has(g.Valyse) then return "valyse" end
    if has(g.Electron) then return "electron" end
    if has(g.Seliware) then return "seliware" end
    if has(g.VegaX) or has(g.VEGA_LOADED) then return "vega" end
    if has(g.ScriptWare) or has(g.scriptware) then return "scriptware" end
    if has(g.Celery) then return "celery" end
    if has(g.Nihon) then return "nihon" end
    if has(g.AWP) or has(g.AWP_LOADED) then return "awp" end
    return nil
end
function jahvex_getExecutorMeta()
    local name, ver = "", ""
    pcall(function()
        if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
            local n, v = identifyexecutor()
            if type(n) == "string" then name = n end
            if type(v) == "string" then ver = v end
        end
    end)
    if name == "" then
        pcall(function()
            if type(getexecutorname) == "function" then
                local n = getexecutorname()
                if type(n) == "string" then name = n end
            end
        end)
    end
    local low = string.lower(name)
    local weak = (name == "" or low == "unknown" or low == "roblox" or low == "executor" or low == "unnamed")
    if weak then
        local env = jahvex_detectExecutorEnv()
        if env then
            name = env
            weak = false
        end
    end
    if name == "" then name = "unknown" end
    local id = jahvex_sanitizeId(name)
    if ver ~= "" then
        id = id .. "_" .. jahvex_sanitizeId(ver)
    end
    if weak or id == "unknown" then
        id = "exec_" .. jahvex_hashId(jahvex_executorCapsKey() .. "|" .. name .. "|" .. ver)
    end
    return id, name, ver
end
function jahvex_getExecutorId()
    local id = jahvex_getExecutorMeta()
    return id
end
function jahvex_bindSavePaths()
    local exec = tostring(jahvexExecutorId or "unknown")
    local uid = tostring(jahvexProfileUserId or "0")
    jahvexSaveRoot = "jahvex/saves/" .. exec
    saveFile = jahvexSaveRoot .. "/u" .. uid .. ".json"
    saveFileLatest = jahvexSaveRoot .. "/latest.json"
    saveFileAlt = "jahvex/" .. exec .. "/config.json"
    saveFileProfile = "jahvex/profiles/" .. exec .. "/" .. uid .. "/config.json"
    saveFileLegacyShared = "jx/c.dat"
    getgenv().jahvex_save_file = saveFile
    getgenv().jahvex_executor_id = exec
end
function jahvex_refreshExecutorIdentity()
    local id, raw, ver = jahvex_getExecutorMeta()
    jahvexExecutorId = id
    jahvexExecutorRaw = raw
    jahvexExecutorVer = ver
    jahvexProfileUserId = jahvex_getProfileUserId()
    getgenv().jahvex_executor_id = jahvexExecutorId
    getgenv().jahvex_executor_raw = raw
    getgenv().jahvex_executor_ver = ver
    getgenv().jahvex_profile_user = jahvexProfileUserId
    jahvex_bindSavePaths()
end
function jahvex_getProfileUserId()
    local id = 0
    pcall(function()
        id = tonumber(lp and lp.UserId) or 0
    end)
    if id == 0 then
        pcall(function()
            local p = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            id = tonumber(p and p.UserId) or 0
        end)
    end
    return tostring(id)
end
jahvex_refreshExecutorIdentity()

jahvexEpochMarker = "jahvex/.cfg_epoch"

function jahvex_ensureFolders(...)
    if not makefolder then return end
    local path = ""
    for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
        local part = select(i, ...)
        if type(part) == "string" and part ~= "" then
            path = (path == "") and part or (path .. "/" .. part)
            pcall(function()
                if isfolder and isfolder(path) then return end
                makefolder(path)
            end)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_deleteConfigFile(path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return end
    pcall(function()
        if delfile and isfile and isfile(path) then
            delfile(path)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_wipeConfigTree(root, depth)
    depth = tonumber(depth) or 0
    if depth > 4 then return end
    if type(listfiles) ~= "function" then return end
    local ok, entries = pcall(listfiles, root)
    if not ok or type(entries) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        local p = tostring(entry)
        if p:lower():match("config%.json$") then
            jahvex_deleteConfigFile(p)
        elseif isfolder and isfolder(p) then
            jahvex_wipeConfigTree(p, depth + 1)
        end
    end
end


function jahvex_wipeLegacyConfigs()
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_ensureFolders("jahvex")
        if writefile then
            writefile(jahvexEpochMarker, tostring(JAHVEX_CONFIG_EPOCH))
        end
    end)
end
jahvex_wipeLegacyConfigs()

function jahvex_saveRestore(key, value)
    local r = getgenv().jahvex_restore
    if type(r) ~= "table" then
        r = {}
        getgenv().jahvex_restore = r
    end
    if r[key] == nil then
        r[key] = value
    end
end
function jahvex_saveMod(key, tbl, field)
    if type(tbl) ~= "table" or type(field) ~= "string" then return end
    jahvex_saveRestore(key, { tbl = tbl, field = field, fn = tbl[field] })
end

end

function jahvex_isFireAnimName(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" then return false end
    local l = string.lower(name)
    if string.find(l, "reload", 1, true) then return false end
    if string.find(l, "inspect", 1, true) then return false end
    if string.find(l, "equip", 1, true) then return false end
    if string.find(l, "idle", 1, true) then return false end
    if string.find(l, "sprint", 1, true) then return false end
    return string.find(l, "shoot", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(l, "fire", 1, true) ~= nil
end


function jahvex_shouldSkipWeaponAnim(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" then return false end
    local l = string.lower(name)
    if noReloadAnim and string.find(l, "reload", 1, true) then return true end
    if noInspectAnim and string.find(l, "inspect", 1, true) then return true end
    return false
end


function jahvex_playFireAnimSounds(animator, name, speedMul)
    if type(animator) ~= "table" or type(name) ~= "string" then return end
    local okLib, animLib = pcall(function()
        return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.AnimationLibrary)
    end)
    if not okLib or type(animLib) ~= "table" or type(animLib.Info) ~= "table" then return end
    local animName
    pcall(function()
        animName = animator:_AnimationKeyToName(name)
    end)
    if type(animName) ~= "string" then return end
    local info = animLib.Info[animName]
    if type(info) ~= "table" or type(info.SoundCallback) ~= "function" then return end
    local hash = 0
    pcall(function()
        local hashes = animator._animation_hashes
        if type(hashes) == "table" then
            hash = hashes[animName] or 0
        end
    end)
    local spd = (tonumber(info.Speed) or 1) * (tonumber(speedMul) or 1)
    task.defer(info.SoundCallback, animator.ClientViewModel, spd, hash)
end


function jahvex_freezeViewModelMotion(self, p77, p78)
    if type(self) ~= "table" or type(p77) ~= "table" then return end
    if not p77.IsActuallyFirstPerson then return end
    if self.IsRenderingDisabled and self:IsRenderingDisabled() then return end
    if type(p78) ~= "table" then return end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
    local vmOff = p78.ViewModelOffset or CFrame.identity
    local root = self._root_part_offset_override
    if not root and self.Info then
        root = self.Info.RootPartOffset
    end
    root = root or CFrame.identity
    local base = cam * vmOff * root

    local eq = 0
    pcall(function()
        eq = self._equip_spring.Value
    end)
    local equipCf = CFrame.new(0, -0.5 * eq, 0.25 * eq)
        * CFrame.Angles(-0.7853981633974483 * eq, 0, 0.7853981633974483 * eq)

    local adsCf = CFrame.identity
    pcall(function()
        local inspectV = self._inspect_spring and self._inspect_spring.Value or 0
        local aimV = self._aim_spring and self._aim_spring.Value or 0
        local v84 = aimV * (1 - inspectV * 0.125)
        local itemInfo = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Info
        local scope = itemInfo and itemInfo.AimScopePercent
        if scope and scope <= v84 then
            adsCf = CFrame.new(0, 0, 10)
            return
        end
        if self.IsAimingAnimationEnabled and not self:IsAimingAnimationEnabled() then
            return
        end
        local posAtt = self._aim_position_attachment
        local lookAtt = self._aim_lookat_attachment
        local primary = self.Model and self.Model.PrimaryPart
        if not posAtt or not lookAtt or not primary then
            return
        end
        local v113 = CFrame.lookAt(posAtt.WorldPosition, lookAtt.WorldPosition, posAtt.WorldCFrame.UpVector):ToObjectSpace(primary.CFrame)
        local v112 = v84
        if self.Info and self.Info.FramesPerSecond then
            local extra = (scope and 0) or 0.5
            v112 = math.floor(v84 * self.Info.FramesPerSecond + extra) / self.Info.FramesPerSecond
        end
        local inv = self._root_part_offset_override_inverse or self._root_part_offset_inverse
        if inv then
            adsCf = CFrame.identity:Lerp(inv * vmOff:Inverse(), v84)
                * CFrame.identity:Lerp(CFrame.new(v113.Position), v112)
                * CFrame.identity:Lerp(v113 - v113.Position, v112)
        end
    end)

    self:SetCFrame(base * equipCf * adsCf)

    local anim = self.Animator
    if type(anim) ~= "table" then return end
    pcall(function()
        if anim.StopSprintAnimation then
            anim:StopSprintAnimation()
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local key = anim.GetIdleAnimationKey and anim:GetIdleAnimationKey()
        local track = key and anim.GetAnimationTrack and anim:GetAnimationTrack(key)
        if track then
            track:AdjustSpeed(0)
            if track.TimePosition > 0.02 then
                track.TimePosition = 0
            end
        end
    end)
end

_jxBootSlice = 0
function jahvex_arcadeBusy()
    return getgenv()._jxArcadeBusy == true
end

function jahvex_worldSkip(inst)
    local p = inst
    for _ = 1, 14 do
        if not p then return false end
        local n = p.Name
        if n == "ShootingRangeEntities" or n == "ViewModels" or n == "ShootingRange" then
            return true
        end
        if p == workspace or p == game then return false end
        p = p.Parent
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_yieldFrame()

    local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
    if rs then
        rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
end


function jahvex_slowHost()
    if jahvex_arcadeBusy() then return true end
    local ok, name = pcall(function()
        if identifyexecutor then
            local n, v = identifyexecutor()
            return string.lower(tostring(n or "") .. " " .. tostring(v or ""))
        end
        return ""
    end)
    if ok and type(name) == "string" then
        if name:find("mac", 1, true) or name:find("apple", 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_breathe(force)
    if not jahvex_booting and not force then return end
    local slow = jahvex_slowHost()
    local now = os.clock()
    if not force then
        local t0 = tonumber(_jxBootSlice) or 0
        if t0 == 0 then
            _jxBootSlice = now
            return
        end

        local slice = slow and 0.0010 or 0.0035
        if (now - t0) < slice then return end
    end
    _jxBootSlice = 0
    jahvex_yieldFrame()
    if slow and force then
        jahvex_yieldFrame()
    end
end

function jahvex_softYield()
    if not jahvex_booting then return end
    jahvex_breathe(true)
end

function jahvex_bootPace(sec)
    if not jahvex_booting then return end
    jahvex_breathe(true)
    if (tonumber(sec) or 0) > 0.08 then
        jahvex_breathe(true)
    end
end

function jahvex_uiBreath()
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    if not jahvex_booting then return end

    jahvex_uiTick = (jahvex_uiTick or 0) + 1
    local every = jahvex_slowHost() and 2 or 6
    if jahvex_uiTick % every == 0 then
        jahvex_breathe(true)
    end
end

function jahvex_paceStep()
    jahvex_yieldFrame()
    if jahvex_slowHost() then
        jahvex_yieldFrame()
    end
end

function jahvex_waitChild(parent, name, timeout)
    if not parent or type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local c = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
    if c then return c end
    timeout = tonumber(timeout) or 3
    local t0 = tick()
    while tick() - t0 < timeout do
        c = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
        if c then return c end
        jahvex_yieldFrame()
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_requireChild(parent, name, timeout)
    local m = jahvex_waitChild(parent, name, timeout)
    if not m then return nil end

    local box = { done = false, result = nil }
    local function run()
        local ok, mod = pcall(require, m)
        if ok then box.result = mod end
        box.done = true
        getgenv()["_jxMod_" .. tostring(name)] = box.result
    end
    if type(task.defer) == "function" then
        task.defer(run)
    elseif type(task.delay) == "function" then
        task.delay(0, run)
    else
        task.spawn(run)
    end
    local t0 = tick()
    local limit = math.clamp(tonumber(timeout) or 0.5, 0.2, 0.7)
    while not box.done and (tick() - t0) < limit do
        jahvex_yieldFrame()
    end
    if not box.done then
        _jxN("jahvex | require skip " .. tostring(name))
    end
    return box.result
end
