function jahvex_bootHooksLpNc()
if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
_jxN("jahvex | hook lp namecall")
pcall(function()
    pmt = getrawmetatable(lp)
    oldnc = pmt.__namecall
    oldIdx_lp = pmt.__index
    setreadonly(pmt, false)
    pmt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        if not rawequal(self, lp) then
            if not (customEnemyEnabled and customEnemyTarget and rawequal(self, customEnemyTarget)) then
                return oldnc(self, ...)
            end
        end
        if getnamecallmethod() == "WaitForChild" and select(1, ...) == "ClientAlert" then
            if fake then return fake end
        end
        if not checkcaller() then
            local method = getnamecallmethod()
            if method == "GetAttribute" then
                local key = select(1, ...)
                if customEnemyEnabled and customEnemyTarget and rawequal(self, customEnemyTarget) then
                    if ceName and ceName ~= "" and (key == "DisplayName" or key == "Display Name" or key == "Nickname") then
                        return ceName
                    end
                    if key == "Level" then return ceLevel end
                    if key == "DisplayELO" or key == "RankedCurrentELO" then return ceElo end
                    if key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreak" or key == "WinStreak" then return ceStreak end
                    if key == "Controls" or key == "PreferredInput" or key == "ControlType" then
                        return (deviceControlMap and deviceControlMap[ceDeviceType]) or "Touch"
                    end
                    if key == "Device" or key == "Platform" or key == "DeviceType" then
                        return ceDeviceType or "Mobile"
                    end
                end
                if rawequal(self, lp) then
                    if _G.jahvex_nameChangerEnabled then
                        if key == "DisplayName" or key == "Display Name" or key == "Nickname" then
                            return _G.jahvex_customName or "jahvex user"
                        end
                    end
                    if levelSpoofEnabled and key == "Level" then return spoofedLevel end
                    if eloSpoofEnabled and (key == "DisplayELO" or key == "RankedCurrentELO") then
                        return spoofedElo
                    end
                    if streakSpoofEnabled and (key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreak" or key == "WinStreak") then
                        return spoofedStreak
                    end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_group and key == "GroupRank" then return 255 end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_admin and key == "IsRobloxEmployee" then return true end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_influencer and key == "IsInfluencer" then return true end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_premium and (key == "IsPremium" or key == "HasPremium") then return true end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_verified and (key == "HasVerifiedBadge" or key == "IsVerified") then return true end
                    if key == "PlayerStatus" then
                        local st = jahvex_getActiveNameStatus and jahvex_getActiveNameStatus()
                        if st then return st end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return oldnc(self, ...)
    end)
    setreadonly(pmt, true)
end)
end

if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end


getgenv()._jxNeedLpIdx = true

function jahvex_wrapLpIndex(handler)
    if type(handler) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        pmt = getrawmetatable(lp)
        local prev = pmt.__index
        if type(oldIdx_lp) ~= "function" then
            oldIdx_lp = prev
        end
        setreadonly(pmt, false)
        pmt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
            if not checkcaller() then
                local hit, val = handler(self, key)
                if hit then
                    return val
                end
            end
            return prev(self, key)
        end)
        setreadonly(pmt, true)
    end)
    return ok
end


function jahvex_ensureLpIndex()
    if getgenv()["_jxLpIdxOn"] then return true end
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return false end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        pmt = getrawmetatable(lp)
        oldIdx_lp = oldIdx_lp or pmt.__index
        setreadonly(pmt, false)
        pmt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
            if not checkcaller() then
                if customEnemyEnabled and customEnemyTarget and rawequal(self, customEnemyTarget) then
                    if ceName and ceName ~= "" and key == "DisplayName" then
                        return ceName
                    end
                end
                if rawequal(self, lp) then
                    if _G.jahvex_nameChangerEnabled and key == "DisplayName" then
                        return _G.jahvex_customName or "jahvex user"
                    end
                    if _G.jahvex_nameChangerEnabled and key == "Name" then
                        return _G.jahvex_customUserName or "jahvex_user"
                    end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_verified and key == "HasVerifiedBadge" then
                        return true
                    end
                    if _G.jahvex_badge_premium then
                        if key == "MembershipType" then return Enum.MembershipType.Premium end
                        if key == "HasRobloxSubscription" then return true end
                    end
                end
            end
            return oldIdx_lp(self, key)
        end)
        setreadonly(pmt, true)
        getgenv()._jxLpIdxOn = true
    end)
    return ok
end

function jahvex_bootHooksGameKick()
if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end

_jxN("jahvex | hook game Kick only")
pcall(function()
    mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    old = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local m = getnamecallmethod()
        if self == lp and (m == "Kick" or m == "kick") then return end
        if m == "Shutdown" then return end
        return old(self, ...)
    end)
    setreadonly(mt, true)
    jahvex_saveRestore("game_namecall", old)
end)

end

if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end

    if getgenv().__jx_ae_session then return end
    task.wait(8)
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    if type(jahvex_deviceInCombat) == "function" and jahvex_deviceInCombat() then return end
    local ls = rf and rf:FindFirstChild("LoadingScreen")
    if not ls or typeof(getgc) ~= "function" or typeof(hookfunction) ~= "function" then return end
    local hooked, maxHook = 0, 8
    local deadline = tick() + 1.2
    local ok, gc = pcall(getgc, false)
    if not (ok and type(gc) == "table") then return end
    local maxScan = math.min(#gc, 800)
    local i = 1
    while i <= maxScan and hooked < maxHook and tick() < deadline do
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        local limit = math.min(i + 20 - 1, maxScan)
        for j = i, limit do
            local f = gc[j]
            if typeof(f) == "function" then
                local okE, e = pcall(getfenv, f)
                if okE and e then
                    local scr = rawget(e, "script")
                    if scr == ls then
                        local ok2, cs = pcall(debug.getconstants, f)
                        if ok2 and type(cs) == "table" then
                            for _, k in cs do
                                if typeof(k) == "string" and (k:find("TakeTheL") or k:find("ban") or k:find("kick")) then
                                    pcall(hookfunction, f, function() end)
                                    hooked = hooked + 1
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        i = limit + 1
        task.wait()
    end
end)

equipped = {}

jahvex_bindSavePaths()
unlockedTypes = {}
unlockAllGunsEnabled = false
unlockAllSkinsEnabled = false
unlockedTypeRarities = {}
nameEffectPrimeEnabled = false
  nameEffectContrabandEnabled = false
  hudSpoofStyle = "None"
  hudSpoofPrimary = ""
  hudSpoofSecondary = ""
  hudSpoofMelee = ""

function jahvex_ensureEmoteOwned(emoteName)
    if type(emoteName) ~= "string" or emoteName == "" then return end
    if cachedProxy then
        rawset(cachedProxy, emoteName, true)
    end

    pcall(function()
        if not cachedProxy and DataController and DataController.Get then
            DataController:Get("CosmeticInventory")
            if cachedProxy then rawset(cachedProxy, emoteName, true) end
        end
    end)
end


function jahvex_emoteSlotKey(slot)
    local n = tonumber(slot)
    if n and n >= 1 and n <= 8 then
        return tostring(n)
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_writeEmoteSlotTable(ee, slot, emoteName)
    if type(ee) ~= "table" then return end
    local key = jahvex_emoteSlotKey(slot)
    if not key then return end
    ee[tonumber(key)] = nil
    if type(emoteName) == "string" and emoteName ~= "" and emoteName ~= "None" then
        ee[key] = { Name = emoteName }
    else
        ee[key] = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_rebuildEquippedEmotesView()
    if type(equippedEmotesView) ~= "table" then
        equippedEmotesView = {}
    end
    for k in pairs(equippedEmotesView) do
        equippedEmotesView[k] = nil
    end
    local src = originalEquippedEmotes
    if type(src) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(src) do
            equippedEmotesView[k] = v
        end
    end
    for i = 1, 8 do
        local num = rawget(equippedEmotesView, i)
        if type(num) == "table" and type(num.Name) == "string" and rawget(equippedEmotesView, tostring(i)) == nil then
            equippedEmotesView[tostring(i)] = num
        end
        equippedEmotesView[i] = nil
    end
    if type(equippedEmotesSlots) == "table" then
        for slot, name in pairs(equippedEmotesSlots) do
            if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
                jahvex_writeEmoteSlotTable(equippedEmotesView, slot, name)
                jahvex_ensureEmoteOwned(name)
            end
        end
    end
    return equippedEmotesView
end

function jahvex_fireEmotesChanged()
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_rebuildEquippedEmotesView()
    end)
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_localDataTouch("EquippedEmotes")
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local sig = DataController and DataController.GetDataChangedSignal and DataController:GetDataChangedSignal("EquippedEmotes")
        if sig and sig.Fire then
            sig:Fire()
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_setEquippedEmoteSlot(slot, emoteName)
    local key = jahvex_emoteSlotKey(slot)
    if not key then return end
    if type(emoteName) == "string" and emoteName ~= "" and emoteName ~= "None" then
        equippedEmotesSlots[key] = emoteName
        jahvex_ensureEmoteOwned(emoteName)
    else
        equippedEmotesSlots[key] = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_applyEquippedEmoteSlots()
    local applied = false
    pcall(function()
        if type(equippedEmotesSlots) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, name in pairs(equippedEmotesSlots) do
            if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
                jahvex_ensureEmoteOwned(name)
                applied = true
            end
        end
        jahvex_rebuildEquippedEmotesView()
        jahvex_fireEmotesChanged()
    end)
    return applied
end

function cloneCosmetic(name, cosmeticType, options)
    local base = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]
    if not base then return nil end
    local data = {}
    for key, value in pairs(base) do data[key] = value end
    data.Name = name
    data.Type = data.Type or cosmeticType
    data.Seed = data.Seed or math.random(1, 1000000)
    if EnumLibrary then
        local success, enumId = pcall(EnumLibrary.ToEnum, EnumLibrary, name)
        if success and enumId then data.Enum = enumId data.ObjectID = data.ObjectID or enumId end
    end
    if options then
        if options.inverted ~= nil then
            data.Inverted = options.inverted and true or false
            data.IsInverted = data.Inverted
        end
        if options.favoritesOnly ~= nil then data.OnlyUseFavorites = options.favoritesOnly end
    end
    return data
end

function jahvex_localApplyEquipCosmetic(weaponName, cosmeticType, cosmeticName, options)
    options = options or {}
    if type(weaponName) ~= "string" or type(cosmeticType) ~= "string" then
        return
    end
    if type(jahvex_isWeaponCosmeticEquip) == "function" and not jahvex_isWeaponCosmeticEquip(weaponName, cosmeticType) then
        return
    end
    if type(equipped) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    equipped[weaponName] = equipped[weaponName] or {}
    if not cosmeticName or cosmeticName == "None" or cosmeticName == "" then
        equipped[weaponName][cosmeticType] = nil
        if not next(equipped[weaponName]) then
            equipped[weaponName] = nil
        end
    else
        local cloned = cloneCosmetic(cosmeticName, cosmeticType, {
            inverted = options.IsInverted,
            favoritesOnly = options.OnlyUseFavorites,
        })
        if cloned then
            equipped[weaponName][cosmeticType] = cloned
            cachedProxy = nil
        end
    end
    task.defer(function()
        pcall(function()
            if type(jahvex_localDataTouch) == "function" then
                jahvex_localDataTouch("WeaponInventory")
            end
        end)
        if type(saveConfig) == "function" then
            task.wait(0.2)
            pcall(saveConfig)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_localApplyFavoriteCosmetic(weaponName, cosmeticName, isFav)
    if type(weaponName) ~= "string" then
        return
    end
    if type(jahvex_isWeaponCosmeticEquip) == "function" and not jahvex_isWeaponCosmeticEquip(weaponName, nil) then
        return
    end
    if type(favorites) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    favorites[weaponName] = favorites[weaponName] or {}
    favorites[weaponName][cosmeticName] = isFav or nil
    if type(saveConfig) == "function" then
        pcall(saveConfig)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            if type(jahvex_localDataTouch) == "function" then
                jahvex_localDataTouch("FavoritedCosmetics")
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if not name then return nil end
    if type(name) == "string" then
        if name:find("MISSING_") then return nil end
        if CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name] then return name end
    end
    if EnumLibrary then
        local ok, resolved = pcall(EnumLibrary.FromEnum, EnumLibrary, name)
        if ok and resolved and type(resolved) == "string" then
            if CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved] then return resolved end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_colorToTable(c)
    if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return {1, 1, 1} end
    return {c.R, c.G, c.B}
end
function jahvex_tableToColor(t, fallback)
    if type(t) == "table" and t[1] and t[2] and t[3] then
        return Color3.new(t[1], t[2], t[3])
    end
    return fallback
end

function jahvex_unlockedToList()
    local list = {}
    for k, v in pairs(unlockedTypes) do
        if v then table.insert(list, tostring(k)) end
    end
    return list
end

function jahvex_unlockedFromList(list)
    unlockedTypes = {}
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
    for k, v in pairs(list) do
        if type(k) == "number" and type(v) == "string" then
            unlockedTypes[v] = true
        elseif v == true then
            unlockedTypes[tostring(k)] = true
        elseif type(v) == "string" then
            unlockedTypes[v] = true
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_isCosmeticUnlocked(base)
    if not base then return false end
    if unlockAllSkinsEnabled then return true end
    local t = tostring(base.Type or "")
    if unlockedTypes[t] then return true end
    local r = tostring(base.Rarity or "")
    local byType = unlockedTypeRarities[t]
    if byType and byType[r] then return true end
    return false
end

function jahvex_setTypeRarityUnlock(cosType, rarity, enabled)
    if not cosType or not rarity then return end
    unlockedTypeRarities[cosType] = unlockedTypeRarities[cosType] or {}
    if enabled then
        unlockedTypeRarities[cosType][rarity] = true
    else
        unlockedTypeRarities[cosType][rarity] = nil
        if not next(unlockedTypeRarities[cosType]) then
            unlockedTypeRarities[cosType] = nil
        end
    end
    cachedProxy = nil
end

function jahvex_jsonSafe(v, depth)
    depth = tonumber(depth) or 0
    if depth > 14 then return nil end
    local ty = typeof(v)
    if v == nil or ty == "boolean" or ty == "number" or ty == "string" then
        return v
    end
    if ty == "table" then
        local out = {}
        for k, val in pairs(v) do
            local kt = type(k)
            if kt == "string" or kt == "number" then
                local sv = jahvex_jsonSafe(val, depth + 1)
                if sv ~= nil or val == nil then
                    out[k] = sv
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_putSafe(tbl, key, fn)
    if type(tbl) ~= "table" or type(key) ~= "string" or type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
    local ok, val = pcall(fn)
    if ok then tbl[key] = val end
end

function jahvex_writeConfigFile(sync)
    if not writefile then return false end
    local function doWrite()
        pcall(function()
            jahvexProfileUserId = jahvex_getProfileUserId()
            getgenv().jahvex_profile_user = jahvexProfileUserId
            jahvex_bindSavePaths()
        end)
        local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
            local config = {
                v = 4,
                equipped = {},
                favorites = favorites,
                equippedEmotes = equippedEmotesSlots,
                unlockedList = jahvex_unlockedToList(),
                unlockAllGuns = unlockAllGunsEnabled and true or false,
                unlockAllSkins = unlockAllSkinsEnabled and true or false,
                unlockedTypeRarities = unlockedTypeRarities,
                executor = jahvexExecutorId,
                executorRaw = jahvexExecutorRaw,
                executorVer = jahvexExecutorVer,
                userId = jahvexProfileUserId,
                features = jahvex_collectFeatureConfig(),
            }
            for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(equipped) do
                config.equipped[weapon] = {}
                for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                    if cosmeticData and cosmeticData.Name then
                        config.equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = {
                            name = cosmeticData.Name, seed = cosmeticData.Seed, inverted = cosmeticData.Inverted
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            return HttpService:JSONEncode(config)
        end)
        if not ok or type(encoded) ~= "string" then return false end
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_ensureFolders("jahvex", "saves", tostring(jahvexExecutorId))
            writefile(saveFile, encoded)
            if saveFileLatest then writefile(saveFileLatest, encoded) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local execDir = "jahvex/" .. tostring(jahvexExecutorId)
            jahvex_ensureFolders("jahvex", tostring(jahvexExecutorId))
            writefile(saveFileAlt, encoded)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if saveFileProfile then
                jahvex_ensureFolders("jahvex", "profiles", tostring(jahvexExecutorId), tostring(jahvexProfileUserId))
                writefile(saveFileProfile, encoded)
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    if sync then
        return doWrite()
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait()
        doWrite()
    end)
    return true
end


function saveConfig()
    if not writefile then return end
    saveDirty = true
    if saveScheduled then return end
    saveScheduled = true
    task.delay(1.0, function()
        saveScheduled = false
        if not saveDirty then return end
        saveDirty = false
        pcall(jahvex_writeConfigFile)
    end)
end

function loadConfig()
    if not readfile or not isfile then return end
    pcall(jahvex_refreshExecutorIdentity)
    local function exists(p)
        local ok, yes = pcall(function()
            return type(p) == "string" and p ~= "" and isfile(p)
        end)
        return ok and yes
    end
    local path = nil
    local fromShared = false
    if exists(saveFile) then
        path = saveFile
    elseif exists(saveFileLatest) then
        path = saveFileLatest
    elseif exists(saveFileProfile) then
        path = saveFileProfile
    elseif exists(saveFileAlt) then
        path = saveFileAlt
    elseif exists(saveFileLegacyShared) then
        path = saveFileLegacyShared
        fromShared = true
    elseif exists("jahvex/config.json") then
        path = "jahvex/config.json"
        fromShared = true
    elseif exists("jx/config.json") then
        path = "jx/config.json"
        fromShared = true
    end
    if not path then return end
    pcall(function()
        local config = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path))
        if type(config) ~= "table" then return end
        if config.equipped then
            for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(config.equipped) do
                equipped[weapon] = {}
                for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                    local cloned = cloneCosmetic(cosmeticData.name, cosmeticType, {inverted = cosmeticData.inverted})
                    if cloned then
                        cloned.Seed = cosmeticData.seed
                        equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = cloned
                    else

                        equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = {
                            Name = cosmeticData.name,
                            Type = cosmeticType,
                            Seed = cosmeticData.seed,
                            Inverted = cosmeticData.inverted,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        favorites = config.favorites or {}

                if sp.spoofedRankedWins ~= nil then spoofedRankedWins = sp.spoofedRankedWins end
                if sp.spoofedCasualWinPercent ~= nil then spoofedCasualWinPercent = sp.spoofedCasualWinPercent end
                if sp.spoofedRankedWinPercent ~= nil then spoofedRankedWinPercent = sp.spoofedRankedWinPercent end
                if sp.badgePremium ~= nil then _G.jahvex_badge_premium = sp.badgePremium and true or false end
                if sp.badgeVerified ~= nil then _G.jahvex_badge_verified = sp.badgeVerified and true or false end
                if sp.badgeGroup ~= nil then _G.jahvex_badge_group = sp.badgeGroup and true or false end
                if sp.badgeAdmin ~= nil then _G.jahvex_badge_admin = sp.badgeAdmin and true or false end
                if sp.badgeInfluencer ~= nil then _G.jahvex_badge_influencer = sp.badgeInfluencer and true or false end
                if sp.nameEffectPrime ~= nil then nameEffectPrimeEnabled = sp.nameEffectPrime and true or false end
                if sp.nameEffectContraband ~= nil then nameEffectContrabandEnabled = sp.nameEffectContraband and true or false end
                  if sp.hudSpoofStyle ~= nil then hudSpoofStyle = sp.hudSpoofStyle end
                  if sp.hudSpoofPrimary ~= nil then hudSpoofPrimary = sp.hudSpoofPrimary end
                  if sp.hudSpoofSecondary ~= nil then hudSpoofSecondary = sp.hudSpoofSecondary end
                  if sp.hudSpoofMelee ~= nil then hudSpoofMelee = sp.hudSpoofMelee end
                  if sp.hudSpoofUtility ~= nil then hudSpoofUtility = sp.hudSpoofUtility end
                if type(sp.customEnemy) == "table" then
                    local ce = sp.customEnemy
                    if ce.enabled ~= nil then customEnemyEnabled = ce.enabled and true or false end
                    if ce.avatarId ~= nil then ceAvatarId = tonumber(ce.avatarId) or 0 end
                    if ce.name ~= nil then ceName = tostring(ce.name) end
                    if ce.level ~= nil then ceLevel = tonumber(ce.level) or ceLevel end
                    if ce.streak ~= nil then ceStreak = tonumber(ce.streak) or ceStreak end
                    if ce.elo ~= nil then ceElo = tonumber(ce.elo) or ceElo end
                    if ce.deviceType ~= nil then ceDeviceType = tostring(ce.deviceType) end
                end
                if sp.lastIdentityId ~= nil and tostring(sp.lastIdentityId) ~= "" then
                    lastAvatarSpoofId = tostring(sp.lastIdentityId):match("%d+") or tostring(sp.lastIdentityId)
                end
            end
            if type(feat.guiKey) == "string" and Enum.KeyCode[feat.guiKey] then
                guiKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode[feat.guiKey]
            end
            if type(feat.font) == "string" and Enum.Font[feat.font] then
                GUI_FONT = Enum.Font[feat.font]
            end
            if type(feat.fontBold) == "string" and Enum.Font[feat.fontBold] then
                GUI_FONT_BOLD = Enum.Font[feat.fontBold]
            end
            if type(feat.theme) == "table" then
                local th = feat.theme
                if th.WINDOW_BG then WINDOW_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.WINDOW_BG, WINDOW_BG) end
                if th.PANEL_BG then PANEL_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.PANEL_BG, PANEL_BG) end
                if th.ELEM_BG then ELEM_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.ELEM_BG, ELEM_BG) end
                if th.ELEM_HOV then ELEM_HOV = jahvex_tableToColor(th.ELEM_HOV, ELEM_HOV) end
                if th.LIST_BG then LIST_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.LIST_BG, LIST_BG) end
                if th.BORDER then BORDER = jahvex_tableToColor(th.BORDER, BORDER) end
                if th.TEXT_W then TEXT_W = jahvex_tableToColor(th.TEXT_W, TEXT_W) end
                if th.TEXT_DIM then TEXT_DIM = jahvex_tableToColor(th.TEXT_DIM, TEXT_DIM) end
                if th.WHITE_ACC then WHITE_ACC = jahvex_tableToColor(th.WHITE_ACC, WHITE_ACC) end
            end
        end
    end)
    if fromShared then
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_writeConfigFile(true)
        end)
    end
end

CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticNormally = function(self, inventory, name)
    local resolved = resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if not resolved then return false end
    local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved]
    if not base then return false end
    return jahvex_isCosmeticUnlocked(base)
end
CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticUniversally = function(self, inventory, name)
    local resolved = resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if not resolved then return false end
    local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved]
    if not base then return false end
    return jahvex_isCosmeticUnlocked(base)
end

    local resolved = resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if not resolved then return false end
    local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved]
    if not base then return false end
    return jahvex_isCosmeticUnlocked(base)
end
local originalOwnsCosmetic = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic

do
    local saved = getgenv().jahvex_restore and getgenv().jahvex_restore.OwnsCosmetic
    if saved and saved.fn then originalOwnsCosmetic = saved.fn end
end
CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic = function(self, inventory, name, weapon)
    local resolved = resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if not resolved then return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon) end
    local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved]
    if not base then return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon) end
    if jahvex_isCosmeticUnlocked(base) then return true end
    return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon)
end

function jahvex_ownsRealWeapon(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return false end
    local inv = originalWeaponInventory
    if type(inv) ~= "table" then return false end
    for _, v in pairs(inv) do
        if type(v) == "table" and v.Name == name then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_allWeaponNames()
    local names = {}
    local seen = {}
    pcall(function()
        local items = ItemLibrary and ItemLibrary.Items
        if type(items) ~= "table" then return end
        for name, _ in pairs(items) do
            if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" and name ~= "MISSING_WEAPON" and not seen[name] then
                seen[name] = true
                table.insert(names, name)
            end
        end
    end)
    if #names == 0 and type(ALL_GUNS) == "table" then
        for i = 1, #ALL_GUNS do
            local n = ALL_GUNS[i]
            if type(n) == "string" and not seen[n] then
                table.insert(names, n)
            end
        end
    end
    return names
end

function jahvex_fakeWeaponEntry(name, src)
    local e = {
        Name = name,
        Level = 1,
        Prestige = 0,
        XP = 0,
    }
    if type(src) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(src) do
            e[k] = v
        end
        e.Name = name
    end
    return e
end

function jahvex_buildUnlockedWeaponInventory(data)
    local result = {}
    local existing = {}
    if type(data) == "table" then
        for i, v in pairs(data) do
            result[i] = v
            if type(v) == "table" and type(v.Name) == "string" then
                existing[v.Name] = true
            end
        end
    end
    for _, gunName in ipairs(jahvex_allWeaponNames()) do
        if not existing[gunName] then
            table.insert(result, jahvex_fakeWeaponEntry(gunName))
            existing[gunName] = true
        end
    end
    return result
end
_jxN("jahvex | unlock cosmetics ok")
end

    _jxN("jahvex | unlock data skip")

jahvex_saveMod("DataController_Get", DataController, "Get")
jahvex_saveMod("DataController_GetWeaponData", DataController, "GetWeaponData")
local originalGet = DataController.Get
do
    local saved = getgenv().jahvex_restore and getgenv().jahvex_restore.DataController_Get
    if saved and saved.fn then originalGet = saved.fn end
end
DataController.Get = function(self, key)
    pcall(jahvex_hookDataReplicate)

    if key == "Level" and levelSpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedLevel
    end

    if key == "WeaponKeys" and keySpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedWeaponKeys
    end
    if key == "Glory" and glorySpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedGlory
    end
    if key == "EventCurrency" and pearlSpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedPearl
    end
    if key == "SkinTickets" and skinTicketsSpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedSkinTickets
    end
    if key == "UnlockTokens" and unlockTokensSpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedUnlockTokens
    end
    if (key == "DisplayELO" or key == "RankedCurrentELO") and eloSpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedElo
    end
    if (key == "WinStreak" or key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreak") and streakSpoofEnabled then
        return spoofedStreak
    end
    if key == "PlayerStatus" then
        local st = jahvex_getActiveNameStatus and jahvex_getActiveNameStatus()
        if st then return st end
    end
    if statsSpoofEnabled then
        local function statNum(v)
            local n = tonumber(v)
            if n == nil then return nil end
            return math.floor(n)
        end
        if key == "StatisticDuelsWon" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatDuelsWon)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticDuelsLost" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatDuelsLost)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticDuelsPlayed" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatDuelsPlayed)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticEliminations" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatElims)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticDeaths" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatDeaths)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticAssists" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatAssists)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreak" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatWinStreak)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        elseif key == "StatisticDuelsWinStreakHighest" then
            local n = statNum(spoofedStatHighestStreak)
            if n ~= nil then return n end
        end
    end
    local data = originalGet(self, key)
    if key == "Seasons" and bpSpoofEnabled and type(data) == "table" then
        local ok, patched = pcall(function()
            local SL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SeasonLibrary)
            local seasonName = SL and SL.CurrentSeason and SL.CurrentSeason.Name
            if type(seasonName) ~= "string" then return data end
            local copy = {}
            for sk, sv in pairs(data) do
                if sk == seasonName and type(sv) == "table" then
                    local seasonCopy = {}
                    for k2, v2 in pairs(sv) do
                        seasonCopy[k2] = v2
                    end
                    local bp = type(sv.BattlePass) == "table" and sv.BattlePass or {}
                    local bpCopy = {}
                    for k3, v3 in pairs(bp) do
                        bpCopy[k3] = v3
                    end
                    bpCopy.MaxPassTrackNum = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spoofedBpTrack) or 2), 1, 3)
                    if bpCopy.Tier ~= nil or true then
                        bpCopy.Tier = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spoofedBpTier) or 50), 1, 200)
                    end
                    seasonCopy.BattlePass = bpCopy
                    copy[sk] = seasonCopy
                else
                    copy[sk] = sv
                end
            end
            return copy
        end)
        if ok and patched then return patched end
    end
    if key == "CosmeticInventory" then
        if type(data) == "table" and originalCosmeticInventory == nil then
            originalCosmeticInventory = {}
            for k, v in pairs(data) do
                originalCosmeticInventory[k] = v
            end
        end
        if not cachedProxy then
            local proxy = {}
            if data then for k, v in pairs(data) do proxy[k] = v end end
            cachedProxy = setmetatable(proxy, {__index = function(t, k)
                local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[k]
                if not base and EnumLibrary then
                    local ok2, resolved = pcall(EnumLibrary.FromEnum, EnumLibrary, k)
                    if ok2 and resolved and type(resolved) == "string" then
                        base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved]
                    end
                end
                if not base then return nil end
                return jahvex_isCosmeticUnlocked(base) or nil
            end})
        end
        return cachedProxy
    end
    if key == "WeaponInventory" then
        if type(data) == "table" and originalWeaponInventory == nil then
            originalWeaponInventory = {}
            for _, v in pairs(data) do
                if type(v) == "table" then
                    table.insert(originalWeaponInventory, {Name=v.Name, Level=v.Level, Prestige=v.Prestige, XP=v.XP})
                end
            end
        end
        if not unlockAllGunsEnabled then
            return data
        end
        return jahvex_buildUnlockedWeaponInventory(data)
    end


    if key == "FavoritedCosmetics" then
        local result = data and table.clone(data) or {}
        for weapon, favs in pairs(favorites) do
            result[weapon] = result[weapon] or {}
            for name2, isFav in pairs(favs) do result[weapon][name2] = isFav end
        end
        return result
    end

    if key == "EquippedEmotes" then
        if type(data) == "table" and originalEquippedEmotes == nil then
            originalEquippedEmotes = {}
            for k, v in pairs(data) do
                originalEquippedEmotes[k] = v
            end
        end
        return jahvex_rebuildEquippedEmotesView()
    end
    return data
end

local originalGetWeaponData = DataController.GetWeaponData
DataController.GetWeaponData = function(self, weaponName)
    local data = originalGetWeaponData(self, weaponName)
    if not data then
        if unlockAllGunsEnabled and type(weaponName) == "string" and weaponName ~= "" then
            data = jahvex_fakeWeaponEntry(weaponName)
        else
            return nil
        end
    end
    local merged = {}
    for k, v in pairs(data) do merged[k] = v end
    merged.Name = weaponName
    if equipped[weaponName] then
        for ctype, cdata in pairs(equipped[weaponName]) do merged[ctype] = cdata end
    end
    return merged
end

function jahvex_unlockClient()
if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
_jxN("jahvex | unlock clientitem")

function jahvex_playLocalEmote(emoteName)
    if type(emoteName) ~= "string" or emoteName == "" then return end
    local now = tick()
    if rawget(_G, "_jxEmoteName") == emoteName and (now - (tonumber(rawget(_G, "_jxEmoteAt")) or 0)) < 0.2 then
        return
    end
    _G._jxEmoteAt = now
    _G._jxEmoteName = emoteName
    pcall(jahvex_hookEmoteBreakOnJumpSlide)
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            local char = lp.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end

            local function getNativeEntity()
                if not CameraControllerModule then return nil end
                local subj = CameraControllerModule:GetCurrentSubject()
                return subj and subj.Entity or nil
            end

            local function cleanupEmoteConns()
                if _G.JahvexEmoteMoveConn then _G.JahvexEmoteMoveConn:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteMoveConn = nil end
                if _G.JahvexEmoteJumpConn then _G.JahvexEmoteJumpConn:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteJumpConn = nil end
                if _G.JahvexEmoteJumpingConn then _G.JahvexEmoteJumpingConn:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteJumpingConn = nil end
                if _G.JahvexEmoteInputConn then _G.JahvexEmoteInputConn:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteInputConn = nil end
                if _G.JahvexEmoteBreakConn then _G.JahvexEmoteBreakConn:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteBreakConn = nil end
                if _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn then _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn = nil end
                if _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn2 then _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn2:Disconnect() _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn2 = nil end
            end

            local function cancelEmote()
                cleanupEmoteConns()
                local ent = getNativeEntity()
                if ent then
                    pcall(function() ent:CancelEmote() end)
                elseif _G.JahvexActiveEmote then
                    pcall(function() _G.JahvexActiveEmote:Destroy() end)
                end
                if ent and rawget(ent, "_current_emote") ~= nil then
                    rawset(ent, "_current_emote", nil)
                    pcall(function() ent.EmoteStatusChanged:Fire() end)
                end
                _G.JahvexActiveEmote = nil
                _G.jahvex_cancelLocalEmote = nil
                task.defer(function()
                    if type(jahvex_restoreHeadScale) == "function" then
                        jahvex_restoreHeadScale(lp.Character)
                    end
                    if headlessEnabled and type(jahvex_applyHeadless) == "function" then
                        jahvex_applyHeadless(lp.Character)
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    if type(jahvex_restoreHeadScale) == "function" then
                        jahvex_restoreHeadScale(lp.Character)
                    end
                    if headlessEnabled and type(jahvex_applyHeadless) == "function" then
                        jahvex_applyHeadless(lp.Character)
                    end
                end)
            end
            _G.jahvex_cancelLocalEmote = cancelEmote

            cancelEmote()

            _G.jahvex_cancelLocalEmote = cancelEmote

            local emotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Modules:FindFirstChild("Emotes")
            if not (emotesFolder and emotesFolder:FindFirstChild(emoteName)) then return end
            local emoteModule = require(emotesFolder[emoteName])
            local emoteInst = emoteModule.new(hum)
            if not (emoteInst and emoteInst.PlayClient) then return end

            pcall(function()
                if emoteInst.SetSerial then
                    emoteInst:SetSerial({ Name = emoteName, Seed = math.random(1, 1000000) })
                end
            end)

            local ent = getNativeEntity()
            if ent then
                pcall(function() ent:CancelEmote() end)
                rawset(ent, "_current_emote", emoteInst)
                pcall(function() ent.EmoteStatusChanged:Fire() end)
            end

            _G.JahvexActiveEmote = emoteInst

            _G.jahvex_cancelLocalEmote = cancelEmote
            emoteInst:PlayClient()

            if type(emoteInst.Destroy) == "function" then
                local oldDestroy = emoteInst.Destroy
                emoteInst.Destroy = function(self, ...)
                    local e = getNativeEntity()
                    if e and rawget(e, "_current_emote") == self then
                        rawset(e, "_current_emote", nil)
                        pcall(function() e.EmoteStatusChanged:Fire() end)
                    end
                    if _G.JahvexActiveEmote == self then
                        _G.JahvexActiveEmote = nil
                    end
                    cleanupEmoteConns()
                    local ret = oldDestroy(self, ...)
                    task.defer(function()
                        if type(jahvex_restoreHeadScale) == "function" then
                            jahvex_restoreHeadScale(lp.Character)
                        end
                        if headlessEnabled and type(jahvex_applyHeadless) == "function" then
                            jahvex_applyHeadless(lp.Character)
                        end
                    end)
                    return ret
                end
            end

            local lifetime = tonumber(rawget(emoteInst, "Lifetime"))
            if lifetime and lifetime > 0 then
                task.delay(lifetime + 0.05, function()
                    if _G.JahvexActiveEmote == emoteInst then
                        cancelEmote()
                    end
                end)
            end

            local isTraversal = false
            pcall(function()
                local info = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[emoteName]
                if info and (info.IsTraversal or info.TraversalWalkSpeedMultiplier ~= nil) then
                    isTraversal = true
                end
            end)
            _G.JahvexEmoteJumpConn = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, state)
                if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
                    or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                    or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                    cancelEmote()
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                _G.JahvexEmoteJumpingConn = hum.Jumping:Connect(function(active)
                    if active then cancelEmote() end
                end)
            end)


            local function isJumpOrSlideInput(input)
                local k = input.KeyCode
                if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then return true end
                if k == Enum.KeyCode.C or k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end
            _G.JahvexEmoteBreakConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if isJumpOrSlideInput(input) then
                    cancelEmote()
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local MC = MechanicsController
                if not MC then
                    MC = jahvex_requireChild(controllers, "MechanicsController", 1)
                end
                if MC and MC.StateChanged then
                    _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn = MC.StateChanged:Connect(function()
                        if MC.IsSliding then cancelEmote() end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local FC = FighterController2 or FighterController
                local f = FC and FC.LocalFighter
                if f and f.GetDataChangedSignal then
                    local sig = f:GetDataChangedSignal("IsSliding")
                    if sig then
                        _G.JahvexEmoteSlideConn2 = sig:Connect(function()
                            local sliding = false
                            pcall(function()
                                sliding = f:Get("IsSliding") == true or f.IsSliding == true
                            end)
                            if sliding then cancelEmote() end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not isTraversal then
                _G.JahvexEmoteMoveConn = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
                    if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then cancelEmote() end
                end)
            else
                local function traversalKeep(input)
                    local t = input.UserInputType
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return true end
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return true end
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return true end
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.Focus then return true end
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                        local k = input.KeyCode
                        return k == Enum.KeyCode.W or k == Enum.KeyCode.A
                            or k == Enum.KeyCode.S or k == Enum.KeyCode.D
                            or k == Enum.KeyCode.Up or k == Enum.KeyCode.Down
                            or k == Enum.KeyCode.Left or k == Enum.KeyCode.Right
                    end
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
                        local k = input.KeyCode
                        return k == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 or k == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2
                    end
                    return false
                end
                _G.JahvexEmoteInputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
                    if traversalKeep(input) then return end
                    if gp then return end
                    cancelEmote()
                end)
            end
        end)
    end)
end
_G.jahvex_playLocalEmote = jahvex_playLocalEmote


function jahvex_hookEmoteBreakOnJumpSlide()
    local MC
    pcall(function()
        MC = MechanicsController
        if type(MC) ~= "table" then
            MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
        end
    end)
    if type(MC) ~= "table" then return end
    local function breakEmote()
        local fn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_cancelLocalEmote")
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            pcall(fn)
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            if CameraControllerModule and CameraControllerModule.GetCurrentSubject then
                local subj = CameraControllerModule:GetCurrentSubject()
                local ent = subj and subj.Entity
                if ent and ent.CancelEmote then
                    ent:CancelEmote()
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local e = rawget(_G, "JahvexActiveEmote")
            if e and e.Destroy then e:Destroy() end
            _G.JahvexActiveEmote = nil
        end)
    end
    if type(MC.Jump) == "function" and not MC._jxEmoteJump then
        MC._jxEmoteJump = true
        local origJ = MC.Jump
        MC.Jump = function(self, ...)
            breakEmote()
            return origJ(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(MC.JumpRequest) == "function" and not MC._jxEmoteJumpReq then
        MC._jxEmoteJumpReq = true
        local origJR = MC.JumpRequest
        MC.JumpRequest = function(self, ...)
            breakEmote()
            return origJR(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(MC.DoubleJump) == "function" and not MC._jxEmoteDJ then
        MC._jxEmoteDJ = true
        local origD = MC.DoubleJump
        MC.DoubleJump = function(self, ...)
            breakEmote()
            return origD(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(MC.DoubleJumpRequest) == "function" and not MC._jxEmoteDJReq then
        MC._jxEmoteDJReq = true
        local origDJR = MC.DoubleJumpRequest
        MC.DoubleJumpRequest = function(self, ...)
            breakEmote()
            return origDJR(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(MC.Slide) == "function" and not MC._jxEmoteSlide then
        MC._jxEmoteSlide = true
        local origS = MC.Slide
        MC.Slide = function(self, ...)
            breakEmote()
            return origS(self, ...)
        end
    end
    rawset(_G, "_jxEmoteBreakMech", true)
end
pcall(jahvex_hookEmoteBreakOnJumpSlide)

        local weaponName = self.Name
        local weaponPlayer = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
        constructingWeapon = (weaponPlayer == lp) and weaponName or nil
        if weaponPlayer == lp and equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Skin and viewmodelRef then
            local dataKey = self:ToEnum("Data")
            local skinKey = self:ToEnum("Skin")
            local nameKey = self:ToEnum("Name")
            if viewmodelRef[dataKey] then
                viewmodelRef[dataKey][skinKey] = equipped[weaponName].Skin
                viewmodelRef[dataKey][nameKey] = equipped[weaponName].Skin.Name
            elseif viewmodelRef.Data then
                viewmodelRef.Data.Skin = equipped[weaponName].Skin
                viewmodelRef.Data.Name = equipped[weaponName].Skin.Name
            end
        end
        local result = origCVM(self, viewmodelRef)
        constructingWeapon = nil
        return result
    end

            return origGC2(self)
        end

                if ok_rc then RC = mod _G.jahvex_RC = RC end
            end

function jahvex_soundIsOff(id)
    if id == nil then return true end
    local s = tostring(id)
    return s == "" or s == "none" or s == "off" or s == "None"
end

function jahvex_syncShootSoundFlag()
    _G.jahvex_shootSoundOn = not jahvex_soundIsOff(selectedShootSoundId)
    if not _G.jahvex_shootSoundOn and type(jahvex_restoreGunSoundVolumes) == "function" then
        pcall(jahvex_restoreGunSoundVolumes)
    end
end

local JAHVEX_SHOOT_SOUND_BL = {

    ["rbxassetid://13087319223"] = true,
    ["rbxassetid://13158735106"] = true,
    ["rbxassetid://13236549929"] = true,
    ["rbxassetid://13236549962"] = true,
    ["rbxassetid://13455395017"] = true,

_jahvexGunVolOrig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
_jahvexCISounds = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
_jahvexShotMuteUntil = 0

function jahvex_inShotMuteWindow()
    return os.clock() <= (_jahvexShotMuteUntil or 0)
end

function jahvex_shouldMuteClientItemSound(snd)
    if not snd or not snd:IsA("Sound") then return false end
    if snd.Name == "OneShotAudio" then return false end
    local p = snd.Parent
    if not p or p.Name ~= "ClientItem" then return false end
    if JAHVEX_SHOOT_SOUND_BL[snd.SoundId] then return false end

    return jahvex_inShotMuteWindow()
end

function jahvex_weaponAllowsShootSound(item)
    if not item then return false end
    local info = item.Info
    if type(info) ~= "table" then
        local n = item.Name
        local IL = ItemLibrary
        if type(IL) == "table" and type(IL.Items) == "table" and n then
            info = IL.Items[n]
        end
    end
    if type(info) ~= "table" then return false end
    if tostring(info.Type) ~= "Gun" then return false end
    local c = tostring(info.Class or "")
    return c == "Primary" or c == "Secondary"
end

function jahvex_getClientItemFolder()
    local ok, ci = pcall(function()
        return lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter:FindFirstChild("ClientItem")
    end)
    if ok then return ci end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_getEquippedItem()
    local eq = nil
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end
        eq = FC and FC.LocalFighter and FC.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
    end)
    return eq
end

function jahvex_muteOneClientItemSound(snd)
    if not jahvex_shouldMuteClientItemSound(snd) then return end
    if _jahvexGunVolOrig[snd] == nil then
        local v = snd.Volume
        if v and v > 0 then
            _jahvexGunVolOrig[snd] = v
        else
            _jahvexGunVolOrig[snd] = 1
        end
    end
    if snd.Volume ~= 0 then
        snd.Volume = 0
    end
end

function jahvex_muteClientItemGunSounds()
    for snd in pairs(_jahvexCISounds) do
        if snd and snd.Parent then
            jahvex_muteOneClientItemSound(snd)
        else
            _jahvexCISounds[snd] = nil
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_restoreGunSoundVolumes()
    for snd, vol in pairs(_jahvexGunVolOrig) do
        pcall(function()
            if snd and snd.Parent then
                snd.Volume = vol
            end
        end)
        _jahvexGunVolOrig[snd] = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_watchClientItemGunSound(snd)
    if not snd or not snd:IsA("Sound") then return end
    _jahvexCISounds[snd] = true
    if snd:GetAttribute("jxGunVolMute") then return end
    pcall(function() snd:SetAttribute("jxGunVolMute", true) end)
    jahvex_track(snd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Playing"):Connect(function()
        if not snd.Playing then

            local vol = _jahvexGunVolOrig[snd]
            if vol ~= nil then
                pcall(function()
                    if snd.Parent then snd.Volume = vol end
                end)
                _jahvexGunVolOrig[snd] = nil
            end
            return
        end
        if not rawget(_G, "jahvex_shootSoundOn") then return end
        if not jahvex_weaponAllowsShootSound(jahvex_getEquippedItem()) then return end
        jahvex_muteOneClientItemSound(snd)
    end))
    jahvex_track(snd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Volume"):Connect(function()
        if not rawget(_G, "jahvex_shootSoundOn") then return end
        if snd.Volume == 0 then return end
        if not jahvex_weaponAllowsShootSound(jahvex_getEquippedItem()) then return end
        jahvex_muteOneClientItemSound(snd)
    end))
end

function jahvex_setupClientItemGunMuteWatch()
    if rawget(_G, "_jahvexGunMuteWatchOn") then return end
    local ci = jahvex_getClientItemFolder()
    if not ci then return end
    _G._jahvexGunMuteWatchOn = true
    for _, d in ipairs(ci:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Sound") then
            jahvex_watchClientItemGunSound(d)
        end
    end
    jahvex_track(ci.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
        if d:IsA("Sound") then
            jahvex_watchClientItemGunSound(d)
        end
    end))
end


_jahvexShootPool = {}
_jahvexShootPoolI = 0
_jahvexLastShootSoundT = 0
function playShootSound()
    if jahvex_soundIsOff(selectedShootSoundId) then return end
    local now = os.clock()

    if now - (_jahvexLastShootSoundT or 0) < 0.012 then return end
    _jahvexLastShootSoundT = now
    _jahvexShootPoolI = (_jahvexShootPoolI % 12) + 1
    local s = _jahvexShootPool[_jahvexShootPoolI]
    if not (s and s.Parent) then
        s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.Name = "OneShotAudio"
        s.RollOffMaxDistance = 10000
        s.RollOffMinDistance = 20
        s.Looped = false
        s.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
        _jahvexShootPool[_jahvexShootPoolI] = s
    end
    s.SoundId = selectedShootSoundId
    s.Volume = math.clamp(((shootSoundVolume or 100) / 100) * 4, 0.2, 8)
    s.PlaybackSpeed = 1
    s.TimePosition = 0
    s:Play()
end

function jahvex_onGunShot(item)
    if not rawget(_G, "jahvex_shootSoundOn") then return end
    local isLocal = false
    pcall(function()
        isLocal = item and item.ClientFighter and item.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer == true
    end)
    if not isLocal then return end
    if not jahvex_weaponAllowsShootSound(item) then return end

    _jahvexShotMuteUntil = os.clock() + 0.15
    jahvex_muteClientItemGunSounds()
    playShootSound()
end
_G.jahvex_onGunShot = jahvex_onGunShot

function jahvex_bindGunShotSound(item)
    if not item then return end
    if item._jahvexShotBound then return end
    item._jahvexShotBound = true
    pcall(function()
        if item.Shot and item.Shot.Connect then
            item.Shot:Connect(function()
                jahvex_onGunShot(item)
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local _jahvexReloadIdsCache = nil
local function getReloadIds()
    if _jahvexReloadIdsCache and next(_jahvexReloadIdsCache) then return _jahvexReloadIdsCache end
    _jahvexReloadIdsCache = {}
    pcall(function()
        local tbl = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.SoundLibrary.ScrapedAnimationSounds)
        for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
            if type(k) == "string" and k:lower():match("reload") and type(v) == "table" then
                for _, id in ipairs(v) do
                    _jahvexReloadIdsCache[id] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    _G.jahvex_reloadIdsCache = _jahvexReloadIdsCache
    return _jahvexReloadIdsCache
end

            end
        end
    end)
end)
