function jahvex_lootRewardWeapon(w, hint)
    if type(w) == "string" and w ~= "" then
        return w
    end
    if type(hint) == "string" and hint ~= "" then
        return hint
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_unwrapLootContent(entry, weaponHint)
    if type(entry) == "string" and entry ~= "" then
        local rd = { Name = entry, Quantity = 1 }
        local wep = jahvex_lootRewardWeapon(nil, weaponHint)
        if wep then
            rd.Weapon = wep
        end
        return rd, 1
    end
    if type(entry) ~= "table" then
        return nil, 0
    end
    local inner = entry
    local weight = tonumber(entry.Weight) or 1
    if type(entry.Reward) == "table" then
        inner = entry.Reward
    elseif type(entry.RewardData) == "table" then
        inner = entry.RewardData
    end
    if type(inner) ~= "table" or type(inner.Name) ~= "string" or inner.Name == "" then
        return nil, 0
    end
    local rd = {
        Name = inner.Name,
        Quantity = inner.Quantity or 1,
    }
    local wep = jahvex_lootRewardWeapon(inner.Weapon, weaponHint)
    if wep then
        rd.Weapon = wep
    end
    if type(inner.Type) == "string" then
        rd.Type = inner.Type
    end
    if type(inner.Rarity) == "string" then
        rd.Rarity = inner.Rarity
    end
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    return rd, weight
end

function jahvex_enrichLootReward(rd, CL)
    if type(rd) ~= "table" or type(rd.Name) ~= "string" then
        return rd
    end
    pcall(function()
        CL = CL or CosmeticLibrary
        if not CL then
            CL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        end
        local cos = CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics[rd.Name]
        if not cos then
            return
        end
        rd.Type = rd.Type or cos.Type or "Skin"
        rd.Rarity = rd.Rarity or cos.Rarity or "Common"
        if type(rd.Weapon) ~= "string" or rd.Weapon == "" then
            local w = cos.ItemName or cos.Weapon
            if type(w) == "string" and w ~= "" then
                rd.Weapon = w
            end
        end
    end)
    return rd
end

function jahvex_getLootboxContents(boxName, weaponHint)
    local CL = CosmeticLibrary
    local list = nil
    pcall(function()
        CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local rew = CL and CL.Rewards and CL.Rewards[boxName]
        if not (rew and type(rew.GetContents) == "function") then
            return
        end
        if type(weaponHint) == "string" and weaponHint ~= "" then
            list = rew.GetContents(weaponHint)
        end
        if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then
            list = rew.GetContents()
        end
        if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then
            list = rew:GetContents()
        end
    end)
    if type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 then
        return list, CL
    end
    pcall(function()
        local IL = ItemLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ItemLibrary)
        local box = IL and IL.Lootboxes and IL.Lootboxes[boxName]
        if box and type(box.Rewards) == "table" then
            list = {}
            for k in pairs(box.Rewards) do
                list[#list + 1] = k
            end
        end
    end)
    return list, CL
end

function jahvex_pickLootboxReward(boxName, weaponHint)
    local rewardData = nil
    pcall(function()
        local list, CL = jahvex_getLootboxContents(boxName, weaponHint)
        if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then
            return
        end
        local pool = {}
        local totalW = 0
        for i = 1, #list do
            local rd, w = jahvex_unwrapLootContent(list[i], weaponHint)
            if rd then
                local named = (CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics[rd.Name])
                    or (CL and CL.Rewards and CL.Rewards[rd.Name])
                if named then
                    pool[#pool + 1] = { rd = rd, w = w }
                    totalW = totalW + w
                end
            end
        end
        if #pool == 0 then
            for i = 1, #list do
                local rd, w = jahvex_unwrapLootContent(list[i], weaponHint)
                if rd then
                    pool[#pool + 1] = { rd = rd, w = w }
                    totalW = totalW + w
                end
            end
        end
        if #pool == 0 then
            return
        end
        local chosen = pool[#pool].rd
        if totalW > 0 then
            local roll = math.random() * totalW
            local acc = 0
            for i = 1, #pool do
                acc = acc + pool[i].w
                if roll <= acc then
                    chosen = pool[i].rd
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        rewardData = jahvex_enrichLootReward(chosen, CL)
    end)
    if type(rewardData) ~= "table" or type(rewardData.Name) ~= "string" or rewardData.Name == "" then
        rewardData = jahvex_enrichLootReward({
            Name = "Sandwich",
            Type = "Skin",
            Rarity = "Legendary",
            Weapon = "Medkit",
            Quantity = 1,
        })
    end
    return rewardData
end


caseMessageEnabled = caseMessageEnabled and true or false

function jahvex_getCaseRarityColor(rarity)
    local col = Color3.fromRGB(123, 255, 0)
    pcall(function()
        local CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local r = CL and CL.Rarities and CL.Rarities[tostring(rarity or "Common")]
        if r and typeof(r.Color) == "Color3" then
            col = r.Color
        end
    end)
    return col
end

function jahvex_grantCosmeticLocal(rewardData)
    if type(rewardData) ~= "table" or type(rewardData.Name) ~= "string" or rewardData.Name == "" then
        return false
    end
    local name = rewardData.Name
    local weapon = rewardData.Weapon
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local dc = DataController or require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.PlayerDataController)
        if not (dc and dc.CurrentData and dc.CurrentData.Data) then return end
        local data = dc.CurrentData.Data
        if type(data.CosmeticInventory) ~= "table" then
            data.CosmeticInventory = {}
        end
        if type(data.CosmeticNotifications) ~= "table" then
            data.CosmeticNotifications = {}
        end
        local inv = data.CosmeticInventory
        local notif = data.CosmeticNotifications
        local CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local cos = CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics[name]
        if not weapon and cos then
            weapon = cos.ItemName or cos.Weapon
        end
        if (not rewardData.Rarity or rewardData.Rarity == "") and cos and cos.Rarity then
            rewardData.Rarity = cos.Rarity
        end
        local isWeaponCos = cos and CL.Types and CL.Types[cos.Type] and CL.Types[cos.Type].IsWeaponCosmetic
        if isWeaponCos and type(weapon) == "string" and weapon ~= "" and weapon ~= "IsUniversal" and weapon ~= "IsRandom" then
            if inv[name] == true then inv[name] = {} end
            if type(inv[name]) ~= "table" then inv[name] = {} end
            inv[name][weapon] = true
            if notif[name] == true then notif[name] = {} end
            if type(notif[name]) ~= "table" then notif[name] = {} end
            notif[name][weapon] = true
        else
            inv[name] = true
            notif[name] = true
        end
        ok = true
    end)
    if ok then
        pcall(jahvex_localDataTouch, "CosmeticInventory")
        pcall(jahvex_localDataTouch, "CosmeticNotifications")
    end
    return ok
end

function jahvex_sendCaseChatMessage(rewardData)
    if type(rewardData) ~= "table" or type(rewardData.Name) ~= "string" then return end
    local itemName = tostring(rewardData.Name)
    local rarity = tostring(rewardData.Rarity or "")
    local weapon = rewardData.Weapon
    pcall(function()
        local CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local cos = CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics[itemName]
        if cos then
            if rarity == "" and cos.Rarity then rarity = tostring(cos.Rarity) end
            if (not weapon or weapon == "") then
                weapon = cos.ItemName or cos.Weapon
            end
        end
    end)
    if rarity == "" then rarity = "Common" end
    if type(weapon) ~= "string" or weapon == "" or weapon == "IsUniversal" or weapon == "IsRandom" then
        weapon = "Unknown"
    end

    local who = tostring(lp.Name or "Player")
    local col = jahvex_getCaseRarityColor(rarity)
    local text = "[SERVER] " .. who .. " just unboxed a " .. rarity .. " " .. itemName .. " skin for the " .. weapon .. "!"
    pcall(function()
        local SendChat = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.Functions.SendChat)
        if type(SendChat) == "function" then

            SendChat({
                Text = text,
                Color = col,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
            })
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_onCaseMessageRewards(rewardTable)
    if not caseMessageEnabled then return end
    if type(rewardTable) ~= "table" then return end
    for i = 1, #rewardTable do
        local rd = rewardTable[i] and rewardTable[i].RewardData
        if type(rd) == "table" then

            pcall(jahvex_grantCosmeticLocal, rd)
        end
    end
end


function jahvex_caseRevealWait(boxName, delaySec)
    delaySec = tonumber(delaySec) or 0
    if delaySec > 0 then
        task.wait(delaySec)
    end

    task.wait(100 / (2 * 60))
    local revealDelay = 2
    pcall(function()
        local lb = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Lootboxes:FindFirstChild(tostring(boxName or ""))
        local anim = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Animation")
        if anim then
            revealDelay = tonumber(anim:GetAttribute("RevealDelay")) or revealDelay
        end
    end)
    task.wait(revealDelay)
end

function jahvex_scheduleCaseChatOnReveal(boxName, rewardOne, delaySec)
    if not caseMessageEnabled then return end
    local rd = rewardOne and rewardOne.RewardData
    if type(rd) ~= "table" then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(jahvex_caseRevealWait, boxName, delaySec)
        if not caseMessageEnabled then return end
        pcall(jahvex_sendCaseChatMessage, rd)
    end)
end

function jahvex_clientOpenCase(caseIndex, quantity)


    quantity = tonumber(quantity)
    if not quantity or quantity < 1 then quantity = 1 end
    quantity = math.floor(quantity)
    if caseIndex == nil then return "Fail" end

    local boxName = nil
    local rewardTable = {}
    local useQty = 0
    local opened = false

    pcall(function()
        local rewards = DataController.CurrentData
            and DataController.CurrentData.Data
            and DataController.CurrentData.Data.UnclaimedRewards
        if type(rewards) ~= "table" then return end

        local entry = rewards[caseIndex]
        if type(entry) ~= "table" then
            entry = rewards[tostring(caseIndex)]
            if type(entry) == "table" then caseIndex = tostring(caseIndex) end
        end
        if type(entry) ~= "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(rewards) do
                if tonumber(k) == tonumber(caseIndex) and type(v) == "table" then
                    entry = v
                    caseIndex = k
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.Name) ~= "string" then return end

        boxName = entry.Name
        local boxWeapon = entry.Weapon
        local have = tonumber(entry.Quantity) or 1
        if have < 1 then return end
        useQty = math.min(quantity, have)
        if useQty < 1 then return end

        for i = 1, useQty do
            rewardTable[i] = { RewardData = jahvex_pickLootboxReward(boxName, boxWeapon) }
        end

        entry.Quantity = have - useQty
        if entry.Quantity <= 0 then
            if type(caseIndex) == "number" then
                table.remove(rewards, caseIndex)
            else
                rewards[caseIndex] = nil
                local rebuilt = {}
                local i = 1
                for _, v in pairs(rewards) do
                    if type(v) == "table" then
                        rebuilt[i] = v
                        i = i + 1
                    end
                end
                DataController.CurrentData.Data.UnclaimedRewards = rebuilt
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            jahvex_localDataTouch("UnclaimedRewards")
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local sig = DataController:GetDataChangedSignal("UnclaimedRewards")
            if sig and type(sig.Fire) == "function" then
                sig:Fire()
            end
        end)

        opened = true
    end)


    if not opened or useQty < 1 or not boxName or #rewardTable == 0 then
        return "Fail"
    end


    pcall(jahvex_onCaseMessageRewards, rewardTable)


    getgenv()._jahvex_lootbox_playing = tick()


    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(jahvex_playCaseOpenFx, boxName, rewardTable, useQty)
        task.delay(18, function()
            if getgenv()["_jahvex_lootbox_playing"] then
                getgenv()._jahvex_lootbox_playing = nil
            end
        end)
    end)

    return "Success"
end

jahvex_lootboxFxFn = nil
jahvex_caseFxStamp = 0


_G.jahvex_remapLootboxCall = function(p3, name, rewards, delay, hrp, plr, extra)
    return p3, name, rewards, delay, hrp, plr, extra
end

function jahvex_getLootboxFx()
    if type(jahvex_lootboxFxFn) == "function" then
        return jahvex_lootboxFxFn
    end
    local mod = nil
    pcall(function()
        mod = lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.Functions.LootboxEffect
    end)
    if not mod then return nil end
    local ok, fn = pcall(require, mod)
    if ok and type(fn) == "function" then
        jahvex_lootboxFxFn = fn
        return fn
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_playCaseOpenFx(boxName, rewardTable, useQty)
    if type(boxName) ~= "string" or boxName == "" then return end
    useQty = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(useQty) or 1))
    if type(rewardTable) ~= "table" or #rewardTable < 1 then
        rewardTable = {}
        for i = 1, useQty do
            rewardTable[i] = { RewardData = jahvex_pickLootboxReward(boxName) }
        end
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (jahvex_caseFxStamp or 0) < 0.12 then
        return
    end
    jahvex_caseFxStamp = now

    task.spawn(function()
        local fx = jahvex_getLootboxFx()
        if type(fx) ~= "function" then return end
        local char = lp.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local pos = hrp and hrp.Position or Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        for i = 1, useQty do
            local idx = i
            local delaySec = (idx - 1) * 0.25
            local packed = rewardTable[idx]
            local rd = packed and packed.RewardData
            local wepHint = type(rd) == "table" and rd.Weapon or nil
            if type(rd) ~= "table" or type(rd.Name) ~= "string" or rd.Name == "" then
                rd = jahvex_pickLootboxReward(boxName, wepHint)
            else
                local flat = jahvex_unwrapLootContent(rd, wepHint)
                rd = jahvex_enrichLootReward(flat or rd)
            end
            local one = { { RewardData = rd } }

            pcall(jahvex_scheduleCaseChatOnReveal, boxName, one[1], delaySec)
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(fx, pos, boxName, one, delaySec, hrp, lp)
            end)
        end
    end)
end


task.spawn(function()
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    local remotes = jahvex_waitChild(ReplicatedStorage, "Remotes", 4)
    local dataRemotes = remotes and jahvex_waitChild(remotes, "Data", 4)
    local useUnclaimed = dataRemotes and jahvex_waitChild(dataRemotes, "UseUnclaimedReward", 4)
    if not useUnclaimed then return end
    _G.jahvex_useUnclaimedRemote = useUnclaimed
    _G.jahvex_clientOpenCase = jahvex_clientOpenCase
    _G.jahvex_useUnclaimedOldInvoke = nil


    local function dispatchOpen(index, quantity)
        local now = tick()
        local lastAt = tonumber(rawget(_G, "_jxCaseOpenAt")) or 0
        local lastIdx = rawget(_G, "_jxCaseOpenIdx")
        if lastIdx == index and (now - lastAt) < 0.5 then
            return rawget(_G, "_jxCaseOpenRet") or "Success"
        end
        _G._jxCaseOpenAt = now
        _G._jxCaseOpenIdx = index
        local open = rawget(_G, "jahvex_clientOpenCase")
        local ret = "Fail"
        if open then
            ret = open(index, quantity)
        end
        _G._jxCaseOpenRet = ret
        return ret
    end
    _G.jahvex_dispatchCaseOpen = dispatchOpen


    -- khook: InvokeServer stays C; case open is namecall-dispatched

    if getconnections then
        pcall(function()
            local funcsEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Misc:FindFirstChild("Functions")
            if not funcsEvent then return end
            local conns = getconnections(funcsEvent.OnClientEvent)
            for _, conn in ipairs(conns or {}) do
                local handlerFn = conn.Function
                if type(handlerFn) ~= "function" then continue end
                hookfunction(handlerFn, newcclosure(function(...)

                    local a1 = ...
                    local isLootbox = false
                    pcall(function()
                        local s = tostring(a1)
                        isLootbox = s:find("Lootbox") ~= nil or s:find("lootbox") ~= nil
                    end)
                    if isLootbox then

                        local stamp = getgenv()["_jahvex_lootbox_playing"]
                        if stamp and (tick() - stamp) < 18 then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    return handlerFn(...)
                end))
                break
            end
        end)
    end
end)


task.spawn(function()
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    local mod
    pcall(function()
        local ps = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts") or playerScripts
        local prompts = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Modules") and ps.Modules:FindFirstChild("Prompts")
        mod = prompts and prompts:WaitForChild("InspectBackpackReward", 8)
    end)
    if not mod then return end
    local ok, cls = pcall(require, mod)
    if not (ok and type(cls) == "table" and type(cls.Use) == "function") then return end
    if rawget(cls, "_jxUseHook") then return end
    rawset(cls, "_jxUseHook", true)
    cls.Use = function(self, qty, ...)
        local fn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_dispatchCaseOpen")
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return "Fail"
        end
        local idx
        pcall(function() idx = self._index end)
        local result = fn(idx, qty)
        if result == "Success" then
            pcall(function()
                if self.ClosePage and self.ClosePage.Fire then
                    self.ClosePage:Fire()
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if type(self.CloseRequest) == "function" then
                    self:CloseRequest()
                end
            end)
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            if self.OpenPrompt and self.OpenPrompt.Fire then
                self.OpenPrompt:Fire("ErrorMessage", "Whoops!", "Failed to open, you probably already have everything!")
            end
        end)
        return
    end
end)

local ClientItem
pcall(function()
    local ps = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts") or playerScripts
    local mods = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    local crc = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("ClientReplicatedClasses")
    local cf = crc and crc:FindFirstChild("ClientFighter")
    local ci = cf and cf:FindFirstChild("ClientItem")
    if ci then ClientItem = require(ci) end
end)
if ClientItem then
    if ClientItem._CreateViewModel then
        local originalCreateViewModel = ClientItem._CreateViewModel
        ClientItem._CreateViewModel = function(self, viewmodelRef)
            local weaponName = self.Name
            local weaponPlayer = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
            constructingWeapon = (weaponPlayer == lp) and weaponName or nil
            if weaponPlayer == lp then
                lastUsedWeapon = weaponName
                currentEquippedWeapon = weaponName
            end
            if weaponPlayer == lp and equipped[weaponName] and viewmodelRef then
                local cosmetics = equipped[weaponName]
                local dataKey = self:ToEnum("Data")
                local dataTable = viewmodelRef[dataKey] or viewmodelRef.Data
                if dataTable then
                    if cosmetics.Skin then
                        dataTable[self:ToEnum("Skin")] = cosmetics.Skin
                        dataTable[self:ToEnum("Name")] = cosmetics.Skin.Name
                    end
                    if cosmetics.Wrap then dataTable[self:ToEnum("Wrap")] = cosmetics.Wrap end
                end
            end
            local result = originalCreateViewModel(self, viewmodelRef)
            constructingWeapon = nil
            return result
        end
    end
    if ClientItem.Equip then
        local originalEquip = ClientItem.Equip
        ClientItem.Equip = function(self, ...)
            local weaponPlayer = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
            if weaponPlayer == lp then
                lastUsedWeapon = self.Name
                currentEquippedWeapon = self.Name
            end
            return originalEquip(self, ...)
        end
    end
end


pcall(function()
    local ps = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts") or playerScripts
    local ci = ps
        and ps:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        and ps.Modules:FindFirstChild("ClientReplicatedClasses")
        and ps.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses:FindFirstChild("ClientFighter")
        and ps.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter:FindFirstChild("ClientItem")
    local vmMod = ci and (ci:FindFirstChild("ClientViewModel") or jahvex_waitChild(ci, "ClientViewModel", 3))
    if not vmMod then return end
    local ClientViewModel = require(vmMod)
    if ClientViewModel.GetCharm then
        local origGC = ClientViewModel.GetCharm
        ClientViewModel.GetCharm = function(self, ...)
            local wn = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Name
            local wp = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Player
            if wn and wp == lp and equipped[wn] and equipped[wn].Charm then return equipped[wn].Charm end
            return origGC(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if ClientViewModel.GetWrap then
        local origGW = ClientViewModel.GetWrap
        ClientViewModel.GetWrap = function(self, ...)
            local wn = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Name
            local wp = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Player
            if wn and wp == lp and equipped[wn] and equipped[wn].Wrap then return equipped[wn].Wrap end
            return origGW(self, ...)
        end
    end
    local origNew = ClientViewModel.new
    ClientViewModel.new = function(replicatedData, clientItem, ...)
        local wp = clientItem.ClientFighter and clientItem.ClientFighter.Player
        local wn = constructingWeapon or clientItem.Name
        if wp == lp and equipped[wn] then
            pcall(function()
                local RC = _G.jahvex_RC
                if not RC then
                    RC = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ReplicatedClass)
                    _G.jahvex_RC = RC
                end
                local dk = RC:ToEnum("Data")
                replicatedData[dk] = replicatedData[dk] or {}
                local c = equipped[wn]
                if c.Skin  then replicatedData[dk][RC:ToEnum("Skin")]  = c.Skin  end
                if c.Charm then replicatedData[dk][RC:ToEnum("Charm")] = c.Charm end
                if c.Wrap  then replicatedData[dk][RC:ToEnum("Wrap")]  = c.Wrap  end
            end)
        end
        local result = origNew(replicatedData, clientItem, ...)
        if wp == lp and equipped[wn] and equipped[wn].Wrap and result._UpdateWrap then
            pcall(function()
                result:_UpdateWrap()
                task.delay(0.1, function() if not result._destroyed then result:_UpdateWrap() end end)
            end)
        end
        return result
    end
    if type(ClientViewModel.PlayAnimation) == "function" and not ClientViewModel._jahvexAnimHook then
        ClientViewModel._jahvexAnimHook = true
        local origPlay = ClientViewModel.PlayAnimation
        ClientViewModel.PlayAnimation = function(self, name, ...)
            if type(name) == "string" and name:lower():match("reload") then
                _G._jahvexReloadMuteUntil = os.clock() + 2.0
                task.spawn(function()
                    local run = rawget(_G, "jahvex_playReloadSound")
                    if run then pcall(run) end
                end)
            end

            if noFireAnim and jahvex_isFireAnimName(name) then
                return origPlay(self, name, ...)
            end
            if jahvex_shouldSkipWeaponAnim(name) then return end
            return origPlay(self, name, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(ClientViewModel.ApplyRecoil) == "function" and not ClientViewModel._jahvexRecoilHook then
        ClientViewModel._jahvexRecoilHook = true
        local origRecoil = ClientViewModel.ApplyRecoil
        ClientViewModel.ApplyRecoil = function(self, ...)
            if noFireAnim then return end
            return origRecoil(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(ClientViewModel.Impulse) == "function" and not ClientViewModel._jahvexImpulseHook then
        ClientViewModel._jahvexImpulseHook = true
        local origImpulse = ClientViewModel.Impulse
        ClientViewModel.Impulse = function(self, ...)
            if noFireAnim then return end
            return origImpulse(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(ClientViewModel.Update) == "function" and not ClientViewModel._jahvexUpdateHook then
        ClientViewModel._jahvexUpdateHook = true

        ClientViewModel.Update = function(self, dt, p77, p78, ...)

            if noFireAnim then
                pcall(jahvex_freezeViewModelMotion, self, p77, p78)
            end
            return ret
        end
    end
    local animMod = vmMod:FindFirstChild("ViewModelAnimator")
    if animMod then
        local VMA = require(animMod)
        if type(VMA.PlayAnimation) == "function" and not VMA._jahvexAnimHookV2 then
            VMA._jahvexAnimHookV2 = true
            local origA = VMA.PlayAnimation
            VMA.PlayAnimation = function(self, name, inspectCd, fade, weight, speed, ...)
                if noFireAnim and jahvex_isFireAnimName(name) then
                    pcall(jahvex_playFireAnimSounds, self, name, speed)
                    return
                end
                if noFireAnim and type(name) == "string" and string.find(string.lower(name), "sprint", 1, true) then
                    return
                end
                if jahvex_shouldSkipWeaponAnim(name) then return end
                return origA(self, name, inspectCd, fade, weight, speed, ...)
            end
        end
        if type(VMA.PlaySprintAnimation) == "function" and not VMA._jahvexSprintHook then
            VMA._jahvexSprintHook = true
            local origSprint = VMA.PlaySprintAnimation
            VMA.PlaySprintAnimation = function(self, ...)
                if noFireAnim then return end
                return origSprint(self, ...)
            end
        end
        if type(VMA.SetInspectCooldown) == "function" and not VMA._jahvexInspectCdHook then
            VMA._jahvexInspectCdHook = true
            local origSIC = VMA.SetInspectCooldown
            VMA.SetInspectCooldown = function(self, dur, ...)
                if noFireAnim then return end
                return origSIC(self, dur, ...)
            end
        end
        if type(VMA.Inspect) == "function" and not VMA._jahvexInspectHook then
            VMA._jahvexInspectHook = true
            local origInspect = VMA.Inspect
            VMA.Inspect = function(self, ...)
                if noFireAnim then
                    self._inspect_cooldown = 0
                end
                return origInspect(self, ...)
            end
        end
    end
end)

            end
            return
        end
    end
end)

function jahvex_rawPlayerName()
    local n = nil
    pcall(function()
        if oldIdx_lp then n = oldIdx_lp(lp, "Name") end
    end)
    if type(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then
        n = tostring(lp)
        pcall(function() n = lp.Name end)
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_decodeEnumName(v)
    if type(v) == "string" then return v end
    if v == nil then return nil end
    if typeof(v) == "Instance" then
        local n = nil
        pcall(function()
            if oldIdx_lp then n = oldIdx_lp(v, "Name") else n = v.Name end
        end)
        return n
    end
    if EnumLibrary and EnumLibrary.FromEnum then
        local ok, decoded = pcall(EnumLibrary.FromEnum, EnumLibrary, v)
        if ok and type(decoded) == "string" and decoded ~= "" then return decoded end
    end
    return tostring(v)
end

function jahvex_getEquippedFinisher()
    local fd = nil
    if lastUsedWeapon and equipped[lastUsedWeapon] then
        fd = equipped[lastUsedWeapon].Finisher
    end
    if not fd and currentEquippedWeapon and equipped[currentEquippedWeapon] then
        fd = equipped[currentEquippedWeapon].Finisher
    end
    if not fd and type(equipped) == "table" then
        for _, cosmetics in pairs(equipped) do
            if type(cosmetics) == "table" and cosmetics.Finisher then
                fd = cosmetics.Finisher
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return fd
end

function jahvex_isOurFinisherKill(killer)
    if killer == nil then return false end
    if typeof(killer) == "Instance" and rawequal(killer, lp) then return true end
    local dk = jahvex_decodeEnumName(killer)
    if type(dk) ~= "string" or dk == "" then return false end
    local rawName = jahvex_rawPlayerName()
    if dk == rawName or dk:lower() == tostring(rawName):lower() then return true end
    if dk == tostring(lp.UserId) then return true end
    local rawDisp = nil
    pcall(function()
        if oldIdx_lp then rawDisp = oldIdx_lp(lp, "DisplayName") end
    end)
    if type(rawDisp) == "string" and rawDisp ~= "" and dk == rawDisp then return true end
    return false
end

function jahvex_resolveFinisherName(fd)
    if not fd then return nil, nil end
    local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    folder = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Finishers")

    local fname, fenum = nil, nil
    if type(fd) == "string" then
        fname = fd
    elseif type(fd) == "table" then
        fname = fd.Name
        fenum = fd.Enum
    end

    if type(fname) == "string" and folder and folder:FindFirstChild(fname) then
        return fname, fenum
    end
    if fenum and EnumLibrary and EnumLibrary.FromEnum then
        local ok, n = pcall(EnumLibrary.FromEnum, EnumLibrary, fenum)
        if ok and type(n) == "string" and folder and folder:FindFirstChild(n) then
            return n, fenum
        end
    end
    if type(fname) == "string" then return fname, fenum end
    return nil, nil
end

function jahvex_hookClientEntityFinishers(mod)
    if type(mod) ~= "table" then return false end
    if rawget(mod, "_jahvexFinisherGen") == JAHVEX_GEN then return true end
    rawset(mod, "_jahvexFinisherGen", JAHVEX_GEN)

    if type(mod._PlayFinisher) == "function" then
        local origPF = mod._PlayFinisher
        pcall(function() jahvex_saveRestore("ClientEntity._PlayFinisher", origPF) end)
        mod._PlayFinisher = function(self, finName, isFinal, killer, serial)
            local spoofed = false
            if jahvex_isOurFinisherKill(killer) then
                pcall(playKillSound)
                local fname = select(1, jahvex_resolveFinisherName(jahvex_getEquippedFinisher()))
                if fname then
                    finName = fname
                    spoofed = true
                end
            end
            local ret = origPF(self, finName, isFinal, killer, serial)
            if spoofed and self._current_finisher and type(self._current_finisher.PlayServer) == "function" then
                pcall(function() self._current_finisher:PlayServer() end)
            end
            return ret
        end
    end

    if type(mod.ReplicateFromServer) == "function" then
        local origRFS = mod.ReplicateFromServer
        pcall(function() jahvex_saveRestore("ClientEntity.ReplicateFromServer", origRFS) end)
        mod.ReplicateFromServer = function(self, action, ...)
            local actionName = jahvex_decodeEnumName(action)
            if actionName == "FinisherEffect" then
                local args = table.pack(...)
                local killerName = args[3]
                if jahvex_isOurFinisherKill(killerName) then
                    pcall(playKillSound)
                    local fname, fe = jahvex_resolveFinisherName(jahvex_getEquippedFinisher())
                    if not fe and fname and EnumLibrary then
                        local ok, r = pcall(EnumLibrary.ToEnum, EnumLibrary, fname)
                        if ok then fe = r end
                    end
                    if fe then args[1] = fe end
                end
                return origRFS(self, action, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
            end
            return origRFS(self, action, ...)
        end
    end
    return true
end

pcall(function()
    local ps = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts") or playerScripts
    local m = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    local crc = m and m:FindFirstChild("ClientReplicatedClasses")

    if ce then ClientEntity = require(ce) end
end)

                ClientEntity = require(ce)
                jahvex_hookClientEntityFinishers(ClientEntity)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

function jahvex_boxText(v)
    if v == nil then return "" end
    if type(v) == "string" then return v end
    if type(v) == "number" then
        if v ~= v then return "" end
        return tostring(v)
    end
    local s = tostring(v)
    if s == "nil" then return "" end
    return s
end

function jahvex_stopSnow()
    if snowRenderConn then
        pcall(function() snowRenderConn:Disconnect() end)
        snowRenderConn = nil
    end
    snowFlakes = {}
    if snowLayer then
        pcall(function() snowLayer:Destroy() end)
        snowLayer = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_startSnow()
    if jahvex_booting then return end
    if snowLayer and snowLayer.Parent and snowRenderConn then return end
    jahvex_stopSnow()
    if not screenGui then return end
    local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
    layer.Name = "FxSnowLayer"
    layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
    layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    layer.Active = false
    layer.ZIndex = 1
    layer.ClipsDescendants = true
    layer.Parent = screenGui
    snowLayer = layer

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local vp = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
    local count = 45
    for i = 1, count do
        local flake = Instance.new("Frame")
        local sz = (i % 5 == 0) and math.random(4, 7) or math.random(2, 4)
        flake.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
        flake.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
        flake.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 + math.random() * 0.45
        flake.BorderSizePixel = 0
        flake.Active = false
        flake.ZIndex = 1
        flake.Parent = layer
        makeCorner(flake, sz)
        table.insert(snowFlakes, {
            gui = flake,
            x = math.random() * vp.X,
            y = math.random() * vp.Y,
            speed = 38 + math.random() * 90,
            drift = (math.random() - 0.5) * 36,
            size = sz,
            wobble = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
        })
    end

    snowRenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not (guiSnowEnabled and mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible and snowLayer) then
            return
        end
        dt = math.clamp(tonumber(dt) or 0.016, 0, 0.05)
        local cam2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp2 = (cam2 and cam2.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        for _, f in ipairs(snowFlakes) do
            f.wobble = f.wobble + dt * 2.4
            f.y = f.y + f.speed * dt
            f.x = f.x + (f.drift + math.sin(f.wobble) * 18) * dt
            if f.y > vp2.Y + 10 then
                f.y = -10
                f.x = math.random() * vp2.X
            end
            if f.x < -12 then f.x = vp2.X + 6 end
            if f.x > vp2.X + 12 then f.x = -6 end
            f.gui.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(f.x, f.y)
        end
    end)
    jahvex_track(snowRenderConn)
end

function jahvex_setGuiBlur(on)
    pcall(function()
        if on then
            if not guiBlurEffect or not guiBlurEffect.Parent then
                local existing = game:GetService("Lighting"):FindFirstChild("MenuBlurFx")
                if existing then existing:Destroy() end
                guiBlurEffect = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
                guiBlurEffect.Name = "MenuBlurFx"
                guiBlurEffect.Size = 0
                guiBlurEffect.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")
            end
            guiBlurEffect.Enabled = true
            guiBlurEffect.Size = 48
            if screenGui then
                if not guiBlurCover or not guiBlurCover.Parent then
                    local cover = Instance.new("Frame")
                    cover.Name = "MenuBlurCover"
                    cover.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    cover.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
                    cover.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 8, 14)
                    cover.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
                    cover.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    cover.Active = false
                    cover.ZIndex = 1
                    cover.Parent = screenGui
                    guiBlurCover = cover
                end
                guiBlurCover.Visible = true
            end
        else
            if guiBlurEffect then
                guiBlurEffect.Size = 0
                guiBlurEffect.Enabled = false
            end
            if guiBlurCover then
                guiBlurCover.Visible = false
            end
            local existing = game:GetService("Lighting"):FindFirstChild("MenuBlurFx")
            if existing and existing ~= guiBlurEffect then
                existing:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_updateGuiAtmosphere()
    if jahvex_booting then
        pcall(jahvex_setGuiBlur, false)
        pcall(jahvex_stopSnow)
        return
    end
    local open = mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible
    jahvex_setGuiBlur(guiBlurEnabled and open)
    if guiSnowEnabled and open then
        jahvex_startSnow()
    else
        jahvex_stopSnow()
    end
end

function jahvex_hkDrawMap(parent, map, px)
    for r, row in ipairs(map) do
        local c = 1
        local n = #row
        while c <= n do
            local ch = string.sub(row, c, c)
            local col = jahvex_hkPalette[ch]
            if col then
                local runEnd = c
                while runEnd < n and string.sub(row, runEnd + 1, runEnd + 1) == ch do
                    runEnd = runEnd + 1
                end
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.Name = "px"
                f.BackgroundColor3 = col
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((c - 1) * px, (r - 1) * px)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((runEnd - c + 1) * px, px)
                f.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex
                f.Active = false
                f.Parent = parent
                c = runEnd + 1
            else
                c = c + 1
            end
        end

        if r % 8 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end

function jahvex_hkBuildFace(root)
    local PXS = 3
    local z = root.ZIndex

    local function container(name, x, y, w, h, zAdd)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name = name
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
        f.ZIndex = z + (zAdd or 1)
        f.Active = false
        f.Parent = root
        return f
    end


    local body = container("Body", 0, 0, 72, 90, 1)
    jahvex_hkDrawMap(body, jahvex_hkBodyMap, PXS)


    local function whisker(x, y)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name = "px"
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 92, 98)
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 2)
        f.ZIndex = body.ZIndex
        f.Active = false
        f.Parent = body
    end
    whisker(-10, 33)
    whisker(-11, 39)
    whisker(-10, 45)
    whisker(73, 33)
    whisker(74, 39)
    whisker(73, 45)


    local bow = container("Bow", 42, -6, 39, 21, 3)
    jahvex_hkDrawMap(bow, jahvex_hkBowMap, PXS)


    local pawL = container("PawL", 9, 45, 18, 18, 3)
    jahvex_hkDrawMap(pawL, jahvex_hkPawMap, PXS)


    local pivot = container("ArmPivot", 0, 0, 15, 48, 3)
    pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    pivot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 63)
    pivot.Rotation = 18
    jahvex_hkDrawMap(pivot, jahvex_hkArmMap, PXS)
end

function jahvex_hkStopAll()
    hkToken = (hkToken or 0) + 1
    if hkSwayConn then
        pcall(function() hkSwayConn:Disconnect() end)
        hkSwayConn = nil
    end
    if hkImg then
        pcall(function()
            hkImg.Visible = false
            hkImg.Rotation = 0
            local pivot = hkImg:FindFirstChild("ArmPivot")
            if pivot then pivot.Rotation = 18 end
        end)
    end
end

function jahvex_hkEnsure()

    if hkImg and hkImg.Parent then
        if hkImg.Size.Y.Offset == 90 and hkImg:FindFirstChild("Body") then
            return hkImg
        end
        pcall(function() hkImg:Destroy() end)
        hkImg = nil
    end
    if screenGui then
        local old = screenGui:FindFirstChild("HelloKitty")
        if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
    end
    local root = Instance.new("Frame")
    root.Name = "HelloKitty"
    root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    root.BorderSizePixel = 0
    root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 90)

    root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    root.ZIndex = 1
    root.Visible = false
    root.Active = false
    root.ClipsDescendants = false
    root.Parent = screenGui
    jahvex_hkBuildFace(root)
    hkImg = root
    return root
end

function jahvex_hkSetDrawZ(root, baseZ)
    if not root then return end
    root.ZIndex = baseZ
    for _, ch in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
        local add = (ch.Name == "Body") and 1 or 3
        if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then ch.ZIndex = baseZ + add end
        for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("GuiObject") then d.ZIndex = baseZ + add end
        end
    end
end


function jahvex_hkTopXY(mode)
    if not mainFrame then return 0, 0 end
    local ap = mainFrame.AbsolutePosition
    local asz = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize
    local insetY = 0
    pcall(function()
        insetY = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y
    end)
    local topY = ap.Y + insetY
    local x = ap.X + asz.X - 70

    if mode == "behind" then

        return x, topY + 106
    elseif mode == "peek" then

        return x, topY + 10
    end

    return x, topY + 14
end

function jahvex_hkWaveArm(token, img)
    local pivot = img and img:FindFirstChild("ArmPivot")
    if not pivot then return end

    for _ = 1, 3 do
        if token ~= hkToken or not mainFrame.Visible then return end
        local t1 = TweenService:Create(pivot, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Rotation = 62 })
        t1:Play()
        t1.Completed:Wait()
        local t2 = TweenService:Create(pivot, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Rotation = 22 })
        t2:Play()
        t2.Completed:Wait()
    end
    TweenService:Create(pivot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Rotation = 18 }):Play()
end

function jahvex_hkPlayHello(token)
    if not mainFrame or not mainFrame.Visible then return end
    local img = jahvex_hkEnsure()
    jahvex_hkSetDrawZ(img, 0)
    img.Visible = true
    img.Rotation = 0
    local pivot = img:FindFirstChild("ArmPivot")
    if pivot then pivot.Rotation = 18 end

    local bx, by = jahvex_hkTopXY("behind")
    img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bx, by)
    local px, py = jahvex_hkTopXY("peek")
    local twIn = TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py),
    })
    twIn:Play()
    twIn.Completed:Wait()
    if token ~= hkToken or not mainFrame.Visible then return end


    task.spawn(function()
        jahvex_hkWaveArm(token, img)
    end)
    for _ = 1, 2 do
        if token ~= hkToken or not mainFrame.Visible then return end
        local t1 = TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.27, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Rotation = 4 })
        t1:Play()
        t1.Completed:Wait()
        local t2 = TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.27, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Rotation = -4 })
        t2:Play()
        t2.Completed:Wait()
    end
    if token ~= hkToken or not mainFrame.Visible then return end
    TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Rotation = 0 }):Play()
    task.wait(0.2)
    if token ~= hkToken or not mainFrame.Visible then return end

    bx, by = jahvex_hkTopXY("behind")
    local twOut = TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bx, by),
    })
    twOut:Play()
    twOut.Completed:Wait()
    if token ~= hkToken then return end
    img.Visible = false
    img.Rotation = 0
end

function jahvex_hkStartSit(token)
    if not mainFrame or not mainFrame.Visible then return end
    if hkSwayConn then
        pcall(function() hkSwayConn:Disconnect() end)
        hkSwayConn = nil
    end
    local img = jahvex_hkEnsure()
    jahvex_hkSetDrawZ(img, 0)
    img.Visible = true
    img.Rotation = 0

    local hx, hy = jahvex_hkTopXY("behind")
    img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hx, hy)
    local sx, sy = jahvex_hkTopXY("sit")
    local tw = TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx, sy),
    })
    tw:Play()
    local t0 = tick()
    local _hkN = 0
    hkSwayConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        _hkN = _hkN + 1
        if _hkN % 2 ~= 0 then return end
        if token ~= hkToken or not (mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible) or not img or not img.Parent then
            return
        end
        local cx, cy = jahvex_hkTopXY("sit")
        local sway = math.sin((tick() - t0) * 1.3) * 8
        img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + sway, cy)
        img.Rotation = math.sin((tick() - t0) * 1.3) * 4
    end)
end

function jahvex_hkOnGuiOpen()
    if jahvex_booting then return end
    jahvex_hkStopAll()
    local token = hkToken
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.08)
        if token ~= hkToken then return end
        jahvex_hkPlayHello(token)
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(30)
        if token ~= hkToken then return end
        if not (mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible) then return end
        jahvex_hkStartSit(token)
    end)
end

function setInsetOverlayHostOpen(open)
    open = open and true or false
    if mainFrame then mainFrame.Visible = open end
    if guiMouseUnlock then
        guiMouseUnlock.Visible = open
        guiMouseUnlock.Modal = open
    end
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_8")
    end)
    if open then
        pcall(function()
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end)
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("__rb_8", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 10, function()
            if not (mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible) then
                return
            end
            if guiMouseUnlock and not guiMouseUnlock.Modal then
                guiMouseUnlock.Visible = true
                guiMouseUnlock.Modal = true
            end
            if not UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled then
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            end
            if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
                UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            end
        end)
        jahvex_updateGuiAtmosphere()
        jahvex_hkOnGuiOpen()
    else
        if guiMouseUnlock then
            guiMouseUnlock.Modal = false
            guiMouseUnlock.Visible = false
        end
        jahvex_hkStopAll()
        jahvex_updateGuiAtmosphere()
    end
end


WINDOW_BG = WINDOW_BG or Color3.fromRGB(11, 11, 14)
PANEL_BG  = PANEL_BG or Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19)
ELEM_BG   = ELEM_BG or Color3.fromRGB(21, 21, 26)
ELEM_HOV  = ELEM_HOV or Color3.fromRGB(29, 29, 35)
LIST_BG   = LIST_BG or Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 23)
BORDER    = BORDER or Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 39)
TEXT_W    = TEXT_W or Color3.fromRGB(228, 228, 232)
TEXT_DIM  = TEXT_DIM or Color3.fromRGB(125, 125, 135)
WHITE_ACC = WHITE_ACC or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235)
GREEN     = GREEN or Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 130)
RED       = RED or Color3.fromRGB(225, 85, 85)
jahvexThemeRefreshers = jahvexThemeRefreshers or {}

do
    local th = jahvexConfigExtra and jahvexConfigExtra.theme
    if type(th) == "table" then
        if th.WINDOW_BG then WINDOW_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.WINDOW_BG, WINDOW_BG) end
        if th.PANEL_BG then PANEL_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.PANEL_BG, PANEL_BG) end
        if th.ELEM_BG then ELEM_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.ELEM_BG, ELEM_BG) end
        if th.ELEM_HOV then ELEM_HOV = jahvex_tableToColor(th.ELEM_HOV, ELEM_HOV) end
        if th.LIST_BG then LIST_BG = jahvex_tableToColor(th.LIST_BG, LIST_BG) end
        if th.BORDER then BORDER = jahvex_tableToColor(th.BORDER, BORDER) end
        if th.TEXT_W then TEXT_W = jahvex_tableToColor(th.TEXT_W, TEXT_W) end
        if th.TEXT_DIM then TEXT_DIM = jahvex_tableToColor(th.TEXT_DIM, TEXT_DIM) end
        if th.WHITE_ACC then WHITE_ACC = jahvex_tableToColor(th.WHITE_ACC, WHITE_ACC) end
    end
end

MAIN_W, MAIN_H = 620, 444
HEADER_H = 40
TAB_Y, TAB_H = 48, 28
CONTENT_X, CONTENT_Y = 16, 88
CONTENT_W = MAIN_W - 32
CONTENT_H = MAIN_H - CONTENT_Y - 14 - 24
COL_W = (CONTENT_W - 12) / 2
COL2_X = COL_W + 12

PANEL_EDGE = 3
function jahvex_panelBox(x, y, w, h)
    local e = PANEL_EDGE or 3

    local yPad = (tonumber(y) or 0) <= 0 and e or 0
    return x + e, y + yPad, w - e * 2, h
end

function jahvex_makeColumnScroll(parent, name, x, w, h)
    local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    sf.Name = name
    sf.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
    sf.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0)
    sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sf.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    sf.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    sf.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never
    sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    sf.ScrollingEnabled = true
    sf.ClipsDescendants = true
    sf.Active = true
    sf.ZIndex = 2
    sf.Parent = parent
    return sf
end

function jahvex_refreshColumnCanvas(scroll)
    if not scroll or not scroll:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return end
    local maxY = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
            maxY = math.max(maxY, child.Position.Y.Offset + child.Size.Y.Offset)
        end
    end
    scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, maxY + 12)
end

function makeCorner(p, r)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6) c.Parent = p return c
end
function makeStroke(p, col, th)
    jahvex_uiBreath()
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke") s.Color = col or BORDER s.Thickness = th or 1 s.Parent = p
    pcall(function() s:SetAttribute("uiRole", "border") end)
    return s
end
function makeLabel(parent, text, x, y, w, h, size, col, xalign)
    jahvex_uiBreath()
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
    l.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Text = text
    l.TextColor3 = col or TEXT_W
    l.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    l.TextSize = size or 12
    l.TextXAlignment = xalign or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.TextWrapped = false
    pcall(function() l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None end)
    l.ZIndex = 3
    l.Parent = parent
    pcall(function()
        if col == TEXT_DIM then
            l:SetAttribute("uiRole", "textDim")
        else
            l:SetAttribute("uiRole", "text")
        end
    end)
    return l
end
function makePanel(parent, x, y, w, h, title)
    jahvex_uiBreath()
    local px, py, pw, ph = jahvex_panelBox(x, y, w, h)
    local p = Instance.new("Frame")
    p.Size = UDim2.new(0, pw, 0, ph)
    p.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
    p.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
    p.BorderSizePixel = 0
    p.ZIndex = 2
    p.Parent = parent
    pcall(function() p:SetAttribute("uiRole", "panel") end)
    makeCorner(p, 8)
    makeStroke(p, BORDER, 1)

    local t = makeLabel(p, title, 12, 0, pw - 24, 30, 12, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    pcall(function() t:SetAttribute("uiRole", "text") end)

    return p
end
function makeBtn(parent, text, x, y, w, h, kind)
    jahvex_uiBreath()
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.ZIndex = 3
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    if kind == "danger" then btn.TextColor3 = RED
    elseif kind == "accent" then btn.TextColor3 = GREEN
    else btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_W end
    btn.Parent = parent
    pcall(function()
        btn:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem")
        if kind ~= "danger" and kind ~= "accent" then
            btn:SetAttribute("jxText", "text")
        end
    end)
    makeCorner(btn, 6)
    makeStroke(btn, BORDER, 1)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_HOV}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG}):Play()
    end)
    local api = {}
    function api:SetBase(col) btn.BackgroundColor3 = col or ELEM_BG end
    return btn, api
end
function makeToggle(parent, text, x, y, w, onChanged)
    jahvex_uiBreath()
    local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 22)
    row.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Text = ""
    row.ZIndex = 3
    row.Parent = parent

    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.Name = "ToggleFill"
    box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -7)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.ClipsDescendants = true
    box.ZIndex = 3
    box.Parent = row
    makeCorner(box, 3)
    local boxStroke = makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)
    pcall(function() box:SetAttribute("uiRole", "toggleBox") end)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.TextWrapped = false
    pcall(function() lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None end)
    lbl.ZIndex = 3
    lbl.Parent = row
    pcall(function() lbl:SetAttribute("uiRole", "toggleLbl") end)

    local state = false
    local function render()
        for _, ch in ipairs(box:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("TextLabel") or ch:IsA("ImageLabel") or ch:IsA("ImageButton") then
                pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        if state then
            box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            boxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        else
            box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
            boxStroke.Color = BORDER
            lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        end
    end

    local api = {}
    function api:Set(v, fire)
        state = v and true or false
        render()
        if fire ~= false and onChanged then onChanged(state) end
    end
    function api:Get() return state end
    api.Row = row
    api.Label = lbl
    row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() api:Set(not state) end)
    render()
    jahvexThemeRefreshers = jahvexThemeRefreshers or {}
    table.insert(jahvexThemeRefreshers, function()
        if row.Parent then render() end
    end)
    if not jahvex_skipFeatReg and type(text) == "string" and text ~= "" then
        jahvex_featIndex = jahvex_featIndex or {}
        local tabName, panelName = "Misc&Visuals", ""
        pcall(function()
            local inst = parent
            for _ = 1, 16 do
                if not inst then break end
                local isPage = false
                if pages then
                    for n, pg in pairs(pages) do
                        if inst == pg then
                            tabName = n
                            isPage = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                if (not isPage) and panelName == "" and inst:IsA("Frame") then
                    local tl = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                    if tl and type(tl.Text) == "string" and tl.Text ~= "" and tl.Text ~= text then
                        panelName = tl.Text
                    end
                end
                inst = inst.Parent
            end
        end)
        table.insert(jahvex_featIndex, {
            name = text,
            key = string.lower(text),
            panel = panelName,
            tab = tabName,
            api = api,
            row = row,
        })
    end
    return api
end

_G.jahvex_openDropdown = nil


function makeDropdown(parent, x, y, w, placeholder, options, onSelect, searchable)
    jahvex_uiBreath()
    options = options or {}
    if searchable == nil then
        searchable = #options >= 8
    end

    local box = Instance.new("TextButton")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 30)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.Text = ""
    box.ZIndex = 3
    box.AutoButtonColor = false
    box.Parent = parent
    pcall(function() box:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    makeCorner(box, 6)
    makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)

    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Text = placeholder
    valLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    valLbl.TextSize = 12
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    valLbl.ZIndex = 4
    valLbl.Parent = box
    pcall(function() valLbl:SetAttribute("uiRole", "textDim") end)

    local chev = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    chev.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
    chev.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 0)
    chev.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    chev.Text = "\226\150\188"
    chev.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    chev.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    chev.TextSize = 9
    chev.ZIndex = 4
    chev.Parent = box

    local ITEM_H = 26
    local SEARCH_H = searchable and 30 or 0
    local LIST_MAX_HEIGHT = searchable and 180 or 150
    local totalHeight = #options * ITEM_H + 6 + SEARCH_H
    local listHeight = math.min(totalHeight, LIST_MAX_HEIGHT + SEARCH_H)


    local listHost = Instance.new("Frame")
    listHost.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, listHeight)
    listHost.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    listHost.BackgroundColor3 = LIST_BG
    listHost.BorderSizePixel = 0
    listHost.ClipsDescendants = true
    listHost.Visible = false
    listHost.ZIndex = 250
    listHost.Parent = screenGui
    makeCorner(listHost, 6)
    makeStroke(listHost, BORDER, 1)

    local searchBox = nil
    if searchable then
        searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
        searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26)
        searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
        searchBox.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        searchBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
        searchBox.Text = ""
        searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search..."
        searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        searchBox.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        searchBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        searchBox.TextSize = 12
        searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        searchBox.ZIndex = 252
        searchBox.Parent = listHost
        makeCorner(searchBox, 4)
        makeStroke(searchBox, BORDER, 1)
    end

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, searchable and -(SEARCH_H + 2) or 0)
    list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, searchable and (SEARCH_H + 2) or 0)
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.ClipsDescendants = true
    list.ZIndex = 251
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    list.Parent = listHost

    local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    listLayout.Parent = list

    local listPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    listPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
    listPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
    listPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    listPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
    listPad.Parent = list

    local api = { open = false }
    local onOpenCb = nil
    local itemRows = {}

    local function placeList()
        local guiPos = screenGui.AbsolutePosition
        local boxPos = box.AbsolutePosition
        local boxSize = box.AbsoluteSize
        local listW = math.max(w, boxSize.X)
        local x = boxPos.X - guiPos.X
        local yBelow = boxPos.Y - guiPos.Y + boxSize.Y + 4
        local yAbove = boxPos.Y - guiPos.Y - listHeight - 4

        local mfPos = mainFrame.AbsolutePosition
        local mfSize = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize
        local mfLeft = mfPos.X - guiPos.X
        local mfTop = mfPos.Y - guiPos.Y
        local mfRight = mfLeft + mfSize.X
        local mfBottom = mfTop + mfSize.Y

        local spaceBelow = (mfPos.Y + mfSize.Y) - (boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y)
        local y = (spaceBelow < listHeight + 8) and yAbove or yBelow
        y = math.clamp(y, mfTop + 4, math.max(mfTop + 4, mfBottom - listHeight - 4))
        x = math.clamp(x, mfLeft + 4, math.max(mfLeft + 4, mfRight - listW - 4))

        listHost.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
        listHost.Size = UDim2.new(0, listW, 0, listHeight)
    end

    local function closeList()
        api.open = false
        listHost.Visible = false
        if searchBox then searchBox.Text = "" end
        if _G.jahvex_openDropdown == api then _G.jahvex_openDropdown = nil end
    end

    local function applyFilter()
        if not searchable then return end
        local q = tostring(searchBox and searchBox.Text or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        local matched, rest = {}, {}
        for _, r in ipairs(itemRows) do
            if q == "" or string.find(r.key, q, 1, true) then
                matched[#matched + 1] = r
            else
                rest[#rest + 1] = r
            end
        end
        for i, r in ipairs(matched) do
            r.btn.Visible = true
            r.btn.LayoutOrder = i
        end
        for _, r in ipairs(rest) do
            r.btn.Visible = false
        end
    end

    local function openList()
        if onOpenCb then pcall(onOpenCb) end
        placeList()
        if _G.jahvex_openDropdown and _G.jahvex_openDropdown ~= api then
            _G.jahvex_openDropdown:Close()
        end
        _G.jahvex_openDropdown = api
        api.open = true
        listHost.Visible = true
        if searchBox then
            searchBox.Text = ""
            applyFilter()
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function() searchBox:CaptureFocus() end)
            end)
        end
    end

    function api:SetOnOpen(fn)
        onOpenCb = fn
    end

    function api:Close()
        if api.open then closeList() end
    end

    function api:SetDisplay(label, fireValue)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(label or "")
        valLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        if fireValue ~= nil and onSelect then
            onSelect(fireValue, label)
        end
    end

    function api:SetByValue(value, fire)
        for _, opt in ipairs(options) do
            if opt.value == value or (type(opt.value) == "table" and type(value) == "string" and opt.value.name == value) then
                valLbl.Text = opt.label
                valLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
                if fire ~= false and onSelect then
                    onSelect(opt.value, opt.label)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
        if type(value) == "string" then
            for _, opt in ipairs(options) do
                if opt.label == value or tostring(opt.value) == value then
                    valLbl.Text = opt.label
                    valLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
                    if fire ~= false and onSelect then
                        onSelect(opt.value, opt.label)
                    end
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function rebuildListItems()
        for _, ch in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and not ch:IsA("UIListLayout") and not ch:IsA("UIPadding") then
                ch:Destroy()
            end
        end
        itemRows = {}
        if searchable then
            listHeight = math.min(#options * ITEM_H + 6 + SEARCH_H, LIST_MAX_HEIGHT)
        else
            listHeight = math.min(#options * ITEM_H + 6, LIST_MAX_HEIGHT)
        end
        listHost.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, listHeight)
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
            local it = Instance.new("TextButton")
            it.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ITEM_H)
            it.BackgroundColor3 = LIST_BG
            it.BorderSizePixel = 0
            it.Text = ""
            it.ZIndex = 251
            it.AutoButtonColor = false
            it.LayoutOrder = i
            it.Parent = list
            makeCorner(it, 4)
            local il = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            il.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
            il.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
            il.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            il.Text = opt.label
            il.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            il.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            il.TextSize = 12
            il.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            il.ZIndex = 252
            il.Parent = it
            it.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                it.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_HOV
                il.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
            end)
            it.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                it.BackgroundColor3 = LIST_BG
                il.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            end)
            it.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                valLbl.Text = opt.label
                valLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
                closeList()
                if onSelect then onSelect(opt.value, opt.label) end
            end)
            itemRows[#itemRows + 1] = {
                btn = it,
                key = tostring(opt.label or ""):lower(),
            }
        end
        applyFilter()
    end

    function api:SetOptions(newOptions, keepSelection)
        options = newOptions or {}
        if searchable == nil then

        end
        rebuildListItems()
        if keepSelection == false then
            valLbl.Text = "None"
            valLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        end
    end

    if searchBox then
        searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(applyFilter)
    end

    rebuildListItems()

    box.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if api.open then closeList() else openList() end
    end)

    box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(function()
        if api.open then placeList() end
    end)

    return api
end

function jahvex_parseAssetId(text)
    if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local s = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if s == "" then return nil end
    if s:find("^rbxasset") then return s end
    local num = s:match("(%d+)")
    if num then return "rbxassetid://" .. num end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_parseSkyCustom(text)
    if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local ids = {}
    for num in text:gmatch("%d+") do
        ids[#ids + 1] = "rbxassetid://" .. num
    end
    if #ids >= 6 then
        return {
            name = "Custom",
            Bk = ids[1], Dn = ids[2], Ft = ids[3],
            Lf = ids[4], Rt = ids[5], Up = ids[6],
        }
    end
    local one = jahvex_parseAssetId(text)
    if not one then return nil end
    return {name = "Custom", Bk = one, Dn = one, Ft = one, Lf = one, Rt = one, Up = one}
end

    box.PlaceholderColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    box.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    box.ZIndex = 3
    box.Parent = parent
    pcall(function() box:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    makeCorner(box, 4)
    local stroke = makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)
    box.Focused:Connect(function()
        box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_HOV
        if stroke then stroke.Color = WHITE_ACC end

        if box.Text == "" or box.Text == "rbxassetid://..." then
            box.Text = ""
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        else
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        end
    end)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        if stroke then stroke.Color = BORDER end
        if box.Text == "" then
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        else
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        end
    end)
    box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if box.Text == "" then
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        else
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        end
    end)
    return box
end

end

    if not mainFrame then return end
    if silentExecute then
        getgenv()._jxGuiRevealed = nil

        mainFrame.Visible = false
    else
        pcall(setInsetOverlayHostOpen, true)
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        getgenv()._jxGuiRevealed = true
    end
end

function jahvex_b64decode(data)
    if type(data) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local out = nil
    pcall(function()
        if crypt and crypt.base64decode then
            out = crypt.base64decode(data)
        elseif crypt and crypt.base64_decode then
            out = crypt.base64_decode(data)
        elseif base64_decode then
            out = base64_decode(data)
        end
    end)
    return out
end

function jahvex_seedTabIcons()
    if not writefile then return end
    if type(jahvex_tabIconB64) ~= "table" then return end
    pcall(function()
        if isfolder and not isfolder("jahvex") then makefolder("jahvex") end
        if isfolder and not isfolder("jx/icons") then makefolder("jx/icons") end
        if isfolder and not isfolder("jx/icons/tabs") then makefolder("jx/icons/tabs") end
        if isfolder and not isfolder("icons") then makefolder("icons") end
        if isfolder and not isfolder("icons/tabs") then makefolder("icons/tabs") end
    end)
    for name, b64 in pairs(jahvex_tabIconB64) do
        local p1 = "jahvex/icons/tabs/" .. name .. ".png"
        local p2 = "icons/tabs/" .. name .. ".png"
        local bin = jahvex_b64decode(b64)
        if type(bin) ~= "string" or #bin < 32 then
            if isfile and isfile(p2) and readfile then
                pcall(function() bin = readfile(p2) end)
            end
        end
        if type(bin) == "string" and #bin > 32 then
            pcall(function() writefile(p1, bin) end)
            pcall(function() writefile(p2, bin) end)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_resolveTabIcon(fileName)
    if type(fileName) ~= "string" or fileName == "" then return nil end
    local cache = getgenv()["_jxTabIconCache"]
    if type(cache) ~= "table" then
        cache = {}
        getgenv()._jxTabIconCache = cache
    end
    local hit = cache[fileName]
    if hit ~= nil then
        if hit == false then return nil end
        return hit
    end
    local candidates = {
        "jahvex/icons/tabs/" .. fileName,
        "icons/tabs/" .. fileName,
        "jahvex/icons/" .. fileName,
        "icons/" .. fileName,
    }
    local loaders = {}
    if getcustomasset then table.insert(loaders, getcustomasset) end
    if getsynasset then table.insert(loaders, getsynasset) end
    for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
        for _, loader in ipairs(loaders) do
            local ok, asset = pcall(loader, path)
            if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
                cache[fileName] = asset
                return asset
            end
        end
    end
    cache[fileName] = false
    return nil
end

function jahvex_ensureTabIconAsset(fileName, key)
    local b64 = key and jahvex_tabIconB64 and jahvex_tabIconB64[key]
    local bin = type(b64) == "string" and jahvex_b64decode(b64) or nil
    if type(bin) == "string" and #bin > 32 and writefile then
        pcall(function()
            if makefolder then
                if isfolder and not isfolder("jahvex") then makefolder("jahvex") end
                if isfolder and not isfolder("jx/icons") then makefolder("jx/icons") end
                if isfolder and not isfolder("jx/icons/tabs") then makefolder("jx/icons/tabs") end
                if isfolder and not isfolder("icons") then makefolder("icons") end
                if isfolder and not isfolder("icons/tabs") then makefolder("icons/tabs") end
            end
            writefile("jx/icons/tabs/" .. fileName, bin)
            writefile("icons/tabs/" .. fileName, bin)
        end)
    end
    return jahvex_resolveTabIcon(fileName)
end
