jahvex_searchOn = false
jahvex_searchSuppress = false

local function jahvex_searchNorm(s)
    s = string.lower(tostring(s or ""))
    s = s:gsub("ı", "i"):gsub("İ", "i"):gsub("ş", "s"):gsub("Ş", "s")
    s = s:gsub("ğ", "g"):gsub("Ğ", "g"):gsub("ü", "u"):gsub("Ü", "u")
    s = s:gsub("ö", "o"):gsub("Ö", "o"):gsub("ç", "c"):gsub("Ç", "c")
    return s
end

local function jahvex_searchScore(feat, q)
    q = jahvex_searchNorm(q)
    q = q:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if q == "" then return nil end
    local name = jahvex_searchNorm(feat.name)
    local panel = jahvex_searchNorm(feat.panel)
    local tab = jahvex_searchNorm(feat.tab)
    local hay = name .. " " .. panel .. " " .. tab
    if name == q then return 10000 end
    if name:sub(1, #q) == q then return 9000 - #name end
    local i = string.find(name, q, 1, true)
    if i then return 8000 - i * 15 - #name end
    local nCompact = name:gsub("[^%w]", "")
    local qCompact = q:gsub("[^%w]", "")
    if qCompact ~= "" then
        if nCompact:sub(1, #qCompact) == qCompact then return 7500 - #nCompact end
        local j = string.find(nCompact, qCompact, 1, true)
        if j then return 7000 - j * 10 end
    end
    local p = string.find(hay, q, 1, true)
    if p then return 5000 - p end
    if qCompact ~= "" then
        local hCompact = hay:gsub("[^%w]", "")
        local k = string.find(hCompact, qCompact, 1, true)
        if k then return 4200 - k end
    end
    local qi = 1
    for ni = 1, #name do
        if name:sub(ni, ni) == q:sub(qi, qi) then
            qi = qi + 1
            if qi > #q then
                return 2000 - (#name - #q)
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_showNormalGui()
    jahvex_searchOn = false
    if searchOverlay then searchOverlay.Visible = false end
    local cur = jahvex_uiTab or "Combat"
    if _G.jahvex_pages then
        for n, pg in pairs(_G.jahvex_pages) do
            pg.Visible = (n == cur)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_exitSearch()
    if jahvex_searchSuppress then return end
    jahvex_searchSuppress = true
    if searchBox and searchBox.Text ~= "" then
        searchBox.Text = ""
    end
    jahvex_searchSuppress = false
    jahvex_showNormalGui()
end

function jahvex_gotoFeat(feat)
    jahvex_exitSearch()
    local tab = feat and feat.tab
    if type(tab) == "string" and _G.jahvex_switchTab then
        _G.jahvex_switchTab(tab)
    end
    local row = feat and (feat.row or (feat.api and feat.api.Row))
    if not (row and row.Parent) then return end
    local scroll = row.Parent
    while scroll and not scroll:IsA("ScrollingFrame") do
        scroll = scroll.Parent
    end
    if scroll and scroll:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
        local y = (row.AbsolutePosition.Y - scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y) + scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, y - 16))
    end
    pcall(function()
        local old = row.BackgroundTransparency
        row.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
        task.delay(0.45, function()
            if row and row.Parent then
                row.BackgroundTransparency = old
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function jahvex_runSearch(raw)
    if jahvex_searchSuppress then return end
    local q = tostring(raw or "")
    q = q:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if q == "" then
        jahvex_showNormalGui()
        return
    end
    local scored = {}
    for _, feat in ipairs(jahvex_featIndex or {}) do
        local sc = jahvex_searchScore(feat, q)
        if sc then
            table.insert(scored, {feat = feat, score = sc})
        end
    end
    table.sort(scored, function(a, b)
        if a.score ~= b.score then return a.score > b.score end
        return tostring(a.feat.name) < tostring(b.feat.name)
    end)
    local maxN = 10
    if #scored > maxN then
        local trimmed = {}
        for i = 1, maxN do trimmed[i] = scored[i] end
        scored = trimmed
    end

    jahvex_searchOn = true
    if _G.jahvex_pages then
        for _, pg in pairs(_G.jahvex_pages) do
            pg.Visible = false
        end
    end
    if not searchOverlay then return end
    searchOverlay.Visible = true
    for _, ch in ipairs(searchOverlay:GetChildren()) do
        if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then ch:Destroy() end
    end

    local y = 8
    if #scored == 0 then
        local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
        empty.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y)

end

function _G.jahvex_switchTab(name)
    jahvex_uiTab = name
    if _G.jahvex_openDropdown then _G.jahvex_openDropdown:Close() end
    local searching = jahvex_searchOn == true
    for n, pg in pairs(_G.jahvex_pages) do
        pg.Visible = (not searching) and (n == name)
    end
    if searchOverlay then
        searchOverlay.Visible = searching and true or false
    end
    for n, btn in pairs(_G.jahvex_tabButtons) do
        local on = (n == name)
        if on then
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            local lbl = btn:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
            if lbl then
                lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
                pcall(function() lbl:SetAttribute("uiRole", "text") end)
            else
                btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
            end
            local ic = btn:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
            if ic and ic:IsA("ImageLabel") then ic.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
        else
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            local lbl = btn:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
            if lbl then
                lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
                pcall(function() lbl:SetAttribute("uiRole", "textDim") end)
            else
                btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            end
            local ic = btn:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
            if ic and ic:IsA("ImageLabel") then ic.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
        end
    end
end

                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

end)

local function jahvex_refreshWrapOnWeapon(weaponName)
    pcall(function()
        local fc = FighterController or FighterController2
        if not fc then return end
        local fighter = fc:GetFighter(lp)
        if not fighter or not fighter.Items then return end
        for _, item in pairs(fighter.Items) do
            if item and item.Name == weaponName then
                local vm = item.ClientViewModel or item._view_model or item.ViewModel
                if vm and vm._UpdateWrap then
                    vm:_UpdateWrap()
                    task.delay(0.08, function()
                        if vm and not vm._destroyed and vm._UpdateWrap then
                            vm:_UpdateWrap()
                        end
                    end)
                end

                pcall(function()
                    local wrap = equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Wrap
                    if not wrap then return end
                    local WC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.WrapController)
                    if WC and WC.ApplyWrap then
                        WC:ApplyWrap(wrap)
                    elseif typeof(WC) == "Instance" then
                    else
                        local mt = getmetatable(WC)
                        local idx = mt and mt.__index
                        if idx and idx.ApplyWrap and vm then

                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local wrap = equipped[weaponName] and equipped[weaponName].Wrap
        if not wrap then return end
        local scanned = 0
        local function consider(obj)
            if type(obj) == "table" and type(rawget(obj, "ApplyWrap")) == "function" and rawget(obj, "_wrap_group_objects") ~= nil then
                pcall(function() obj:ApplyWrap(wrap) end)
            end
        end
        if typeof(filtergc) == "function" then
            local list = filtergc("table", true)
            if type(list) == "table" then
                for _, obj in ipairs(list) do
                    consider(obj)
                    scanned = scanned + 1
                    if scanned % 80 == 0 then task.wait() end
                end
                return
            end
        end

        local gc = getgc(false)
        for _, obj in ipairs(gc) do
            consider(obj)
            scanned = scanned + 1
            if scanned > 4000 then break end
            if scanned % 80 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end
    end)
end

applyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not selectedCosWeapon then setStatus("Select a weapon!", RED) return end
    if not selectedCosType    then setStatus("Select a type!", RED) return end
    if not selectedCosItem    then setStatus("Select an item!", RED) return end
    equipped[selectedCosWeapon] = equipped[selectedCosWeapon] or {}
    local wantInvert = (selectedCosType == "Wrap") and invertWrapEnabled or false
    local cloned = cloneCosmetic(selectedCosItem, selectedCosType, {inverted = wantInvert})
    if not cloned then
        cloned = {Name = selectedCosItem, Type = selectedCosType, Seed = math.random(1, 1000000)}
        if EnumLibrary then
            local okE, eid = pcall(EnumLibrary.ToEnum, EnumLibrary, selectedCosItem)
            if okE and eid then cloned.Enum = eid cloned.ObjectID = eid end
        end
    end
    if selectedCosType == "Wrap" then
        cloned.Inverted = wantInvert and true or false
        cloned.IsInverted = wantInvert and true or false
    end
    equipped[selectedCosWeapon][selectedCosType] = cloned
    cachedProxy = nil
    pcall(function() jahvex_localDataTouch("WeaponInventory") end)
    if selectedCosType == "Wrap" then
        task.defer(function()
            jahvex_refreshWrapOnWeapon(selectedCosWeapon)
        end)
    end
    task.delay(0.2, saveConfig)
    local invTxt = (selectedCosType == "Wrap" and wantInvert) and " [INVERTED]" or ""
    setStatus("Applied: " .. selectedCosItem .. " -> " .. selectedCosWeapon .. invTxt, GREEN)
end)

removeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not selectedCosWeapon or not selectedCosType then
        setStatus("Select a weapon and type!", RED) return
    end
    if equipped[selectedCosWeapon] then
        equipped[selectedCosWeapon][selectedCosType] = nil
        if not next(equipped[selectedCosWeapon]) then equipped[selectedCosWeapon] = nil end
    end
    cachedProxy = nil
    pcall(function() jahvex_localDataTouch("WeaponInventory") end)
    task.delay(0.2, saveConfig)
    setStatus("Removed.", RED)
end)

local previewWorldModel = nil

local function jahvex_getCosmeticImage(cosName)
    if not cosName then return nil end
    local img = nil
    pcall(function()
        local info = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cosName]
        if info then
            img = info.ImageHighResolution or info.Image
            if type(img) == "string" and img == "" then img = nil end
        end
    end)
    if not img then
        pcall(function()
            local vm = ItemLibrary and ItemLibrary.ViewModels and ItemLibrary.ViewModels[cosName]
            if vm then
                img = vm.ImageHighResolution or vm.Image
                if type(img) == "string" and img == "" then img = nil end
            end
        end)
    end
    return img
end

local function jahvex_findMaterialVariant(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
    local MS = game:GetService("MaterialService")
    local direct = MS:FindFirstChild(name, true)
    if direct and direct:IsA("MaterialVariant") then return direct end
    local lower = name:lower()
    for _, d in ipairs(MS:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("MaterialVariant") and d.Name:lower() == lower then
            return d
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function jahvex_getAssetsFolder(name)
    local assets = lp.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Assets")
    return assets and assets:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
end


local function jahvex_getWrapTextureImage(cosName)
    local info = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cosName]
    if not info or tostring(info.Type or "") ~= "Wrap" then return nil end
    local img = nil
    pcall(function()
        local WT = jahvex_getAssetsFolder("WrapTextures")
        local function fromWrapTexturesFolder(folderName)
            if not WT or type(folderName) ~= "string" or folderName == "" then return nil end
            local folder = WT:FindFirstChild(folderName)
            if not folder then
                local nospace = folderName:gsub("%s+", "")
                folder = WT:FindFirstChild(nospace)
            end
            if not folder then return nil end
            for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
                if (d:IsA("Texture") or d:IsA("Decal")) and type(d.Texture) == "string" and d.Texture ~= "" then
                    return d.Texture
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function fromMaterialVariant(mvName)
            local mv = jahvex_findMaterialVariant(mvName)
            if mv and type(mv.ColorMap) == "string" and mv.ColorMap ~= "" then
                return mv.ColorMap
            end
            return nil
        end

        local aliases = { cosName }
        pcall(function()
            local ren = CosmeticLibrary.RENAMED_COSMETICS
            if type(ren) == "table" then
                if ren[cosName] then table.insert(aliases, ren[cosName]) end
                for a, b in pairs(ren) do
                    if b == cosName then table.insert(aliases, a) end
                end
            end
        end)
        if info.WrapGroups then
            for _, g in pairs(info.WrapGroups) do
                if type(g) == "table" then
                    img = fromWrapTexturesFolder(g.Textures)
                        or fromMaterialVariant(g.MaterialVariant)
                        or fromMaterialVariant(g.Textures)
                    if img then return end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, alias in ipairs(aliases) do
            img = fromWrapTexturesFolder(alias)
                or fromWrapTexturesFolder((tostring(alias):gsub("%s+", "")))
                or fromMaterialVariant(alias)
                or fromMaterialVariant((tostring(alias):gsub("%s+", "")))
            if img then return end
        end
    end)
    return img
end

local function jahvex_getCharmTextureImage(cosName)
    local img = nil
    pcall(function()
        local folder = jahvex_getAssetsFolder("Charms")
        local src = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(cosName)
        if not src then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
            local tex = nil
            if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
                tex = d.TextureID
            elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                tex = d.TextureId
            elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                tex = d.Texture
            end
            if type(tex) == "string" and tex ~= "" and tex ~= "rbxassetid://0" then
                img = tex
                return
            end
        end
    end)
    return img
end

local function jahvex_clearCosmeticPreview()
    if previewWorldModel then
        pcall(function() previewWorldModel:Destroy() end)
        previewWorldModel = nil
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(previewViewport:GetChildren()) do
        if not c:IsA("Camera") then
            pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    previewImage.Image = ""
    previewImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    previewImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    previewImage.Visible = false
    previewViewport.Visible = false
previewViewport.Active = true
end

local currentPreviewLook = Vector3.new()
local currentPreviewDist = 5
local camDistanceMult = 2.0
local camXRot = -40
local camYRot = 20
local isPreviewDragging = false
local lastMousePos = nil

local function jahvex_updatePreviewCamera()
    if not previewCam then return end
    local dist = currentPreviewDist * camDistanceMult
    local cf = CFrame.new(currentPreviewLook)
        * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(camXRot), 0)
        * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(camYRot), 0, 0)
        * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)
    previewCam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.Position, currentPreviewLook)
end

local function jahvex_fitPreviewModel(model)
    if not model or not previewCam then return end
    local ok, bbCf, bbSize = pcall(function()
        return model:GetBoundingBox()
    end)
    if not ok or not bbCf then return end


    local maxDim = math.max(bbSize.X, bbSize.Y, bbSize.Z, 3.0)

    currentPreviewDist = maxDim
    currentPreviewLook = bbCf.Position
    previewCam.FieldOfView = 28

    camDistanceMult = 2.0
    camXRot = -40
    camYRot = 20

    jahvex_updatePreviewCamera()
end


local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

local function jahvex_setScrollingGlobally(state)
    pcall(function()
        if _G.jahvex_cosRightScroll then _G.jahvex_cosRightScroll.ScrollingEnabled = state end
        if _G.jahvex_cosLeftScroll then _G.jahvex_cosLeftScroll.ScrollingEnabled = state end
    end)
end

local wasInPreview = false
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local inPreview = false
        pcall(function()
            local pv = getgenv().jahvex_previewViewport
            if pv and pv.Visible then
                local absPos = pv.AbsolutePosition
                local absSize = pv.AbsoluteSize
                local m = input.Position
                if m.X >= absPos.X and m.X <= absPos.X + absSize.X and m.Y >= absPos.Y and m.Y <= absPos.Y + absSize.Y then
                    inPreview = true
                end
            end
        end)

        if inPreview and not wasInPreview then
            wasInPreview = true
            jahvex_setScrollingGlobally(false)
        elseif not inPreview and wasInPreview then
            wasInPreview = false
            jahvex_setScrollingGlobally(true)
        end
    end
end)


previewViewport.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        isPreviewDragging = true
        getgenv().jahvex_isPreviewDragging = true
        lastMousePos = input.Position
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        isPreviewDragging = false
        getgenv().jahvex_isPreviewDragging = false
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and isPreviewDragging then
        if lastMousePos then
            local delta = input.Position - lastMousePos
            camXRot = camXRot - delta.X * 0.8
            camYRot = math.clamp(camYRot - delta.Y * 0.8, -80, 80)
            jahvex_updatePreviewCamera()
        end
        lastMousePos = input.Position
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
        if wasInPreview then
            camDistanceMult = math.clamp(camDistanceMult - input.Position.Z * 0.4, 0.5, 8.0)
            jahvex_updatePreviewCamera()
        end
    end
end)
local function jahvex_showModelInPreview(srcModel)
    if not srcModel then return false end
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        wm.Parent = previewViewport
        previewWorldModel = wm

        local oldArch = srcModel.Archivable
        srcModel.Archivable = true
        local model = srcModel:Clone()
        srcModel.Archivable = oldArch

        if not model then return end

        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Anchored = true
            end
        end

        model.Parent = wm
        if model:IsA("Model") then
            pcall(function() model:PivotTo(CFrame.new()) end)
        end
        jahvex_fitPreviewModel(model)
        previewViewport.Visible = true
        ok = true
    end)
    return ok
end

local function jahvex_showWrapModelPreview(cosName)
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local info = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cosName]
        local tpl = jahvex_getAssetsFolder("Misc") and jahvex_getAssetsFolder("Misc"):FindFirstChild("Wrap")
        if not tpl then return end
        local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        wm.Parent = previewViewport
        previewWorldModel = wm
        local model = tpl:Clone()
        model.Parent = wm
        local parts = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end
        end
        table.sort(parts, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
        if info and info.WrapGroups then
            for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
                local g = info.WrapGroups[i] or info.WrapGroups[1]
                if type(g) == "table" then
                    if typeof(g.Color) == "Color3" then part.Color = g.Color end
                    if g.Material ~= nil then pcall(function() part.Material = g.Material end) end
                    if type(g.MaterialVariant) == "string" and g.MaterialVariant ~= "" then
                        pcall(function() part.MaterialVariant = g.MaterialVariant end)
                    end
                    if type(g.Reflectance) == "number" then part.Reflectance = g.Reflectance end
                    if type(g.Transparency) == "number" then part.Transparency = g.Transparency end
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function() model:PivotTo(CFrame.new()) end)
        jahvex_fitPreviewModel(model)
        previewViewport.Visible = true
        ok = true
    end)
    return ok
end

local function jahvex_showSkinModelPreview(cosName)
    local vmFolder = jahvex_getAssetsFolder("ViewModels")
    if not vmFolder then return false end
    local src = nil
    for _, d in ipairs(vmFolder:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == cosName then
            src = d
            break
        end
    end


    if not src then
        local info = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cosName]
        local baseName = info and info.ItemName
        if baseName then
            for _, d in ipairs(vmFolder:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == baseName then
                    src = d
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not src then return false end

    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        wm.Parent = previewViewport
        previewWorldModel = wm

        local oldArch = src.Archivable
        src.Archivable = true
        local model = src:Clone()
        src.Archivable = oldArch

        if not model then return end


        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Anchored = true
            end
        end

        model.Parent = wm


        local info = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cosName]
        if info and src.Name == info.ItemName then
            local skinImg = info.ImageHighResolution or info.Image
            if skinImg and skinImg ~= "" then
                for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        d.TextureID = skinImg
                    elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local tex = Instance.new("Texture")
                        tex.Texture = skinImg
                        tex.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                        tex.Parent = d
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if model:IsA("Model") then
            pcall(function() model:PivotTo(CFrame.new()) end)
        end
        jahvex_fitPreviewModel(model)
        previewViewport.Visible = true
        ok = true
    end)
    return ok
end

local function jahvex_showCharmModelPreview(cosName)
    local folder = jahvex_getAssetsFolder("Charms")
    local src = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(cosName)
    if not src then return false end

    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        wm.Parent = previewViewport
        previewWorldModel = wm
        local model = src:Clone()
        model.Parent = wm


        local charmImg = jahvex_getCharmTextureImage(cosName)
        if charmImg then
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    d.TextureID = charmImg
                elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local tex = Instance.new("Texture")
                    tex.Texture = charmImg
                    tex.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                    tex.Parent = d
                end
            end
        end

        if model:IsA("Model") then
            pcall(function() model:PivotTo(CFrame.new()) end)
        end
        jahvex_fitPreviewModel(model)
        previewViewport.Visible = true
        ok = true
    end)
    return ok
end

local function jahvex_updateCosmeticPreview(cosName)
    jahvex_clearCosmeticPreview()
    if not cosName then return end

    local info = nil
    pcall(function()
        info = CosmeticLibrary and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cosName]
    end)
    local cosType = info and tostring(info.Type or "") or ""

    if cosType == "Skin" then
        if jahvex_showSkinModelPreview(cosName) then
            return
        end
        local img = jahvex_getCosmeticImage(cosName)
        if img then
            jahvex_showImagePreview(img)
            return
        end
    end

    if cosType == "Wrap" then
        if jahvex_showWrapModelPreview(cosName) then
            return
        end
        local wrapImg = jahvex_getWrapTextureImage(cosName)
        if wrapImg then
            jahvex_showImagePreview(wrapImg)
            return
        end
    end

    if cosType == "Charm" then
        if jahvex_showCharmModelPreview(cosName) then
            return
        end
        local charmImg = jahvex_getCharmTextureImage(cosName)
        if charmImg then
            jahvex_showImagePreview(charmImg)
            return
        end
    end

    local img = jahvex_getCosmeticImage(cosName)
    if img then
        jahvex_showImagePreview(img)
    end
end

local currentSearchQuery = ""

local function filterItems()
    local q = currentSearchQuery:lower()
    for _, btn in ipairs(cosItemButtons) do
        if btn:GetAttribute("cosKind") == "header" then
        elseif btn:IsA("TextButton") then
            btn.Visible = q == "" or btn.Text:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
        end
    end
    local i = 1
    while i <= #cosItemButtons do
        local b = cosItemButtons[i]
        if b and b:GetAttribute("cosKind") == "header" then
            local any = false
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= #cosItemButtons do
                local n = cosItemButtons[j]
                if n:GetAttribute("cosKind") == "header" then break end
                if n.Visible then any = true end
                j = j + 1
            end
            b.Visible = any
            i = j
        else
            i = i + 1
        end
    end
end

searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    currentSearchQuery = searchBox.Text
    filterItems()
end)

function populateItems(cosType)
    for _, b in ipairs(cosItemButtons) do pcall(function() b:Destroy() end) end
    cosItemButtons = {}
    if cosPlaceholder then cosPlaceholder:Destroy() cosPlaceholder = nil end
    selectedCosItem = nil
    jahvex_clearCosmeticPreview()

    local grouped = (cosType == "Skin" or cosType == "Wrap") and (showAllCosList or not filterByWeapon)
    local rows = {}
    pcall(function()
        local lib = CosmeticLibrary
        if not (lib and lib.Cosmetics) then
            lib = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        end
        for name, data in pairs(lib.Cosmetics) do
            if tostring(data.Type or "") == cosType then
                local itemName = tostring(data.ItemName or "")
                local okRow = true
                if (not grouped) and (cosType == "Skin" or cosType == "Wrap") and filterByWeapon and selectedCosWeapon then
                    if itemName ~= selectedCosWeapon then okRow = false end
                end
                if okRow then
                    table.insert(rows, { name = name, item = itemName })
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    if grouped then
        table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
            if a.item ~= b.item then return a.item < b.item end
            return a.name < b.name
        end)
    else
        table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
    end

    if #rows == 0 then
        local noLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        noLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
        noLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        noLbl.Text = "No items found"
        noLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        noLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        noLbl.TextSize = 11
        noLbl.ZIndex = 4
        noLbl.Parent = cosItemsScrollFrame
        table.insert(cosItemButtons, noLbl)
        return
    end

    local function addHeader(text)
        local h = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        h.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
        h.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        h.Text = text
        h.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        h.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        h.TextSize = 11
        h.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        h.ZIndex = 4
        h.Parent = cosItemsScrollFrame
        pcall(function() h:SetAttribute("cosKind", "header") end)
        table.insert(cosItemButtons, h)
    end

    local lastItem = nil
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        if grouped and row.item ~= lastItem then
            lastItem = row.item
            addHeader(row.item ~= "" and row.item or "Other")
        end
        local cosName = row.name
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = "  " .. cosName
        btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        btn.TextSize = 11
        btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        btn.ZIndex = 4
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.Parent = cosItemsScrollFrame
        pcall(function() btn:SetAttribute("cosKind", "item") end)
        makeCorner(btn, 4)
        makeStroke(btn, BORDER, 1)
        local thisName = cosName
        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if selectedCosItem ~= thisName then btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_HOV end
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if selectedCosItem ~= thisName then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
                btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            end
        end)
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            for _, b in ipairs(cosItemButtons) do
                if b:IsA("TextButton") then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
                    b.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
                end
            end
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
            btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
            selectedCosItem = thisName
            if selectedCosType == "Skin" or selectedCosType == "Wrap" then
                pcall(function()
                    local d = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[thisName]
                    if d and d.ItemName and d.ItemName ~= "" then
                        selectedCosWeapon = d.ItemName
                    end
                end)
            end
            jahvex_updateCosmeticPreview(thisName)
        end)
        table.insert(cosItemButtons, btn)
    end
    filterItems()
end

        { label = "Jellyfish", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "jellyfish" },
        { label = "Spectre", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "spectre" },
        { label = "Iced Out", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "icedout" },
        { label = "Stealth M4", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "stealth" },
        { label = "Crown Sniper", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "crown" },
        { label = "Divine Intervention", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "divine" },

    local cfoMeleePresets = {
        { label = "Heartbreak", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "heartbreak_melee" },
        { label = "Lovely", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "lovely" },
        { label = "Rose", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "rose" },
        { label = "Mochi", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "mochi" },
        { label = "Blood Oath", mesh = "", tex = "", pack = "bloodoath_melee" },

    local function cfoPresetsForSlot(slot)
        if slot == "Melee" then return cfoMeleePresets end
        return cfoGunPresets
    end

    local function cfoPresetOpts(slot)
        local opts = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(cfoPresetsForSlot(slot)) do
            table.insert(opts, { label = p.label, value = p })
        end
        return opts
    end

    local function cfoRefreshPresetList()
        if not cfoPresetDrop then return end
        local src = cfoPresetsForSlot(cfoSlot)
        cfoPresetDrop:SetOptions(cfoPresetOpts(cfoSlot), true)
        local matched
        for _, p in ipairs(src) do
            if p.pack and p.pack == cfoPack then
                matched = p
                break
            end
            if not p.pack and (cfoPack == nil or cfoPack == "") and p.label == "Custom IDs" then
                matched = p
                break
            end
        end
        if matched then
            cfoPresetDrop:SetByValue(matched, false)
            return
        end
        local first = src[1]
        if not first then return end
        cfoPresetDrop:SetDisplay(first.label)
        cfoPack = first.pack
        if first.pack then
            cfoMeshId = ""
            cfoTexId = ""
            if cfoMeshBox then cfoMeshBox.Text = "" end
            if cfoTexBox then cfoTexBox.Text = "" end
        end
    end

    local function cfoAsset(id)
        id = tostring(id or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
        if id == "" then return "" end
        if id:find("rbxassetid://", 1, true) or id:find("rbxasset://", 1, true) then return id end
        local n = id:match("(%d+)")
        if n then return "rbxassetid://" .. n end
        return id
    end

    local function cfoFindGrip()
        local vms = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
        local fp = vms and vms:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson")
        if not fp then return nil end
        local prefer = { "RightItem", "LeftItem", "Handle" }
        for _, n in ipairs(prefer) do
            local inst = fp:FindFirstChild(n, true)
            if inst and inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(fp:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local ln = string.lower((d.Name:gsub("%s+", "")))
                if ln == "leftarm" or ln == "rightarm" or ln == "lefthand" or ln == "righthand" then
                    -- skip; No Arms hides these
                elseif d.Name ~= "Camera" and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    if string.find(ln, "item", 1, true) or string.find(ln, "handle", 1, true) then
                        return d
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function cfoWeaponModel(grip)
        local p = grip
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            if not p then break end
            if p.Parent and p.Parent.Name == "FirstPerson" then return p end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return grip.Parent
    end

    local function cfoIdNum(id)
        return tostring(id or ""):match("(%d+)")
    end

    local function cfoTryGet(id)
        local n = cfoIdNum(id)
        if not n then return nil end
        local urls = {
            "rbxassetid://" .. n,
            "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. n,
        }
        local fns = {}
        if typeof(getobjects) == "function" then
            for _, u in ipairs(urls) do
                table.insert(fns, function() return getobjects(u) end)
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            if game.GetObjects then
                for _, u in ipairs(urls) do
                    table.insert(fns, function() return game:GetObjects(u) end)
                end
            end
        end)
        for _, fn in ipairs(fns) do
            local ok, objs = pcall(fn)
            if ok and type(objs) == "table" and objs[1] then
                return objs[1]
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function cfoIsArmPart(part)
        local p = part
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            if not p then return false end
            local n = string.lower(p.Name)
            if n == "leftarm" or n == "rightarm" or n == "left arm" or n == "right arm" then
                return true
            end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function cfoRestoreVm()
        for p, ltm in pairs(cfoHidVm) do
            if p and p.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    p.LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm
                end)
            end
            if type(jahvex_uncoverLtm) == "function" then
                jahvex_uncoverLtm(p)
            end
        end
        table.clear(cfoHidVm)
    end

    local function cfoHideVmForGlass()
        if not cfoGlass then
            cfoRestoreVm()
            return
        end
        local vms = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
        local fp = vms and vms:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson")
        if not fp then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(fp:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and not cfoIsArmPart(d) then
                if cfoFolder and (d == cfoFolder or d:IsDescendantOf(cfoFolder)) then
                    -- skip overlay
                else
                    if cfoHidVm[d] == nil then
                        cfoHidVm[d] = d.LocalTransparencyModifier
                        if type(jahvex_coverLtm) == "function" then
                            jahvex_coverLtm(d, cfoHidVm[d])
                        end
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function cfoPrepPart(p)
        if not p or not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        p.Anchored = false
        p.Massless = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        pcall(function() p.CanQuery = false end)
        pcall(function() p.CanTouch = false end)
        pcall(function() p.Archivable = false end)
    end

    local function cfoSeal(folder, parent)
        if not folder then return end
        folder.Name = CFO_MODEL
        folder.Parent = parent
    end

    local function cfoDestroy()
        pcall(function()
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CFO_BIND)
        end)
        pcall(cfoRestoreVm)
        if cfoFolder then pcall(function() cfoFolder:Destroy() end) end
        cfoFolder, cfoWeld, cfoPart, cfoSm, cfoModel, cfoGripRef = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        cfoOrigParts = {}
    end

    local function cfoCaptureOrig()
        cfoOrigParts = {}
        local function take(p)
            if not p or not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
            local sm = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
            table.insert(cfoOrigParts, {
                part = p,
                size = p.Size,
                sm = sm,
                smScale = sm and sm.Scale or nil,
                trans = p.Transparency,
                mat = p.Material,
                color = p.Color,
                refl = p.Reflectance,
                mv = p.MaterialVariant,
                smTex = sm and sm.TextureId or "",
                mpTex = p:IsA("MeshPart") and p.TextureID or "",
            })
        end
        if cfoFolder then
            if cfoFolder:IsA("BasePart") then take(cfoFolder) end
            for _, d in ipairs(cfoFolder:GetDescendants()) do
                take(d)
            end
        elseif cfoPart then
            take(cfoPart)
        end
    end

    local function cfoScaleVec()
        local s = tonumber(cfoT.scale) or 0.25
        if s < 0.001 then s = 0.001 end
        local wid = tonumber(cfoT.wid) or 1
        local hgt = tonumber(cfoT.hgt) or 1
        local len = tonumber(cfoT.len) or 1
        if wid < 0.001 then wid = 0.001 end
        if hgt < 0.001 then hgt = 0.001 end
        if len < 0.001 then len = 0.001 end
        return s * wid, s * hgt, s * len
    end

    local function cfoStripSA(p)
        if not p then return end
        for _, ch in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                pcall(function()
                    ch:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function cfoAttachSA(p, rec)
        if not p or not p:IsA("MeshPart") or type(rec) ~= "table" then return end
        cfoStripSA(p)
        local function id(v)
            local n = tostring(v or ""):match("(%d+)")
            if n and n ~= "0" then return "rbxassetid://" .. n end
            return nil
        end
        local cm = id(rec.cm)
        if not cm then return end
        pcall(function()
            local sa = Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance")
            sa.ColorMap = cm
            local mm = id(rec.mm)
            local nm = id(rec.nm)
            local rm = id(rec.rm)
            if mm then sa.MetalnessMap = mm end
            if nm then sa.NormalMap = nm end
            if rm then sa.RoughnessMap = rm end
            pcall(function()
                sa.AlphaMode = Enum.AlphaMode.Overlay
            end)
            sa.Parent = p
        end)
    end

    local function cfoGameGlassSpec()
        local spec = {
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128),
            Transparency = 0.7,
            Reflectance = 0,
            Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
            MaterialVariant = "",
        }
        pcall(function()
            local CL = CosmeticLibrary
            if type(CL) ~= "table" then
                CL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
            end
            local info = CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics.Glass
            local groups = info and info.WrapGroups
            local g = groups and (groups[1] or groups["1"])
            if type(g) ~= "table" then return end
            if g.Material then spec.Material = g.Material end
            if type(g.MaterialVariant) == "string" then spec.MaterialVariant = g.MaterialVariant end
            spec.Reflectance = tonumber(g.Reflectance) or 0
        end)
        return spec
    end

    local function cfoPaintGlassPart(p, sm, spec)
        if not p or not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
            pcall(function()
                p.MaterialVariant = ""
            end)
            p.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            p.Reflectance = 0
            p.Transparency = 0.5
            p.TextureID = ""
            p.CastShadow = false
            pcall(function()
                p.DoubleSided = false
            end)
            for _, ch in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    pcall(function()
                        ch:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
            return
        end
        spec = spec or cfoGameGlassSpec()
        p.Material = spec.Material
        pcall(function()
            p.MaterialVariant = spec.MaterialVariant or ""
        end)
        p.Color = spec.Color
        p.Reflectance = spec.Reflectance
        p.Transparency = spec.Transparency
        if not (sm and sm.Parent) then
            sm = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
        end
        if sm then
            sm.TextureId = ""
            sm.VertexColor = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        end
    end

    local function cfoApplyGlassLook()
        local spec = cfoGlass and cfoGameGlassSpec() or nil
        for _, rec in ipairs(cfoOrigParts) do
            local p = rec.part
            if p and p.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    local hide = (tonumber(rec.trans) or 0) >= 0.99
                    if cfoGlass then
                        if hide then
                            p.Transparency = rec.trans
                            return
                        end
                        cfoPaintGlassPart(p, rec.sm, spec)
                    else
                        if rec.mat then p.Material = rec.mat end
                        if rec.color then p.Color = rec.color end
                        if rec.refl ~= nil then p.Reflectance = rec.refl end
                        if rec.trans ~= nil then p.Transparency = rec.trans end
                        if rec.mv ~= nil then
                            pcall(function()
                                p.MaterialVariant = rec.mv
                            end)
                        end
                        if p:IsA("MeshPart") and type(rec.mpTex) == "string" then
                            p.TextureID = rec.mpTex
                        end
                        if rec.sm and rec.sm.Parent and type(rec.smTex) == "string" then
                            rec.sm.TextureId = rec.smTex
                        end
                        pcall(cfoAttachSA, p, rec)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if cfoGlass and cfoPart and cfoPart.Parent and #cfoOrigParts == 0 then
            pcall(function()
                cfoPaintGlassPart(cfoPart, cfoSm, spec)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function cfoForceVis()
        local function vis(p)
            if not p or not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
            pcall(function()
                p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                p.CastShadow = false
            end)
        end
        if cfoFolder then
            if cfoFolder:IsA("BasePart") then vis(cfoFolder) end
            for _, d in ipairs(cfoFolder:GetDescendants()) do
                vis(d)
            end
        end
        cfoHideVmForGlass()
    end

    local function cfoApplyXform()
        local sx, sy, sz = cfoScaleVec()
        for _, rec in ipairs(cfoOrigParts) do
            local p = rec.part
            if p and p.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    p.Size = Vector3.new(rec.size.X * sx, rec.size.Y * sy, rec.size.Z * sz)
                    p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                end)
                if rec.packWeld and rec.packWeld.Parent and rec.rel then
                    local r = rec.rel
                    local rx, ry, rz, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i = r:GetComponents()
                    rec.packWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(rx * sx, ry * sy, rz * sz, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i)
                end
                if rec.sm and rec.sm.Parent and rec.smScale then
                    pcall(function()
                        rec.sm.Scale = Vector3.new(rec.smScale.X * sx, rec.smScale.Y * sy, rec.smScale.Z * sz)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        if cfoSm and cfoSm.Parent and #cfoOrigParts == 0 then
            cfoSm.Scale = Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz)
        end
        if cfoWeld and cfoWeld:IsA("Weld") and cfoWeld.Parent then
            cfoWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(cfoT.ox, cfoT.oy, cfoT.oz) * CFrame.Angles(
                math.rad(tonumber(cfoT.rx) or 0),
                math.rad(tonumber(cfoT.ry) or 0),
                math.rad(tonumber(cfoT.rz) or 0)
            )
            cfoWeld.C1 = CFrame.new()
        end
        cfoApplyGlassLook()
        cfoForceVis()
    end

    local function cfoWriteT(dst)
        if type(dst) ~= "table" then return end
        dst.scale = cfoT.scale
        dst.wid = cfoT.wid
        dst.hgt = cfoT.hgt
        dst.len = cfoT.len
        dst.ox = cfoT.ox
        dst.oy = cfoT.oy
        dst.oz = cfoT.oz
        dst.rx = cfoT.rx
        dst.ry = cfoT.ry
        dst.rz = cfoT.rz
    end

    local function cfoWeldTo(grip, part)
        local w = Instance.new("Weld")
        cfoWeld = w
        w.Part0 = grip
        w.Part1 = part
        w.Parent = part
        return w
    end

    local function cfoParseRow(s)
        local f = {}
        for v in string.gmatch(tostring(s), "([^,]+)") do
            f[#f + 1] = v
        end
        if #f < 26 then return nil end
        return {
            m = f[1], t = f[2], cm = f[3], mm = f[4], nm = f[5], rm = f[6],
            sx = tonumber(f[7]) or 1, sy = tonumber(f[8]) or 1, sz = tonumber(f[9]) or 1,
            x = tonumber(f[10]) or 0, y = tonumber(f[11]) or 0, z = tonumber(f[12]) or 0,
            r00 = tonumber(f[13]) or 1, r01 = tonumber(f[14]) or 0, r02 = tonumber(f[15]) or 0,
            r10 = tonumber(f[16]) or 0, r11 = tonumber(f[17]) or 1, r12 = tonumber(f[18]) or 0,
            r20 = tonumber(f[19]) or 0, r21 = tonumber(f[20]) or 0, r22 = tonumber(f[21]) or 1,
            cr = tonumber(f[22]) or 255, cg = tonumber(f[23]) or 255, cb = tonumber(f[24]) or 255,
            tr = tonumber(f[25]) or 0, mat = f[26],
        }
    end

    local function cfoMeshUrl(id)
        local n = tostring(id or ""):match("(%d+)")
        if not n then return "" end
        return "rbxassetid://" .. n
    end

    local function cfoTryMeshPart(meshId)
        local url = cfoMeshUrl(meshId)
        if url == "" then return nil end
        local mp
        local ok = pcall(function()
            mp = Instance.new("MeshPart")
            mp.Name = CFO_PART
            mp.MeshId = url
            pcall(function()
                mp.CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box
            end)
            pcall(function()
                mp.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic
            end)
            mp.DoubleSided = false
        end)
        if not ok or not mp then
            if mp then
                pcall(function()
                    mp:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            return nil
        end
        local id = tostring(mp.MeshId or "")
        local want = tostring(meshId or ""):match("(%d+)")
        if id == "" or string.find(id, "://0", 1, true) or (want and not string.find(id, want, 1, true)) then
            pcall(function()
                mp:Destroy()
            end)
            return nil
        end
        return mp
    end

    local function cfoMakePackPart(row)
        local p = cfoTryMeshPart(row.m)
        local sm = nil
        if not p then
            p = Instance.new("Part")
            sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            sm.MeshId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. tostring(row.m)
            sm.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            sm.Parent = p
            if row.t and row.t ~= "0" then
                sm.TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. row.t
            end
            p.Size = Vector3.new(row.sx, row.sy, row.sz)
        else
            if row.t and row.t ~= "0" then
                p.TextureID = "rbxassetid://" .. row.t
            else
                p.TextureID = ""
            end
        end
        p.Name = CFO_PART
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(row.cr, row.cg, row.cb)
        p.Transparency = row.tr
        local mat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        pcall(function()
            if row.mat and Enum.Material[row.mat] then
                mat = Enum.Material[row.mat]
            end
        end)
        p.Material = mat
        cfoPrepPart(p)
        if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
            cfoAttachSA(p, row)
        end
        return p, sm
    end

    local function cfoBuildPack(pack)
        if type(pack) ~= "table" or #pack < 1 then return false end
        local grip = cfoFindGrip()
        if not grip then return false end
        cfoGripRef = grip
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local folder = cfoFolder
        if not folder then
            folder = Instance.new("Model")
            cfoFolder = folder
            cfoSeal(folder, cam or grip)
        end
        local built = {}
        local primary, primMag = nil, 1e9
        for i = 1, #pack do
            local row = cfoParseRow(pack[i])
            if row then
                local part, sm = cfoMakePackPart(row)
                part.Parent = folder
                local rel = CFrame.new(row.x, row.y, row.z, row.r00, row.r01, row.r02, row.r10, row.r11, row.r12, row.r20, row.r21, row.r22)
                local mag = math.abs(row.x) + math.abs(row.y) + math.abs(row.z)
                table.insert(built, { part = part, sm = sm, row = row, rel = rel })
                if mag < primMag then
                    primMag = mag
                    primary = part
                end
            end
        end
        if not primary then return false end
        cfoPart = primary
        cfoWeldTo(grip, primary)
        cfoOrigParts = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(built) do
            local w
            if b.part ~= primary then
                w = Instance.new("Weld")
                w.Part0 = primary
                w.Part1 = b.part
                w.C0 = b.rel
                w.C1 = CFrame.new()
                w.Parent = b.part
            end
            table.insert(cfoOrigParts, {
                part = b.part,
                size = b.part.Size,
                sm = b.sm,
                smScale = (b.sm and b.sm.Scale) or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
                trans = b.row.tr,
                mat = b.part.Material,
                color = b.part.Color,
                refl = b.part.Reflectance,
                mv = b.part.MaterialVariant,
                smTex = b.sm and b.sm.TextureId or "",
                mpTex = b.part:IsA("MeshPart") and b.part.TextureID or "",
                cm = b.row.cm,
                mm = b.row.mm,
                nm = b.row.nm,
                rm = b.row.rm,
                packWeld = w,
                rel = b.rel,
            })
        end
        cfoApplyXform()
        return true
    end

    local function cfoBuild()
        cfoDestroy()
        local pack = cfoPack
        if type(pack) == "string" then
            pack = cfoPacks[pack]
        end
        if type(pack) == "table" and #pack > 0 then
            local grip = cfoFindGrip()
            if not grip then return false end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local folder = Instance.new("Model")
            cfoFolder = folder
            cfoSeal(folder, cam or grip)
            return cfoBuildPack(pack)
        end
        local grip = cfoFindGrip()
        if not grip then return false end
        cfoGripRef = grip
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local folder = Instance.new("Model")
        cfoFolder = folder
        cfoSeal(folder, cam or grip)

        local src = cfoTryGet(cfoMeshId)
        if src then
            local inst = src:Clone()
            inst.Name = CFO_PART
            inst.Parent = folder
            for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
                cfoPrepPart(d)
            end
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then cfoPrepPart(inst) end
            local primary = inst:IsA("Model") and (inst.PrimaryPart or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then primary = inst end
            if not primary then
                folder:Destroy()
                cfoFolder = nil
                return false
            end
            cfoPart = primary
            cfoModel = inst:IsA("Model") and inst or nil
            local tex = cfoAsset(cfoTexId)
            if tex ~= "" then
                if primary:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    pcall(function() primary.TextureID = tex end)
                end
                for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then d.TextureId = tex end
                    if d:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() d.TextureID = tex end) end
                end
            end
            cfoWeldTo(grip, primary)
            if cfoModel then
                pcall(function() folder.PrimaryPart = primary end)
            end
            cfoCaptureOrig()
            cfoApplyXform()
            return true
        end

        local mp
        pcall(function()
            mp = Instance.new("MeshPart")
            mp.Name = CFO_PART
            mp.MeshId = cfoAsset(cfoMeshId)
            local tex = cfoAsset(cfoTexId)
            if tex ~= "" then mp.TextureID = tex end
        end)
        if mp and mp.MeshId ~= "" then
            cfoPart = mp
            cfoPrepPart(mp)
            mp.Parent = folder
            cfoWeldTo(grip, mp)
            cfoCaptureOrig()
            cfoApplyXform()
            return true
        end
        if mp then pcall(function() mp:Destroy() end) end

        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        cfoPart = part
            part.Name = CFO_PART
        part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        part.Transparency = 1
        part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        cfoPrepPart(part)
        part.Parent = folder
        local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        cfoSm = sm
        sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        local n = cfoIdNum(cfoMeshId)
        sm.MeshId = n and ("http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. n) or cfoAsset(cfoMeshId)
        sm.TextureId = cfoAsset(cfoTexId)
        sm.Parent = part
        cfoWeldTo(grip, part)
        cfoCaptureOrig()
        cfoApplyXform()
        return true
    end

    local function cfoEquippedClass()
        local item = nil
        pcall(function()
            if type(jahvex_getEquippedItem) == "function" then
                item = jahvex_getEquippedItem()
            end
        end)
        local name, typ, cls
        if type(item) == "table" then
            name = item.Name
            typ = item.Type
            cls = item.Class
            if type(item.Info) == "table" then
                typ = typ or item.Info.Type
                cls = cls or item.Info.Class
            end
        end
        if cls == "Primary" or cls == "Secondary" or cls == "Melee" or cls == "Utility" then
            return cls
        end
        if typ == "Melee" then return "Melee" end
        if typ == "Utility" then return "Utility" end
        local IL = ItemLibrary
        if type(IL) == "table" and type(IL.Items) == "table" and type(name) == "string" then
            local info = IL.Items[name]
            if type(info) == "table" then
                local c = info.Class
                if c == "Primary" or c == "Secondary" or c == "Melee" or c == "Utility" then
                    return c
                end
                if info.Type == "Melee" then return "Melee" end
                if info.Type == "Utility" then return "Utility" end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function cfoAnyOn()
        for _, cfg in pairs(cfoSlotCfgs) do
            if cfg and cfg.on then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function cfoSaveSlot(slot)
        cfoSlotCfgs[slot] = {
            on = true,
            mesh = cfoMeshId,
            tex = cfoTexId,
            pack = cfoPack,
            glass = cfoGlass and true or false,
            T = {
                scale = cfoT.scale,
                wid = cfoT.wid,
                hgt = cfoT.hgt,
                len = cfoT.len,
                ox = cfoT.ox,
                oy = cfoT.oy,
                oz = cfoT.oz,
                rx = cfoT.rx,
                ry = cfoT.ry,
                rz = cfoT.rz,
            },
        }
    end

    local cfoBindVis
    local function cfoLoadCfg(cfg)
        if not cfg then return end
        if cfg.mesh ~= nil then cfoMeshId = cfg.mesh end
        if cfg.tex ~= nil then cfoTexId = cfg.tex end
        cfoPack = cfg.pack
        if cfg.glass ~= nil then
            cfoGlass = cfg.glass and true or false
            if cfoGlassToggle then
                pcall(function()
                    cfoGlassToggle:Set(cfoGlass, false)
                end)
            end
        end
        if type(cfg.T) == "table" then
            cfoT.scale = cfg.T.scale
            cfoT.wid = cfg.T.wid or 1
            cfoT.hgt = cfg.T.hgt or 1
            cfoT.len = cfg.T.len or 1
            cfoT.ox = cfg.T.ox
            cfoT.oy = cfg.T.oy
            cfoT.oz = cfg.T.oz
            cfoT.rx = cfg.T.rx or 0
            cfoT.ry = cfg.T.ry
            cfoT.rz = cfg.T.rz or 0
        end
    end

    local function cfoSync()
        if not cfoAnyOn() then
            cfoDestroy()
            cfoShowing = nil
            cfoApplied = false
            return
        end
        cfoApplied = true
        local cls = cfoEquippedClass()
        local cfg = cls and cfoSlotCfgs[cls]
        if not (cfg and cfg.on) then
            cfoDestroy()
            cfoShowing = nil
            return
        end
        local grip = cfoFindGrip()
        if not grip then
            pcall(cfoBindVis)
            pcall(cfoForceVis)
            return
        end
        local needBuild = (cfoShowing ~= cls)
            or not cfoPart or not cfoPart.Parent
            or not cfoFolder or not cfoFolder.Parent
        if cfoWeld and cfoWeld.Part0 ~= grip then
            needBuild = true
        end
        if needBuild then
            cfoLoadCfg(cfg)
            if cfoBuild() then
                cfoShowing = cls
            else
                cfoShowing = nil
            end
        end
        pcall(cfoBindVis)
        pcall(cfoForceVis)
    end

    cfoBindVis = function()
        pcall(function()
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CFO_BIND)
        end)
        if not cfoAnyOn() then return end
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(CFO_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
            if type(jahvex_isCurrent) == "function" and not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
            if not cfoFolder or not cfoFolder.Parent then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and cfoFolder.Parent ~= cam then
                pcall(function() cfoFolder.Parent = cam end)
            end
            cfoForceVis()
            local grip = cfoFindGrip()
            if grip and cfoPart and cfoPart.Parent then
                if not cfoWeld or not cfoWeld.Parent or cfoWeld.Part0 ~= grip then
                    pcall(function()
                        if cfoWeld then cfoWeld:Destroy() end
                    end)
                    cfoWeldTo(grip, cfoPart)
                    cfoApplyXform()
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function cfoMakeSlider(y, label, minV, maxV, step, getV, setV, fmt)
        local KW = 12
        makeLabel(cfoPanel, label, 12, y, cfoW - 50, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
        local valLbl = makeLabel(cfoPanel, "", 12, y + 13, cfoW, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
        valLbl.ZIndex = 10
        makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
        local tr = Instance.new("Frame")
        tr.Size = UDim2.new(0, cfoW, 0, 4)
        tr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
        tr.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        tr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        tr.ZIndex = 4
        tr.Parent = cfoPanel
        makeCorner(tr, 3)
        makeStroke(tr, BORDER, 1)
        local fi = Instance.new("Frame")
        fi.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        fi.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fi.ZIndex = 5
        fi.Parent = tr
        makeCorner(fi, 3)
        local kn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        kn.Size = UDim2.new(0, KW, 0, KW)
        kn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        kn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        kn.Text = ""
        kn.AutoButtonColor = false
        kn.ZIndex = 6
        kn.Parent = tr
        makeCorner(kn, KW / 2)
        makeStroke(kn, BORDER, 1)
        local function applyFrac(frac)
            frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
            local raw = minV + frac * (maxV - minV)
            local v = math.floor(raw / step + 0.5) * step
            v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
            setV(v)
            frac = (v - minV) / (maxV - minV)
            fi.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            kn.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KW / 2, 0.5, -KW / 2)
            valLbl.Text = (fmt and fmt(v)) or tostring(v)
            local cfg = cfoSlotCfgs[cfoSlot]
            if cfg and cfg.on and cfg.T then
                cfoWriteT(cfg.T)
            end
            if cfoShowing == cfoSlot then cfoApplyXform() end
        end
        applyFrac((getV() - minV) / math.max(maxV - minV, 1e-9))
        table.insert(cfoSliderRefresh, function()
            applyFrac((getV() - minV) / math.max(maxV - minV, 1e-9))
        end)
        local drag = false
        kn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true end
        end)
        tr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                drag = true
                applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if drag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                if drag then
                    drag = false
                    pcall(saveConfig)
                else
                    drag = false
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function cfoMakeBox(y, placeholder, getText, onCommit)
        local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
        box.Size = UDim2.new(0, cfoW, 0, 24)
        box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        box.Text = getText()
        box.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
        box.PlaceholderColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        box.TextSize = 11
        box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        box.ZIndex = 3
        box.Parent = cfoPanel
        pcall(function() box:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
        makeCorner(box, 6)
        makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            onCommit(box.Text)
            pcall(saveConfig)
        end)
        return box
    end

    jahvexUiRefs.cfoGlassToggle = cfoGlassToggle
    cy = cy + 28

    makeLabel(cfoPanel, "Custom Mesh ID", 12, cy, cfoW, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM)
    cy = cy + 14

        cfoMeshId = t

        if cfg and cfg.on then
            cfg.mesh = t
            if cfoShowing == cfoSlot then cfoSync() end
        end

    cy = cy + 30
    makeLabel(cfoPanel, "Custom Texture ID", 12, cy, cfoW, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM)

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not cfoAnyOn() then return end

    getgenv().jahvex_cfoSave = function()
        local slots = {}
        for k, cfg in pairs(cfoSlotCfgs) do
            if type(cfg) == "table" then
                slots[k] = {
                    on = cfg.on and true or false,
                    mesh = cfg.mesh,
                    tex = cfg.tex,
                    pack = cfg.pack,
                    glass = cfg.glass and true or false,
                    T = cfoCopyT(cfg.T or cfoT),
                }
            end
        end
        return {
            slot = cfoSlot,
            mesh = cfoMeshId,
            tex = cfoTexId,
            pack = cfoPack,
            glass = cfoGlass and true or false,
            T = cfoCopyT(cfoT),
            slots = slots,
        }
    end
    getgenv().jahvex_cfoLoad = function(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
        if type(t.T) == "table" then
            cfoT.scale = tonumber(t.T.scale) or cfoT.scale
            cfoT.wid = tonumber(t.T.wid) or cfoT.wid
            cfoT.hgt = tonumber(t.T.hgt) or cfoT.hgt
            cfoT.len = tonumber(t.T.len) or cfoT.len
            cfoT.ox = tonumber(t.T.ox) or cfoT.ox
            cfoT.oy = tonumber(t.T.oy) or cfoT.oy
            cfoT.oz = tonumber(t.T.oz) or cfoT.oz
            cfoT.rx = tonumber(t.T.rx) or cfoT.rx or 0
            cfoT.ry = tonumber(t.T.ry) or cfoT.ry
            cfoT.rz = tonumber(t.T.rz) or cfoT.rz or 0
        end
        if t.mesh ~= nil then cfoMeshId = tostring(t.mesh) end
        if t.tex ~= nil then cfoTexId = tostring(t.tex) end
        if t.pack ~= nil then cfoPack = t.pack end
        if t.glass ~= nil then cfoGlass = t.glass and true or false end
        if type(t.slots) == "table" then
            for k, cfg in pairs(t.slots) do
                if type(cfg) == "table" then
                    cfoSlotCfgs[k] = {
                        on = cfg.on and true or false,
                        mesh = cfg.mesh,
                        tex = cfg.tex,
                        pack = cfg.pack,
                        glass = cfg.glass and true or false,
                        T = cfoCopyT(cfg.T or t.T or cfoT),
                    }
                end
            end
        end
        if type(t.slot) == "string" and cfoSlotCfgs[t.slot] then
            cfoSlot = t.slot
        end
        local cur = cfoSlotCfgs[cfoSlot]
        if cur then pcall(cfoLoadCfg, cur) end
        if cfoGlassToggle then
            pcall(function()
                cfoGlassToggle:Set(cfoGlass, false)
            end)
        end
        if cfoMeshBox then cfoMeshBox.Text = tostring(cfoMeshId or "") end
        if cfoTexBox then cfoTexBox.Text = tostring(cfoTexId or "") end
        for n, b in pairs(cfoSlotBtns) do
            if b then b.TextColor3 = (n == cfoSlot) and GREEN or TEXT_W end
        end
        for _, fn in ipairs(cfoSliderRefresh) do pcall(fn) end
        cfoSync()
    end
    pcall(function()
        local extra = jahvexConfigExtra or getgenv().jahvexConfigExtra
        if type(extra) == "table" and type(extra.cfo) == "table" then
            getgenv().jahvex_cfoLoad(extra.cfo)
        end
    end)
end

    local allTypes = {"Skin", "Wrap", "Charm", "Finisher", "Emote"}

        for _, t in ipairs(allTypes) do unlockedTypes[t] = true end
    else
        for _, t in ipairs(allTypes) do unlockedTypes[t] = nil end
        unlockedTypeRarities = {}
    end
    cachedProxy = nil
    pcall(function() jahvex_localDataTouch("WeaponInventory") end)
end

local animChangerMainGun = "Assault Rifle"
local animChangerTarget = "Event Horizon"
local animChangerReload = false
local animChangerShoot = false
local animChangerScope = false
local animChangerInspect = false

local animChangerReloadVoice = false
local animChangerScopeVoice = false
local animChangerInspectVoice = false

_G.jahvex_animBackup = _G.jahvex_animBackup or {}
_G.jahvex_soundBackup = _G.jahvex_soundBackup or {}

function jahvex_applyAnimChanger()
    pcall(function()
        local AL = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.AnimationLibrary)

        for origKey, backupId in pairs(_G.jahvex_animBackup) do
            if AL.Info[origKey] then
                AL.Info[origKey].AnimationID = backupId
            end
        end
        _G.jahvex_animBackup = {}

        for origKey, backupSound in pairs(_G.jahvex_soundBackup) do
            if AL.Info[origKey] then
                if backupSound == "NONE" then
                    AL.Info[origKey].SoundCallback = nil
                else
                    AL.Info[origKey].SoundCallback = backupSound
                end
            end
        end
        _G.jahvex_soundBackup = {}

        if not (animChangerMainGun and animChangerTarget) then return end
        if animChangerMainGun == "" or animChangerTarget == "" then return end

        local mainBase = animChangerMainGun:lower():gsub("%s", "")

        local CL = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local targetPrefix = ""
        local info = CL.Cosmetics[animChangerTarget]
        if info and info.ItemName then
            local base = info.ItemName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
            local skin = animChangerTarget:lower():gsub("%s", "")
            targetPrefix = base .. "_" .. skin
        else
            targetPrefix = animChangerTarget:lower():gsub("%s", "")
        end

        local map = {}
        if animChangerReload then table.insert(map, "reload"); table.insert(map, "reload_empty") end
        if animChangerShoot then table.insert(map, "shoot1"); table.insert(map, "shoot2") end
        if animChangerScope then table.insert(map, "equip"); table.insert(map, "sprint") end
        if animChangerInspect then table.insert(map, "inspect") end

        for _, action in ipairs(map) do
            local sourceKey = targetPrefix .. "_" .. action
            local sourceData = AL.Info[sourceKey]
            if sourceData then
                for k, v in pairs(AL.Info) do
                    if k:match("^" .. mainBase .. "_.*" .. action .. "$") or k == (mainBase .. "_" .. action) then
                        if not _G.jahvex_animBackup[k] then
                            _G.jahvex_animBackup[k] = v.AnimationID
                        end
                        v.AnimationID = sourceData.AnimationID

                        local doVoice = false
                        if action == "reload" or action == "reload_empty" then doVoice = animChangerReloadVoice end
                        if action == "equip" or action == "sprint" then doVoice = animChangerScopeVoice end
                        if action == "inspect" then doVoice = animChangerInspectVoice end

                        if doVoice then
                            if not _G.jahvex_soundBackup[k] then
                                _G.jahvex_soundBackup[k] = v.SoundCallback or "NONE"
                            end
                            v.SoundCallback = sourceData.SoundCallback
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

pcall(function()

            local base = v.ItemName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
            local skin = tostring(k):lower():gsub("%s", "")
            local prefix = base .. "_" .. skin
            if AL.Info[prefix .. "_reload"] or AL.Info[prefix .. "_inspect"] then
                table.insert(animChangerSkins, { label = tostring(k), value = tostring(k) })
            end
        end
    end
end)

    table.insert(animChangerSkins, { label = c.label .. " (Default)", value = c.value })
end
