            local _rbSpecOob
            local _rbSpecRay = RaycastParams.new()
            _rbSpecRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            _rbSpecRay.IgnoreWater = true
            local function rbSpecMapSafe(pos)
                if typeof(pos) ~= 'Vector3' then return false end
                if rbDesyncIsVoid(pos) then return false end
                local fh = WorkspaceRB.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
                if type(fh) == 'number' and fh == fh and pos.Y < (fh + 10) then
                    return false
                end
                local oob = false
                pcall(function()
                    if not _rbSpecOob then
                        _rbSpecOob = require(ReplicatedStorageRB.Modules.GameplayUtility)
                    end
                    if _rbSpecOob and type(_rbSpecOob.IsWithinOOBPart) == 'function' then
                        oob = _rbSpecOob:IsWithinOOBPart(pos) and true or false
                    end
                end)
                return not oob
            end
            local function rbSpecPullInMap(pos, anchor)
                if rbSpecMapSafe(pos) then return pos end
                if typeof(anchor) ~= 'Vector3' then return pos end
                for t = 0.9, 0.12, -0.13 do
                    local p = anchor + (pos - anchor) * t
                    if rbSpecMapSafe(p) then return p end
                end
                local up = Vector3.new(anchor.X, anchor.Y + 8, anchor.Z)
                if rbSpecMapSafe(up) then return up end
                return Vector3.new(anchor.X, anchor.Y + 6, anchor.Z)
            end
            local function rbSpecLook(pos, lookAt)
                if typeof(lookAt) ~= 'Vector3' then
                    return CFrame.new(pos)
                end
                if (pos - lookAt).Magnitude < 0.05 then
                    return CFrame.new(pos)
                end
                return CFrame.lookAt(pos, lookAt)
            end
            local function rbSpecAbove(anchor, height, lookAt, exclude)
                local want = Vector3.new(anchor.X, anchor.Y + height, anchor.Z)
                _rbSpecRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude or {}
                local hit = WorkspaceRB:Raycast(anchor + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), Vector3.new(0, height + 6, 0), _rbSpecRay)
                if hit then
                    want = Vector3.new(want.X, math.min(want.Y, hit.Position.Y - 1.35), want.Z)
                end
                for h = height, 3, -1 do
                    local p = Vector3.new(anchor.X, math.min(anchor.Y + h, want.Y), anchor.Z)
                    p = rbSpecPullInMap(p, anchor)
                    if rbSpecMapSafe(p) then
                        return rbSpecLook(p, lookAt)
                    end
                end
                return rbSpecLook(rbSpecPullInMap(Vector3.new(anchor.X, anchor.Y + 4, anchor.Z), anchor), lookAt)
            end
            local function rbEnemyWeaponKey(target)
                local n = string.lower(tostring(target and target.equippedName or ''))
                local ty = string.lower(tostring(target and target.equippedType or ''))
                if n == '' and ty == '' then return 'none', n end
                if string.find(n, 'katana', 1, true) or string.find(n, 'riot', 1, true) then
                    return 'parry', n
                end
                if n == 'rpg' or n == 'grenade launcher' then
                    return 'high', n
                end
                if n == 'maul' then
                    return 'high', n
                end
                if ty == 'melee' or n == 'knife' or n == 'fists' or n == 'chainsaw' or n == 'scythe'
                    or n == 'trowel' or n == 'spear' or n == 'daggers' or n == 'glast shard'
                    or n == 'battle axe' or string.find(n, 'axe', 1, true) then
                    return 'melee', n
                end
                return 'none', n
            end
            local function rbSpecialGunCf(target)
                if not target or not target.rootPart then return nil end
                local kind = rbEnemyWeaponKey(target)
                local head = target.hitboxHead or target.rootPart
                local look = head.Position
                local root = target.rootPart
                local exclude = { LPRB.Character, target.model }
                if kind == 'parry' then
                    local step = math.floor(os.clock() / 0.1) % 4
                    local dist = 7.5
                    local cf = root.CFrame
                    local off
                    if step == 0 then
                        off = cf.RightVector * dist
                    elseif step == 1 then
                        off = cf.LookVector * dist
                    elseif step == 2 then
                        off = -cf.RightVector * dist
                    else
                        off = -cf.LookVector * dist
                    end
                    local pos = rbSpecPullInMap(root.Position + off + Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0), root.Position)
                    return rbSpecLook(pos, look)
                end
                if kind == 'high' then
                    return rbSpecAbove(root.Position, 15, look, exclude)
                end
                if kind == 'melee' then
                    return rbSpecAbove(root.Position, 13, look, exclude)
                end
                return nil
            end
            local SpatialLimitGate = {}
            SpatialLimitGate.__index = SpatialLimitGate
            function SpatialLimitGate.new()
                return setmetatable({ _measurements = {} }, SpatialLimitGate)
            end
            function SpatialLimitGate:Tick(target)
                local key = target.fighter or target
                local m = self._measurements[key]
                if m == nil then
                    m = { expectedDuration = 1 }
                    self._measurements[key] = m
                end
                local now = os.clock()
                local entry = m.limitEntryTime
                local hasAmmo = target.equippedAmmoState ~= false
                if not outOfSpatialBound(target.rootPart.Position) then
                    if entry ~= nil then
                        if hasAmmo then
                            m.expectedDuration = now - entry
                        end
                        m.limitEntryTime = nil
                    end
                    return false
                end
                if entry == nil then
                    m.limitEntryTime = now
                    entry = now
                end
                if hasAmmo and (m.expectedDuration - Setting.Stability()) <= (now - entry) then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end

            -- ---- defensive module (Kicia t156, lines 151628-151664) ----------------------
            local function localShieldStance(fighter)
                local items = fighter and rawget(fighter, 'Items') or nil
                if type(items) ~= 'table' then
                    return 'None'
                end
                for _, item in next, items do
                    if type(item) == 'table' and itemName(item) == 'Riot Shield' then
                        if itemIsEquipped(item) then
                            return 'Equipped'
                        end
                        return 'Unequipped'
                    end
                end
                return 'None'
            end
            local function getDefensiveCFrame(cframe, stance, targetRootPart)
                if stance == 'Equipped' then
                    return CFrame.new(cframe.Position, targetRootPart.Position)
                end
                if stance == 'Unequipped' then
                    return CFrame.new(cframe.Position, cframe.Position + (cframe.Position - targetRootPart.Position))
                end
                return cframe
            end
            local function getDefensiveViewAngles(stance)
                if stance == 'None' then
                    return nil
                end
                local pitch = (stance == 'Equipped') and 90 or -90
                return { kind = 'Normalized', pitch = pitch, yaw = rbRandom:NextNumber(0, 360) }
            end

            -- ---- evasion (Kicia f573 / f4230 / t167 / t103) ------------------------------
            local FAR_AXIS = 1073741824
            local function ringPoint(anchor, minR, maxR)
                local angle = rbRandom:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi)
                local radius = rbRandom:NextNumber(minR, maxR)
                return CFrame.new(anchor + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius))
                    * CFrame.fromOrientation(
                        rbRandom:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi),
                        rbRandom:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi),
                        rbRandom:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi)
                    )
            end
            local function scatterFar(pos, anchorFromCharacter, baseRadius, radiusFactor)
                local extra = baseRadius * radiusFactor
                local anchor = anchorFromCharacter and pos or Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, 0)
                local ring = ringPoint(anchor, baseRadius, baseRadius + extra)
                local ringPos = ring.Position
                local x, y, z = ringPos.X, ringPos.Y, ringPos.Z
                local pick = rbRandom:NextInteger(1, 3)
                if pick == 1 then
                    x = FAR_AXIS
                elseif pick == 2 then
                    y = FAR_AXIS
                else
                    z = FAR_AXIS
                end
                return ring - ringPos + Vector3.new(x, y, z)
            end
            local function randomEvade(clientCF)
                return scatterFar(clientCF.Position, Setting.RandomAnchorFromCharacter(), Setting.RandomBaseRadius(), Setting.RandomRadiusFactor())
            end
            local function translocateEvade(clientCF, hasTargetsNow)
                -- Kicia fallback (t103.compute): a far ring-scatter (v107(pos, 10000, 1e9)).
                if not hasTargetsNow then
                    return ringPoint(clientCF.Position, 10000, 1000000000)
                end
                local chosen = nil
                for _, part in ipairs(CollectionServiceRB:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsPart')) do
                    if part:GetAttribute('KillDelay') == 0 then
                        chosen = part
                        break
                    end
                end
                if chosen == nil then
                    return ringPoint(clientCF.Position, 10000, 1000000000)
                end
                return chosen.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -chosen.Size.Y / 2 + Setting.TranslocateOffset(), 0)
            end
            local function depthOsc(range, freq)
                return range.Min + (range.Max - range.Min) * ((math.sin(os.clock() * (2 * math.pi * freq)) + 1) * 0.5)
            end
            local function surfaceCFrame(surface, up, forward)
                return CFrame.fromMatrix(
                    surface.surfacePosition - surface.up * 0.01 - surface.up * up + surface.forward * forward,
                    surface.right,
                    surface.up,
                    -surface.forward
                )
            end
            local PB_OVERLAP = OverlapParams.new()
            PB_OVERLAP.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            PB_OVERLAP.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}
            PB_OVERLAP.BruteForceAllSlow = true
            local PB_PROBE_SIZE = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
            local function isBoundaryPart(part)
                return part.Name == 'Barriers' or part:HasTag('OutOfBoundsPart') or part:HasTag('KillBrick')
            end
            local function hasBoundaryNear(pos)
                for _, part in ipairs(WorkspaceRB:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(pos), PB_PROBE_SIZE, PB_OVERLAP)) do
                    if isBoundaryPart(part) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            -- Kicia's f6204 (surface descriptor from a part face) is erased; reconstructed as the
            -- part's top-face frame - the only shape consistent with surfaceCFrame's fields.
            local function describeSurface(part)
                local cf = part.CFrame
                return {
                    surfacePosition = (cf * CFrame.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0)).Position,
                    up = cf.UpVector,
                    right = cf.RightVector,
                    forward = cf.LookVector,
                }
            end
            local ProjectileBreaker = {}
            ProjectileBreaker.__index = ProjectileBreaker
            function ProjectileBreaker.new()
                return setmetatable({
                    _nextPositionCooldown = -1,
                    _poolEnvironmentID = nil,
                    _pool = {},
                    _processedParts = {},
                    _lastBreakSurface = nil,
                }, ProjectileBreaker)
            end
            function ProjectileBreaker:BindEnvironment(envId)
                self._poolEnvironmentID = envId
                self._pool = {}
                self._processedParts = {}
            end
            function ProjectileBreaker:_HasProjectileThreat()
                for _, entry in ipairs(collectEnemies()) do
                    if entry.equippedGunProjectile then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            function ProjectileBreaker:_ScanBatch(envId)
                local depthForwardMax = PB_DEPTH_FORWARD.Min + PB_DEPTH_FORWARD.Max
                local upMid = (PB_DEPTH_UP.Min + PB_DEPTH_UP.Max) * 0.5
                local forwardMid = depthForwardMax * 0.5
                local scanned = 0
                local function consider(part)
                    if not (part:IsA('BasePart') and not self._processedParts[part]) then
                        return
                    end
                    self._processedParts[part] = true
                    scanned = scanned + 1
                    local surface = describeSurface(part)
                    if hasBoundaryNear(surfaceCFrame(surface, upMid, forwardMid).Position) then
                        return
                    end
                    self._pool[#self._pool + 1] = surface
                end
                for _, tagged in ipairs(CollectionServiceRB:GetTagged('RaycastWhitelist' .. tostring(envId))) do
                    if not isBoundaryPart(tagged) then
                        consider(tagged)
                        if 64 <= scanned or 30 <= #self._pool then
                            return
                        end
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(tagged:GetDescendants()) do
                            if not isBoundaryPart(descendant) then
                                consider(descendant)
                                if 64 <= scanned or 30 <= #self._pool then
                                    return
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            function ProjectileBreaker:_BreakLine()
                local envId = self._poolEnvironmentID
                if envId == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                if #self._pool < 30 then
                    self:_ScanBatch(envId)
                end
                if #self._pool < 30 then
                    return nil
                end
                self._nextPositionCooldown = os.clock() + Setting.RepositionInterval()
                return self._pool[rbRandom:NextInteger(1, #self._pool)]
            end
            function ProjectileBreaker:Compute(clientCF)
                if os.clock() < self._nextPositionCooldown then
                    local last = self._lastBreakSurface
                    if last ~= nil then
                        return surfaceCFrame(last, depthOsc(PB_DEPTH_UP, PB_DEPTH_UP_FREQ), depthOsc(PB_DEPTH_FORWARD, PB_DEPTH_FORWARD_FREQ))
                    end
                end
                if not self:_HasProjectileThreat() then
                    self._lastBreakSurface = nil
                    return scatterFar(clientCF.Position, PB_FALLBACK_ANCHOR_FROM_CHARACTER, PB_FALLBACK_BASE_RADIUS, PB_FALLBACK_RADIUS_FACTOR)
                end
                local breakLine = self:_BreakLine()
                if breakLine == nil then
                    return scatterFar(clientCF.Position, PB_FALLBACK_ANCHOR_FROM_CHARACTER, PB_FALLBACK_BASE_RADIUS, PB_FALLBACK_RADIUS_FACTOR)
                end
                self._lastBreakSurface = breakLine
                return surfaceCFrame(breakLine, depthOsc(PB_DEPTH_UP, PB_DEPTH_UP_FREQ), depthOsc(PB_DEPTH_FORWARD, PB_DEPTH_FORWARD_FREQ))
            end
            function ProjectileBreaker:ResetState()
                self._nextPositionCooldown = -1
                self._lastBreakSurface = nil
            end

            -- ---- firing strategies (Kicia t96 hitscan / t98 melee) -----------------------
            local function farMiss()
                return CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-1000000, 1000000),
                    math.random(5000, 10000),
                    math.random(-1000000, 1000000)
                )
            end
            local HitscanStrategy = {}
            HitscanStrategy.__index = HitscanStrategy
            function HitscanStrategy.new(partGlue)
                return setmetatable({ _partGlue = partGlue, _shootLock = ShootLock.new() }, HitscanStrategy)
            end
            function HitscanStrategy:Plan(dt, target, item, ourRootPart, canFire)
                local hitboxHead = target.hitboxHead
                local special = rbSpecialGunCf(target)
                local cframe
                local fromAbove = true
                if special then
                    cframe = special
                else
                    local above = isAbove(target)
                    fromAbove = above
                    local offset = above and OFFSET_ABOVE or OFFSET_BELOW
                    local void = self._partGlue:Acquire(ourRootPart, hitboxHead)
                    self._gluedOurPart = ourRootPart
                    if above then
                        cframe = void + offset
                    else
                        cframe = CFrame.new(void.Position + offset, hitboxHead.Position)
                    end
                end
                if not self._shootLock:ShouldFire(canFire, dt * Setting.ShootFrames()) then
                    if special then
                        return special, nil, true
                    end
                    return farMiss(), nil, false
                end
                local _, oy, oz = target.rootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
                local pitch = fromAbove and PITCH_ABOVE or PITCH_BELOW
                local aim1 = buildAim(fromAbove and AIM_ABOVE_ORIGIN or AIM_BELOW_ORIGIN, pitch, oy, oz)
                local aim2 = buildAim(fromAbove and AIM_ABOVE_END or AIM_BELOW_END, pitch, oy, oz)
                local objectId = itemObjectId(item)
                local isRaycast = itemIsRaycast(item)
                local function weaponAction()
                    fireGun(objectId, isRaycast, aim1, aim2, hitboxHead, AIM_EXTRA)
                end
                return cframe, weaponAction, special ~= nil
            end
            function HitscanStrategy:ResetState()
                self._shootLock:Reset()
                local glued = self._gluedOurPart
                if glued ~= nil then
                    self._partGlue:Free(glued)
                    self._gluedOurPart = nil
                end
            end

            local BACKSTAB_WINDOW = 0.625
            local BACKSTAB_COOLDOWN = 1.25
            local MeleeStrategy = {}
            MeleeStrategy.__index = MeleeStrategy
            function MeleeStrategy.new(partGlue)
                return setmetatable({
                    _partGlue = partGlue,
                    _shootLock = ShootLock.new(),
                    _hitboxWindowUntil = -1,
                    _attackCooldown = -1,
                }, MeleeStrategy)
            end
            local function meleeViewAngles(px, oy)
                return { kind = 'Normalized', pitch = math.deg(px), yaw = math.deg(oy) }
            end
            function MeleeStrategy:_RecordBackstab()
                local now = os.clock()
                self._hitboxWindowUntil = now + BACKSTAB_WINDOW
                self._attackCooldown = now + BACKSTAB_COOLDOWN
            end
            function MeleeStrategy:Plan(dt, target, item, ourRootPart, canFire)
                local hitboxHead = target.hitboxHead
                local above = isAbove(target)
                local offset = above and OFFSET_ABOVE or OFFSET_BELOW
                local void = self._partGlue:Acquire(ourRootPart, hitboxHead)
                self._gluedOurPart = ourRootPart
                local cframe
                if above then
                    cframe = void + offset
                else
                    cframe = CFrame.new(void.Position + offset, hitboxHead.Position)
                end
                local px, oy, oz = target.rootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
                local pitch = above and PITCH_ABOVE or PITCH_BELOW
                local aim1 = buildAim(above and AIM_ABOVE_ORIGIN or AIM_BELOW_ORIGIN, pitch, oy, oz)
                local aim2 = buildAim(above and AIM_ABOVE_END or AIM_BELOW_END, pitch, oy, oz)
                local objectId = itemObjectId(item)
                local now = os.clock()
                if now < self._hitboxWindowUntil then
                    return cframe, meleeViewAngles(px, oy), function()
                        fireMeleeHeavy(objectId, aim1, aim2, hitboxHead, AIM_EXTRA)
                    end
                end
                if not self._shootLock:ShouldFire(canFire, dt * Setting.ShootFrames()) then
                    return farMiss(), nil, nil
                end
                if now < self._attackCooldown then
                    return farMiss(), nil, nil
                end
                if itemName(item) ~= 'Knife' then
                    return cframe, nil, function()
                        fireMeleeAttack(objectId, aim1, aim2, hitboxHead, AIM_EXTRA)
                    end
                end
                self:_RecordBackstab()
                return cframe, meleeViewAngles(px, oy), function()
                    fireMeleeHeavy(objectId, aim1, aim2, hitboxHead, AIM_EXTRA)
                end
            end
            function MeleeStrategy:ResetState()
                self._hitboxWindowUntil = -1
                self._attackCooldown = -1
                self._shootLock:Reset()
                local glued = self._gluedOurPart
                if glued ~= nil then
                    self._partGlue:Free(glued)
                    self._gluedOurPart = nil
                end
            end

            -- ---- FFlag environment toggles (Kicia SetEnabled, lines 63538-63571) ----------
            local ORIGINAL_FALLEN_PARTS_HEIGHT = nil
            local function applyEnabledFFlags(enabled)
                if enabled and ORIGINAL_FALLEN_PARTS_HEIGHT == nil then
                    ORIGINAL_FALLEN_PARTS_HEIGHT = WorkspaceRB.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
                end
                pcall(function()
                    WorkspaceRB.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = enabled and (0 / 0) or (ORIGINAL_FALLEN_PARTS_HEIGHT or -500)
                end)
                if rbSetFFlag then
                    pcall(rbSetFFlag, 'DFIntS2PhysicsSenderRate', enabled and '120' or '15')
                    pcall(rbSetFFlag, 'DFIntAssemblyHistoryBufferSize', enabled and '2147483648' or '15')
                    pcall(rbSetFFlag, 'DFIntAssemblyHistorySkipSize', enabled and '0' or '8')
                end
            end

            -- ---- controller (Kicia t1, lines 63573-63758) --------------------------------
            local Controller = {}
            Controller.__index = Controller
            function Controller.new()
                local partGlue = PartGlue.new()
                return setmetatable({
                    _enabled = false,
                    _partGlue = partGlue,
                    _hitscanStrategy = HitscanStrategy.new(partGlue),
                    _meleeStrategy = MeleeStrategy.new(partGlue),
                    _projectileBreaker = ProjectileBreaker.new(),
                    _spatialLimitGate = SpatialLimitGate.new(),
                    _stateHook = StateHook.new(),
                    _characterController = nil,
                    _boundRootPart = nil,
                    _lastTargetWorld = nil,
                    _lastDefensiveViewAngles = nil,
                }, Controller)
            end
            function Controller:SetEnabled(enabled)
                if self._enabled == enabled then
                    return
                end
                self._enabled = enabled
                applyEnabledFFlags(enabled)
                self:_Reset()
            end
            function Controller:_ApplyForcedCrouch(on)
                if on then
                    self._stateHook:SetForced('IsCrouching', true)
                else
                    self._stateHook:ClearForced('IsCrouching', false)
                end
            end
            function Controller:_EnsureCharacterController()
                local Char, HumanoidRootPart = GetChar(), GetRoot()
                if not HumanoidRootPart or HumanoidRootPart.Parent ~= Char then
                    if self._characterController then
                        self._characterController:Destroy()
                        self._characterController = nil
                        self._boundRootPart = nil
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                if self._characterController == nil or self._boundRootPart ~= HumanoidRootPart then
                    if self._characterController then
                        self._characterController:Destroy()
                    end
                    self._characterController = CharacterController.new(HumanoidRootPart)
                    self._boundRootPart = HumanoidRootPart
                end
                return self._characterController
            end
            function Controller:_EvadePlan(clientCF, mode)
                if mode == 'Off' then
                    return {}
                end
                if mode ~= 'ProjectileBreaker' then
                    return { cframe = randomEvade(clientCF) }
                end
                return { cframe = self._projectileBreaker:Compute(clientCF), shouldSkipDefense = true }
            end
            function Controller:_Plan(dt, action, target, ourRootPart, clientCF, mode)
                local canFire = true
                if target ~= nil then
                    canFire = not self._spatialLimitGate:Tick(target)
                end
                if action == nil then
                    return self:_EvadePlan(clientCF, mode)
                end
                if action.type == 'Swap' then
                    local plan = self:_EvadePlan(clientCF, mode)
                    local item = action.item
                    local index = action.index
                    plan.weaponAction = function() equipItem(item, index) end
                    return plan
                end
                if action.type == 'Reload' then
                    local plan = self:_EvadePlan(clientCF, mode)
                    local item = action.item
                    plan.weaponAction = function() reloadItem(item) end
                    return plan
                end
                if target == nil then
                    return self:_EvadePlan(clientCF, mode)
                end
                if action.itemType == 'Melee' then
                    local cframe, viewAngles, weaponAction = self._meleeStrategy:Plan(dt, target, action.item, ourRootPart, canFire)
                    return { cframe = cframe, viewAngles = viewAngles, weaponAction = weaponAction, shouldSkipDefense = true, shouldForceCrouch = true }
                end
                if action.itemType ~= 'Gun' then
                    return {}
                end
                if itemIsReloading(action.item) then
                    return self:_EvadePlan(clientCF, mode)
                end
                local cframe, weaponAction, isSpecial = self._hitscanStrategy:Plan(dt, target, action.item, ourRootPart, canFire)
                return {
                    cframe = cframe,
                    weaponAction = weaponAction,
                    shouldForceCrouch = true,
                    isAimPose = weaponAction ~= nil,
                    shouldSkipDefense = isSpecial == true,
                    viewAngles = isSpecial and { kind = 'Normalized', pitch = 90, yaw = 0 } or nil,
                }
            end
            function Controller:_ApplyPlan(plan, target, characterController, fighter)
                local cframe = plan.cframe
                if cframe == nil or target == nil or plan.shouldSkipDefense then
                    characterController:SetServerCFrame(cframe)
                    characterController:SendViewAngles(20, plan.viewAngles)
                    return
                end
                local stance = localShieldStance(fighter)
                characterController:SetServerCFrame(getDefensiveCFrame(cframe, stance, target.rootPart))
                if plan.isAimPose or plan.shouldDefendInPlace then
                    self._lastDefensiveViewAngles = getDefensiveViewAngles(stance)
                end
                characterController:SendViewAngles(20, plan.viewAngles or self._lastDefensiveViewAngles)
            end
            function Controller:Update(dt)
                local fighter = resolveLocalFighter()
                local characterController = self:_EnsureCharacterController()
                if fighter == nil or characterController == nil or not self._enabled then
                    self:_Reset()
                    return
                end
                if RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsReadyToFight and not RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsReadyToFight() then
                    self:_Reset()
                    return
                end
                local ourRootPart = self._boundRootPart
                local clientCF = characterController:GetClientCFrame()
                local mode = Setting.EvasionMode()
                if mode == 'Translocate' then
                    self:_ApplyForcedCrouch(false)
                    characterController:SetServerCFrame(translocateEvade(clientCF, hasTargets()))
                    characterController:HeartbeatUpdate()
                    return
                end
                local target = selectTarget()
                local action = getAction(fighter)
                self._lastTargetWorld = target ~= nil and target.rootPart.Position or nil
                local plan = self:_Plan(dt, action, target, ourRootPart, clientCF, mode)
                self:_ApplyPlan(plan, target, characterController, fighter)
                self:_ApplyForcedCrouch(plan.shouldForceCrouch == true)
                if plan.weaponAction ~= nil then
                    plan.weaponAction()
                end
                characterController:HeartbeatUpdate()
            end
            function Controller:GetLastTargetWorld()
                return self._lastTargetWorld
            end
            function Controller:_Reset()
                self._lastTargetWorld = nil
                self._lastDefensiveViewAngles = nil
                self:_ApplyForcedCrouch(false)
                self._meleeStrategy:ResetState()
                self._hitscanStrategy:ResetState()
                self._projectileBreaker:ResetState()
                if self._characterController then
                    self._characterController:SetServerCFrame(nil)
                    self._characterController:SendViewAngles(20, nil)
                    self._characterController:HeartbeatUpdate()
                end
            end
            function Controller:Destroy()
                self:SetEnabled(false)
                self:_Reset()
                if self._characterController then
                    self._characterController:Destroy()
                    self._characterController = nil
                    self._boundRootPart = nil
                end
                self._partGlue:Destroy()
                applyEnabledFFlags(false)
            end

            -- ---- lifecycle / bridge ------------------------------------------------------
            local controllerInstance = nil
            local function ensureController()
                if controllerInstance == nil then
                    controllerInstance = Controller.new()
                end
                return controllerInstance
            end
            function KiciaRagebot.IsEnabled()
                if not togValue('P8S4T1', false) then
                    return false
                end
                -- Executor support: FighterController discovery walks the GC and the
                -- void redirect writes the hidden PhysicsRepRootPart property. Without
                -- either the bot cannot function, so decline (one-time notice via the
                -- gate) instead of running the loop's side effects for nothing.
                -- Checked after the toggle so the notice fires at enable, not at load;
                -- cached because this runs per-frame.
                if KiciaRagebot.CapsOk == nil then
                    KiciaRagebot.CapsOk = __kicia_hook_genv.KiciaHookCaps.gate('Ragebot', 'getgc', 'sethiddenproperty')
                end
                if not KiciaRagebot.CapsOk then
                    return false
                end
                -- Practice / shooting range: the ragebot must never act here (target dummies, no real
                -- match). Live-verified: the local fighter carries IsInShootingRange=true in
                -- the practice range and IsInDuel=true in real 1v1s. Returning false makes the controller
                -- settle to disabled (release part-glue, restore FFlags) via the normal Update path. The
                -- Seeded guard means we only gate once the duel state has actually been read.
                local localDuel = FighterDataCache and FighterDataCache.LocalDuel
                if localDuel and localDuel.Seeded and localDuel.IsInShootingRange == true then
                    return false
                end
                -- Enabled AND keybind-active (Kicia ObserveEnabledKeybind); Mode 'Always' -> always true.
                local keypicker = Options and Options.P8S4T1K
                if keypicker and type(keypicker.GetState) == 'function' then
                    return keypicker:GetState() == true
                end
                return true
            end
            function KiciaRagebot.Update(dt)
                local controller = ensureController()
                local enabled = KiciaRagebot.IsEnabled()
                if controller._enabled ~= enabled then
                    controller:SetEnabled(enabled)
                end
                controller:Update(dt or 0)
            end
            function KiciaRagebot.Reset()
                if controllerInstance then
                    controllerInstance:_Reset()
                end
            end
            function KiciaRagebot.Destroy()
                if controllerInstance then
                    controllerInstance:Destroy()
                    controllerInstance = nil
                end
            end
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateKiciaRagebot = KiciaRagebot.Update
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetKiciaRagebot = KiciaRagebot.Reset
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.DestroyKiciaRagebot = KiciaRagebot.Destroy

            return KiciaRagebot
end


local rbPanelStatus = nil
local rbAlive = false
local rbPaused = false
local rbConns = {}
local rbGen = 0
local _rbKiciaBot = nil

local function rbPosVoid(p)
    if typeof(p) ~= "Vector3" then return true end
    return math.abs(p.X) > 20000 or math.abs(p.Y) > 20000 or math.abs(p.Z) > 20000 or p.Magnitude > 25000
end

local function isInLobby()
    if type(jahvex_inMatchWorld) == "function" then
        if jahvex_inMatchWorld() then
            local over
            pcall(function() over = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeGameOver") end)
            return over == true
        end
        return true
    end
    local status, over
    pcall(function()
        status = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeStatus")
        over = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeGameOver")
    end)
    if over == true then return true end
    if status == "Started" then return false end
    if type(jahvex_deviceInCombat) == "function" and jahvex_deviceInCombat() then
        return false
    end
    if workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") then return true end
    return game.PlaceId == 17625359962
end

local function rbOnMapSpawn()
    if isInLobby() then return false end
    local char = lp.Character
    local root = char and (char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if not root then return false end
    return not rbPosVoid(root.Position)
end

local function rbAdd(c)
    if c then rbConns[#rbConns + 1] = c end
end

local function rbSetStatus(text, col)
    if rbPanelStatus then
        rbPanelStatus.Text = tostring(text or "")
        rbPanelStatus.TextColor3 = col or TEXT_DIM
    end
end

local function rbStop()
    rbAlive = false
    rbPaused = false
    ragebotEnabled = false
    _G.jahvex_ragebot_active = false
    pcall(function()
        if type(getgenv) == "function" then
            getgenv().__jahvex_rb_run = false
            getgenv().__jahvex_rb_paused = false
            getgenv().__jahvex_rb_stop = nil
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if _rbKiciaBot and type(_rbKiciaBot.Destroy) == "function" then
            _rbKiciaBot.Destroy()
        end
    end)
    _rbKiciaBot = nil
    for i = 1, #rbConns do
        pcall(function() rbConns[i]:Disconnect() end)
    end
    rbConns = {}
    rbSetStatus("OFF", TEXT_DIM)
end

local function rbStart()
    rbStop()
    rbGen = rbGen + 1
    local myGen = rbGen
    rbAlive = true
    rbPaused = false
    ragebotEnabled = true
    pcall(function()
        if type(jahvex_ensureCombatAcBypass) == "function" then
            jahvex_ensureCombatAcBypass()
        end
    end)
    getgenv().__jahvex_rb_run = true
    getgenv().__jahvex_rb_paused = false
    if myGen ~= rbGen then return end

    local kiciaToggles = {
        P8S4T1 = { Value = true },
        P8S4T4 = { Value = false },
        P8S4T5 = { Value = true },
        P8S4T6 = { Value = true },
        P8S4T7 = { Value = true },
        P8S4T8 = { Value = false },
    }
    local kiciaOpts = {
        P8S4S1 = { Value = tonumber(rbHideTime) or 0.15 },
        P8S4S2 = { Value = 1 },
        P8S4D1 = { Value = "SwapOrReload" },
        P8S4D2 = { Value = "Random" },
        P8S4S3 = { Value = -5 },
        P8S4S4 = { Value = 100 },
        P8S4S5 = { Value = 0.5 },
    }
    local function syncRbOpts()
        kiciaOpts.P8S4S1.Value = tonumber(rbHideTime) or 0.15
        kiciaToggles.P8S4T5.Value = true
        kiciaToggles.P8S4T6.Value = true
        kiciaToggles.P8S4T7.Value = true
        kiciaToggles.P8S4T1.Value = rbPaused ~= true
    end
    syncRbOpts()

    _rbKiciaBot = jahvex_initKiciaRagebot({
        RivalsRuntimeBridge = {},
        Options = kiciaOpts,
        Toggles = kiciaToggles,
        FighterDataCache = { LocalDuel = { Seeded = true, IsInShootingRange = false } },
        GetChar = function() return lp.Character end,
        GetRoot = function()
            local c = lp.Character
            return c and (c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        end,
        Genv = {
            KiciaHookCaps = {
                gate = function() return true end,
            },
        },
    })

    local _rbArmed = false
    rbAdd(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        _rbArmed = false
        pcall(function()
            if _rbKiciaBot and type(_rbKiciaBot.Reset) == "function" then
                _rbKiciaBot.Reset()
            end
        end)
    end))

    rbAdd(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not rbAlive or getgenv().__jahvex_rb_run ~= true then return end
        if rbPaused or isInLobby() then
            _rbArmed = false
            return
        end
        if not _rbArmed then
            if not rbOnMapSpawn() then
                rbSetStatus("SPAWN", TEXT_DIM)
                return
            end
            _rbArmed = true
            rbSetStatus("ON", GREEN)
        end
        syncRbOpts()
        _G.jahvex_ragebot_active = true
        if _rbKiciaBot and type(_rbKiciaBot.Update) == "function" then
            pcall(_rbKiciaBot.Update, dt)
        end
    end))

    getgenv().__jahvex_rb_stop = function()
        getgenv().__jahvex_rb_run = false
        pcall(function()
            if _rbKiciaBot and type(_rbKiciaBot.Destroy) == "function" then
                _rbKiciaBot.Destroy()
            end
        end)
        _G.jahvex_ragebot_active = false
    end

    local _rbLobbyHbFrame = 0
    rbAdd(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not rbAlive then return end
        _rbLobbyHbFrame = _rbLobbyHbFrame + 1
        if _rbLobbyHbFrame % 6 ~= 0 then return end
        local lobby = isInLobby()
        if lobby then
            if not rbPaused then
                rbPaused = true
                getgenv().__jahvex_rb_paused = true
                _G.jahvex_ragebot_active = false
                kiciaToggles.P8S4T1.Value = false
                pcall(function()
                    if _rbKiciaBot and type(_rbKiciaBot.Reset) == "function" then
                        _rbKiciaBot.Reset()
                    end
                end)
                rbSetStatus("LOBBY", TEXT_DIM)
            end
        elseif rbPaused then
            rbPaused = false
            getgenv().__jahvex_rb_paused = false
            kiciaToggles.P8S4T1.Value = true
            _rbArmed = false
            rbSetStatus("SPAWN", TEXT_DIM)
        end
    end))
    if isInLobby() then
        rbPaused = true
        getgenv().__jahvex_rb_paused = true
        _G.jahvex_ragebot_active = false
        kiciaToggles.P8S4T1.Value = false
        rbSetStatus("LOBBY", TEXT_DIM)
    elseif not rbOnMapSpawn() then
        rbSetStatus("SPAWN", TEXT_DIM)
    else
        rbSetStatus("ON", GREEN)
    end
end

local function rbSetActive(on)
    if on then
        task.spawn(rbStart)
    else
        rbStop()
    end
end

local function rbMakeTimeSlider(title, key, cur)
    makeLabel(rbPanel, title, 12, ry, 90, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local valLbl = makeLabel(rbPanel, string.format("%.1fs", cur), 12, ry + 13, rw, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
    ry = ry + 18
    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size = UDim2.new(0, rw, 0, 4)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, ry)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 3
    track.Parent = rbPanel
    pcall(function() track:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    makeCorner(track, 3)
    makeStroke(track, BORDER, 1)
    local initFrac = math.clamp((cur - 0.1) / 0.9, 0, 1)
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(initFrac, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 4
    fill.Parent = track
    pcall(function() fill:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
    makeCorner(fill, 3)
    local K = 12
    local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, K, 0, K)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(initFrac, -K / 2, 0.5, -K / 2)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Text = ""
    knob.AutoButtonColor = false
    knob.ZIndex = 5
    knob.Parent = track
    pcall(function() knob:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
    makeCorner(knob, K / 2)
    makeStroke(knob, BORDER, 1)
    local dragging = false
    local function setFrac(frac)
        frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
        local v = math.clamp(math.floor((0.1 + frac * 0.9) * 10 + 0.5) / 10, 0.1, 1)
        frac = (v - 0.1) / 0.9
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -K / 2, 0.5, -K / 2)
        valLbl.Text = string.format("%.1fs", v)
        if key == "hide" then
            rbHideTime = v
            _G.jahvex_rb_hide = v
        else
            rbAttackTime = v
            _G.jahvex_rb_attack = v
        end
    end
    local function fromX(x)
        local abs = track.AbsolutePosition.X
        local w = track.AbsoluteSize.X
        if w <= 0 then return end
        setFrac((x - abs) / w)
    end
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
    end)
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            fromX(inp.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        if dragging and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            fromX(inp.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and dragging then
            dragging = false
            saveConfig()
        end
    end)
    ry = ry + 16
    return { Set = function(_, v)
        setFrac((math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0.15, 0.1, 1) - 0.1) / 0.9)
    end }
end

local function jahvex_rbPriorityOpts()
    local opts = { { label = "None", value = 0 } }
    local rest = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp then
            table.insert(rest, {
                label = tostring(p.DisplayName) .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")",
                value = p.UserId,
            })
        end
    end
    table.sort(rest, function(a, b)
        return tostring(a.label) < tostring(b.label)
    end)
    for _, o in ipairs(rest) do
        table.insert(opts, o)
    end
    return opts
end

function jahvex_rbRefreshPriorityDrop(keep)
    local drop = jahvexUiRefs and jahvexUiRefs.rbPriorityDrop
    if not drop or not drop.SetOptions then return end
    drop:SetOptions(jahvex_rbPriorityOpts(), keep ~= false)
    local uid = math.floor(tonumber(rbPriorityUserId) or 0)
    if uid > 0 then
        local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            ok = drop:SetByValue(uid, false)
        end)
        if not ok then
            rbPriorityUserId = 0
            _G.jahvex_rb_priority_uid = 0
            pcall(function() drop:SetByValue(0, false) end)
        end
    else
        pcall(function() drop:SetByValue(0, false) end)
    end
end

jahvexUiRefs.rbPriorityDrop = makeDropdown(rbPanel, 12, ry, rw, "None", jahvex_rbPriorityOpts(), function(v)
    local uid = math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0)

        local plr
        pcall(function() plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid) end)
        if not plr or plr == lp then
            uid = 0
        end
    end
    rbPriorityUserId = uid
    _G.jahvex_rb_priority_uid = uid
    saveConfig()
end)
pcall(function()

        jahvex_rbRefreshPriorityDrop(true)
    end)
    jahvexUiRefs.rbPriorityDrop:SetByValue(math.floor(tonumber(rbPriorityUserId) or 0), false)
end)

antiKatanaEnabled = antiKatanaEnabled or false
antiRiotEnabled = antiRiotEnabled or false
_jahvexAkHoldBlock = false
_jahvexAkWasDanger = false
function jahvex_akGetFighter(plr)
    local f = nil
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end
        f = FC and FC.GetFighter and FC:GetFighter(plr)
    end)
    return f
end

function jahvex_playerKatanaDanger(plr)
    if not antiKatanaEnabled then return false end
    if not plr or plr == lp then return false end
    local f = jahvex_akGetFighter(plr)
    local item = f and f.EquippedItem
    if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
    local name = nil
    pcall(function()
        name = (item.Info and item.Info.Name) or item.Name
    end)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or string.lower(name) ~= "katana" then return false end
    local fov = nil
    pcall(function()
        if type(item.Get) == "function" then
            fov = item:Get("FOVOffset")
        end
    end)
    if fov == nil then
        pcall(function()
            local ent = f.Entity
            if ent and type(ent.Get) == "function" then
                fov = ent:Get("FOVOffset")
            end
        end)
    end
    fov = tonumber(fov)
    if fov ~= nil then
        return fov ~= 0
    end
    return true
end

function jahvex_playerRiotDanger(plr)
    if not antiRiotEnabled then return false end
    if not plr or plr == lp then return false end
    local f = jahvex_akGetFighter(plr)
    local item = f and f.EquippedItem
    if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
    local name = nil
    pcall(function()
        name = (item.Info and item.Info.Name) or item.Name
    end)
    if type(name) ~= "string" then return false end
    local l = string.lower(name)
    return l == "riot shield" or string.find(l, "riot shield", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function jahvex_playerGunDanger(plr)
    return jahvex_playerKatanaDanger(plr) or jahvex_playerRiotDanger(plr)
end


function jahvex_getPlayerTeamId(plr)
    if not plr then return nil end
    local tid = plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
    if tid ~= nil then return tid end
    local char = plr.Character
    if char then
        tid = char:GetAttribute("TeamID")
        if tid ~= nil then return tid end
        tid = char:GetAttribute("Team")
        if tid ~= nil then return tid end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end
        local f = FC and FC:GetFighter(plr)
        if not f then return end
        if f.Team ~= nil then tid = f.Team return end
        if type(f.Get) == "function" then
            tid = f:Get("TeamID")
            if tid == nil then tid = f:Get("Team") end
        end
    end)
    if tid ~= nil then return tid end
    pcall(function()
        local DC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.DuelController)
        local duel = DC and DC:GetDuel(plr)
        if not duel and DC then
            duel = DC:GetDuel(lp)
        end
        if not duel then
            local SC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.SpectateController)
            duel = SC and SC.CurrentDuelSubject
        end
        if not (duel and type(duel.GetDueler) == "function") then return end
        local d = duel:GetDueler(plr)
        if d and type(d.Get) == "function" then
            tid = d:Get("TeamID")
        end
    end)
    return tid
end

function jahvex_isAlly(plr)
    if not plr or plr == lp then return true end
    local char = plr.Character
    if char then
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("TeammateLabel") then return true end
        if char:FindFirstChild("TeammateLabel", true) then return true end
    end
    if lp.Team and plr.Team and lp.Team == plr.Team then
        return true
    end
    local myTid = jahvex_getPlayerTeamId(lp)
    local theirTid = jahvex_getPlayerTeamId(plr)
    if myTid ~= nil and theirTid ~= nil and myTid == theirTid then
        return true
    end
    local myChar = lp.Character
    if char and myChar then
        local a, b = char:GetAttribute("Team"), myChar:GetAttribute("Team")
        if a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a == b then return true end
    end
    return false
end
_G.jahvex_isAlly = jahvex_isAlly
_G.jahvex_getPlayerTeamId = jahvex_getPlayerTeamId

function jahvex_akTargetPlayer()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return nil end
    local params = rawget(_G, "jahvex_akRayParams")
    if not params then
        params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        _G.jahvex_akRayParams = params
    end
    local filter = { cam }
    if lp.Character then filter[2] = lp.Character end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 800, params)
    if hit and hit.Instance then
        local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local p = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        if p and p ~= lp then return p end
    end
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == lp then continue end
        local char = plr.Character
        local hrp = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        if not hrp then continue end
        local to = hrp.Position - origin
        local mag = to.Magnitude
        if mag < 0.05 or mag > 250 then continue end
        local dot = look:Dot(to.Unit)
        if dot < 0.25 then continue end
        local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
        local pix = 1e9
        if onScreen and screen.Z > 0 then
            pix = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
        end
        local score = pix + (1 - dot) * 400
        if score < bestScore then
            bestScore = score
            best = plr
        end
    end
    return best
end
jahvex_crosshairPlayer = jahvex_akTargetPlayer

function jahvex_akForceReleaseShoot()
    _jahvexAkHoldBlock = true
    _G.jahvex_ak_breakLock = true
    pcall(function()
        local MC = _jahvexAfMC
        if not MC then
            MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
            _jahvexAfMC = MC
        end
        if MC and type(MC.SimulateInputEnded) == "function" then
            MC:SimulateInputEnded({
                UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
                KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
            })
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_akShouldBlockFire()
    if not antiKatanaEnabled and not antiRiotEnabled then return false end
    return jahvex_playerGunDanger(jahvex_akTargetPlayer())
end

            end
        end
    end
end)

do
local aimEnabled = false

local aimSmooth = 0
local aimHitPart = "Head"
local aimHolding = false
local aimToggled = false
local aimListening = false
local aimBindBtn = nil
local aimBindLbl = nil

local HIT_PART_MAP = {
    Head = {"HitboxHead", "PhysicalHitboxHead", "HitboxHeadSmall", "Head"},
    Body = {"HitboxBody", "HitboxBodySmall", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart"},
    LeftArm = {"LeftUpperArm", "Left Arm", "LeftLowerArm"},
    RightArm = {"RightUpperArm", "Right Arm", "RightLowerArm"},
    LeftHand = {"LeftHand", "Left Arm", "LeftLowerArm"},
    RightHand = {"RightHand", "Right Arm", "RightLowerArm"},
    Closest = {"HitboxHead", "Head", "HitboxBody", "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftHand", "RightHand"},
}

local HIT_PART_OPTIONS = {
    {label = "Head", value = "Head"},
    {label = "Body", value = "Body"},
    {label = "Left Arm", value = "LeftArm"},
    {label = "Right Arm", value = "RightArm"},
    {label = "Left Hand", value = "LeftHand"},
    {label = "Right Hand", value = "RightHand"},
    {label = "Closest", value = "Closest"},
}

local aimStickyPart = nil
local aimStickyUntil = 0
local aimSavedShake = nil

local function aimBindText()
    if aimKeyKind == "Mouse" then
        if aimMouseBtn == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return "lmb" end
        if aimMouseBtn == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return "rmb" end
        if aimMouseBtn == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then return "mmb" end
        return "mouse"
    end
    local n = tostring(aimKeyCode)
    return string.lower((n:gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "")))
end

local function refreshAimBindLbl()
    if not aimBindLbl then return end
    if aimListening then
        aimBindLbl.Text = "..."
        aimBindLbl.TextColor3 = GREEN
        if aimBindBtn then
            local st = aimBindBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then st.Color = GREEN end
        end
        return
    end

    if aimMode == "Always" then
        aimBindLbl.Text = "always"
        aimBindLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    else
        aimBindLbl.Text = aimBindText()
        aimBindLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    end
    if aimBindBtn then
        local st = aimBindBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if st then
            st.Color = (aimMode == "Always") and WHITE_ACC or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 82)
        end
    end
end

local function getAimHitPart(char)
    if aimHitPart == "Closest" then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return char:FindFirstChild("Head") end
        local vp = cam.ViewportSize
        local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
        local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
        local names = HIT_PART_MAP.Closest
        for _, n in ipairs(names) do
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(n)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p.Position)
                if onScreen and screen.Z > 0 then
                    local score = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if score < bestScore then
                        bestScore = score
                        best = p
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local names = HIT_PART_MAP[aimHitPart] or HIT_PART_MAP.Head
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        local p = char:FindFirstChild(n) or char:FindFirstChild(n, true)
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
    end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end

local function aimIsVisible(part)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or not part then return false end
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local toPart = part.Position - origin
    local dist = toPart.Magnitude
    if dist < 0.05 then return true end


    local params = rawget(_G, "jahvex_aimRayParams")
    if not params then
        params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        _G.jahvex_aimRayParams = params
    end
    local filter = {cam}
    if lp.Character then filter[2] = lp.Character end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter

    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, toPart.Unit * dist, params)
    if not result then return true end
    local hitChar = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or part.Parent
    return hitChar ~= nil and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(hitChar)
end

local function aimIsActive()
    if not aimEnabled then return false end
    if mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible then return false end
    if aimMode == "Always" then return true end
    if aimMode == "Hold" then return aimHolding end
    if aimMode == "Toggle" then return aimToggled end
    return false
end

local function aimMatchesBind(input)
    if aimKeyKind == "Mouse" then
        return input.UserInputType == aimMouseBtn
    end
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode == aimKeyCode
end


local function aimIsTeammate(plr)
    if not plr or plr == lp then return true end
    if not aimTeamCheck then return false end
    return jahvex_isAlly(plr)
end

local function getAimTarget()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return nil end
    local now = tick()
    if rawget(_G, "jahvex_ak_breakLock") then
        aimStickyPart = nil
        aimStickyUntil = 0
    end


    if aimStickyPart and aimStickyPart.Parent and now < aimStickyUntil then
        local char = aimStickyPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local plr = char and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local ok = plr and plr ~= lp and hum and (not aimHealthCheck or hum.Health > 0)
        if ok and aimIsTeammate(plr) then ok = false end
        if ok and jahvex_playerGunDanger(plr) then ok = false end
        if ok and (not aimVisCheck or aimIsVisible(aimStickyPart)) then
            return aimStickyPart
        end
    end

    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local bestPart, bestScore = nil, math.huge

    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == lp then continue end
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then continue end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then continue end
        if aimHealthCheck and hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
        if aimIsTeammate(plr) then continue end
        if jahvex_playerGunDanger(plr) then continue end

        local part = getAimHitPart(char)
        if not part then continue end
        if aimVisCheck and not aimIsVisible(part) then continue end

        local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if (not onScreen) or screen.Z <= 0 then continue end

        local score = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
        if score < bestScore then
            bestScore = score
            bestPart = part
        end
    end

    if bestPart then
        aimStickyPart = bestPart
        aimStickyUntil = now + 0.35
    else
        aimStickyPart = nil
    end
    return bestPart
end

local CameraController = nil
task.defer(function()
    pcall(function()
        CameraController = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.CameraController)
    end)
end)

local function shortestAngle(a, b)
    return a + ((b - a + math.pi) % (math.pi * 2) - math.pi)
end


local function getAimOrigin()
    if CameraController then
        local sub = CameraController._current_subject or (CameraController.GetCurrentSubject and CameraController:GetCurrentSubject())
        local ent = sub and sub.Entity
        local root = ent and ent.RootPart
        if root then
            local off = Vector3.zero
            pcall(function()
                if CameraController._position_spring then
                    off = CameraController._position_spring.Value
                end
            end)
            return root.Position + off
        end
    end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    return cam and cam.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
end

local function aimSetLookAt(targetPos, dt)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local origin = getAimOrigin()
    local delta = targetPos - origin
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end

    local look = CFrame.lookAt(origin, targetPos)
    local pitch, yaw = look:ToOrientation()

    if CameraController and type(CameraController.SetRotation) == "function" then
        local cur = CameraController.Rotation or Vector2.zero
        local targetYaw = shortestAngle(cur.Y, yaw)
        local targetPitch = pitch

        if aimSmooth <= 0 then

            local dx = math.abs(targetPitch - cur.X)
            local dy = math.abs(targetYaw - cur.Y)
            if dx > 0.00005 or dy > 0.00005 then
                CameraController:SetRotation(Vector2.new(targetPitch, targetYaw))
            end
        else
            local speed = 1 / (0.02 + aimSmooth * 0.012)
            local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-speed * (dt or 0.016))
            CameraController:SetRotation(Vector2.new(
                cur.X + (targetPitch - cur.X) * alpha,
                cur.Y + (targetYaw - cur.Y) * alpha
            ))
        end
    else
        if aimSmooth <= 0 then
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
        else
            local alpha = 1 / (1 + aimSmooth * 0.35)
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, targetPos), alpha)
        end
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if aimListening then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
            aimKeyKind = "Mouse"
            aimMouseBtn = input.UserInputType
            aimListening = false
            refreshAimBindLbl()
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                aimListening = false
                refreshAimBindLbl()
                return
            end
            if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
                aimKeyKind = "Key"
                aimKeyCode = input.KeyCode
                aimListening = false
                refreshAimBindLbl()
                return
            end
        end
        return
    end

    if gp then return end
    if not aimEnabled then return end
    if aimMode == "Always" then return end
    if not aimMatchesBind(input) then return end

    if aimMode == "Hold" then
        aimHolding = true
    elseif aimMode == "Toggle" then
        aimToggled = not aimToggled
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if aimMode == "Hold" and aimMatchesBind(input) then
        aimHolding = false
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_9")
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_10")
end)

local camPri = Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value
local aimCurrentTargetPos = nil

task.defer(function()
    while jahvex_booting and jahvex_isCurrent() do
        jahvex_yieldFrame()
    end
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_9")
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_10")
    end)
    RunService:BindToRenderStep("__rb_9", camPri - 1, function(dt)
        if not aimIsActive() then
            aimCurrentTargetPos = nil
            aimStickyPart = nil
            if CameraController and aimSavedShake ~= nil then
                CameraController._shake_enabled = aimSavedShake
                aimSavedShake = nil
            end
            return
        end

        local target = getAimTarget()
        if not target then
            aimCurrentTargetPos = nil
            return
        end
        aimCurrentTargetPos = target.Position

        if aimSmooth <= 0 and CameraController then
            if aimSavedShake == nil then
                aimSavedShake = CameraController._shake_enabled
            end
            CameraController._shake_enabled = false
            pcall(function()
                CameraController.ShakeCFrame = CFrame.identity
            end)
        elseif CameraController and aimSavedShake ~= nil then
            CameraController._shake_enabled = aimSavedShake
            aimSavedShake = nil
        end

        aimSetLookAt(aimCurrentTargetPos, dt)
    end)

    RunService:BindToRenderStep("__rb_10", camPri + 1, function()
        if not aimIsActive() or aimSmooth > 0 then return end
        if not aimCurrentTargetPos then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local pos = cam.CFrame.Position
        if (aimCurrentTargetPos - pos).Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, aimCurrentTargetPos)
    end)
end)

local AIM_MODES = {"Hold", "Toggle", "Always"}
local aimModePopup = nil
local aimModeOpen = false

local function closeAimModePopup()
    aimModeOpen = false
    if aimModePopup then
        aimModePopup.Visible = false
    end
end

local function placeAimModePopup()
    if not aimModePopup or not aimBindBtn then return end
    local guiPos = screenGui.AbsolutePosition
    local btnPos = aimBindBtn.AbsolutePosition
    local btnSize = aimBindBtn.AbsoluteSize
    local popW = math.max(86, btnSize.X)
    local popH = aimModePopup.Size.Y.Offset
    local x = btnPos.X - guiPos.X + btnSize.X - popW
    local y = btnPos.Y - guiPos.Y - popH - 4
    if y < 4 then y = btnPos.Y - guiPos.Y + btnSize.Y + 4 end
    aimModePopup.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    aimModePopup.Size = UDim2.new(0, popW, 0, popH)
end

local function refreshAimModePopup()
    if not aimModePopup then return end
    for _, child in ipairs(aimModePopup:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            local on = child.Name == aimMode
            child.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65) or LIST_BG
            child.TextColor3 = on and TEXT_W or TEXT_DIM
        end
    end
end

local function openAimModePopup()
    if aimListening then
        aimListening = false
        refreshAimBindLbl()
    end
    if _G.jahvex_openDropdown then
        pcall(function() _G.jahvex_openDropdown:Close() end)
    end
    if aimModeOpen then
        closeAimModePopup()
        return
    end
    placeAimModePopup()
    refreshAimModePopup()
    aimModePopup.Visible = true
    aimModeOpen = true
end

do
    local ITEM_H = 24
    local popH = #AIM_MODES * ITEM_H + 8
    aimModePopup = Instance.new("Frame")
    aimModePopup.Name = "AimModePopup"
    aimModePopup.Size = UDim2.new(0, 86, 0, popH)
    aimModePopup.BackgroundColor3 = LIST_BG
    aimModePopup.BorderSizePixel = 0
    aimModePopup.Visible = false
    aimModePopup.ZIndex = 260
    aimModePopup.Parent = screenGui
    makeCorner(aimModePopup, 8)
    makeStroke(aimModePopup, Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 82), 1)

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.Parent = aimModePopup

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Parent = aimModePopup

    for i, mode in ipairs(AIM_MODES) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Name = mode
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ITEM_H)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = LIST_BG
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = mode
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        btn.TextSize = 11
        btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = 261
        btn.LayoutOrder = i
        btn.Parent = aimModePopup
        makeCorner(btn, 5)
        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if btn.Name ~= aimMode then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_HOV
                btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
            end
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            refreshAimModePopup()
        end)
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            aimMode = mode
            aimHolding = false
            aimToggled = false
            refreshAimBindLbl()
            refreshAimModePopup()
            closeAimModePopup()
            if setStatus then setStatus("Aimbot: " .. aimMode, GREEN) end
        end)
    end
end

    if not aimModeOpen then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        return
    end
    task.defer(function()
        if not aimModeOpen then return end
        local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        local p = aimModePopup.AbsolutePosition
        local s = aimModePopup.AbsoluteSize
        local b = aimBindBtn.AbsolutePosition
        local bs = aimBindBtn.AbsoluteSize
        local inPop = pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + s.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
        local inBtn = pos.X >= b.X and pos.X <= b.X + bs.X and pos.Y >= b.Y and pos.Y <= b.Y + bs.Y
        if not inPop and not inBtn then
            closeAimModePopup()
        end
    end)
end)

end)

local smoothDragging = false
local function setSmoothFrac(frac)
    frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
    aimSmooth = math.floor(frac * 100 + 0.5)
    smoothFill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
    smoothKnob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -SKNOB / 2, 0.5, -SKNOB / 2)
    smoothValLbl.Text = tostring(aimSmooth)
end

    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then smoothDragging = true end
end)
smoothKnob.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then smoothDragging = false end
end)
smoothTrack.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        smoothDragging = true
        local trackX = smoothTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
        local trackW = smoothTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
        setSmoothFrac((inp.Position.X - trackX) / trackW)
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
    if not smoothDragging then return end
    if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
    local trackX = smoothTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
    local trackW = smoothTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
    setSmoothFrac((inp.Position.X - trackX) / trackW)
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then smoothDragging = false end
end)

_G.__jxAimSave = function()
    return {
        enabled = aimEnabled and true or false,
        mode = tostring(aimMode or "Hold"),
        keyKind = tostring(aimKeyKind or "Mouse"),
        mouseBtn = tostring(aimMouseBtn or Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2):gsub("Enum.UserInputType.", ""),
        keyCode = tostring(aimKeyCode or Enum.KeyCode.E):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", ""),
        teamCheck = aimTeamCheck and true or false,
        visCheck = aimVisCheck and true or false,
        healthCheck = aimHealthCheck and true or false,
        smooth = tonumber(aimSmooth) or 0,
        hitPart = tostring(aimHitPart or "Head"),
    }
end
_G.__jxAimLoad = function(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
    if t.enabled ~= nil then
        aimEnabled = t.enabled and true or false
        if enableApi and enableApi.Set then enableApi:Set(aimEnabled, false) end
    end
    if type(t.mode) == "string" and t.mode ~= "" then aimMode = t.mode end
    if type(t.keyKind) == "string" and t.keyKind ~= "" then aimKeyKind = t.keyKind end
    if type(t.mouseBtn) == "string" and Enum.UserInputType[t.mouseBtn] then
        aimMouseBtn = Enum.UserInputType[t.mouseBtn]
    end
    if type(t.keyCode) == "string" and Enum.KeyCode[t.keyCode] then
        aimKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode[t.keyCode]
    end
    if t.teamCheck ~= nil then aimTeamCheck = t.teamCheck and true or false end
    if t.visCheck ~= nil then aimVisCheck = t.visCheck and true or false end
    if t.healthCheck ~= nil then aimHealthCheck = t.healthCheck and true or false end
    if t.smooth ~= nil then aimSmooth = tonumber(t.smooth) or aimSmooth end
    if type(t.hitPart) == "string" and t.hitPart ~= "" then aimHitPart = t.hitPart end
end
end


do
local saEnabled = false
local saTeamCheck = true
local saVisCheck = false
local saHealthCheck = true
local saHitChance = 100
local saFov = 2500
local saHitPart = "Head"
local saStickyPart = nil
local saStickyUntil = 0
local SA_STICKY_TIME = 1.25
local SA_MAX_RANGE = 2000

local function saForceHead(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local bag = rawget(_G, "_jxSaHeadCache")
    if type(bag) ~= "table" then
        bag = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        _G._jxSaHeadCache = bag
    end
    local now = tick()
    local rec = bag[char]
    if rec and rec.p and rec.p.Parent and (now - rec.t) < 0.15 then
        return rec.p
    end
    local function find(name)
        local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
        if p then return p end
        return char:FindFirstChild(name, true)
    end
    local n1 = find("HitboxHead")
    local n2 = find("PhysicalHitboxHead")
    local n3 = find("HitboxHeadSmall")
    local n4 = find("HitboxHeadBig")
    local n5 = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local function sky(p)
        if not p then return false end
        local pos = p.Position
        return math.abs(pos.X) > 50000 or math.abs(pos.Y) > 50000 or math.abs(pos.Z) > 50000
    end
    local pick = nil
    if n1 and sky(n1) then pick = n1
    elseif n2 and sky(n2) then pick = n2
    elseif n3 and sky(n3) then pick = n3
    elseif n4 and sky(n4) then pick = n4
    elseif n5 and sky(n5) then pick = n5
    else pick = n1 or n2 or n3 or n4 or n5
    end
    bag[char] = { p = pick, t = now }
    return pick
end


local function saIsHeadPart(p)
    if not (p and p.Parent) then return false end
    local n = string.lower(tostring(p.Name))
    return n == "head" or n:find("hitboxhead", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local SA_HIT_PART_MAP = {
    Head = {"HitboxHead", "PhysicalHitboxHead", "HitboxHeadSmall", "HitboxHeadBig", "Head"},
    Body = {"HitboxBody", "PhysicalHitboxBody", "HitboxBodySmall", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart"},
    LeftArm = {"LeftUpperArm", "Left Arm", "LeftLowerArm", "HitboxLeftArm"},
