    RightHand = {"RightHand", "Right Arm", "RightLowerArm"},
    Closest = {"HitboxHead", "PhysicalHitboxHead", "Head", "HitboxBody", "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftHand", "RightHand"},
}

_G.jahvex_sa_enabled = false
_G.jahvex_sa_part = nil

_G.jahvex_sa2_part = nil

local function saSameTeam(plr)
    if not plr or plr == lp then return true end
    if not saTeamCheck then return false end
    return jahvex_isAlly(plr)
end

local function saIsVisible(part)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or not part then return false end
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local toPart = part.Position - origin
    local dist = toPart.Magnitude
    if dist < 0.05 then return true end
    local params = rawget(_G, "jahvex_saRayParams")
    if not params then
        params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        _G.jahvex_saRayParams = params
    end
    local filter = {cam}
    if lp.Character then filter[2] = lp.Character end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, toPart.Unit * dist, params)
    if not result then return true end
    local hitChar = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or part.Parent
    return hitChar ~= nil and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(hitChar)
end

local function getSaHitPart(char, cam, center)

    return saForceHead(char)
end

local function saPlayerValid(plr)
    if not plr or plr == lp then return false end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end
    if saHealthCheck and hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    if saSameTeam(plr) then return false end
    return true, char, hum
end

local function saScorePart(cam, center, part, fovSq)

    local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    local dx = screen.X - center.X
    local dy = screen.Y - center.Y
    local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
    if screen.Z > 0 and distSq <= fovSq then
        return distSq, true
    end

    local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
    local toPart = part.Position - cam.CFrame.Position
    local mag = toPart.Magnitude
    if mag < 0.05 then return 0, true end
    if mag > SA_MAX_RANGE then return nil, false end
    local cosAng = look:Dot(toPart.Unit)

    local minCos = (saFov >= 2000) and -0.35 or ((saFov >= 1000) and 0.0 or 0.35)
    if cosAng < minCos then return nil, false end

    return (1 - cosAng) * 1e7 + mag, true
end

local function saIsSkyPos(p)

    if typeof(p) ~= "Vector3" then return true end
    if math.abs(p.X) > 50000 or math.abs(p.Y) > 50000 or math.abs(p.Z) > 50000 then return true end
    return false
end

local function saIsVoidDesyncPos(p)
    return typeof(p) == "Vector3" and saIsSkyPos(p)
end

local function getSaTarget()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return nil end
    local now = tick()
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local fovSq = saFov * saFov

    if saStickyPart and saStickyPart.Parent and now < saStickyUntil then
        local char = saStickyPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local plr = char and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
        local ok = saPlayerValid(plr)
        if ok and jahvex_playerGunDanger(plr) then ok = false end
        if ok and (not saVisCheck or saIsVisible(saStickyPart)) then
            local score = saScorePart(cam, center, saStickyPart, fovSq)
            if score ~= nil then
                return saStickyPart
            end
        end
    end

    local bestPart, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    local fallbackPart, fallbackDist = nil, math.huge
    local myPos = cam.CFrame.Position
    local root = lp.Character and (lp.Character.PrimaryPart or lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if root then myPos = root.Position end

    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local ok, char = saPlayerValid(plr)
        if not ok then continue end
        if jahvex_playerGunDanger(plr) then continue end

        local part = getSaHitPart(char, cam, center)
        if not part then continue end
        local vis = saIsVisible(part)
        if saVisCheck and not vis then continue end


        local worldDist = (part.Position - myPos).Magnitude
        if worldDist <= SA_MAX_RANGE then
            local fbScore = vis and worldDist or (worldDist + SA_MAX_RANGE * 10)
            if fbScore < fallbackDist then
                fallbackDist = fbScore
                fallbackPart = part
            end
        end

        local score, inRange = saScorePart(cam, center, part, fovSq)
        if inRange then
            if not vis then score = score + 1e9 end
            if score < bestScore then
                bestScore = score
                bestPart = part
            end
        end
    end


    if not bestPart then
        bestPart = fallbackPart
    end

    if bestPart then
        saStickyPart = bestPart
        saStickyUntil = now + SA_STICKY_TIME
    else
        saStickyPart = nil
    end
    return bestPart
end

_G.jahvex_sa2_getTarget = getSaTarget

local function getSaShotOrigin()
    local char = lp.Character
    local root = char and (char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if root and not saIsSkyPos(root.Position) then return root.Position end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local cp = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
    if cp and not saIsSkyPos(cp) then return cp end
    return nil
end

    "HitboxHead", "PhysicalHitboxHead", "HitboxHeadSmall", "HitboxHeadBig", "Head",
}

local function saGetLeadTime(extraDist, bulletSpeed)
    return 0
end

local function saTargetVelocity(char)
    local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart)
    if not root then return Vector3.zero end
    local assem = Vector3.zero
    pcall(function() assem = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
    local move = Vector3.zero
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        local md = hum.MoveDirection
        local ws = tonumber(hum.WalkSpeed) or 16
        if md.Magnitude > 0.2 then
            move = Vector3.new(md.X * ws, 0, md.Z * ws)
        end
    end


    local hx = move.Magnitude > 2 and move.X or assem.X
    local hz = move.Magnitude > 2 and move.Z or assem.Z
    local hy = (math.abs(assem.Y) < 8) and 0 or assem.Y
    local v = Vector3.new(hx, hy, hz)
    local h = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
    if h.Magnitude > 28 then
        h = h.Unit * 28
        v = Vector3.new(h.X, v.Y, h.Z)
    end
    if math.abs(v.Y) > 40 then
        v = Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y > 0 and 40 or -40, v.Z)
    end
    return v
end

local function saVisibleFrom(origin, pos, char)
    local params = rawget(_G, "jahvex_saShotRayParams")
    if not params then
        params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        _G.jahvex_saShotRayParams = params
    end
    local filter = {}
    if lp.Character then filter[#filter + 1] = lp.Character end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then filter[#filter + 1] = cam end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local dir = pos - origin
    if dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then return true end
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
    if not result then return true end
    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char)
end


local function saResolveShot(origin, part, bulletSpeed)
    local char = part and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if not char then
        if saIsHeadPart(part) then return part, part.Position, Vector3.zero end
        return nil, nil, Vector3.zero
    end
    local shotPart = saForceHead(char)
    if not shotPart then return nil, nil, Vector3.zero end
    return shotPart, shotPart.Position, Vector3.zero
end

_G.jahvex_sa2_resolveShot = saResolveShot

task.spawn(function()
    local okGun, Gun = pcall(function()
        return require(lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun", 10))
    end)
    local okUtil, Utility = pcall(function()
        return require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("Utility", 10))
    end)
    if not okGun or not Gun or type(Gun.StartShooting) ~= "function" then return end
    if not okUtil or not Utility or type(Utility.EncodeCFrame) ~= "function" then return end

    local shot_offset_cf = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(0.43, 0.25, 0.42))
    local k0, k1, k2, k3 = utf8.char(0), utf8.char(1), utf8.char(2), utf8.char(3)


    local SCOPED_NEED = {
        Sniper = true,
        Crossbow = true,
    }

    local SLOW_PROJ = {
        Bow = true,
        Slingshot = true,
    }


    local dbgConsts = (debug and debug.getconstants) or (getconstants or nil)
    local dbgUps = (debug and debug.getupvalues) or (getupvalues or nil)

    local function isOurLayer(f)
        if not dbgConsts then return false end
        local ok, consts = pcall(dbgConsts, f)
        if not ok or type(consts) ~= "table" then return false end
        for _, c in pairs(consts) do
            if type(c) == "string" and string.find(c, "jahvex", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function nextLayer(f, marker)
        if not dbgUps then return nil end
        local ok, ups = pcall(dbgUps, f)
        if not ok or type(ups) ~= "table" then return nil end
        for _, uv in pairs(ups) do
            if type(uv) == "function" then
                if not marker then return uv end
                local ok2, cs = pcall(dbgConsts, uv)
                if ok2 and type(cs) == "table" then
                    for _, c in pairs(cs) do
                        if c == marker then return uv end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function findOriginal(f, marker)
        for _ = 1, 15 do
            if not isOurLayer(f) then return f end
            local nf = nextLayer(f, marker)
            if not nf then return f end
            f = nf
        end
        return f
    end


    local origStart = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_origStart")
    if type(origStart) ~= "function" then
        origStart = findOriginal(Gun.StartShooting, "StartShooting")
        _G.jahvex_sa2_origStart = origStart
    end
    local origIFA = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_origIFA")
    if type(origIFA) ~= "function" and type(Gun.IsFullyAiming) == "function" then
        origIFA = findOriginal(Gun.IsFullyAiming, nil)
        _G.jahvex_sa2_origIFA = origIFA
    end

    if type(origIFA) == "function" then
        Gun.IsFullyAiming = function(self, ...)
            if rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_enabled") then
                local isLocal = false
                pcall(function()
                    isLocal = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer == true
                end)
                if isLocal then
                    local n = nil
                    pcall(function() n = self.Name end)
                    if n and SCOPED_NEED[n] then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return origIFA(self, ...)
        end
    end

    local function buildPayload(origin, targetPos, part)
        local d = targetPos - origin
        if d.Magnitude < 0.45 then
            if saIsVoidDesyncPos(targetPos) then
                origin = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 180, 360)
            else
                origin = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0.9)
            end
        end
        local aim_cf = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.lookAt(origin, targetPos))
        return {
            [k0] = aim_cf,
            [k1] = aim_cf,
            [k2] = part,
            [k3] = shot_offset_cf,
        }
    end

    local function resolvePart()
        local cached = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_part")
        local part = nil
        if cached and cached.Parent and cached:IsA("BasePart") then
            local char = cached:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local plr = char and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
            if plr and saSameTeam(plr) then
                cached = nil
                _G.jahvex_sa2_part = nil
            else
                part = cached
            end
        else
            local getter = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_getTarget")
            if type(getter) == "function" then
                part = getter()
            end
        end
        if not (part and part.Parent) then
            part = cached
        end
        if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            local char = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local plr = char and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
            if plr and saSameTeam(plr) then return nil end
            local hs = saForceHead(char)
            if hs and saIsHeadPart(hs) then return hs end
            if saIsHeadPart(part) then return part end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function shotOrigin(weaponName)
        if weaponName and (SCOPED_NEED[weaponName] or SLOW_PROJ[weaponName]) then
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then return cam.CFrame.Position end
        end
        return getSaShotOrigin()
    end

    local function gunIsSlowProj(self)
        local n = nil
        pcall(function() n = self.Name end)
        n = tostring(n or "")
        if n == "Crossbow" then return false, n end
        if SLOW_PROJ[n] then return true, n end
        local base = nil
        pcall(function()
            if type(self.Get) == "function" then
                base = self:Get("Name") or self:Get("ObjectID")
            end
        end)
        base = tostring(base or "")
        if base == "Crossbow" then return false, n end
        if SLOW_PROJ[base] then return true, base end
        if string.find(n, "Slingshot", 1, true) then return true, "Slingshot" end
        if string.find(n, "Bow", 1, true) and not string.find(n, "Cross", 1, true) then
            return true, "Bow"
        end
        return false, n
    end

    local function gunBulletSpeed(self)
        local s = nil
        pcall(function()
            s = tonumber(self.BulletSpeed) or tonumber(self.ProjectileSpeed)
                or tonumber(self.BulletVelocity) or tonumber(self.MuzzleVelocity)
            if (not s) and type(self.Get) == "function" then
                s = tonumber(self:Get("ProjectileSpeed")) or tonumber(self:Get("BulletSpeed"))
            end
            if (not s) and type(self.Info) == "table" then
                s = tonumber(self.Info.ProjectileSpeed) or tonumber(self.Info.BulletSpeed)
            end
        end)
        if s and s > 40 and s < 100000 then return s end
        return nil
    end

    local function gunProjGravity(self)
        local g = nil
        pcall(function()
            g = tonumber(self.ProjectileGravity)
            if g == nil and type(self.Get) == "function" then
                g = tonumber(self:Get("ProjectileGravity"))
            end
            if g == nil and type(self.Info) == "table" then
                g = tonumber(self.Info.ProjectileGravity)
            end
        end)
        return tonumber(g) or 0
    end


    local function saProjAim(origin, headPos, vel, speed, gravity)
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(headPos) ~= "Vector3" then
            return headPos
        end
        if typeof(vel) ~= "Vector3" then vel = Vector3.zero end
        if vel.Magnitude < 1.5 then return headPos end
        speed = math.max(tonumber(speed) or 350, 160)
        gravity = tonumber(gravity) or 0
        local dist = (headPos - origin).Magnitude
        local t = math.clamp(dist / speed, 0.02, 0.55)
        local pred = headPos + Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * t
        if gravity > 1 and t > 0.08 then
            pred = pred + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * gravity * t * t, 0)
        end
        local delta = pred - headPos
        if delta.Magnitude > 12 then
            pred = headPos + delta.Unit * 12
        end
        return pred
    end

    Gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
        local saOn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_enabled") == true
        local trOn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_tracer_enabled") == true
        local isLocal = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer == true
        if isLocal and (antiKatanaEnabled or antiRiotEnabled) then
            local blockPlr = jahvex_akTargetPlayer()
            local part = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_part")
            if part and part.Parent then
                local char = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                local sp = char and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
                if jahvex_playerGunDanger(sp) then
                    blockPlr = sp
                end
            end
            if jahvex_playerGunDanger(blockPlr) then
                if not _jahvexAkHoldBlock then
                    jahvex_akForceReleaseShoot()
                else
                    _G.jahvex_ak_breakLock = true
                end
                return false
            end
            if _jahvexAkHoldBlock then
                return false
            end
        end
        if not saOn and not trOn then
            return origStart(self, ...)
        end
        if not isLocal then
            return origStart(self, ...)
        end
        if rawget(_G, "jahvex_nest_bow_pass") then
            return origStart(self, ...)
        end

        local tryShoot = select(1, ...)
        local packed = table.pack(origStart(self, ...))
        local a, b, c = packed[1], packed[2], packed[3]
        local fired = a == true and b == "StartShooting"

        if fired and trOn then
            task.defer(function()
                local fn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_spawnTracer")
                if type(fn) == "function" then pcall(fn) end
            end)
        end

        if not saOn then
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end


        if not fired then
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end
        local chance = tonumber(rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_chance")) or 100
        if chance < 100 and math.random(1, 100) > chance then
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end

        local part = resolvePart()
        if not part then
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end


        local char = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            _G.jahvex_sa2_part = getSaTarget()
            part = resolvePart()
            if not part then
                return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
            end
            char = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
            end
        end

        local weaponName = self.Name
        local shotPart = saForceHead(char)
        if not shotPart or not saIsHeadPart(shotPart) then
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end
        if not shotPart or not shotPart.Parent then
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end
        local slowProj, slowName = gunIsSlowProj(self)
        local aimPos = shotPart.Position
        local origin
        if slowProj then
            origin = shotOrigin(slowName or weaponName)
        else
            origin = getSaShotOrigin() or shotOrigin(weaponName)
        end
        if not slowProj then
            if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or (origin - aimPos).Magnitude > 40 or saIsSkyPos(origin) then
                origin = aimPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0.85)
            end
        else
            if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or saIsSkyPos(origin) then
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or aimPos
            end
        end

        if slowProj and not saIsVoidDesyncPos(aimPos) and typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
            local speed = gunBulletSpeed(self)
            if not speed then
                speed = (slowName == "Slingshot") and 300 or 380
            end
            local grav = gunProjGravity(self)
            if grav < 0 then grav = 0 end
            aimPos = saProjAim(origin, aimPos, saTargetVelocity(char), speed, grav)
        end

        local payload = buildPayload(origin, aimPos, shotPart)
        if fired then
            if type(c) == "table" then
                c[k1] = payload[k1]
                c[k2] = payload[k2]
                packed[3] = c
            else
                packed[3] = payload
            end
            return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
        end

        return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
    end
end)

_G.__jxSaSave = function()
    return {
        enabled = saEnabled and true or false,
        teamCheck = saTeamCheck and true or false,
        visCheck = saVisCheck and true or false,
        healthCheck = saHealthCheck and true or false,
        hitChance = tonumber(saHitChance) or 100,
        fov = tonumber(saFov) or 2500,
        hitPart = tostring(saHitPart or "Head"),
    }
end
_G.__jxSaLoad = function(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
    if t.enabled ~= nil then
        saEnabled = t.enabled and true or false
        _G.jahvex_sa2_enabled = saEnabled
        if saEnableApi and saEnableApi.Set then saEnableApi:Set(saEnabled, false) end
        if saEnabled then
            pcall(function()
                if type(jahvex_ensureCombatAcBypass) == "function" then
                    jahvex_ensureCombatAcBypass()
                elseif type(jahvex_installCombatAcBypass) == "function" then
                    jahvex_installCombatAcBypass(false)
                end
            end)
        else
            _G.jahvex_sa2_part = nil
            saStickyPart = nil
        end
    end
    if t.teamCheck ~= nil then
        saTeamCheck = t.teamCheck and true or false
        if saTeamToggleApi and saTeamToggleApi.Set then
            saTeamToggleApi:Set(saTeamCheck, false)
        end
    end
    if t.visCheck ~= nil then saVisCheck = t.visCheck and true or false end
    if t.healthCheck ~= nil then saHealthCheck = t.healthCheck and true or false end
    if t.hitChance ~= nil then
        saHitChance = math.clamp(tonumber(t.hitChance) or 100, 0, 100)
        _G.jahvex_sa2_chance = saHitChance
    end
    if t.fov ~= nil then saFov = math.max(0, tonumber(t.fov) or saFov) end
    if type(t.hitPart) == "string" and t.hitPart ~= "" then saHitPart = t.hitPart end
end

_G.jahvex_combatSave = function()
    local out = {}
    if type(rawget(_G, "__jxAimSave")) == "function" then
        local ok, a = pcall(_G.__jxAimSave)
        if ok then out.aim = a end
    end
    if type(rawget(_G, "__jxSaSave")) == "function" then
        local ok, s = pcall(_G.__jxSaSave)
        if ok then out.sa = s end
    end
    return out
end
_G.jahvex_combatLoad = function(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
    if type(rawget(_G, "__jxAimLoad")) == "function" then
        pcall(_G.__jxAimLoad, t.aim)
    end
    if type(rawget(_G, "__jxSaLoad")) == "function" then
        pcall(_G.__jxSaLoad, t.sa)
    end
end
end
end
