function jahvex_antiFreezeGetEntity()
    local ent = nil
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController or _jahvexAfFC
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
            _jahvexAfFC = FC
        end
        local lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
        ent = lf and lf.Entity
    end)
    return ent
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeRawGet(ent, key)
    if not ent then return nil end
    local getter = ent._jahvex_af_rawGet or ent.Get
    if type(getter) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, v = pcall(getter, ent, key)
    if ok then return v end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeIsFrozenRaw()
    return jahvex_antiFreezeRawGet(jahvex_antiFreezeGetEntity(), "IsFrozen")
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeHookEntity(ent)
    if not ent or type(ent.Get) ~= "function" then return end
    if ent._jahvex_af_hooked then return end
    ent._jahvex_af_rawGet = ent.Get
    ent._jahvex_af_hooked = true
    ent.Get = function(e, key, ...)
        if antiFreezeEnabled and key == "IsFrozen" then
            return nil
        end
        return e._jahvex_af_rawGet(e, key, ...)
    end
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeHookFighter(lf)
    if not lf or type(lf.AreItemsLocked) ~= "function" then return end
    if lf._jahvex_af_items_hooked then return end
    lf._jahvex_af_items_orig = lf.AreItemsLocked
    lf._jahvex_af_items_hooked = true
    lf.AreItemsLocked = function(self, ...)

        if antiFreezeEnabled and jahvex_antiFreezeIsFrozenRaw() then
            return false
        end
        return self._jahvex_af_items_orig(self, ...)
    end
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeDesiredWalkSpeed()
    local ws = nil
    pcall(function()
        local MC = _jahvexAfMC
        if not MC then
            MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
            _jahvexAfMC = MC
        end
        if MC and type(MC._GetWalkSpeed) == "function" then
            ws = MC:_GetWalkSpeed()
        end
    end)
    ws = tonumber(ws)
    if ws and ws > 0.1 then
        antiFreezeBaseWs = ws
        return ws
    end
    if antiFreezeBaseWs and antiFreezeBaseWs > 0.1 then
        return antiFreezeBaseWs
    end
    return 16
end

local function jahvex_antiFreezeHideGui(g)
    if not g then return end
    if g:IsA("GuiObject") then g.Visible = false end
    if g:IsA("ImageLabel") or g:IsA("ImageButton") then
        g.ImageTransparency = 1
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("ImageLabel") or c:IsA("ImageButton") then
            c.ImageTransparency = 1
        elseif c:IsA("GuiObject") then
            c.Visible = false
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeClearVisuals()

    pcall(function()
        local g = _jahvexAfVignette
        if not (g and g.Parent) then
            local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if not pg then return end
            g = pg:FindFirstChild("FrozenVignette", true) or pg:FindFirstChild("Frozen", true)
            _jahvexAfVignette = g
        end
        jahvex_antiFreezeHideGui(g)
    end)


    pcall(function()
        local ent = jahvex_antiFreezeGetEntity()
        local model = ent and ent.Model
        if ent then
            if ent._thaw_highlight then
                pcall(function() ent._thaw_highlight:Destroy() end)
                ent._thaw_highlight = nil
            end
            if type(ent._ThawFreezeEffect) == "function" then
                pcall(function() ent:_ThawFreezeEffect() end)
            end
        end
        if model then
            for _, h in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                if h:IsA("Highlight") then
                    local fc = h.FillColor
                    if fc and fc.B > fc.R and fc.B > fc.G then
                        h:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                local n = string.lower(h.Name)
                if n:find("freeze", 1, true) or n:find("ice", 1, true) or n:find("thaw", 1, true) then
                    pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if inst:IsA("Model") then
                local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
                if n:find("freeze", 1, true) or n:find("icecage", 1, true) or n:find("thaw", 1, true) then
                    pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
        for i = #_jahvexAfFreezeModels, 1, -1 do
            local m = _jahvexAfFreezeModels[i]
            if m and m.Parent then pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) end
            table.remove(_jahvexAfFreezeModels, i)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeClearFrozenState(ent)
    if not ent then return end
    pcall(function()
        if type(ent.Set) == "function" then
            ent:Set("IsFrozen", nil)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local data = rawget(ent, "Data") or ent.Data
        if type(data) == "table" then
            rawset(data, "IsFrozen", nil)
            if data.IsFrozen ~= nil then
                data.IsFrozen = nil
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeApply()
    if not antiFreezeEnabled then return end
    local ent = jahvex_antiFreezeGetEntity()
    jahvex_antiFreezeHookEntity(ent)
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController or _jahvexAfFC
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
            _jahvexAfFC = FC
        end
        jahvex_antiFreezeHookFighter(FC and FC.LocalFighter)
    end)

    local frozen = jahvex_antiFreezeIsFrozenRaw()
    local char = lp.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    if not frozen then
        if hum.WalkSpeed and hum.WalkSpeed > 1 then
            antiFreezeBaseWs = hum.WalkSpeed
        end

        if _jahvexAfWasFrozen then
            jahvex_antiFreezeClearVisuals()
            _jahvexAfWasFrozen = false
        end
        return
    end

    _jahvexAfWasFrozen = true

    jahvex_antiFreezeClearFrozenState(ent)

    pcall(function()
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, false)
        if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end
    end)

    local want = jahvex_antiFreezeDesiredWalkSpeed()
    if hum.WalkSpeed ~= want then
        hum.WalkSpeed = want
    end

    local now = tick()
    if now - _jahvexAfVisAt >= 0.25 then
        _jahvexAfVisAt = now
        jahvex_antiFreezeClearVisuals()
    end
end

function jahvex_antiFreezeSetLoop(on)
    if _jahvexAfHb then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAfHb:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAfHb = nil
    end
    if not on then return end
    local _afTick = 0
    _jahvexAfHb = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not antiFreezeEnabled then return end
        _afTick = _afTick + 1
        if _afTick % 3 ~= 0 then return end
        jahvex_antiFreezeApply()
    end)
    jahvex_track(_jahvexAfHb)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local okMC, MC = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Controllers"):WaitForChild("MechanicsController", 10))
    if okMC and type(MC) == "table" and type(MC.IsFrozen) == "function" then
        if not MC._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_IsFrozen then
            MC._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_IsFrozen = MC.IsFrozen
        end
        local origIsFrozen = MC._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_IsFrozen
        MC.IsFrozen = function(self, ...)
            if antiFreezeEnabled then return nil end
            return origIsFrozen(self, ...)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        local State = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientFighterCharacter.State)
        if type(State) == "table" and type(State._UpdateHumanoidStates) == "function" then
            if not State._jahvex_antifreeze_orig then
                State._jahvex_antifreeze_orig = State._UpdateHumanoidStates
            end
            local orig = State._jahvex_antifreeze_orig
            State._UpdateHumanoidStates = function(self, ...)
                if antiFreezeEnabled then
                    local hum = self and self.ClientFighterCharacter and self.ClientFighterCharacter.Humanoid
                    if hum then
                        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
                        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
                        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, false)
                        hum.PlatformStand = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                return orig(self, ...)
            end
        end
    end)


    pcall(function()
        local CE = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientEntity)
        if type(CE) == "table" and type(CE._FreezeEffect) == "function" then
            if not CE._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_Freeze then
                CE._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_Freeze = CE._FreezeEffect
            end
            local origF = CE._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_Freeze
            CE._FreezeEffect = function(self, ...)
                local isLocal = false
                pcall(function()
                    isLocal = self and self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer
                end)
                if antiFreezeEnabled and isLocal then
                    return
                end
                return origF(self, ...)
            end
        end
        if type(CE) == "table" and type(CE.ReplicateFromServer) == "function" then
            if not CE._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_RFS then
                CE._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_RFS = CE.ReplicateFromServer
            end
            local origR = CE._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_RFS
            CE.ReplicateFromServer = function(self, action, ...)
                local isLocal = false
                pcall(function()
                    isLocal = self and self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer
                end)
                if antiFreezeEnabled and isLocal then
                    local name = action
                    pcall(function()
                        if type(jahvex_decodeEnumName) == "function" then
                            name = jahvex_decodeEnumName(action) or action
                        end
                    end)
                    name = tostring(name)
                    if name == "FreezeEffect" or name == "ThawFreezeEffect" then
                        return
                    end
                end
                return origR(self, action, ...)
            end
        end
    end)


    pcall(function()
        local Frozen = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.FighterInterface.Frozen)
        if type(Frozen) == "table" and type(Frozen.Refresh) == "function" then
            if not Frozen._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_Refresh then
                Frozen._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_Refresh = Frozen.Refresh
            end
            local orig = Frozen._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_Refresh
            Frozen.Refresh = function(self, ...)
                if antiFreezeEnabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        if self.Vignette then
                            self.Vignette.ImageTransparency = 1
                            self.Vignette.Visible = false
                        end
                        if self.VignetteTexture then
                            self.VignetteTexture.ImageTransparency = 1
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                return orig(self, ...)
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local Cam = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.CameraController)
        if type(Cam) == "table" and type(Cam.SetRotation) == "function" then
            if not Cam._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_SetRotation then
                Cam._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_SetRotation = Cam.SetRotation
            end
            local orig = Cam._jahvex_antifreeze_orig_SetRotation
            Cam.SetRotation = function(self, ...)
                if antiFreezeEnabled then
                    local sub = self and self._current_subject
                    if sub and sub.Entity then
                        jahvex_antiFreezeHookEntity(sub.Entity)
                    end
                end
                return orig(self, ...)
            end
        end
    end)

    if antiFreezeEnabled then
        jahvex_antiFreezeSetLoop(true)
    end
end)

_jahvexAflHb = nil
_jahvexAflGuiConn = nil
_jahvexAflLitConn = nil
_jahvexAflHooked = false
function jahvex_antiFlashClearVisuals()
    pcall(function()
        local g = lp.PlayerGui and lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("FlashbangGui")
        if g then g:Destroy() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        for _, c in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if c.Name == "Flashbang" then
                pcall(function()
                    if c:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                        c.Enabled = false
                        c.Brightness = 0
                    end
                    c:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_antiFlashHook()
    if _jahvexAflHooked then return end
    local Flashed
    pcall(function()
        Flashed = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.FighterInterface.Flashed)
    end)
    if type(Flashed) ~= "table" then return end
    _jahvexAflHooked = true
    jahvex_saveMod("Flashed_Flash", Flashed, "Flash")
    jahvex_saveMod("Flashed_AttemptToFlash", Flashed, "AttemptToFlash")
    local origFlash = Flashed.Flash
    local origAttempt = Flashed.AttemptToFlash
    if type(origFlash) == "function" then
        Flashed.Flash = function(self, ...)
            if antiFlashEnabled then
                jahvex_antiFlashClearVisuals()
                return
            end
            return origFlash(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(origAttempt) == "function" then
        Flashed.AttemptToFlash = function(self, ...)
            if antiFlashEnabled then
                jahvex_antiFlashClearVisuals()
                return
            end
            return origAttempt(self, ...)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_antiFlashSetLoop(on)
    if _jahvexAflHb then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAflHb:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAflHb = nil
    end
    if _jahvexAflGuiConn then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAflGuiConn:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAflGuiConn = nil
    end
    if _jahvexAflLitConn then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAflLitConn:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAflLitConn = nil
    end
    if not on then return end
    jahvex_antiFlashHook()
    jahvex_antiFlashClearVisuals()
    local _aflFrame = 0
    _jahvexAflHb = jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() or not antiFlashEnabled then return end
        _aflFrame = _aflFrame + 1
        if _aflFrame % 6 ~= 0 then return end
        jahvex_antiFlashClearVisuals()
    end))
    _jahvexAflGuiConn = jahvex_track(lp.PlayerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(g)
        if antiFlashEnabled and g and g.Name == "FlashbangGui" then
            task.defer(function() pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end)
        end
    end))
    _jahvexAflLitConn = jahvex_track(Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if antiFlashEnabled and c and c.Name == "Flashbang" then
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if c:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                        c.Enabled = false
                        c.Brightness = 0
                    end
                    c:Destroy()
                end)
            end)
        end
    end))
end
pcall(jahvex_antiFlashHook)

_jahvexUjHooked = false
_jahvexUjLast = 0
function jahvex_unlimitedJumpHook()
    if _jahvexUjHooked then return end
    local MC
    pcall(function()
        MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
    end)
    if type(MC) ~= "table" or type(MC.DoubleJumpRequest) ~= "function" then return end
    _jahvexUjHooked = true
    jahvex_saveMod("MC_DoubleJumpRequest", MC, "DoubleJumpRequest")
    local orig = MC.DoubleJumpRequest
    MC.DoubleJumpRequest = function(self, ...)
        if unlimitedJumpEnabled then
            local f = self.LocalFighter
            local grounded = true
            pcall(function()
                grounded = f and f:IsGrounded()
            end)
            if f and not grounded then
                local now = tick()
                if now - (_jahvexUjLast or 0) >= 0.08 then
                    _jahvexUjLast = now
                    return self:DoubleJump()
                end
                return
            end
        end
        return orig(self, ...)
    end
end
pcall(jahvex_unlimitedJumpHook)

_jahvexSbHooked = false
function jahvex_slideBoostHookFighter(lf)
    if not lf or type(lf.Get) ~= "function" then return end
    if lf._jahvex_sb_hooked then return end
    lf._jahvex_sb_rawGet = lf.Get
    lf._jahvex_sb_hooked = true
    lf.Get = function(self, key, ...)
        if slideBoostEnabled and key == "SlidingSpeedMax" then
            return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(slideBoostValue) or 10), 1, 50)
        end
        return self._jahvex_sb_rawGet(self, key, ...)
    end
end

function jahvex_slideBoostHook()
    local FC, MC, lf
    pcall(function()
        FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
    end)
    pcall(jahvex_slideBoostHookFighter, lf)
    if _jahvexSbHooked then return end
    pcall(function()
        MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
    end)
    if type(MC) ~= "table" or type(MC.Slide) ~= "function" then return end
    _jahvexSbHooked = true
    jahvex_saveMod("MC_Slide", MC, "Slide")
    local origSlide = MC.Slide
    MC.Slide = function(self, ...)
        pcall(jahvex_slideBoostHookFighter, self.LocalFighter)
        return origSlide(self, ...)
    end
end
pcall(jahvex_slideBoostHook)

function jahvex_playerBindEncode(b)
    b = b or { kind = "none" }
    if b.kind == "Key" and b.key then
        return { kind = "Key", key = tostring(b.key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "") }
    end
    if b.kind == "Mouse" and b.mouse then
        return { kind = "Mouse", mouse = tostring(b.mouse):gsub("Enum.UserInputType.", "") }
    end
    return { kind = "none" }
end

function jahvex_playerBindDecode(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return { kind = "none" } end
    if t.kind == "Key" and type(t.key) == "string" and Enum.KeyCode[t.key] then
        return { kind = "Key", key = Enum.KeyCode[t.key] }
    end
    if t.kind == "Mouse" and type(t.mouse) == "string" and Enum.UserInputType[t.mouse] then
        return { kind = "Mouse", mouse = Enum.UserInputType[t.mouse] }
    end
    return { kind = "none" }
end

function jahvex_playerBindText(b)
    b = b or { kind = "none" }
    if b.kind == "Mouse" then
        if b.mouse == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return "lmb" end
        if b.mouse == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return "rmb" end
        if b.mouse == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then return "mmb" end
        return "mouse"
    end
    if b.kind == "Key" and b.key then
        return string.lower(tostring(b.key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", ""))
    end
    return "none"
end

function jahvex_playerBindMatch(b, input)
    if not b or b.kind == "none" or not input then return false end
    if b.kind == "Mouse" then
        return input.UserInputType == b.mouse
    end
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode == b.key
end

playerFlyBind = jahvex_playerBindDecode(playerFlyBind)
playerNoclipBind = jahvex_playerBindDecode(playerNoclipBind)
playerWsBind = jahvex_playerBindDecode(playerWsBind)
playerJumpBind = jahvex_playerBindDecode(playerJumpBind)

_jahvexMvHooked = false
_jahvexMvMC = nil
_jahvexMvHb = nil
_jahvexMvStep = nil
_jahvexMvCharConn = nil
_jahvexMvInputConn = nil
_jahvexMvListen = nil

local function jahvex_playerFlyCleanup(hrp)
    if not hrp then return end
    pcall(function()
        local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("MoveBV")
        if bv then bv:Destroy() end
        local bg = hrp:FindFirstChild("MoveBG")
        if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    end)
end

function jahvex_playerMoveHook()
    if _jahvexMvHooked then return end
    local MC
    pcall(function()
        MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
    end)
    if type(MC) ~= "table" then return end
    _jahvexMvHooked = true
    _jahvexMvMC = MC
    if type(MC._GetWalkSpeed) == "function" then
        jahvex_saveMod("MC_GetWalkSpeed", MC, "_GetWalkSpeed")
        local origGet = MC._GetWalkSpeed
        MC._GetWalkSpeed = function(self, ...)
            if playerWsEnabled then
                return math.clamp(tonumber(playerWalkSpeed) or 32, 16, 200)
            end
            return origGet(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(MC.Jump) == "function" then
        jahvex_saveMod("MC_Jump", MC, "Jump")
        local origJump = MC.Jump
        MC.Jump = function(self, ...)
            if playerJumpEnabled then
                local jp = math.clamp(tonumber(playerJumpBoost) or 50, 20, 200)
                self._original_jump_power = jp
                pcall(function()
                    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        hum.UseJumpPower = true
                        hum.JumpPower = jp
                    end
                end)
            end
            return origJump(self, ...)
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_playerApplyNoclip(char, on)
    if not char then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            if on then
                p.CanCollide = false
            elseif p.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or p.Name == "Torso" or p.Name == "UpperTorso" or p.Name == "LowerTorso" then
                p.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_playerRefreshWs()
    pcall(function()
        local MC = _jahvexMvMC
        if MC and type(MC._UpdateWalkSpeed) == "function" then
            MC:_UpdateWalkSpeed()
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_playerMoveTick(dt)
    if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
    local char = lp.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    _G.flying = playerFlyEnabled and true or false
    if playerWsEnabled and hum then
        local want = math.clamp(tonumber(playerWalkSpeed) or 32, 16, 200)
        if hum.WalkSpeed ~= want then
            hum.WalkSpeed = want
        end
    end
    if playerJumpEnabled and hum then
        local jp = math.clamp(tonumber(playerJumpBoost) or 50, 20, 200)
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        if hum.JumpPower ~= jp then
            hum.JumpPower = jp
        end
    end
    if playerFlyEnabled and hrp and hum then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(playerFlySpeed) or 50, 10, 200)
        local cf = cam.CFrame
        local move = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cf.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cf.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cf.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cf.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.C) then
            move = move - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        local vel = (move.Magnitude > 0) and (move.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("MoveBV")
        if not bv then
            bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "MoveBV"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            bv.P = 1250
            bv.Parent = hrp
        end
        bv.Velocity = vel
        local bg = hrp:FindFirstChild("MoveBG")
        if not bg then
            bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "MoveBG"
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.P = 9e4
            bg.Parent = hrp
        end
        local look = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
        if look.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            bg.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + look)
        end
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
    elseif hrp then
        jahvex_playerFlyCleanup(hrp)
    end
end

function jahvex_playerNoclipTick()
    if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end

    if not (playerFlyEnabled or playerNoclipEnabled) then return end
    jahvex_playerApplyNoclip(lp.Character, true)
end

function jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop()
    if _jahvexMvHb then
        pcall(function() _jahvexMvHb:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexMvHb = nil
    end
    if _jahvexMvStep then
        pcall(function() _jahvexMvStep:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexMvStep = nil
    end
    local any = playerFlyEnabled or playerNoclipEnabled or playerWsEnabled or playerJumpEnabled
    if not any then
        _G.flying = false
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_playerFlyCleanup(lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            jahvex_playerApplyNoclip(lp.Character, false)
            jahvex_playerRefreshWs()
        end)
        return
    end
    pcall(jahvex_playerMoveHook)
    _jahvexMvHb = jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        jahvex_playerMoveTick(dt)
    end))
    _jahvexMvStep = jahvex_track(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        jahvex_playerNoclipTick()
    end))
    if not playerFlyEnabled then
        _G.flying = false
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_playerFlyCleanup(lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        end)
    end
    if not (playerFlyEnabled or playerNoclipEnabled) then
        pcall(function() jahvex_playerApplyNoclip(lp.Character, false) end)
    end
    pcall(jahvex_playerRefreshWs)
end

function jahvex_playerMoveToggle(name, state, statusText)
    if name == "fly" then
        playerFlyEnabled = state and true or false
        if not playerFlyEnabled then
            _G.flying = false
            pcall(function()
                jahvex_playerFlyCleanup(lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            end)
        end
    elseif name == "noclip" then
        playerNoclipEnabled = state and true or false
        if not playerNoclipEnabled and not playerFlyEnabled then
            pcall(function() jahvex_playerApplyNoclip(lp.Character, false) end)
        end
    elseif name == "ws" then
        playerWsEnabled = state and true or false
    elseif name == "jump" then
        playerJumpEnabled = state and true or false
    end
    jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop()
    if statusText and setStatus then
        setStatus(statusText, state and GREEN or RED)
    end
    pcall(saveConfig)
end

if not _jahvexMvCharConn then
    _jahvexMvCharConn = jahvex_track(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.defer(function()
            if playerFlyEnabled or playerNoclipEnabled or playerWsEnabled or playerJumpEnabled then
                jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop()
            end
        end)
    end))
end
pcall(jahvex_playerMoveHook)
if playerFlyEnabled or playerNoclipEnabled or playerWsEnabled or playerJumpEnabled then
    jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop()
end


local function jahvex_cfVoid(cf)
    local p = typeof(cf) == "CFrame" and cf.Position or nil
    if typeof(p) ~= "Vector3" then return true end
    return math.abs(p.X) > 50000 or math.abs(p.Y) > 50000 or math.abs(p.Z) > 50000 or p.Magnitude > 50000
end
function jahvex_visGet()
    local v = getgenv().__jahvex_vis
    if typeof(v) == "CFrame" and not jahvex_cfVoid(v) then return v end
    v = getgenv().__rb_vis_bindual
    if typeof(v) == "CFrame" and not jahvex_cfVoid(v) then return v end
    return nil
end
local function jahvex_visSet(cf)
    if typeof(cf) == "CFrame" and not jahvex_cfVoid(cf) then
        getgenv().__jahvex_vis = cf
    end
end

_jahvexLobbyUiAt = 0
_jahvexLobbyUi = false
function jahvex_gameInLobby()
    if type(jahvex_inMatchWorld) == "function" then
        if jahvex_inMatchWorld() then
            local over
            pcall(function() over = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeGameOver") end)
            return over == true
        end
        return true
    end
    if not lp.Character then return true end
    if not lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return true end
    local status, over
    pcall(function()
        status = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeStatus")
        over = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeGameOver")
    end)
    if over == true then return true end
    if status == "Started" then return false end
    if workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") and not workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena") then return true end
    return false
end

local JX_UG_BIND = "jahvex_ug_visual"
local JX_UG_MAX_BURY = 6.35
local JX_UG_HEAD_BELOW = 2.45
_jahvexUgVis = nil
_jahvexUgRoot = nil
_jahvexUgPost = nil
_jahvexUgOobUtil = nil
_jahvexUgRay = RaycastParams.new()
_jahvexUgRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
_jahvexUgRay.IgnoreWater = true

local function jahvex_ugLooksBuried(cf, vis)
    if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(vis) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
    return (vis.Position.Y - cf.Position.Y) > 1.1
end

local function jahvex_ugFloorY(char, origin)
    _jahvexUgRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
    local r = workspace:Raycast(origin + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -26, 0), _jahvexUgRay)
    if r then return r.Position.Y end
    return nil
end

local function jahvex_ugIsOob(pos)
    local bad = false
    pcall(function()
        if not _jahvexUgOobUtil then
            _jahvexUgOobUtil = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.GameplayUtility)
        end
        if _jahvexUgOobUtil:IsWithinOOBPart(pos) then
            bad = true
        end
    end)
    local fh = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
    if type(fh) == "number" and pos.Y < (fh + 16) then
        bad = true
    end
    return bad
end

local function jahvex_ugServerCf(char, hrp, vis)
    local visPos = vis.Position
    local surf = jahvex_ugFloorY(char, visPos)
    if type(surf) ~= "number" then return nil end
    local headOff = 1.75
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
        headOff = math.clamp(math.abs(head.Position.Y - hrp.Position.Y), 1.3, 2.55)
    end
    local bury = math.clamp(headOff + JX_UG_HEAD_BELOW, 3.35, JX_UG_MAX_BURY)
    local pos = Vector3.new(visPos.X, surf - bury, visPos.Z)
    if jahvex_ugIsOob(pos) then
        for _ = 1, 5 do
            bury = bury * 0.6
            if bury < 0.85 then return nil end
            pos = Vector3.new(visPos.X, surf - bury, visPos.Z)
            if not jahvex_ugIsOob(pos) then break end
        end
        if jahvex_ugIsOob(pos) then return nil end
    end
    return CFrame.new(pos) * (vis - vis.Position)
end

local function jahvex_ugRestore()
    local char = lp.Character
    local root = char and (char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    local vis = jahvex_visGet() or _jahvexUgVis
    if not root or typeof(vis) ~= "CFrame" then return end
    if jahvex_cfVoid(vis) or jahvex_cfVoid(root.CFrame) then return end
    if (root.Position - vis.Position).Magnitude > 40 then return end
    root.CFrame = vis
end

function jahvex_undergroundSetLoop(on)
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(JX_UG_BIND) end)
    if _jahvexUgPost then
        pcall(function() _jahvexUgPost:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexUgPost = nil
    end
    if not on then
        jahvex_ugRestore()
        _jahvexUgVis = nil
        _jahvexUgRoot = nil
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(JX_UG_BIND, 1, function()
            if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not playerUndergroundEnabled then return end
            if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
            jahvex_ugRestore()
        end)
    end)
    _jahvexUgPost = jahvex_track(RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not playerUndergroundEnabled then return end
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        local char = lp.Character
        local root = char and (char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        if not root then return end
        if type(jahvex_mapAnchorWatch) == "function" then
            pcall(jahvex_mapAnchorWatch, root)
        end
        if jahvex_cfVoid(root.CFrame) then
            _jahvexUgVis = nil
            return
        end
        if root ~= _jahvexUgRoot then
            _jahvexUgRoot = root
            _jahvexUgVis = nil
        end
        local vis = jahvex_visGet() or _jahvexUgVis
        if typeof(vis) == "CFrame" and (vis.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 48 then
            vis = root.CFrame
            jahvex_visSet(vis)
        end
        if typeof(vis) ~= "CFrame" or not jahvex_ugLooksBuried(root.CFrame, vis) then
            if not jahvex_cfVoid(root.CFrame) then
                vis = root.CFrame
                jahvex_visSet(vis)
            end
        end
        _jahvexUgVis = vis
        if typeof(_jahvexUgVis) ~= "CFrame" or jahvex_cfVoid(_jahvexUgVis) then return end
        local ug = jahvex_ugServerCf(char, root, _jahvexUgVis)
        if ug and not jahvex_cfVoid(ug) then
            root.CFrame = ug
        end
    end))
end

jahvex_track(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    _jahvexUgVis = nil
    _jahvexUgRoot = nil
    if playerUndergroundEnabled then
        task.defer(function()
            jahvex_undergroundSetLoop(true)
        end)
    end
end))
if playerUndergroundEnabled then
    jahvex_undergroundSetLoop(true)
end


function jahvex_thirdPersonSet(enabled)
    thirdPersonEnabled = enabled and true or false
    pcall(function()
        local CC = CameraControllerModule
        if not CC then
            CC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.CameraController)
            CameraControllerModule = CC
        end
        if not CC or not CC.CameraState then return end
        local CS = CC.CameraState
        local States = CS.States
        if thirdPersonEnabled then
            CC:SetThirdPersonOverride(true)
            local pov = CS._pov_state
            if pov == States.FirstPerson or pov == nil then
                CS:_SetPOVState(States.ThirdPerson)
            elseif pov ~= States.ThirdPerson and pov ~= States.ThirdPersonMirrored and pov ~= States.ThirdPersonUnlockedMouse then
                CS:_SetPOVState(States.ThirdPerson)
            end
        else
            local restoreOverride = nil
            pcall(function()
                local FC = FighterController
                if not FC then
                    FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
                end
                local lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
                if lf and type(lf.Get) == "function" then
                    restoreOverride = lf:Get("ThirdPersonOverride")
                end
            end)
            CC:SetThirdPersonOverride(restoreOverride)
            CS:_SetPOVState(States.FirstPerson)
        end
    end)
end
if thirdPersonEnabled then
    task.defer(function()
        if thirdPersonEnabled then jahvex_thirdPersonSet(true) end
    end)
end


local JX_AA_BIND = "jahvex_aa_visual"
local JX_AA_MOTORS = {
    Head = "Neck",
    Torso = "Waist",
    LeftArm = "LeftShoulder",
    RightArm = "RightShoulder",
    LeftLeg = "LeftHip",
    RightLeg = "RightHip",
}
local JX_AA_MOTOR_GROUPS = {
    Head = { "Neck" },
    Torso = { "Waist", "Root" },
    LeftArm = { "LeftShoulder", "LeftElbow", "LeftWrist" },
    RightArm = { "RightShoulder", "RightElbow", "RightWrist" },
    LeftLeg = { "LeftHip", "LeftKnee", "LeftAnkle" },
    RightLeg = { "RightHip", "RightKnee", "RightAnkle" },
}
function jahvex_aaDefaultPart()
    return { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, spin = 0 }
end
function jahvex_aaPartsEncode(t)
    local out = {}
    t = type(t) == "table" and t or {}
    for name in pairs(JX_AA_MOTORS) do
        local p = t[name] or jahvex_aaDefaultPart()
        out[name] = {
            x = math.clamp(tonumber(p.x) or 0, -6, 6),
            y = math.clamp(tonumber(p.y) or 0, -6, 6),
            z = math.clamp(tonumber(p.z) or 0, -6, 6),
            spin = math.clamp(tonumber(p.spin) or 0, 0, 20),
        }
    end
    return out
end
aaParts = jahvex_aaPartsEncode(aaParts)
_jahvexAaRoot = nil
_jahvexAaPost = nil
_jahvexAaHb = nil
_jahvexAaRandYaw = 0
_jahvexAaRandPitch = 0
_jahvexAaRandAt = 0
_jahvexAaSpin = 0
_jahvexAaLastT = 0
_jahvexAaOrigC0 = {}
_jahvexAaMotorMap = nil
_jahvexAaRotHooked = false
_jahvexAaJointsHooked = false
_jahvexAaCamHooked = false
_jahvexAaCamFireOrig = nil
_jahvexAaLookAt = 0
_jahvexAaSendingLook = false
_jahvexAaUtility = nil
_jahvexAaBind = {}
_jahvexAaScatter = false
_jahvexAaNeck = nil
_jahvexAaAnimTracks = {}
_jahvexAaAnimOn = false
_jahvexAaVisPos = nil
_jahvexAaAnimOffs = 0
_jahvexAaReal = nil
_jahvexAaFake = nil
_jahvexAaStep = nil
_jahvexAnchorRoot = nil
_jahvexAnchorPos = nil
_jahvexWasLobby = nil
function jahvex_mapAnchorReset()
    getgenv().__jahvex_vis = nil
    getgenv().__rb_vis_bindual = nil
    getgenv().__jahvex_anchor_clear = true
    _jahvexUgVis = nil
    _jahvexAaReal = nil
    _jahvexAaFake = nil
    _jahvexAaVisPos = nil
    _jahvexAaBoxCf = nil
end
function jahvex_mapAnchorWatch(root)
    if not root then return end
    local pos = root.Position
    local voidNow = jahvex_cfVoid(root.CFrame)
    if root ~= _jahvexAnchorRoot then
        _jahvexAnchorRoot = root
        _jahvexAnchorPos = voidNow and nil or pos
        jahvex_mapAnchorReset()
        return
    end
    if voidNow then
        return
    end
    if typeof(_jahvexAnchorPos) == "Vector3" and (pos - _jahvexAnchorPos).Magnitude > 48 then
        jahvex_mapAnchorReset()
        _jahvexAnchorPos = pos
        return
    end
    _jahvexAnchorPos = pos
end
local JX_AA_BREAK_IDS = {
    "rbxassetid://86806707642727",
    "rbxassetid://118493257042591",
    "rbxassetid://110835852737455",
}

local function jahvex_aaSetAutoRotate(on)
    pcall(function()
        local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.AutoRotate = on and true or false
        end
    end)
end

local function jahvex_aaStopBreakAnim()
    _jahvexAaAnimOn = false
    for _, t in pairs(_jahvexAaAnimTracks) do
        pcall(function()
            t:Stop(0.05)
            t:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    _jahvexAaAnimTracks = {}
end

local function jahvex_aaBreakSpeed()
    local s = 1
    if type(aaParts) == "table" then
        for _, p in pairs(aaParts) do
            if type(p) == "table" then
                s = s + (tonumber(p.spin) or 0) * 0.12
                s = s + (math.abs(tonumber(p.x) or 0) + math.abs(tonumber(p.y) or 0) + math.abs(tonumber(p.z) or 0)) * 0.06
            end
        end
    end
    if aaSpinEnabled then
        s = s * (0.7 + (tonumber(aaSpinSpeed) or 12) / 28)
    end
    return math.clamp(s, 0.25, 4)
end

local function jahvex_aaAnimOffset()
    local o = 0
    if type(aaParts) ~= "table" then return 0 end
    for _, p in pairs(aaParts) do
        if type(p) == "table" then
            o = o + (tonumber(p.x) or 0) * 0.17
            o = o + (tonumber(p.y) or 0) * 0.23
            o = o + (tonumber(p.z) or 0) * 0.19
            o = o + (tonumber(p.spin) or 0) * 0.08
        end
    end
    return o
end

local function jahvex_aaPartScore(key)
    local p = type(aaParts) == "table" and aaParts[key]
    if type(p) ~= "table" then return 0 end
    return math.abs(tonumber(p.x) or 0) + math.abs(tonumber(p.y) or 0) + math.abs(tonumber(p.z) or 0) + (tonumber(p.spin) or 0)
end

local function jahvex_aaPickBreakIndex()
    local head = jahvex_aaPartScore("Head")
    local torso = jahvex_aaPartScore("Torso")
    local limbs = jahvex_aaPartScore("LeftArm") + jahvex_aaPartScore("RightArm")
        + jahvex_aaPartScore("LeftLeg") + jahvex_aaPartScore("RightLeg")
    if head >= torso and head >= limbs and head > 0.05 then return 3 end
    if limbs >= torso and limbs > 0.05 then return 2 end
    return 1
end

local function jahvex_aaTuneBreakAnim()
    if not _jahvexAaAnimOn then return end
    local pick = jahvex_aaPickBreakIndex()
    local sp = jahvex_aaBreakSpeed()
    local offs = jahvex_aaAnimOffset()
    local dOff = offs - (_jahvexAaAnimOffs or 0)
    _jahvexAaAnimOffs = offs
    for i, t in ipairs(_jahvexAaAnimTracks) do
        pcall(function()
            local on = i == pick
            t:AdjustWeight(on and 1 or 0, 0)
            t:AdjustSpeed(on and sp or 2.8)
            if on then
                local len = t.Length
                if type(len) == "number" and len > 0.05 and math.abs(dOff) > 0.001 then
                    t.TimePosition = (t.TimePosition + dOff) % len
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaStartBreakAnim()
    if _jahvexAaAnimOn then
        jahvex_aaTuneBreakAnim()
        return
    end
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    _jahvexAaAnimOn = true
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    local function play(id)
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            local a = Instance.new("Animation")
            a.AnimationId = id
            local t
            if animator then
                t = animator:LoadAnimation(a)
            else
                t = hum:LoadAnimation(a)
            end
            t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            t.Looped = true
            t:Play(0)
            t:AdjustWeight(1, 0)
            t:AdjustSpeed(1.29)
            return t
        end)
        if ok and track then
            table.insert(_jahvexAaAnimTracks, track)
            pcall(function()
                track.Ended:Connect(function()
                    if _jahvexAaAnimOn and getgenv().jahvex_alive and aaEnabled then
                        pcall(function()
                            track:Play(0)
                            jahvex_aaTuneBreakAnim()
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(JX_AA_BREAK_IDS) do
        play(id)
    end
    jahvex_aaTuneBreakAnim()
end

local function jahvex_aaCaptureScales(hum)
    if not hum or _jahvexAaScaleOrig then return end
    _jahvexAaScaleOrig = {}
    _jahvexAaHipOrig = hum.HipHeight
    for name in pairs(JX_AA_SCALES) do
        local o = hum:FindFirstChild(name)
        if o and o:IsA("NumberValue") then
            _jahvexAaScaleOrig[name] = o.Value
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaRestoreScales(hum)
    if not hum then return end
    pcall(function()
        if _jahvexAaHipOrig ~= nil then
            hum.HipHeight = _jahvexAaHipOrig
        end
    end)
    if type(_jahvexAaScaleOrig) ~= "table" then return end
    for name, val in pairs(_jahvexAaScaleOrig) do
        local o = hum:FindFirstChild(name)
        if o and o:IsA("NumberValue") then
            pcall(function() o.Value = val end)
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaBoxScales(hum)
    if not hum then return end
    jahvex_aaCaptureScales(hum)
    pcall(function()
        hum.HipHeight = 0
        hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled = true
    end)
    for name, val in pairs(JX_AA_SCALES) do
        local o = hum:FindFirstChild(name)
        if o and o:IsA("NumberValue") then
            pcall(function() o.Value = val end)
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaBoxGroundCf(char, root)
    if typeof(_jahvexAaBoxCf) == "CFrame" then
        return _jahvexAaBoxCf
    end
    pcall(function()
        _jahvexAaBoxRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, workspace.CurrentCamera }
    end)
    local from = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, Vector3.new(0, -90, 0), _jahvexAaBoxRay)
    local y
    if hit then
        y = hit.Position.Y + 0.35
    else
        y = root.Position.Y - 2.5
    end
    _jahvexAaBoxCf = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, y, root.Position.Z)
    return _jahvexAaBoxCf
end

local function jahvex_aaAngles()
    local now = tick()
    if now - (_jahvexAaRandAt or 0) >= 0.07 then
        _jahvexAaRandAt = now
        _jahvexAaRandYaw = math.rad(math.random(-180, 180))
        _jahvexAaRandPitch = math.rad(math.random(-40, 40))
        if aaPitchMode == "extended_random" then
            _jahvexAaRandPitch = math.rad(math.random(-70, 70))
        end
    end
    local yaw = 0
    local ym = aaYawMode or "backwards"
    if ym == "offset" or ym == "custom" then
        yaw = math.rad(tonumber(aaYawOffset) or 180)
    elseif ym == "backwards" then
        yaw = math.pi
    elseif ym == "random" then
        yaw = _jahvexAaRandYaw
    end
    local pitch = 0
    local pm = aaPitchMode or "look_up"
    local extra = math.rad(math.clamp(tonumber(aaPitchOffset) or 0, -180, 180))
    if pm == "offset" or pm == "custom" then
        pitch = extra
    elseif pm == "extended_custom" then
        pitch = extra * 1.45
    elseif pm == "random" or pm == "extended_random" then
        pitch = _jahvexAaRandPitch + extra
    elseif pm == "look_up" then
        pitch = math.rad(-72) + extra
    elseif pm == "look_down" then
        pitch = math.rad(100) + math.sin(tick() * 7.2) * math.rad(58) + extra
    end
    return yaw, pitch
end

local function jahvex_aaPitchDunk(pitch)
    pitch = tonumber(pitch) or 0
    if pitch > 0.65 then
        return -(pitch - 0.65) * 1.25
    end
    if pitch < -1.05 then
        return (pitch + 1.05) * 0.4
    end
    return 0
end

local function jahvex_aaPartExtra(key)
    local p = type(aaParts) == "table" and aaParts[key] or nil
    if type(p) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local spin = math.clamp(tonumber(p.spin) or 0, 0, 20)
    if spin <= 0 then return nil end
    local t = tick() * spin
    return CFrame.Angles(t, t * 0.73, t * 0.41)
end

local function jahvex_aaCaptureMotors(char)
    if not char then return end
    if _jahvexAaMotorMap and next(_jahvexAaOrigC0) then return end
    _jahvexAaMotorMap = {}
    _jahvexAaOrigC0 = {}
    _jahvexAaOrigC1 = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Motor6D") then
            _jahvexAaMotorMap[d.Name] = d
            _jahvexAaOrigC0[d] = d.C0
            _jahvexAaOrigC1[d] = d.C1
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaCollapseMotors()
    jahvex_aaCaptureMotors(lp.Character)
    if not _jahvexAaMotorMap then return end
    for _, m in pairs(_jahvexAaMotorMap) do
        pcall(function()
            m.C0 = CFrame.new()
            m.C1 = CFrame.new()
        end)
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaRestoreMotors()
    for motor, c0 in pairs(_jahvexAaOrigC0) do
        pcall(function()
            if motor and motor.Parent then
                motor.C0 = c0
                local c1 = _jahvexAaOrigC1 and _jahvexAaOrigC1[motor]
                if c1 then motor.C1 = c1 end
            end
        end)
    end
    _jahvexAaOrigC0 = {}
    _jahvexAaMotorMap = nil
end

local function jahvex_aaWantsScatter()
    if type(aaParts) ~= "table" then return false end
    for key in pairs(JX_AA_MOTORS) do
        if jahvex_aaPartExtra(key) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function jahvex_aaScatterOff()
    if not _jahvexAaScatter then
        _jahvexAaBind = {}
        return
    end
    _jahvexAaScatter = false
    for _, b in pairs(_jahvexAaBind) do
        pcall(function()
            if b.motor and b.motor.Parent then
                b.motor.Part1 = b.part1
                b.motor.Enabled = b.on
            end
            if b.part and b.part.Parent then
                b.part.Anchored = b.anchored
                b.part.CanCollide = b.col
                b.part.Massless = b.mass
            end
        end)
    end
    _jahvexAaBind = {}
    local char = lp.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and _jahvexAaNeck ~= nil then
        pcall(function() hum.RequiresNeck = _jahvexAaNeck end)
    end
    _jahvexAaNeck = nil
end

local function jahvex_aaScatterOn(char, root)
    if _jahvexAaScatter or not char or not root then return end
    jahvex_aaCaptureMotors(char)
    if not _jahvexAaMotorMap then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    _jahvexAaBind = {}
    _jahvexAaNeck = hum.RequiresNeck
    pcall(function() hum.RequiresNeck = false end)
    for motor, c0 in pairs(_jahvexAaOrigC0) do
        pcall(function()
            if motor and motor.Parent then motor.C0 = c0 end
        end)
    end
    for key, motorName in pairs(JX_AA_MOTORS) do
        if jahvex_aaPartExtra(key) then
            local m = _jahvexAaMotorMap[motorName]
            local part = m and m.Part1
            if part and part ~= root and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                _jahvexAaBind[key] = {
                    part = part,
                    motor = m,
                    part1 = m.Part1,
                    rel = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame),
                    on = m.Enabled,
                    anchored = part.Anchored,
                    col = part.CanCollide,
                    mass = part.Massless,
                }
                pcall(function()
                    part.CanCollide = false
                    part.Massless = true
                    m.Enabled = false
                    m.Part1 = nil
                    part.Anchored = true
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    _jahvexAaScatter = next(_jahvexAaBind) ~= nil
    if not _jahvexAaScatter then
        if _jahvexAaNeck ~= nil then
            pcall(function() hum.RequiresNeck = _jahvexAaNeck end)
        end
        _jahvexAaNeck = nil
        _jahvexAaBind = {}
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaPlaceLimbs(rootCF, pitch)
    for key, b in pairs(_jahvexAaBind) do
        local part = b.part
        if part and part.Parent then
            local cf = rootCF * b.rel
            if key == "Head" then
                cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
            elseif key == "Torso" then
                cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.35, 0, 0)
            end
            local extra = jahvex_aaPartExtra(key)
            if extra then
                cf = cf * extra
            end
            pcall(function()
                part.Anchored = true
                part.CanCollide = false
                part.CFrame = cf
                part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaApplyMotors(char, pitch)
    jahvex_aaCaptureMotors(char)
    if not _jahvexAaMotorMap then return end
    for key, names in pairs(JX_AA_MOTOR_GROUPS) do
        local extra = jahvex_aaPartExtra(key)
        for _, motorName in ipairs(names) do
            local m = _jahvexAaMotorMap[motorName]
            local orig = m and _jahvexAaOrigC0[m]
            if m and orig then
                local cf = orig
                if motorName == "Neck" then
                    local dunk = jahvex_aaPitchDunk(pitch)
                    local pos = orig.Position
                    cf = CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y + dunk, pos.Z + math.max(pitch, 0) * 0.12) * (orig - pos) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
                elseif motorName == "Waist" then
                    cf = orig * CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.45, 0, 0)
                end
                if extra then
                    cf = cf * extra
                end
                pcall(function()
                    m.C0 = cf
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaLookRemote()
    local r
    pcall(function()
        r = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation
    end)
    return r
end

local function jahvex_aaEncodeLook(yaw, pitch)
    if not _jahvexAaUtility then
        pcall(function()
            _jahvexAaUtility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
        end)
    end
    local tau = math.pi * 2
    local px = (tonumber(pitch) or 0) % tau
    local py = (tonumber(yaw) or 0) % tau
    local vec = Vector2.new(px, py)
    local enc
    if _jahvexAaUtility and type(_jahvexAaUtility.EncodeCameraRotation) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            enc = _jahvexAaUtility:EncodeCameraRotation(vec)
        end)
    end
    if type(enc) ~= "string" or #enc < 2 then
        local function b(a)
            return math.clamp(math.floor((a % tau) / tau * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        end
        enc = utf8.char(b(px), b(py))
    end
    return enc
end

local function jahvex_aaLookAngles()
    local yaw, pitch = jahvex_aaAngles()
    local function spinOf(key)
        local p = type(aaParts) == "table" and aaParts[key]
        return math.clamp(tonumber(p and p.spin) or 0, 0, 20)
    end
    local hs = spinOf("Head")
    local ts = spinOf("Torso")
    if hs > 0 then
        pitch = pitch + tick() * hs
    end
    if ts > 0 then
        yaw = yaw + tick() * ts
    end
    return yaw, pitch
end

local function jahvex_aaSendLook(force)
    if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not (aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled) then return end
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    local now = tick()
    local gap = 0.045
    local pm = aaPitchMode or "look_up"
    if aaSpinEnabled then
        gap = 0.1
    elseif pm == "look_down" or pm == "random" or pm == "extended_random" then
        gap = 0.016
    end
    if not force and now - (_jahvexAaLookAt or 0) < gap then return end
    _jahvexAaLookAt = now
    local rem = jahvex_aaLookRemote()
    if not rem then return end
    local yaw, pitch = jahvex_aaLookAngles()
    if aaSpinEnabled then
        yaw = _jahvexAaSpin
    end
    local enc = jahvex_aaEncodeLook(yaw, pitch)
    _jahvexAaSendingLook = true
    pcall(function()
        if type(jahvex_stealthFireServer) == "function" then
            jahvex_stealthFireServer(rem, enc, nil)
        else
            rem:FireServer(enc, nil)
        end
    end)
    _jahvexAaSendingLook = false
end

local function jahvex_aaHookCameraRemote()
    -- khook: FireServer stays [C]. Look rewrite is in namecall cover.
    _jahvexAaCamHooked = true
end

local function jahvex_aaPickLookRaw(self, a, b)
    local function pick(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local raw = t.CameraRotationRaw
        if typeof(raw) == "Vector2" then return raw end
        if type(t.Get) == "function" then
            local ok, v = pcall(function()
                return t:Get("CameraRotationRaw")
            end)
            if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector2" then return v end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local raw = pick(b) or pick(a)
    if raw then return raw end
    local f = self and self.ClientFighterCharacter and self.ClientFighterCharacter.ClientFighter
    return pick(f)
end

local function jahvex_aaUnwrapAxis(joints, rawKey, accKey, v)
    if v > math.pi then
        v = v - math.pi * 2
    end
    joints[rawKey] = joints[rawKey] or v
    local d = v - joints[rawKey]
    if d > math.pi then
        d = d - math.pi * 2
    elseif d < -math.pi then
        d = d + math.pi * 2
    end
    joints[rawKey] = v
    joints[accKey] = (joints[accKey] or 0) + d
    return joints[accKey]
end

local function jahvex_aaApplySpectateYaw(joints, raw)
    if type(joints) ~= "table" or typeof(raw) ~= "Vector2" then return end
    local yaw = jahvex_aaUnwrapAxis(joints, "_jxRawY", "_jxYaw", raw.Y)
    local pitch = jahvex_aaUnwrapAxis(joints, "_jxRawX", "_jxPitch", raw.X)
    local dunk = jahvex_aaPitchDunk(pitch)
    local neck = joints._neck_joint
    if neck then
        if not joints._jxNeckPos then
            joints._jxNeckPos = neck.C0.Position
        end
        local pos = joints._jxNeckPos
        local c0 = CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y + dunk, pos.Z + math.max(pitch, 0) * 0.12) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, 0)
        if joints._neck_joint_is_motor6d then
            pcall(function()
                neck.C0 = c0
            end)
        end
    end
    local waist = joints._waist_joint
    if waist then
        local c0 = CFrame.new(waist.C0.Position) * CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.45, yaw * 0.45, 0)
        if joints._waist_joint_is_motor6d then
            pcall(function()
                waist.C0 = c0
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaHookJoints()
    if _jahvexAaJointsHooked then return end
    local Joints
    pcall(function()
        Joints = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientFighterCharacter.Joints)
    end)
    if type(Joints) ~= "table" or type(Joints.Update) ~= "function" then return end
    _jahvexAaJointsHooked = true
    jahvex_saveMod("FighterJoints_Update", Joints, "Update")
    local orig = Joints.Update
    Joints.Update = function(self, a, b)
        local r = orig(self, a, b)
        if not (getgenv().jahvex_alive and aaEnabled) then
            return r
        end
        local model = self.ClientFighterCharacter and self.ClientFighterCharacter.Model
        local isLocal = model and lp.Character and model == lp.Character
        if not isLocal then
            local raw = jahvex_aaPickLookRaw(self, a, b)
            if raw then
                jahvex_aaApplySpectateYaw(self, raw)
            end
        elseif jahvex_isCurrent() then
            local _, pitch = jahvex_aaLookAngles()
            jahvex_aaApplyMotors(model, pitch)
        end
        return r
    end
end

local function jahvex_aaGoodPos(p)
    if typeof(p) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if math.abs(p.X) > 50000 or math.abs(p.Y) > 50000 or math.abs(p.Z) > 50000 or p.Magnitude > 50000 then
        return false
    end
    local fh = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
    if type(fh) == "number" and p.Y < (fh + 48) then return false end
    return true
end

local function jahvex_aaFacing(pos)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local look = cam and Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.LookVector.Z) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    if look.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        return CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look.Unit)
    end
    return CFrame.new(pos)
end

local function jahvex_aaSameRot(a, b)
    return typeof(a) == "CFrame" and typeof(b) == "CFrame"
        and a.LookVector:Dot(b.LookVector) > 0.9995
        and a.UpVector:Dot(b.UpVector) > 0.9995
end

local function jahvex_aaApplyPose(kind)
    if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not (aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled) then return end
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    local char = lp.Character
    local root = char and (char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if not root then return end
    if type(jahvex_mapAnchorWatch) == "function" then
        pcall(jahvex_mapAnchorWatch, root)
    end
    if root ~= _jahvexAaRoot then
        jahvex_aaStopBreakAnim()
        jahvex_aaScatterOff()
        jahvex_aaRestoreMotors()
        local hum0 = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        jahvex_aaRestoreScales(hum0)
        _jahvexAaScaleOrig = nil
        _jahvexAaHipOrig = nil
        _jahvexAaBoxCf = nil
        _jahvexAaVisPos = nil
        _jahvexAaReal = nil
        _jahvexAaFake = nil
        _jahvexAaRoot = root
        _jahvexAaSpin = 0
        _jahvexAaLastT = tick()
    end
    jahvex_aaSetAutoRotate(false)
    local now = tick()
    local spinOmega = 0
    if aaSpinEnabled then
        local spd = math.clamp(tonumber(aaSpinSpeed) or 24, 1, 40)
        spinOmega = 18 + (spd / 40) * 8
        if kind == "repl" then
            local dt = math.clamp(now - (_jahvexAaLastT or now), 0, 0.05)
            _jahvexAaLastT = now
            _jahvexAaSpin = (_jahvexAaSpin or 0) + dt * spinOmega
        end
    elseif kind == "repl" then
        _jahvexAaLastT = now
    end
    local yaw, pitch = jahvex_aaLookAngles()
    if aaSpinEnabled then
        yaw = _jahvexAaSpin
    end
    local function applySpinCf()
        local pos = root.Position
        local spun = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        root.CFrame = spun
        _jahvexAaFake = spun
        pcall(function()
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spinOmega, 0)
            root.Anchored = false
        end)
    end
    if not jahvex_aaGoodPos(root.Position) then
        _jahvexAaReal = nil
        _jahvexAaFake = nil
        _jahvexAaVisPos = nil
        return
    end
    local cur = root.CFrame
    local stale = typeof(_jahvexAaFake) == "CFrame" and jahvex_aaSameRot(cur, _jahvexAaFake)
    if not stale and jahvex_aaGoodPos(cur.Position) then
        _jahvexAaReal = cur
        _jahvexAaVisPos = cur.Position
    end
    local real = _jahvexAaReal
    if typeof(real) ~= "CFrame" then
        real = cur
        _jahvexAaReal = real
    end
    if kind == "draw" then
        if aaSpinEnabled then
            applySpinCf()
        else
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * (real - real.Position)
            pcall(function()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.Anchored = false
            end)
        end
        jahvex_aaApplyMotors(char, pitch)
        return
    end
    local fake
    if aaSpinEnabled then
        applySpinCf()
        jahvex_aaApplyMotors(char, pitch)
        jahvex_aaSendLook(false)
        return
    end
    fake = CFrame.new(root.Position) * (real - real.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    if not jahvex_aaGoodPos(fake.Position) then return end
    root.CFrame = fake
    _jahvexAaFake = fake
    pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.Anchored = false
    end)
    jahvex_aaApplyMotors(char, pitch)
    jahvex_aaSendLook(false)
end

local function jahvex_aaHookRotation()
    if _jahvexAaRotHooked then return end
    local MC
    pcall(function()
        MC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
    end)
    if type(MC) ~= "table" or type(MC._UpdateCharacterRotation) ~= "function" then return end
    _jahvexAaRotHooked = true
    jahvex_saveMod("MC_UpdateCharacterRotation", MC, "_UpdateCharacterRotation")
    local orig = MC._UpdateCharacterRotation
    MC._UpdateCharacterRotation = function(self, ...)
        if getgenv().jahvex_alive and (aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled) and jahvex_isCurrent() then
            jahvex_aaApplyPose("draw")
            return
        end
        return orig(self, ...)
    end
end

function jahvex_aaSetLoop(on)
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(JX_AA_BIND) end)
    if _jahvexAaPost then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAaPost:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAaPost = nil
    end
    if _jahvexAaHb then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAaHb:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAaHb = nil
    end
    if _jahvexAaStep then
        pcall(function() _jahvexAaStep:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexAaStep = nil
    end
    if not on then
        jahvex_aaSetAutoRotate(true)
        jahvex_aaStopBreakAnim()
        jahvex_aaScatterOff()
        jahvex_aaRestoreMotors()
        jahvex_aaRestoreScales(lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
        _jahvexAaBoxCf = nil
        _jahvexAaScaleOrig = nil
        _jahvexAaHipOrig = nil
        _jahvexAaVisPos = nil
        _jahvexAaReal = nil
        _jahvexAaFake = nil
        _jahvexAaRoot = nil
        return
    end
    _jahvexAaBoxCf = nil
    _jahvexAaScaleOrig = nil
    _jahvexAaHipOrig = nil
    pcall(jahvex_aaHookRotation)
    pcall(jahvex_aaHookCameraRemote)
    task.defer(function()
        pcall(jahvex_aaHookJoints)
    end)
    jahvex_aaSetAutoRotate(false)
    _jahvexAaLastT = tick()
    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(JX_AA_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, function()
            jahvex_aaApplyPose("draw")
        end)
    end)
    _jahvexAaStep = jahvex_track(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        jahvex_aaApplyPose("draw")
    end))
    _jahvexAaPost = jahvex_track(RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
        jahvex_aaApplyPose("repl")
    end))
    _jahvexAaHb = jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if getgenv().jahvex_alive and (aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled) then
            jahvex_aaSendLook(false)
        end
    end))
    jahvex_aaSendLook(true)
end

jahvex_track(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if type(jahvex_mapAnchorReset) == "function" then
        pcall(jahvex_mapAnchorReset)
    end
    _jahvexAnchorRoot = nil
    _jahvexAnchorPos = nil
    jahvex_aaStopBreakAnim()
    jahvex_aaScatterOff()
    jahvex_aaRestoreMotors()
    _jahvexAaBoxCf = nil
    _jahvexAaScaleOrig = nil
    _jahvexAaHipOrig = nil
    _jahvexAaVisPos = nil
    _jahvexAaReal = nil
    _jahvexAaFake = nil
    _jahvexAaRoot = nil
    _jahvexAaSpin = 0
    if aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled then
        task.defer(function()
            jahvex_aaSetLoop(true)
        end)
    end
end))
if aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled then
    jahvex_aaSetLoop(true)
end

local function mvRefreshBindLbl(lbl, btn, bind, listening)
    if not lbl then return end
    if listening then
        lbl.Text = "..."
        lbl.TextColor3 = GREEN
        if btn then
            local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then st.Color = GREEN end
        end
        return
    end
    lbl.Text = jahvex_playerBindText(bind)
    lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    if btn then
        local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if st then st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 82) end
    end
end

local function mvMakeBind(y, getBind, setBind)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BIND_W, 0, 22)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12 + pw - BIND_W, 0, y)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.ZIndex = 5
    btn.Parent = playersPanel
    pcall(function() btn:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    makeCorner(btn, 11)
    makeStroke(btn, BORDER, 1)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = jahvex_playerBindText(getBind())
    lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.ZIndex = 6
    lbl.Parent = btn
    pcall(function() lbl:SetAttribute("uiRole", "textDim") end)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        task.defer(function()
            _jahvexMvListen = { get = getBind, set = setBind, lbl = lbl, btn = btn }
            mvRefreshBindLbl(lbl, btn, getBind(), true)
        end)
    end)
    btn.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
        _jahvexMvListen = nil
        setBind({ kind = "none" })
        mvRefreshBindLbl(lbl, btn, getBind(), false)
        pcall(saveConfig)
    end)
    return { btn = btn, lbl = lbl, refresh = function()
        mvRefreshBindLbl(lbl, btn, getBind(), _jahvexMvListen and _jahvexMvListen.lbl == lbl)
    end }
end

local function mvMakeSlider(y, label, minV, maxV, getV, setV)
    local KW = 12
    makeLabel(playersPanel, label, 12, y, pw - 50, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local valLbl = makeLabel(playersPanel, tostring(getV()), 12, y + 13, pw, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
    local tr = Instance.new("Frame")
    tr.Size = UDim2.new(0, pw, 0, 4)
    tr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
    tr.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    tr.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tr.ZIndex = 4
    tr.Parent = playersPanel
    pcall(function() tr:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    makeCorner(tr, 3)
    makeStroke(tr, BORDER, 1)
    local fi = Instance.new("Frame")
    fi.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    fi.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fi.ZIndex = 5
    fi.Parent = tr
    pcall(function() fi:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
    makeCorner(fi, 3)
    local kn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    kn.Size = UDim2.new(0, KW, 0, KW)
    kn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    kn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    kn.Text = ""
    kn.AutoButtonColor = false
    kn.ZIndex = 6
    kn.Parent = tr
    pcall(function() kn:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
    makeCorner(kn, KW / 2)
    makeStroke(kn, BORDER, 1)
    local function applyFrac(frac)
        frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
        local v = math.clamp(math.floor(minV + frac * (maxV - minV) + 0.5), minV, maxV)
        setV(v)
        frac = (v - minV) / (maxV - minV)
        fi.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
        kn.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KW / 2, 0.5, -KW / 2)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(v)
    end
    applyFrac((getV() - minV) / (maxV - minV))
    local drag = false
    kn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true end
    end)
    tr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            drag = true
            applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if drag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and drag then
            drag = false
            saveConfig()
        end
    end)
    return {
        Set = function(_, v)
            applyFrac((math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(v) or minV), minV, maxV) - minV) / (maxV - minV))
        end,
    }
end

do
    local colW = math.floor((pw - 8) / 2)
    local rowH = 32
    local cells = {
        { "Head", "Head" },
        { "Torso", "Torso" },
        { "L Arm", "LeftArm" },
        { "R Arm", "RightArm" },
        { "L Leg", "LeftLeg" },
        { "R Leg", "RightLeg" },
    }
    local function partSpinOf(key)
        if type(aaParts) ~= "table" then
            aaParts = jahvex_aaPartsEncode(nil)
        end
        if type(aaParts[key]) ~= "table" then
            aaParts[key] = jahvex_aaDefaultPart()
        end
        return aaParts[key]
    end
    local function miniSpin(x, y, w, label, key)
        makeLabel(playersPanel, label, x, y, w - 28, 12, 10, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
        local valLbl = makeLabel(playersPanel, tostring(partSpinOf(key).spin or 0), x, y + 13, w, 12, 10, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
        local tr = Instance.new("Frame")
        tr.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 4)
        tr.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y + 14)
        tr.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        tr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        tr.ZIndex = 4
        tr.Parent = playersPanel
        pcall(function() tr:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
        makeCorner(tr, 3)
        local KW = 10
        local fi = Instance.new("Frame")
        fi.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        fi.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fi.ZIndex = 5
        fi.Parent = tr
        pcall(function() fi:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
        makeCorner(fi, 3)
        local kn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        kn.Size = UDim2.new(0, KW, 0, KW)
        kn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        kn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        kn.Text = ""
        kn.AutoButtonColor = false
        kn.ZIndex = 6
        kn.Parent = tr
        pcall(function() kn:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
        makeCorner(kn, KW / 2)
        local minV, maxV = 0, 20
        local function applyFrac(frac)
            frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
            local v = math.clamp(math.floor(minV + frac * (maxV - minV) + 0.5), minV, maxV)
            partSpinOf(key).spin = v
            frac = (maxV > minV) and ((v - minV) / (maxV - minV)) or 0
            fi.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            kn.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KW / 2, 0.5, -KW / 2)
            valLbl.Text = tostring(v)
        end
        applyFrac(((partSpinOf(key).spin or 0) - minV) / (maxV - minV))
        local drag = false
        kn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true end
        end)
        tr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                drag = true
                applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and drag then
                drag = false
                pcall(saveConfig)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if drag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
            end
        end)
        jahvexUiRefs["aaSpin_" .. key] = {
            Set = function(_, v)
                applyFrac((math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0, minV, maxV) - minV) / (maxV - minV))
            end,
        }
    end
    for i, cell in ipairs(cells) do
        local col = (i - 1) % 2
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 2)
        miniSpin(12 + col * (colW + 8), py + row * rowH, colW, cell[1], cell[2])
    end
    py = py + rowH * 3 + 4
end

if not _jahvexMvInputConn then
    _jahvexMvInputConn = jahvex_track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        if _jahvexMvListen then
            local slot = _jahvexMvListen
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                slot.set({ kind = "none" })
            elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                slot.set({ kind = "Key", key = input.KeyCode })
            elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
                slot.set({ kind = "Mouse", mouse = input.UserInputType })
            else
                return
            end
            _jahvexMvListen = nil
            mvRefreshBindLbl(slot.lbl, slot.btn, slot.get(), false)
            pcall(saveConfig)
            return
        end
        if gp or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local function fire(name, enabled, toggleRef)
            local on = not enabled
            if toggleRef and toggleRef.Set then
                toggleRef:Set(on, true)
            else
                jahvex_playerMoveToggle(name, on)
            end
        end
        if jahvex_playerBindMatch(playerFlyBind, input) then
            fire("fly", playerFlyEnabled, jahvexUiRefs.playerFlyToggle)
        elseif jahvex_playerBindMatch(playerNoclipBind, input) then
            fire("noclip", playerNoclipEnabled, jahvexUiRefs.playerNoclipToggle)
        elseif jahvex_playerBindMatch(playerWsBind, input) then
            fire("ws", playerWsEnabled, jahvexUiRefs.playerWsToggle)
        elseif jahvex_playerBindMatch(playerJumpBind, input) then
            fire("jump", playerJumpEnabled, jahvexUiRefs.playerJumpToggle)
        end
    end))
end
