FULL_AUTO_GUNS = {
    ["Handgun"] = true,
    ["Burst Rifle"] = true,
    ["Revolver"] = true,
    ["Sniper"] = true,
    ["Daggers"] = true,
    ["Spray"] = true,
    ["Permafrost"] = true,
}
FULL_AUTO_ORIG = {
    ["Handgun"] = { BurstCount = 1, BurstCooldown = 0, ShootCooldown = 0.13, spam = false },
    ["Burst Rifle"] = { BurstCount = 3, BurstCooldown = 0.07, ShootCooldown = 0.6, spam = 0 },
    ["Revolver"] = { BurstCount = 1, BurstCooldown = 0, ShootCooldown = 0.4, spam = false },
    ["Sniper"] = { BurstCount = 1, BurstCooldown = 0, ShootCooldown = 1.5, spam = 0 },
    ["Daggers"] = { BurstCount = 2, BurstCooldown = 0.1, ShootCooldown = 0.6, spam = 0 },
    ["Spray"] = { BurstCount = 5, BurstCooldown = 0.04, ShootCooldown = 0.5, spam = 0 },
    ["Permafrost"] = { BurstCount = 2, BurstCooldown = 0.08, ShootCooldown = 0.2, spam = 0 },
}

FULL_AUTO_RATE = {
    ["Burst Rifle"] = 0.09,
    ["Permafrost"] = 0.09,
    ["Spray"] = 0.04,
    ["Daggers"] = 0.08,
    ["Handgun"] = 0.13,
    ["Revolver"] = 0.13,
    ["Sniper"] = 0.13,
}
_jahvexFullAutoBackup = _jahvexFullAutoBackup or {}
_jahvexFullAutoConn = _jahvexFullAutoConn

local function jahvex_fullAutoStats(item)
    if type(item) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end
    if type(item.Info) == "table" and (item.Info.BurstCount ~= nil or item.Info.ShootCooldown ~= nil or item.Info.Name ~= nil) then
        return item.Info, item
    end
    return item, item
end

function jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem(item, on)
    if type(item) ~= "table" then return end
    local stats, live = jahvex_fullAutoStats(item)
    if type(stats) ~= "table" then return end
    local name = stats.Name or item.Name
    if type(name) ~= "string" or not FULL_AUTO_GUNS[name] then return end
    if on then
        if not _jahvexFullAutoBackup[name] then
            local spam = nil
            if type(stats.InputSpammingEnabled) == "table" then
                spam = stats.InputSpammingEnabled.StartShooting
            end
            local orig = FULL_AUTO_ORIG[name]
            local alreadyPatched = orig and tonumber(stats.BurstCount) == 1 and tonumber(orig.BurstCount) > 1
            if alreadyPatched then
                _jahvexFullAutoBackup[name] = {
                    BurstCount = orig.BurstCount,
                    BurstCooldown = orig.BurstCooldown,
                    ShootCooldown = orig.ShootCooldown,
                    spam = orig.spam,
                }
            else
                _jahvexFullAutoBackup[name] = {
                    BurstCount = stats.BurstCount,
                    BurstCooldown = stats.BurstCooldown,
                    ShootCooldown = stats.ShootCooldown,
                    spam = spam,
                }
            end
        end
        local orig = FULL_AUTO_ORIG[name]
        local rate = FULL_AUTO_RATE[name]
        if not rate then
            local burst = tonumber((orig and orig.BurstCount) or stats.BurstCount) or 1
            local bcd = tonumber((orig and orig.BurstCooldown) or stats.BurstCooldown) or 0
            local scd = tonumber((orig and orig.ShootCooldown) or stats.ShootCooldown) or 0.12
            if burst > 1 and bcd > 0 then
                rate = 0.09
            elseif scd > 0.15 then
                rate = 0.13
            elseif scd > 0 then
                rate = scd
            else
                rate = 0.09
            end
        end
        stats.BurstCount = 1
        stats.BurstCooldown = 0
        stats.ShootCooldown = rate
        if type(stats.InputSpammingEnabled) == "table" then
            stats.InputSpammingEnabled.StartShooting = 0
        end
        if live and live.ClientFighter then
            live._burst_count = 1
            local now = tick()
            if type(live._shoot_cooldown) == "number" then
                live._shoot_cooldown = math.min(live._shoot_cooldown, now + rate)
            end
        end
    else
        local b = _jahvexFullAutoBackup[name]
        if not b then return end
        stats.BurstCount = b.BurstCount
        stats.BurstCooldown = b.BurstCooldown
        stats.ShootCooldown = b.ShootCooldown
        if type(stats.InputSpammingEnabled) == "table" then
            stats.InputSpammingEnabled.StartShooting = b.spam
        end
        if live and live.ClientFighter and type(live._burst_count) == "number" then
            live._burst_count = tonumber(b.BurstCount) or 1
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_fullAutoPatchAll(on)
    pcall(function()
        local IL = ItemLibrary
        if not IL then
            IL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ItemLibrary)
        end
        if IL and type(IL.Items) == "table" then
            for name in pairs(FULL_AUTO_GUNS) do
                jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem(IL.Items[name], on)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController
        local lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
        if not lf then return end
        local bags = { lf.Items, lf.ClientItems, lf._Items }
        if lf.GetItems then
            local ok, got = pcall(function() return lf:GetItems() end)
            if ok then table.insert(bags, got) end
        end
        for _, bag in ipairs(bags) do
            if type(bag) == "table" then
                for _, it in pairs(bag) do
                    if type(it) == "table" then
                        jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem(it, on)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if lf.EquippedItem then jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem(lf.EquippedItem, on) end
        if lf.CurrentItem then jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem(lf.CurrentItem, on) end
    end)
end

function jahvex_fullAutoApply(on)
    on = on and true or false
    fullAutoEnabled = on
    getgenv().jahvex_fullAutoEnabled = on
    jahvex_fullAutoPatchAll(on)
    if _jahvexFullAutoConn then
        pcall(function() _jahvexFullAutoConn:Disconnect() end)
        _jahvexFullAutoConn = nil
    end
    if on then
        local n = 0
        _jahvexFullAutoConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not fullAutoEnabled then return end
            n = n + 1
            if n % 20 ~= 0 then return end
            jahvex_fullAutoPatchAll(true)
        end)
    end
end

task.defer(function()
    pcall(function()
        local Gun = require(lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun", 8))
        if not (Gun and type(Gun.new) == "function") then return end
        if Gun._jahvex_fullAutoNew then return end
        Gun._jahvex_fullAutoNew = true
        local origNew = Gun.new
        Gun.new = function(...)
            local item = origNew(...)
            if fullAutoEnabled then
                pcall(jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem, item, true)
            end
            return item
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end
        local lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
        if lf and lf.EquippedItemChanged and lf.EquippedItemChanged.Connect and not lf._jahvexFullAutoEquip then
            lf._jahvexFullAutoEquip = true
            lf.EquippedItemChanged:Connect(function()
                if fullAutoEnabled then
                    pcall(jahvex_fullAutoPatchItem, lf.EquippedItem, true)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    if fullAutoEnabled then
        pcall(jahvex_fullAutoApply, true)
    end
end)

end

local function espHideAll(d)
    if d.Hidden then return end
    d.Hidden = true
    d._sx, d._sy, d._sw, d._sh = nil, nil, nil, nil
    d.Box.Visible = false; d.BoxOutline.Visible = false; d.BoxFill.Visible = false
    d.Name.Visible = false; d.Distance.Visible = false
    d.HealthBar.Visible = false; d.HealthBarBG.Visible = false; d.HealthNum.Visible = false
    d.Tracer.Visible = false; d.Snapline.Visible = false
    d.HeadDot.Visible = false; d.OSIndicator.Visible = false
    for i=1,8 do d.CornerLines[i].Visible=false; d.CornerOutlines[i].Visible=false end
    for _,l in pairs(d.Skeleton) do l.Visible=false end
    if d.Highlight then pcall(function() d.Highlight.Enabled=false end) end
end

local function espRemove(plr)
    if ESP_Cache[plr] then
        local d = ESP_Cache[plr]
        if d.Highlight then pcall(function() d.Highlight:Destroy() end) end
        for _, v in pairs(d) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                for _, l in pairs(v) do pcall(function() l:Remove() end) end
            else
                pcall(function() v:Remove() end)
            end
        end
        ESP_Cache[plr] = nil
    end
end


Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) espRemove(p) end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() espRemove(p) end)
end)
for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= lp then
        p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() espRemove(p) end)
    end
end


local _espWasEnabled = false
local _espSkelFrame = 0
jahvex_track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    if not espEnabled then
        if _espWasEnabled then
            for _, d in pairs(ESP_Cache) do espHideAll(d) end
            _espWasEnabled = false
        end
        return
    end
    _espWasEnabled = true
    _espSkelFrame = _espSkelFrame + 1
    dt = math.clamp(tonumber(dt) or 0.016, 0, 0.05)
    local smooth = 1 - math.exp(-dt * 22)

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local _hlFillT, _hlFillC, _hlOutC, _hlOutT, _hlSigNow
    if espChams or espGlow then
        _hlFillT = espChams and 0.5 or 1
        _hlFillC = espColorChams
        _hlOutC = espGlow and espColorGlow or (espChams and espColorChams or Color3.new(1,1,1))
        _hlOutT = espGlow and math.clamp(1-(espGlowDepth/10), 0, 0.9) or 0
        _hlSigNow = tostring(_hlFillT)..tostring(_hlFillC)..tostring(_hlOutC)..tostring(_hlOutT)
    end
    for _, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v == lp then continue end
        if not ESP_Cache[v] then espCreateDrawings(v) end
        local d = ESP_Cache[v]
        local char = v.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not hrp or not hum then espHideAll(d) continue end
        if espHideDead and hum.Health <= 0 then espHideAll(d) continue end


        if _hlSigNow then
            if not d.Highlight or d.Highlight.Parent ~= char then
                pcall(function() if d.Highlight then d.Highlight:Destroy() end end)
                local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Name = "CharHighlight"
                hl.Parent = char
                d.Highlight = hl
                d._hlSig = nil
            end
            if d._hlSig ~= _hlSigNow then
                d._hlSig = _hlSigNow
                d.Highlight.Enabled = true
                d.Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                d.Highlight.FillColor = _hlFillC
                d.Highlight.FillTransparency = _hlFillT
                d.Highlight.OutlineColor = _hlOutC
                d.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = _hlOutT
            elseif not d.Highlight.Enabled then
                d.Highlight.Enabled = true
            end
        else
            if d.Highlight and d.Highlight.Enabled then
                d.Highlight.Enabled = false
                d._hlSig = nil
            end
        end

        local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
        local dist = (cam.CFrame.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

        if dist > espMaxDist then espHideAll(d) continue end


        if espTeamCheck and jahvex_isAlly(v) then
            espHideAll(d) continue
        end


        if espOSIndicators and not onScreen then
            local camCF = cam.CFrame
            local rel = camCF:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
            local angle = math.atan2(-rel.X, -rel.Z)
            local center = cam.ViewportSize / 2
            local dir = Vector2.new(math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle)).Unit
            local ip = center + dir * 150
            local as = 12
            local right = Vector2.new(-dir.Y, dir.X)
            d.OSIndicator.PointA = ip + dir*as
            d.OSIndicator.PointB = ip - dir*(as/2) + right*(as/1.8)
            d.OSIndicator.PointC = ip - dir*(as/2) - right*(as/1.8)
            d.OSIndicator.Color  = espColorEnemy
            espHideAll(d)
            d.OSIndicator.Visible = true
            continue
        else
            d.OSIndicator.Visible = false
        end

        if not onScreen then espHideAll(d) continue end

        d.Hidden = false
        local sizeY = (cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0,3,0)).Y - cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0,3,0)).Y)
        local tw, th = math.abs(sizeY) * 0.6, math.abs(sizeY)
        local px, py = pos.X - tw/2, pos.Y - th/2
        if not d._sx then
            d._sx, d._sy, d._sw, d._sh = px, py, tw, th
        else
            d._sx = d._sx + (px - d._sx) * smooth
            d._sy = d._sy + (py - d._sy) * smooth
            d._sw = d._sw + (tw - d._sw) * smooth
            d._sh = d._sh + (th - d._sh) * smooth
        end
        local boxSize = Vector2.new(d._sw, d._sh)
        local boxPos  = Vector2.new(d._sx, d._sy)
        pos = Vector3.new(d._sx + d._sw/2, d._sy + d._sh/2, pos.Z)
        local color   = espColorEnemy


        if espCornerBoxes then
            local w,h = boxSize.X, boxSize.Y
            local x,y = boxPos.X, boxPos.Y
            local len = math.min(w/4, 15)
            local cl, co = d.CornerLines, d.CornerOutlines
            local _cv = espColorBox
            cl[1].From = Vector2.new(x,y); cl[1].To = Vector2.new(x+len,y); cl[1].Color = _cv; cl[1].Visible = true; co[1].From = cl[1].From; co[1].To = cl[1].To; co[1].Visible = true
            cl[2].From = Vector2.new(x,y); cl[2].To = Vector2.new(x,y+len); cl[2].Color = _cv; cl[2].Visible = true; co[2].From = cl[2].From; co[2].To = cl[2].To; co[2].Visible = true
            cl[3].From = Vector2.new(x+w,y); cl[3].To = Vector2.new(x+w-len,y); cl[3].Color = _cv; cl[3].Visible = true; co[3].From = cl[3].From; co[3].To = cl[3].To; co[3].Visible = true
            cl[4].From = Vector2.new(x+w,y); cl[4].To = Vector2.new(x+w,y+len); cl[4].Color = _cv; cl[4].Visible = true; co[4].From = cl[4].From; co[4].To = cl[4].To; co[4].Visible = true
            cl[5].From = Vector2.new(x,y+h); cl[5].To = Vector2.new(x+len,y+h); cl[5].Color = _cv; cl[5].Visible = true; co[5].From = cl[5].From; co[5].To = cl[5].To; co[5].Visible = true
            cl[6].From = Vector2.new(x,y+h); cl[6].To = Vector2.new(x,y+h-len); cl[6].Color = _cv; cl[6].Visible = true; co[6].From = cl[6].From; co[6].To = cl[6].To; co[6].Visible = true
            cl[7].From = Vector2.new(x+w,y+h); cl[7].To = Vector2.new(x+w-len,y+h); cl[7].Color = _cv; cl[7].Visible = true; co[7].From = cl[7].From; co[7].To = cl[7].To; co[7].Visible = true
            cl[8].From = Vector2.new(x+w,y+h); cl[8].To = Vector2.new(x+w,y+h-len); cl[8].Color = _cv; cl[8].Visible = true; co[8].From = cl[8].From; co[8].To = cl[8].To; co[8].Visible = true
            d.Box.Visible=false; d.BoxOutline.Visible=false
        elseif espFullBoxes then
            for i=1,8 do d.CornerLines[i].Visible=false; d.CornerOutlines[i].Visible=false end
            d.Box.Color=espColorBox; d.Box.Size=boxSize; d.Box.Position=boxPos; d.Box.Visible=true
            d.BoxOutline.Size=boxSize; d.BoxOutline.Position=boxPos; d.BoxOutline.Visible=true
        else
            for i=1,8 do d.CornerLines[i].Visible=false; d.CornerOutlines[i].Visible=false end
            d.Box.Visible=false; d.BoxOutline.Visible=false
        end


        d.BoxFill.Visible = espBoxFill
        if espBoxFill then
            d.BoxFill.Size=boxSize; d.BoxFill.Position=boxPos
            d.BoxFill.Color=espColorFill; d.BoxFill.Transparency=0.25
        end


        if espNames then
            d.Name.Visible = true
            if d._nm ~= v.Name then
                d._nm = v.Name
                d.Name.Text = v.Name
            end
            d.Name.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, boxPos.Y - 15)
            d.Name.Color = espColorName
            d.Name.Size = espTextSize
        elseif d.Name.Visible then
            d.Name.Visible = false
        end


        if espDistance then
            d.Distance.Visible = true
            local ds = math.floor(dist) .. "m"
            if d._ds ~= ds then
                d._ds = ds
                d.Distance.Text = ds
            end
            d.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y + 2)
            d.Distance.Color = color
            d.Distance.Size = espTextSize - 2
        elseif d.Distance.Visible then
            d.Distance.Visible = false
        end


        local hpPct = hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth
        d.HealthBar.Visible = espHealthBar
        d.HealthBarBG.Visible = espHealthBar
        if espHealthBar then
            d.HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(boxPos.X-5, boxPos.Y+boxSize.Y)
            d.HealthBar.To   = Vector2.new(boxPos.X-5, boxPos.Y+boxSize.Y-(boxSize.Y*hpPct))
            d.HealthBar.Color = espColorHP
            d.HealthBarBG.From = Vector2.new(boxPos.X-5, boxPos.Y+boxSize.Y)
            d.HealthBarBG.To   = Vector2.new(boxPos.X-5, boxPos.Y)
        end


        d.HealthNum.Visible = espHealthNum and espHealthBar
        if d.HealthNum.Visible then
            d.HealthNum.Text = tostring(math.floor(hum.Health))
            d.HealthNum.Position = Vector2.new(boxPos.X-18, boxPos.Y+boxSize.Y-(boxSize.Y*hpPct)-5)
            d.HealthNum.Color = espColorHP
            d.HealthNum.Size = espTextSize - 3
        end


        d.Tracer.Visible = espTracers
        if espTracers then
            local sv
            if espTracerOrigin == "Bottom" then sv = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X/2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
            elseif espTracerOrigin == "Top"  then sv = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X/2, 0)
            else sv = cam.ViewportSize/2 end
            d.Tracer.From = sv
            d.Tracer.To   = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
            d.Tracer.Color = espColorTracer
        end


        d.Snapline.Visible = espSnaplines
        if espSnaplines then
            d.Snapline.From  = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X/2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
            d.Snapline.To    = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
            d.Snapline.Color = espColorTracer
        end


        d.HeadDot.Visible = false
        if espHeadDot then
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local hp2, hon = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                if hon then
                    d.HeadDot.Visible = true
                    d.HeadDot.Position = Vector2.new(hp2.X, hp2.Y)
                    d.HeadDot.Color = espColorHeadDot
                end
            end
        end


        if espSkeleton then
            if _espSkelFrame % 2 == 0 then
                for i, pair in ipairs(Skeleton_Parts) do
                    local p1 = char:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
                    local p2 = char:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
                    if p1 and p2 then
                        local s1, o1 = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p1.Position)
                        local s2, o2 = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p2.Position)
                        d.Skeleton[i].Visible = o1 and o2
                        d.Skeleton[i].From = Vector2.new(s1.X, s1.Y)
                        d.Skeleton[i].To   = Vector2.new(s2.X, s2.Y)
                        d.Skeleton[i].Color = espColorSkel
                    else
                        d.Skeleton[i].Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            for _, l in pairs(d.Skeleton) do l.Visible=false end
        end
    end
end))


do
    local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
    local UTIL_ICON = {
        ["Subspace Tripmine"] = "",
        ["Satchel"] = "",
        ["Molotov"] = "",
        ["Warpstone"] = "",
        ["Flashbang"] = "",
        ["Grenade"] = "",
        ["Smoke Grenade"] = "",
    }
    local THROWN_ITEMS = {
        Molotov = true,
        Warpstone = true,
        Flashbang = true,
        Grenade = true,
        ["Smoke Grenade"] = true,
    }

    local utilGui
    local utilCache = {}
    local utilRay = RaycastParams.new()
    utilRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    utilRay.IgnoreWater = true

    local function utilEnsureGui()
        local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return nil end
        if utilGui and utilGui.Parent then return utilGui end
        pcall(function()
            local old = pg:FindFirstChild("WorldMarkers")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
        end)
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name = "WorldMarkers"
        g.ResetOnSpawn = false
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        g.DisplayOrder = 100001
        g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        g.Parent = pg
        pcall(jahvex_guiParent, g)
        utilGui = g
        return g
    end

    local function utilDestroyGui()
        if utilGui then
            pcall(function() utilGui:Destroy() end)
            utilGui = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local old = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("WorldMarkers")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    local function utilIsTeammate(plr)
        if not plr or plr == lp then return true end
        if lp.Team and plr.Team and lp.Team == plr.Team then return true end
        local a, b = lp:GetAttribute("TeamID"), plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
        if a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a == b then return true end
        local myChar, theirChar = lp.Character, plr.Character
        if myChar and theirChar then
            local mt, tt = myChar:GetAttribute("Team"), theirChar:GetAttribute("Team")
            if mt ~= nil and tt ~= nil and mt == tt then return true end
            local hrp = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("TeammateLabel") then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function utilClosestPlayer(pos, maxDist)
        local best, bestD = nil, maxDist
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local d = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if d <= bestD then
                    best, bestD = plr, d
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestD
    end

    local function utilGetPart(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
        if inst:IsA("Model") then
            return inst.PrimaryPart
                or inst:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or inst:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
                or inst:FindFirstChild("Primary")
                or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function utilMakeMarker(name, icon)
        local gui = utilEnsureGui()
        if not gui then return nil end
        local root = Instance.new("Frame")
        root.Name = "UtilMark"
        root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 92)
        root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        root.Visible = false
        root.ZIndex = 20
        root.Parent = gui

        local box = Instance.new("Frame")
        box.Name = "IconBox"
        box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
        box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -24, 0, 0)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
        box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
        box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        box.ZIndex = 21
        box.Parent = root
        local boxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        boxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
        boxCorner.Parent = box
        local boxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        boxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        boxStroke.Thickness = 1.5
        boxStroke.Transparency = 0.1
        boxStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        boxStroke.Parent = box
        local boxPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        boxPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3)
        boxPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
        boxPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3)
        boxPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 3)
        boxPad.Parent = box

        local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        img.Name = "Icon"
        img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        img.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        img.Image = icon or ""
        img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        img.ZIndex = 22
        img.Parent = box

        local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLbl.Name = "ItemName"
        nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46)
        nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        nameLbl.TextSize = 13
        nameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        nameLbl.Text = name
        nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        nameLbl.ZIndex = 22
        nameLbl.Parent = root

        local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        distLbl.Name = "Dist"
        distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
        distLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 62)
        distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        distLbl.TextSize = 12
        distLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
        distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        distLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        distLbl.Text = ""
        distLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        distLbl.ZIndex = 22
        distLbl.Parent = root

        local trails = {}
        for i = 1, 8 do
            local ln = Instance.new("Frame")
            ln.Name = "Trail" .. i
            ln.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ln.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 70)
            ln.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ln.Visible = false
            ln.ZIndex = 19
            ln.Parent = gui
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            c.Parent = ln
            trails[i] = ln
        end

        return { root = root, img = img, nameLbl = nameLbl, distLbl = distLbl, trails = trails, hist = {} }
    end

    local function utilHideTrails(entry)
        if not entry or not entry.trails then return end
        for _, ln in ipairs(entry.trails) do
            ln.Visible = false
        end
    end

    local function utilRemove(inst)
        local entry = utilCache[inst]
        if not entry then return end
        utilHideTrails(entry)
        if entry.root then pcall(function() entry.root:Destroy() end) end
        if entry.trails then
            for _, ln in ipairs(entry.trails) do
                pcall(function() ln:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        if entry.conn then pcall(function() entry.conn:Disconnect() end) end
        utilCache[inst] = nil
    end

    local function utilClearAll()
        for inst in pairs(utilCache) do
            utilRemove(inst)
        end
        utilDestroyGui()
    end

    local function utilTrack(inst, kind, itemName)
        if not inst or utilCache[inst] then return end
        if not UTIL_ICON[itemName] then return end
        local ui = utilMakeMarker(itemName, UTIL_ICON[itemName])
        if not ui then return end
        local entry = {
            kind = kind,
            name = itemName,
            root = ui.root,
            img = ui.img,
            nameLbl = ui.nameLbl,
            distLbl = ui.distLbl,
            trails = ui.trails,
            hist = {},
            landed = false,
            falling = false,
            born = os.clock(),
        }
        utilCache[inst] = entry
        entry.conn = inst.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if not parent or not inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                utilRemove(inst)
            end
        end)
        jahvex_track(entry.conn)
    end

    local function utilIsViewModel(inst)
        local vm = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
        if vm and inst:IsDescendantOf(vm) then return true end
        local n = inst.Name:lower()
        if n:find(" - satchel - ", 1, true) or n:find("firstperson", 1, true) then return true end
        local p = inst.Parent
        while p and p ~= workspace do
            if p.Name == "ViewModels" or p.Name == "FirstPerson" then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function utilAlreadyTrackedNear(pos, itemName)
        if not pos then return false end
        for inst, entry in pairs(utilCache) do
            if entry.name == itemName then
                local part = utilGetPart(inst)
                if part and (part.Position - pos).Magnitude < 6 then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function utilIsSatchelWorld(inst)
        if not inst then return false end
        if utilIsViewModel(inst) then return false end
        if inst.Name == "FakeSatchelModel" then return true end
        if inst.Name == "Throwable - Satchel" then return true end
        if inst.Name == "SatchelEntityHitbox" then return true end
        if inst.Name == "Satchel" and (inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("BasePart")) then
            if inst.Parent == workspace then return true end
        end
        local hrp = inst:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and hrp:GetAttribute("IsSatchel") == true then return true end
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst:GetAttribute("IsSatchel") == true then return true end
        return false
    end

    local function utilSatchelRoot(inst)
        if inst.Name == "SatchelEntityHitbox" and inst.Parent then
            return inst.Parent
        end
        return inst
    end

    local function utilConsider(inst, fromScan)
        if not inst or utilCache[inst] then return end
        local vm = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
        if vm and inst:IsDescendantOf(vm) then return end
        local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
        if lobby and inst:IsDescendantOf(lobby) then return end

        local isTripmine = inst.Name == "SubspaceTripmineHitbox"
        pcall(function()
            if CS:HasTag(inst, "SubspaceTripmine") then isTripmine = true end
        end)
        if isTripmine and inst:IsA("Model") then
            local uid = inst:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserID")
            if uid == lp.UserId then return end
            if typeof(uid) == "number" then
                local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
                if owner and utilIsTeammate(owner) then return end
            end
            utilTrack(inst, "placed", "Subspace Tripmine")
            return
        end

        if utilIsSatchelWorld(inst) then
            local root = utilSatchelRoot(inst)
            if utilCache[root] then return end
            local part = utilGetPart(root)
            if utilAlreadyTrackedNear(part and part.Position, "Satchel") then return end
            utilTrack(root, "placed", "Satchel")
            return
        end

        if fromScan then return end
        local thrownName = string.match(inst.Name, "^Throwable %-%s*(.+)$")
        if thrownName and THROWN_ITEMS[thrownName] and inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            local owner = utilClosestPlayer(inst.Position, 22)
            if owner == lp or (owner and utilIsTeammate(owner)) then return end
            utilTrack(inst, "thrown", thrownName)
        end
    end

    local function utilScanExisting()
        pcall(function()
            for _, inst in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("SubspaceTripmine")) do
                utilConsider(inst, true)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for _, e in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("Entity")) do
                local hrp = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if e.Name == "FakeSatchelModel" or (hrp and hrp:GetAttribute("IsSatchel") == true) then
                    utilConsider(e, true)
                end
            end
        end)
        for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            utilConsider(inst, true)
        end
    end

    local function utilSetLine(frame, a, b)
        local dx, dy = b.X - a.X, b.Y - a.Y
        local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        if len < 2 then
            frame.Visible = false
            return
        end
        frame.Visible = true
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2)
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) * 0.5, (a.Y + b.Y) * 0.5)
        frame.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
    end

    local function utilUpdate()
        if not utilEspEnabled then
            if next(utilCache) then utilClearAll() end
            return
        end
        if not utilEnsureGui() then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
        local lpHrp = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if lpHrp then origin = lpHrp.Position end

        for inst, entry in pairs(utilCache) do
            if not inst or not inst.Parent or not inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                utilRemove(inst)
                continue
            end
            local part = utilGetPart(inst)
            if not part then
                utilRemove(inst)
                continue
            end
            local pos = part.Position
            local vel = Vector3.zero
            pcall(function() vel = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)

            if entry.kind == "thrown" and not entry.landed then
                if vel.Y < -5 then entry.falling = true end
                if os.clock() - (entry.born or 0) > 0.12 then
                    local exclude = { inst }
                    if lp.Character then table.insert(exclude, lp.Character) end
                    utilRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
                    local hit = workspace:Raycast(pos, Vector3.new(0, -1.35, 0), utilRay)
                    if (entry.falling and vel.Y > 2) or (hit and vel.Y > -4) then
                        entry.landed = true
                        utilRemove(inst)
                        continue
                    end
                end
            end

            local dist = (pos - origin).Magnitude
            local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
            if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then
                entry.root.Visible = true
                entry.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X, sp.Y - 8)
                entry.distLbl.Text = tostring(math.floor(dist + 0.5)) .. "m"
                if entry.kind == "thrown" then
                    local hist = entry.hist
                    hist[#hist + 1] = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
                    if #hist > 9 then table.remove(hist, 1) end
                    for i = 1, #entry.trails do
                        local a = hist[i]
                        local b = hist[i + 1]
                        if a and b then
                            utilSetLine(entry.trails[i], a, b)
                        else
                            entry.trails[i].Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                else
                    utilHideTrails(entry)
                end
            else
                entry.root.Visible = false
                utilHideTrails(entry)
            end
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        local old = lp.PlayerGui and lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("WorldMarkers")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end)

    jahvex_track(workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(inst)
        local function try()
            if utilEspEnabled then utilConsider(inst) end
        end
        task.defer(try)
        task.delay(0.12, try)
        task.delay(0.4, try)
    end))
    jahvex_track(workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(inst)
        if utilCache[inst] then utilRemove(inst) end
    end))
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_track(CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("SubspaceTripmine"):Connect(function(inst)
            task.defer(function()
                if utilEspEnabled then utilConsider(inst) end
            end)
        end))
        jahvex_track(CS:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("SubspaceTripmine"):Connect(function(inst)
            if utilCache[inst] then utilRemove(inst) end
        end))
    end)

    local _utilScanAcc = 0
    jahvex_track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        if not utilEspEnabled then
            if next(utilCache) then utilClearAll() end
            return
        end
        utilUpdate()
        _utilScanAcc += dt
        if _utilScanAcc >= 0.35 then
            _utilScanAcc = 0
            utilScanExisting()
        end
    end))

    _G.jahvex_utilEspClear = utilClearAll
    _G.jahvex_utilEspScan = utilScanExisting
    getgenv().jahvex_setUtilEsp = function(state)
        utilEspEnabled = state and true or false
        getgenv().jahvex_utilEspEnabled = utilEspEnabled
        if utilEspEnabled then
            utilEnsureGui()
            utilScanExisting()
        else
            utilClearAll()
        end
    end
end


local EPW  = COL_W
local EPX  = COL2_X

local espScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

espScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, EPX, 0, 0)

local function espPanel(h, title)
    local px, py, pw = jahvex_panelBox(0, epCursorY, EPW, h)
    local p = Instance.new("Frame")
    p.Size = UDim2.new(0, pw, 0, h)
    p.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
    p.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
    p.BorderSizePixel = 0
    p.ZIndex = 3
    p.ClipsDescendants = false
    p.Parent = espScroll
    pcall(function() p:SetAttribute("uiRole", "panel") end)
    makeCorner(p, 8)
    makeStroke(p, BORDER, 1)

    makeLabel(p, title, 12, 6, pw - 24, 22, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    epCursorY = epCursorY + h + EP_GAP
    return p
end

local function espSlider(parent, label, x, y, w, minV, maxV, initVal, suffix, onChange)
    local KW = 12
    local valStr = tostring(initVal)..(suffix or "")
    makeLabel(parent, label, x, y, w-50, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local valLbl = makeLabel(parent, valStr, x, y + 13, w, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
    local tr = Instance.new("Frame")
    tr.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 4)
    tr.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y+18)
    tr.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG; tr.BorderSizePixel=0; tr.ZIndex=4
    tr.Parent = parent
    pcall(function() tr:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    makeCorner(tr,3); makeStroke(tr, BORDER, 1)
    local initFrac = math.clamp((initVal-minV)/(maxV-minV), 0, 1)
    local fi = Instance.new("Frame")
    fi.Size = UDim2.new(initFrac, 0, 1, 0)
    fi.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC; fi.BorderSizePixel=0; fi.ZIndex=5
    fi.Parent = tr; makeCorner(fi,3)
    pcall(function() fi:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
    local kn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    kn.Size = UDim2.new(0,KW,0,KW)
    kn.Position = UDim2.new(initFrac,-KW/2,0.5,-KW/2)
    kn.BackgroundColor3=WHITE_ACC; kn.BorderSizePixel=0
    kn.Text=""; kn.AutoButtonColor=false; kn.ZIndex=6
    kn.Parent=tr; makeCorner(kn,KW/2); makeStroke(kn,BORDER,1)
    pcall(function() kn:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
    local drag=false
    kn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag=true end end)
    kn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag=false end end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if not drag then return end
        if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
        local frac=math.clamp((i.Position.X-tr.AbsolutePosition.X)/tr.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)
        local val=math.floor(minV+frac*(maxV-minV))
        fi.Size=UDim2.new(frac,0,1,0)
        kn.Position=UDim2.new(frac,-KW/2,0.5,-KW/2)
        valLbl.Text=tostring(val)..(suffix or "")
        onChange(val)
    end)
end


local activeColorPicker = nil
local spectrumHost = Instance.new("Frame")
spectrumHost.Name = "EspSpectrumHost"
spectrumHost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
spectrumHost.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
spectrumHost.ZIndex = 200
spectrumHost.Visible = false
spectrumHost.Parent = screenGui

local function closeSpectrumPicker()
    activeColorPicker = nil
    spectrumHost.Visible = false
    for _, c in ipairs(spectrumHost:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
end

local function openSpectrumPicker(anchorBtn, getColor, setColor)
    closeSpectrumPicker()
    spectrumHost.Visible = true

    local sink = Instance.new("TextButton")
    sink.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    sink.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sink.Text = ""
    sink.ZIndex = 49
    sink.Parent = spectrumHost
    sink.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeSpectrumPicker)


    local SV_W, SV_H = 140, 120
    local HUE_W = 14
    local GAP = 8
    local PAD = 8
    local shellW = PAD + SV_W + GAP + HUE_W + PAD
    local shellH = PAD + SV_H + PAD

    local abs = anchorBtn.AbsolutePosition
    local asz = anchorBtn.AbsoluteSize
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
    local px = math.clamp(abs.X + asz.X - shellW, 8, vp.X - shellW - 8)
    local py = abs.Y + asz.Y + 6
    if py + shellH > vp.Y - 8 then
        py = math.max(8, abs.Y - shellH - 6)
    end

    local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
    shell.Size = UDim2.new(0, shellW, 0, shellH)
    shell.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
    shell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
    shell.BorderSizePixel = 0
    shell.ZIndex = 51
    shell.Parent = spectrumHost
    makeCorner(shell, 8)
    makeStroke(shell, BORDER, 1)

    local curH, curS, curV = Color3.toHSV(getColor())


    local sv = Instance.new("Frame")
    sv.Size = UDim2.new(0, SV_W, 0, SV_H)
    sv.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0, PAD)
    sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(curH, 1, 1)
    sv.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sv.ClipsDescendants = true
    sv.ZIndex = 52
    sv.Parent = shell
    makeCorner(sv, 6)


    local satLayer = Instance.new("Frame")
    satLayer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    satLayer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    satLayer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    satLayer.ZIndex = 53
    satLayer.Parent = sv
    local satGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    satGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    satGrad.Parent = satLayer


    local valLayer = Instance.new("Frame")
    valLayer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    valLayer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    valLayer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    valLayer.ZIndex = 54
    valLayer.Parent = sv
    local valGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    valGrad.Rotation = 90
    valGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })
    valGrad.Parent = valLayer

    local svCursor = Instance.new("Frame")
    svCursor.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    svCursor.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    svCursor.Position = UDim2.new(curS, 0, 1 - curV, 0)
    svCursor.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    svCursor.BorderSizePixel = 0
    svCursor.ZIndex = 56
    svCursor.Parent = sv
    local svStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    svStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    svStroke.Thickness = 2
    svStroke.Parent = svCursor
    makeCorner(svCursor, 5)

    local svHit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    svHit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    svHit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    svHit.Text = ""
    svHit.ZIndex = 57
    svHit.Parent = sv


    local hueBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    hueBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, HUE_W, 0, SV_H)
    hueBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD + SV_W + GAP, 0, PAD)
    hueBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hueBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hueBar.ClipsDescendants = true
    hueBar.ZIndex = 52
    hueBar.Parent = shell
    makeCorner(hueBar, 4)

    local hueGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    hueGrad.Rotation = 90
    hueGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.17, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.67, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.83, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
    })
    hueGrad.Parent = hueBar

    local hueCursor = Instance.new("Frame")
    hueCursor.Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, 4)
    hueCursor.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    hueCursor.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, curH, 0)
    hueCursor.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hueCursor.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hueCursor.ZIndex = 56
    hueCursor.Parent = hueBar
    makeCorner(hueCursor, 2)
    makeStroke(hueCursor, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1)

    local hueHit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hueHit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    hueHit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hueHit.Text = ""
    hueHit.ZIndex = 57
    hueHit.Parent = hueBar

    local function applyColor()
        local c = Color3.fromHSV(curH, curS, curV)
        sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(curH, 1, 1)
        setColor(c)
    end

    local function sampleSV(input)
        local ap, asz2 = sv.AbsolutePosition, sv.AbsoluteSize
        if asz2.X <= 0 or asz2.Y <= 0 then return end
        curS = math.clamp((input.Position.X - ap.X) / asz2.X, 0, 1)
        curV = 1 - math.clamp((input.Position.Y - ap.Y) / asz2.Y, 0, 1)
        svCursor.Position = UDim2.new(curS, 0, 1 - curV, 0)
        applyColor()
    end

    local function sampleHue(input)
        local ap, asz2 = hueBar.AbsolutePosition, hueBar.AbsoluteSize
        if asz2.Y <= 0 then return end
        curH = math.clamp((input.Position.Y - ap.Y) / asz2.Y, 0, 1)
        hueCursor.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, curH, 0)
        applyColor()
    end

    local dragSV, dragHue = false, false
    svHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragSV = true
            sampleSV(i)
        end
    end)
    svHit.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragSV = false end
    end)
    hueHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragHue = true
            sampleHue(i)
        end
    end)
    hueHit.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragHue = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
        if dragSV then sampleSV(i) end
        if dragHue then sampleHue(i) end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragSV = false
            dragHue = false
        end
    end)

    activeColorPicker = closeSpectrumPicker
end


local function espToggleRow(parent, text, x, y, w, initVal, cb, colorGet, colorSet)
    local hasColor = colorGet ~= nil and colorSet ~= nil
    local toggleW = hasColor and (w - SWATCH_W - 10) or w

    local tog = makeToggle(parent, text, x, y, toggleW, cb)
    if tog.Label then
        tog.Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 0)
        tog.Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
    end

    if hasColor then
        local swatch = Instance.new("TextButton")
        swatch.Size = UDim2.new(0, SWATCH_W, 0, 16)
        swatch.Position = UDim2.new(0, x + w - SWATCH_W, 0, y + 3)
        swatch.BackgroundColor3 = colorGet()
        swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
        swatch.Text = ""
        swatch.AutoButtonColor = false
        swatch.ZIndex = 5
        swatch.Parent = parent
        makeCorner(swatch, 4)
        makeStroke(swatch, BORDER, 1)
        swatch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            openSpectrumPicker(swatch, colorGet, function(c)
                swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
                colorSet(c)
            end)
        end)
    end

    if initVal then task.defer(function() tog:Set(true) end) end
    return tog
end

    if antiKatanaEnabled and jahvexUiRefs.antiKatanaToggle and jahvexUiRefs.antiKatanaToggle.Set then
        jahvexUiRefs.antiKatanaToggle:Set(true, false)
    end
    jahvexUiRefs.antiRiotToggle = espToggleRow(p3, "Anti Riot", 12, 38 + TH * 2, rw, false, function(s)
        antiRiotEnabled = s and true or false
        saveConfig()
    end)
    if antiRiotEnabled and jahvexUiRefs.antiRiotToggle and jahvexUiRefs.antiRiotToggle.Set then
        jahvexUiRefs.antiRiotToggle:Set(true, false)
    end
end

function jahvex_inMatchWorld()
    local ws = workspace
    if ws:FindFirstChild("Arena") or ws:FindFirstChild("Big Arena") or ws:FindFirstChild("_drop") then
        return true
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(ws:GetChildren()) do
        if c.Name ~= "Lobby" and (c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("Folder")) then
            if c:FindFirstChild("Spawns") or c:FindFirstChild("SpawnsArcade") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_weaponDropdownOpts(kind)
    local opts = { { label = "None", value = "" } }
    local names = {}
    pcall(function()
        local items = ItemLibrary and ItemLibrary.Items
        if type(items) ~= "table" then return end
        for name, info in pairs(items) do
            if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "MISSING_WEAPON" then
                local ty = type(info) == "table" and (info.Type or info.Slot) or nil
                local cls = type(info) == "table" and tostring(info.Class or "") or ""
                local ok = false
                if kind == "primary" then
                    ok = ty == "Gun" and cls ~= "Secondary"
                elseif kind == "secondary" then
                    ok = ty == "Gun" and cls ~= "Primary"
                elseif kind == "gun" then
                    ok = ty == "Gun"
                elseif kind == "melee" then
                    ok = ty == "Melee"
                elseif kind == "util" then
                    ok = ty == "Throwable" or ty == "Custom"
                else
                    ok = true
                end
                if ok then table.insert(names, name) end
            end
        end
    end)
    table.sort(names)

    if #names == 0 then
        pcall(function()
            for name, _ in pairs(ItemLibrary.Items or {}) do
                if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "MISSING_WEAPON" then
                    table.insert(names, name)
                end
            end
            table.sort(names)
        end)
    end
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        table.insert(opts, { label = n, value = n })
    end
    return opts
end
_G.jahvex_weaponDropdownOpts = jahvex_weaponDropdownOpts

function jahvex_mapDropdownOpts()
    local opts = { { label = "None", value = "" } }
    local names = {}
    local seen = {}
    pcall(function()
        local DL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.DuelLibrary)
        local maps = DL and DL.Maps
        if type(maps) ~= "table" then return end
        for k, v in pairs(maps) do
            local name = type(k) == "string" and k or (type(v) == "table" and (v.Name or v.DisplayName))
            if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" and name ~= "Random" and not seen[name] then
                seen[name] = true
                table.insert(names, name)
            end
        end
    end)
    if #names == 0 then
        names = {
            "Arena", "Backrooms", "Baseplate", "Battleground", "Big Arena", "Big Backrooms",
            "Big Crossroads", "Big Graveyard", "Big Onyx", "Big Splash", "Big Station", "Boss Arena",
            "Bridge", "Chess", "Construction", "Crossroads", "Dimension", "Docks", "Factory",
            "Graveyard", "Iceberg", "Legacy Backrooms", "Legacy Battleground", "Legacy Big Splash",
            "Legacy Crossroads", "Legacy Docks", "Legacy Onyx", "Legacy Sandbox", "Legacy Splash",
            "Museum", "Obby", "Onyx", "Playground", "Sandbox", "Shooting Range", "Splash", "Spleef",
            "Station", "Studio", "Village", "Westown", "Zombie Tower",
        }
    end
    table.sort(names)
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        table.insert(opts, { label = n, value = n })
    end
    return opts
end
_G.jahvex_mapDropdownOpts = jahvex_mapDropdownOpts

do
    local MAX_N = 5
    local HOLD = 2.5
    local rows = {}
    local lastKey, lastAt = "", 0
    local lastHitAt = 0
    local lastDropName, lastDropAt = nil, 0
    local lastHp = {}
    local watch = {}
    local nhGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    nhGui.Name = "HitFeedbackGui"
    nhGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    nhGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    nhGui.DisplayOrder = 100010
    nhGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    nhGui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    pcall(jahvex_guiParent, nhGui)
    local host = Instance.new("Frame")
    host.Name = "HitFeedbackHost"
    host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    host.BorderSizePixel = 0
    host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    host.ZIndex = 85
    host.Parent = nhGui

    local function lineH()
        return math.max(22, (tonumber(notifyHitSize) or 18) + 16)
    end

    local function rowPos(i)
        local y = -(tonumber(notifyHitY) or 72) - (i - 1) * lineH()
        return UDim2.new(0.5, tonumber(notifyHitX) or 0, 1, y)
    end

    local function killRow(row, instant)
        if not row or row._dead then return end
        row._dead = true
        local fr = row.frame
        local sc = row.scale
        local lbl = row.label
        if instant or not fr or not fr.Parent then
            pcall(function() if fr then fr:Destroy() end end)
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                TextTransparency = 1,
                TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
            }):Play()
            if row.chip then
                TweenService:Create(row.chip, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                }):Play()
            end
            if row.stroke then
                TweenService:Create(row.stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    Transparency = 1,
                }):Play()
            end
            if sc then
                TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    Scale = 0.35,
                }):Play()
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.2, function()
            pcall(function() if fr then fr:Destroy() end end)
        end)
    end

    local function relayout()
        for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
            if row.frame and row.frame.Parent and not row._dead then
                pcall(function()
                    TweenService:Create(row.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Position = rowPos(i),
                    }):Play()
                    row.label.TextSize = tonumber(notifyHitSize) or 18
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    jahvex_notifyHitRelayout = relayout

    local function playIn(row, effect)
        local fr, sc, lbl = row.frame, row.scale, row.label
        effect = tostring(effect or "side_stretch")
        local dest = fr.Position
        lbl.TextTransparency = 1
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        if row.chip then
            row.chip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        end
        if row.stroke then
            row.stroke.Transparency = 1
        end
        local ti = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            TextTransparency = 0,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55,
        }):Play()
        if row.chip then
            TweenService:Create(row.chip, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
            }):Play()
        end
        if row.stroke then
            TweenService:Create(row.stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Transparency = 0,
            }):Play()
        end
        if effect == "slide_right" then
            fr.Position = dest + UDim2.fromOffset(240, 0)
            TweenService:Create(fr, ti, { Position = dest }):Play()
        elseif effect == "slide_left" then
            fr.Position = dest + UDim2.fromOffset(-240, 0)
            TweenService:Create(fr, ti, { Position = dest }):Play()
        elseif effect == "center_expand" then
            sc.Scale = 0.18
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        elseif effect == "side_stretch" then
            sc.Scale = 0.08
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.36, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        elseif effect == "rise_up" then
            fr.Position = dest + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46)
            TweenService:Create(fr, ti, { Position = dest }):Play()
        elseif effect == "fade_in" then

        elseif effect == "bounce_pop" then
            sc.Scale = 0.28
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        else
            sc.Scale = 0.08
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.36, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        end
    end

    local function victimFromGui(gui)
        if not gui then return nil end
        local inst = gui.Adornee or gui.Parent
        local cur = inst
        for _ = 1, 12 do
            if not cur then break end
            if cur:IsA("Model") then
                local p = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(cur)
                if p and p ~= lp then return p.Name end
            end
            cur = cur.Parent
        end
        if inst then
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= lp and plr.Character and inst:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
                    return plr.Name
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function closestEnemyName()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil end
        local vs = cam.ViewportSize
        local center = Vector2.new(vs.X * 0.5, vs.Y * 0.5)
        local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr == lp then continue end
            local char = plr.Character
            if not char then continue end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
            if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then continue end
            local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            if (not on and sp.Z <= 0) or sp.Z <= 0 then continue end
            local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
            if d < bestD then
                bestD = d
                best = plr.Name
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function resolveVictim(gui)
        local n = victimFromGui(gui)
        if n then return n end
        if lastDropName and (os.clock() - lastDropAt) < 0.35 then
            return lastDropName
        end
        local sa = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_part")
        if typeof(sa) == "Instance" and sa.Parent then
            local cur = sa
            for _ = 1, 8 do
                if not cur then break end
                if cur:IsA("Model") then
                    local p = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(cur)
                    if p and p ~= lp then return p.Name end
                end
                cur = cur.Parent
            end
        end
        return closestEnemyName()
    end

    function jahvex_notifyHitPush(guiOrName)
        if not notifyHitEnabled or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        local victim
        if type(guiOrName) == "string" then
            victim = guiOrName
        else
            victim = resolveVictim(guiOrName)
        end
        if type(victim) ~= "string" or victim == "" or victim == lp.Name then
            victim = closestEnemyName()
        end
        if type(victim) ~= "string" or victim == "" or victim == lp.Name then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local key = victim
        if key == lastKey and (now - lastAt) < 0.09 then return end
        lastKey = key
        lastAt = now
        if #rows >= MAX_N then
            local old = table.remove(rows, 1)
            killRow(old, false)
        end
        local sz = tonumber(notifyHitSize) or 18
        local padX, padY = 14, 6
        local fr = Instance.new("Frame")
        fr.Name = "NotifyHitRow"
        fr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        fr.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
        fr.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        fr.Position = rowPos(#rows + 1)
        fr.ZIndex = 86
        fr.Parent = host
        local sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
        sc.Scale = 1
        sc.Parent = fr
        local chip = Instance.new("Frame")
        chip.Name = "Chip"
        chip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
        chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        chip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
        chip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
        chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
        chip.ZIndex = 86
        chip.Parent = fr
        makeCorner(chip, 6)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(228, 228, 236)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.4
        stroke.Transparency = 0
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = chip
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, padX)
        pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, padX)
        pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, padY)
        pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, padY)
        pad.Parent = chip
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
        lbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = sz
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
        do
            local me = tostring(lp.Name or "me")
            local custom = tostring(notifyHitCustom or "")
            if custom ~= "" then
                local msg = custom
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{me}", me)
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{you}", me)
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{self}", me)
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{enemy}", victim)
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{victim}", victim)
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{name}", victim)
                msg = string.gsub(msg, "{target}", victim)
                lbl.Text = msg
            else
                lbl.Text = me .. "  hits  " .. victim
            end
        end
        lbl.ZIndex = 87
        lbl.Parent = chip
        local row = { frame = fr, scale = sc, label = lbl, chip = chip, stroke = stroke, born = now }
        table.insert(rows, row)
        relayout()
        playIn(row, notifyHitEffect)
        task.delay(HOLD, function()
            if row._dead then return end
            for i, r in ipairs(rows) do
                if r == row then
                    table.remove(rows, i)
                    break
                end
            end
            killRow(row, false)
            relayout()
        end)
    end
    getgenv().jahvex_notifyHitPush = jahvex_notifyHitPush

    local function unwatch()
        for _, c in ipairs(watch) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
        watch = {}
    end

    local function track(c)
        if c then
            table.insert(watch, c)
            jahvex_track(c)
        end
    end

    local function bindChar(plr, char)
        if not char or plr == lp then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then
            hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 2)
        end
        if not hum then return end
        lastHp[plr] = hum.Health
        track(hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
            local prev = lastHp[plr]
            lastHp[plr] = h
            if typeof(prev) == "number" and h < prev - 0.4 then
                lastDropName = plr.Name
                lastDropAt = os.clock()
                if notifyHitEnabled and (os.clock() - lastHitAt) < 0.4 then
                    jahvex_notifyHitPush(plr.Name)
                end
            end
        end))
    end

    local function bindPlayer(plr)
        if plr == lp then return end
        if plr.Character then
            task.defer(bindChar, plr, plr.Character)
        end
        track(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            bindChar(plr, char)
        end))
    end

    local function hookDamageEffect()
        local function wrap(mod, key)
            if type(mod) ~= "table" or type(mod.DamageEffect) ~= "function" then return end
            if mod._jahvexNotifyHit then return end
            mod._jahvexNotifyHit = true
            pcall(function()
                jahvex_saveMod(key, mod, "DamageEffect")
            end)
            local orig = mod.DamageEffect
            mod.DamageEffect = function(self, p7, p8, ...)
                local a, b, c = orig(self, p7, p8, ...)
                lastHitAt = os.clock()
                if notifyHitEnabled and getgenv().jahvex_alive then
                    task.defer(function()
                        local name = resolveVictim(nil)
                        if name then
                            jahvex_notifyHitPush(name)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                return a, b, c
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local ps = lp.PlayerScripts
            local base = ps.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem
            wrap(require(base.ItemInterface.Mouse.MouseCrosshair), "MouseCrosshair_DamageEffect")
            wrap(require(base.ItemInterface), "ItemInterface_DamageEffect")
        end)
    end

    local function bindGui(gui)
        if not gui or not gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then return end
        local function fire()
            if notifyHitEnabled then
                lastHitAt = os.clock()
                jahvex_notifyHitPush(gui)
            end
        end
        track(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Adornee"):Connect(function()
            if gui.Adornee then fire() end
        end))
        local val = gui:FindFirstChild("Value", true) or gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        if val and (val:IsA("TextLabel") or val:IsA("TextButton")) then
            track(val:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                if tonumber((val.Text or ""):match("[-%d%.]+")) then
                    fire()
                end
            end))
        end
    end

    function jahvex_notifyHitSet(on)
        notifyHitEnabled = on and true or false
        unwatch()
        if not on then
            for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
                killRow(row, true)
            end
            rows = {}
            return
        end
        hookDamageEffect()
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            bindPlayer(plr)
        end
        track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer))
        pcall(function()
            local ps = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
            local ui = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("UserInterface")
            if ui then
                local dg = ui:FindFirstChild("DamageGui")
                if dg then bindGui(dg) end
                track(ui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                    if ch.Name == "DamageGui" or ch:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        task.defer(bindGui, ch)
                    end
                end))
            end
        end)
    end

    _G.jahvex_notifyHitDestroy = function()
        notifyHitEnabled = false
        unwatch()
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            killRow(row, true)
        end
        rows = {}
        pcall(function() nhGui:Destroy() end)
    end

    hookDamageEffect()
    if notifyHitEnabled then
        jahvex_notifyHitSet(true)
    end
end

    local function applyHudGeom()
        local w = math.clamp(tonumber(targetHudW) or 300, HUD_MIN_W, HUD_MAX_W)
        local h = math.clamp(tonumber(targetHudH) or 156, HUD_MIN_H, HUD_MAX_H)
        targetHudW, targetHudH = w, h
        card.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vs = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local x = tonumber(targetHudX)
        local y = tonumber(targetHudY)
        if not x or not y then
            x = math.max(8, vs.X - w - 24)
            y = 92
        end
        x = math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(0, vs.X - w))
        y = math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, vs.Y - h))
        targetHudX, targetHudY = x, y
        card.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
        local slot = math.clamp(math.floor((w - 40) / SLOT_N) - 6, 32, 56)
        for i = 1, SLOT_N do
            slots[i].cell.Size = UDim2.new(0, slot, 0, math.min(slot, h - 108))
        end
    end
