    local function hexCol(c)
        local r = math.clamp(math.floor((c.R * 255) + 0.5), 0, 255)
        local g = math.clamp(math.floor((c.G * 255) + 0.5), 0, 255)
        local b = math.clamp(math.floor((c.B * 255) + 0.5), 0, 255)
        return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", r, g, b)
    end

    local function itemName(it)
        local n = ""
        pcall(function()
            n = (it.Info and it.Info.Name) or it.Name or ""
        end)
        return tostring(n)
    end

    local function itemImageOf(it, nm)
        local img
        pcall(function()
            img = it.Info and it.Info.Image
        end)
        if (not img or img == "") and ItemLibrary and ItemLibrary.Items and nm and nm ~= "" then
            local d = ItemLibrary.Items[nm]
            if d then img = d.Image end
        end
        return img
    end

    local function itemSlotKey(it)
        local s
        pcall(function() s = it:Get("Slot") end)
        if not s then pcall(function() s = it.Info and it.Info.Slot end) end
        return tostring(s or "")
    end

    local SLOT_RANK = {
        Primary = 1, Secondary = 2, Melee = 3, Utility = 4,
        Explosive = 5, Equipment = 6, Consumable = 7,
    }

    local function collectLoadout(f)
        local list = {}
        if not f or type(f.Items) ~= "table" then return list end
        for idx, it in pairs(f.Items) do
            if type(it) == "table" then
                local nm = itemName(it)
                if nm ~= "" then
                    local rank = SLOT_RANK[itemSlotKey(it)] or (typeof(idx) == "number" and (10 + idx) or 50)
                    table.insert(list, { it = it, name = nm, rank = rank, idx = tonumber(idx) or 99 })
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b)
            if a.rank ~= b.rank then return a.rank < b.rank end
            return a.idx < b.idx
        end)
        return list
    end

    local function readDevice(plr, f)
        local v
        pcall(function()
            if f and type(f.Data) == "table" then
                v = f.Data.CurrentControls or f.Data.Device or f.Data.Platform
            end
        end)
        if v == nil then
            pcall(function() v = plr:GetAttribute("CurrentControls") or plr:GetAttribute("Device") or plr:GetAttribute("Platform") end)
        end
        if v == nil and plr.Character then
            pcall(function() v = plr.Character:GetAttribute("Device") or plr.Character:GetAttribute("CurrentControls") end)
        end
        local s = string.lower(tostring(v or ""))
        if s == "" or s == "nil" then return "?" end
        if string.find(s, "mouse", 1, true) or string.find(s, "keyboard", 1, true) or s == "pc" or string.find(s, "computer", 1, true) then
            return "computer"
        end
        if string.find(s, "touch", 1, true) or string.find(s, "mobile", 1, true) then return "mobile" end
        if string.find(s, "gamepad", 1, true) or string.find(s, "control", 1, true) then return "controller" end
        if string.find(s, "vr", 1, true) then return "vr" end
        return tostring(v)
    end

    local function readLevelElo(plr, f)
        local level, elo = "?", nil
        local cl = plr:FindFirstChild("CustomLeaderstats") or plr:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        if cl then
            local lv = cl:FindFirstChild("Level")
            if lv then level = tostring(lv.Value) end
            local ev = cl:FindFirstChild("Current ELO") or cl:FindFirstChild("ELO") or cl:FindFirstChild("DisplayELO") or cl:FindFirstChild("Elo")
            if ev then elo = tonumber(ev.Value) end
        end
        if level == "?" then
            local a = plr:GetAttribute("Level")
            if a ~= nil then level = tostring(a) end
        end
        if elo == nil then
            elo = tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("DisplayELO") or plr:GetAttribute("RankedCurrentELO"))
        end
        if elo == nil and f and type(f.Get) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                elo = tonumber(f:Get("DisplayELO") or f:Get("RankedCurrentELO"))
            end)
        end
        return level, elo
    end

    local function readRank(plr, elo)
        local rank = "?"
        if seasonLib and type(seasonLib.GetRank) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                rank = tostring(seasonLib:GetRank(tonumber(elo) or 0, plr.UserId, nil) or "?")
            end)
        end
        return rank
    end

    local function equippedNameOf(f, plr)
        local n = ""
        pcall(function()
            if f and f.EquippedItem then
                n = itemName(f.EquippedItem)
            end
        end)
        if n == "" and plr and plr.Character then
            for _, ch in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("Tool") then
                    n = ch.Name
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        return n
    end

    local function setSlotHeld(slot, held)
        slot.holdGreen = held and true or false
        if held then
            slot.stroke.Color = GREEN
            slot.stroke.Thickness = 2
            pcall(function() slot.stroke:SetAttribute("uiRole", nil) end)
        else
            slot.stroke.Color = BORDER
            slot.stroke.Thickness = 1
            pcall(function() slot.stroke:SetAttribute("uiRole", "border") end)
        end
    end

    local function paintSlots(loadout, heldName)
        local heldLow = string.lower(heldName or "")
        for i = 1, SLOT_N do
            local row = loadout[i]
            local sl = slots[i]
            if not row then
                sl.cell.Visible = false
            else
                sl.cell.Visible = true
                local img = itemImageOf(row.it, row.name)
                if type(img) == "string" and img ~= "" then
                    sl.img.Image = img
                    sl.img.Visible = true
                    sl.fb.Text = ""
                else
                    sl.img.Image = ""
                    sl.img.Visible = false
                    sl.fb.Text = string.upper(string.sub(row.name, 1, 3))
                end
                setSlotHeld(sl, heldLow ~= "" and string.lower(row.name) == heldLow)
            end
        end
    end

    local function inMatch()
        local ws = workspace
        if ws:FindFirstChild("Arena") or ws:FindFirstChild("Big Arena") or ws:FindFirstChild("_drop") then
            return true
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(ws:GetChildren()) do
            if c.Name ~= "Lobby" and (c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("Folder")) then
                if c:FindFirstChild("Spawns") or c:FindFirstChild("SpawnsArcade") then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function isVoidPos(pos)
        if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        return math.abs(pos.X) > 50000 or math.abs(pos.Y) > 50000 or math.abs(pos.Z) > 50000 or pos.Magnitude > 50000
    end

    local function hudTeammate(plr)
        if not plr or plr == lp then return true end
        if lp.Team and plr.Team and lp.Team == plr.Team then return true end
        local myF, tgF
        pcall(function()
            myF = jahvex_akGetFighter and jahvex_akGetFighter(lp)
            tgF = jahvex_akGetFighter and jahvex_akGetFighter(plr)
        end)
        if myF and tgF and myF.Team and tgF.Team and myF.Team == tgF.Team then
            return true
        end
        local char, myChar = plr.Character, lp.Character
        if char and myChar then
            local a, b = char:GetAttribute("Team"), myChar:GetAttribute("Team")
            if a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a == b then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function hudAlive(plr)
        local char = plr and plr.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
            return true
        end
        local f
        pcall(function()
            f = jahvex_akGetFighter and jahvex_akGetFighter(plr)
        end)
        if f then
            local ok, alive = pcall(function()
                if type(f.IsAlive) == "function" then return f:IsAlive() end
                return nil
            end)
            if ok and alive == true then return true end
            local hp
            pcall(function() hp = f:Get("Health") end)
            if type(hp) == "number" and hp > 0 then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function hudRootPos(plr)
        local char = plr and plr.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local part = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("HitboxHumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or char:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead")
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            return part.Position
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function stillValid(plr)
        return plr and plr.Parent and plr ~= lp and not hudTeammate(plr) and hudAlive(plr)
    end

    local function pickTarget()
        if lastPlr and stillValid(lastPlr) then
            local pos = hudRootPos(lastPlr)
            if pos and isVoidPos(pos) then
                return lastPlr
            end
        end
        local origin
        local myChar = lp.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and (myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or myChar:FindFirstChild("Head"))
        if myRoot then
            origin = myRoot.Position
        else
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
        end
        local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
        local bestVoid, bestVoidD = nil, math.huge
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if not stillValid(plr) then continue end
            local pos = hudRootPos(plr)
            local dist = pos and (pos - origin).Magnitude or 1e12
            if pos and isVoidPos(pos) then
                if dist < bestVoidD then
                    bestVoid, bestVoidD = plr, dist
                end
            elseif dist < bestD then
                best, bestD = plr, dist
            end
        end
        local p = best or bestVoid
        lastPlr = p
        return p
    end

    local function refreshHud()
        if not targetHudEnabled or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then
            card.Visible = false
            return
        end
        if not inMatch() then
            lastPlr = nil
            card.Visible = false
            return
        end
        local plr = pickTarget()
        if not plr then
            card.Visible = false
            return
        end
        card.Visible = true
        local f
        pcall(function()
            f = jahvex_akGetFighter and jahvex_akGetFighter(plr)
        end)
        nameLbl.Text = tostring(plr.DisplayName or plr.Name)
        local level, elo = readLevelElo(plr, f)
        local rank = readRank(plr, elo)
        local device = readDevice(plr, f)
        local dim = hexCol(TEXT_DIM)
        local bright = hexCol(TEXT_W)
        metaLbl.RichText = true
        metaLbl.Text = string.format(
            '<font color="%s">level</font> <font color="%s">%s</font>   <font color="%s">rank</font> <font color="%s">%s</font>   <font color="%s">device</font> <font color="%s">%s</font>',
            dim, bright, level, dim, bright, rank, dim, bright, device
        )
        local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hp, mx = 0, 100
        if hum then
            hp = math.max(0, hum.Health)
            mx = math.max(1, hum.MaxHealth)
        elseif f and type(f.Get) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                hp = tonumber(f:Get("Health")) or hp
                mx = tonumber(f:Get("MaxHealth")) or mx
            end)
        end
        local frac = math.clamp(hp / mx, 0, 1)
        hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
        if frac <= 0.28 then
            hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = RED
            pcall(function() hpFill:SetAttribute("uiRole", nil) end)
        else
            hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
            pcall(function() hpFill:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
        end
        hpVal.Text = string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(hp + 0.5), math.floor(mx + 0.5))

        local held = equippedNameOf(f, plr)
        local ammoTxt = "ammo  —"
        local spentTxt = "spent  —"
        if f and f.EquippedItem and type(f.EquippedItem.Get) == "function" then
            local ammo, mag
            pcall(function() ammo = f.EquippedItem:Get("Ammo") end)
            pcall(function()
                mag = f.EquippedItem.Info and f.EquippedItem.Info.MaxAmmo
            end)
            if type(ammo) == "number" then
                mag = tonumber(mag) or ammo
                local spent = math.max(0, mag - ammo)
                ammoTxt = string.format("ammo  %d / %d", ammo, mag)
                spentTxt = string.format("spent  %d", spent)
            end
        end
        ammoLbl.RichText = true
        ammoLbl.Text = string.format(
            '<font color="%s">%s</font>     <font color="%s">%s</font>',
            bright, ammoTxt, bright, spentTxt
        )

        paintSlots(collectLoadout(f), held)
    end

    function jahvex_targetHudSet(on)
        targetHudEnabled = on and true or false
        if targetHudEnabled then
            applyHudGeom()
            refreshHud()
        else
            card.Visible = false
        end
    end

    applyHudGeom()
    jahvexThemeRefreshers = jahvexThemeRefreshers or {}
    table.insert(jahvexThemeRefreshers, function()
        if not card or not card.Parent then return end
        card.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
        accent.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        grip.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        if GUI_FONT then
            metaLbl.Font = GUI_FONT
            hpCaption.Font = GUI_FONT
            hpVal.Font = GUI_FONT
            ammoLbl.Font = GUI_FONT
        end
        for i = 1, SLOT_N do
            if slots[i].holdGreen then
                slots[i].stroke.Color = GREEN
            end
        end
        if card.Visible then refreshHud() end
    end)

    local _thudFrame = 0
    jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        if not targetHudEnabled then
            if card.Visible then card.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        _thudFrame = _thudFrame + 1
        if _thudFrame % 4 ~= 0 then return end
        refreshHud()
    end))

    if targetHudEnabled then
        jahvex_targetHudSet(true)
    end
end


do
    task.spawn(function()
        local UIC, Pages, CONSTANTS, ArcadeController
        pcall(function()
            UIC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.UserInterfaceController)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            Pages = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.UserInterface.Pages)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            CONSTANTS = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CONSTANTS)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            ArcadeController = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.ArcadeController)
        end)
        local function patchPlay(play)
            if type(play) ~= "table" or play._jxOpenPlayPatch then return false end
            if type(play.OpenPlayPage) ~= "function" then return false end
            play._jxOpenPlayPatch = true
            local orig = play.OpenPlayPage
            play.OpenPlayPage = function(self, ...)
                local arcade = false
                pcall(function()
                    if (CONSTANTS and CONSTANTS.IS_ARCADE_SERVER) or (ArcadeController and ArcadeController.CurrentDuel) then
                        ArcadeController:Join()
                        arcade = true
                    end
                end)
                if arcade then return end
                if statsSpoofEnabled then
                    pcall(function()
                        if Pages and Pages.PageSystem then
                            Pages.PageSystem:OpenPage("Matchmaking", true)
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                return orig(self, ...)
            end
            return true
        end
        for _ = 1, 40 do
            local ok = false
            pcall(function()
                local play = UIC and UIC._elements and UIC._elements.Lobby and UIC._elements.Lobby.Play
                ok = patchPlay(play)
            end)
            if ok then break end
            task.wait(0.35)
        end
    end)

    local lastQueueAt, lastLoadoutAt, lastPlayAgainAt = 0, 0, 0
    local matchEnterAt = 0
    local lastVoteAt = 0
    local votedKey = {}
    local lastDuelToken = nil

    local function getClientDuel()
        local d
        pcall(function()
            local SC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.SpectateController)
            d = SC and SC.CurrentDuelSubject
        end)
        return d
    end

    local function duelIsRankedBan(d)
        if not d then return false end
        local maps, weps = 0, 0
        pcall(function()
            maps = tonumber(d:Get("MaxMapBansPerTeam")) or 0
            weps = tonumber(d:Get("MaxWeaponBansPerTeam")) or 0
        end)
        if maps > 0 or weps > 0 then return true end
        local q = ""
        pcall(function()
            q = tostring(d:Get("QueueName") or d:Get("MatchmakingQueue") or "")
        end)
        return string.find(string.lower(q), "ranked", 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function findVoteOption(opts, name)
        if type(opts) ~= "table" or name == nil or name == "" then return nil end
        for _, v in pairs(opts) do
            if type(v) == "table" and v.Name == name then
                return v
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function tryVoteBan(name)
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return false end
        local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local vote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Duels") and remotes.Duels:FindFirstChild("Vote")
        if not vote then return false end
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_stealthFireServer(vote, name)
        end)
        return true
    end

    local function resolveQueueName()
        local size = tostring(autoQueueSize or "1v1")
        if size == "" then size = "1v1" end
        local ranked = tostring(autoQueueKind or "normal") == "ranked"
        local name = ranked and ("ranked_" .. size) or size
        local queues
        pcall(function()
            local DL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.DuelLibrary)
            queues = DL and DL.MatchmakingQueues
        end)
        if type(queues) == "table" then
            if queues[name] then return name end
            if queues[size] then return size end
        end
        return name
    end

    local function chosenWeapons()
        local w = {}
        local a = tostring(autoLoadoutPrimary or "")
        local b = tostring(autoLoadoutSecondary or "")
        local c = tostring(autoLoadoutMelee or "")
        local d = tostring(autoLoadoutUtility or "")
        if a ~= "" then w[1] = a end
        if b ~= "" then w[2] = b end
        if c ~= "" then w[3] = c end
        if d ~= "" then w[4] = d end
        return w
    end

    local function applyLoadout()
        local w = chosenWeapons()
        if not w[1] then return end
        local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        if not remotes then return end
        pcall(function()
            local ahead = remotes:FindFirstChild("Duels") and remotes.Duels:FindFirstChild("PickWeaponsAheadOfTime")
            if ahead then jahvex_stealthFireServer(ahead, w) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local pick = remotes:FindFirstChild("Replication")
                and remotes.Replication:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
                and remotes.Replication.Fighter:FindFirstChild("PickWeapons")
            if pick then jahvex_stealthFireServer(pick, w) end
        end)
    end

    local function tryQueue()
        local qn = resolveQueueName()
        local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            local MMC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MatchmakingController)
            if MMC and type(MMC.QueueInto) == "function" then
                MMC:QueueInto(qn)
                ok = true
            end
        end)
        if ok then return end
        pcall(function()
            ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Matchmaking.JoinQueue:InvokeServer(qn)
        end)
    end

    local function tryPlayAgain()
        pcall(function()
            local ev = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Matchmaking:FindFirstChild("PlayAgain")
            if ev then jahvex_stealthFireServer(ev) end
        end)
    end

    local _alFrame = 0
    jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        if not autoLoadoutEnabled and not autoQueueEnabled and not autoBanMapEnabled and not autoBanWeaponEnabled then return end
        _alFrame = _alFrame + 1
        if _alFrame % 6 ~= 0 then return end
        local now = tick()
        local inMatch = type(jahvex_inMatchWorld) == "function" and jahvex_inMatchWorld() or false

        if autoBanMapEnabled or autoBanWeaponEnabled then
            local duel = getClientDuel()
            if duel and duelIsRankedBan(duel) then
                local token
                pcall(function()
                    token = tostring(duel:Get("DuelSeed") or duel)
                end)
                if token ~= lastDuelToken then
                    lastDuelToken = token
                    votedKey = {}
                end
                local isLocal = false
                pcall(function()
                    isLocal = duel:GetDueler(lp) ~= nil
                end)
                if isLocal and (now - lastVoteAt) >= 0.35 then
                    local opts, optType
                    pcall(function()
                        opts = duel:Get("VoteOptions")
                        optType = duel:Get("VoteOptionsType")
                    end)
                    if type(opts) == "table" then
                        if autoBanMapEnabled and optType ~= "Weapons" then
                            local mapName = tostring(autoBanMap or "")
                            local key = tostring(token) .. "|map|" .. mapName
                            local opt = findVoteOption(opts, mapName)
                            if mapName ~= "" and opt and not opt.IsBanned and not votedKey[key] then
                                if tryVoteBan(mapName) then
                                    votedKey[key] = true
                                    lastVoteAt = now
                                end
                            end
                        elseif autoBanWeaponEnabled and optType == "Weapons" then
                            local w1 = tostring(autoBanWeapon1 or "")
                            local w2 = tostring(autoBanWeapon2 or "")
                            local picks = {}
                            if w1 ~= "" then table.insert(picks, w1) end
                            if w2 ~= "" and w2 ~= w1 then table.insert(picks, w2) end
                            for _, wname in ipairs(picks) do
                                local key = tostring(token) .. "|wep|" .. wname
                                local opt = findVoteOption(opts, wname)
                                if opt and not opt.IsBanned and not votedKey[key] then
                                    if tryVoteBan(wname) then
                                        votedKey[key] = true
                                        lastVoteAt = now
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if inMatch then
            if matchEnterAt == 0 then matchEnterAt = now end
            if autoLoadoutEnabled and (now - matchEnterAt) < 14 and (now - lastLoadoutAt) >= 1.15 then
                lastLoadoutAt = now
                applyLoadout()
            end
            if autoQueueEnabled then
                local over = workspace:GetAttribute("MatchmadeGameOver")
                if over and (now - lastPlayAgainAt) >= 2.0 then
                    lastPlayAgainAt = now
                    tryPlayAgain()
                end
            end
            return
        end

        matchEnterAt = 0
        if autoQueueEnabled and workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") then
            if (now - lastQueueAt) >= 2.4 then
                lastQueueAt = now
                tryQueue()
            end
        end
    end))
end


_G.jahvex_espSave = function()
    local function c(col)
        return {col.R, col.G, col.B}
    end
    return {
        enabled = espEnabled,
        corner = espCornerBoxes,
        full = espFullBoxes,
        fill = espBoxFill,
        names = espNames,
        hp = espHealthBar,
        hpNum = espHealthNum,
        skel = espSkeleton,
        dist = espDistance,
        team = espTeamCheck,
        hideDead = espHideDead,
        tracers = espTracers,
        chams = espChams,
        glow = espGlow,
        os = espOSIndicators,
        snap = espSnaplines,
        headDot = espHeadDot,
        maxDist = espMaxDist,
        textSize = espTextSize,
        glowDepth = espGlowDepth,
        tracerOrigin = espTracerOrigin,
        utilEsp = utilEspEnabled or getgenv().jahvex_utilEspEnabled,
        colors = {
            enemy = c(espColorEnemy),
            team = c(espColorTeam),
            box = c(espColorBox),
            fill = c(espColorFill),
            skel = c(espColorSkel),
            tracer = c(espColorTracer),
            hp = c(espColorHP),
            name = c(espColorName),
            chams = c(espColorChams),
            glow = c(espColorGlow),
            head = c(espColorHeadDot),
        },
    }
end
_G.jahvex_espLoad = function(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
    local function col(k, fallback)
        local v = t.colors and t.colors[k]
        if type(v) == "table" and v[1] then return Color3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]) end
        return fallback
    end
    if t.enabled ~= nil then espEnabled = t.enabled end
    if t.corner ~= nil then espCornerBoxes = t.corner end
    if t.full ~= nil then espFullBoxes = t.full end
    if t.fill ~= nil then espBoxFill = t.fill end
    if t.names ~= nil then espNames = t.names end
    if t.hp ~= nil then espHealthBar = t.hp end
    if t.hpNum ~= nil then espHealthNum = t.hpNum end
    if t.skel ~= nil then espSkeleton = t.skel end
    if t.dist ~= nil then espDistance = t.dist end
    if t.team ~= nil then espTeamCheck = t.team end
    if t.hideDead ~= nil then espHideDead = t.hideDead end
    if t.tracers ~= nil then espTracers = t.tracers end
    if t.chams ~= nil then espChams = t.chams end
    if t.glow ~= nil then espGlow = t.glow end
    if t.os ~= nil then espOSIndicators = t.os end
    if t.snap ~= nil then espSnaplines = t.snap end
    if t.headDot ~= nil then espHeadDot = t.headDot end
    if t.maxDist ~= nil then espMaxDist = tonumber(t.maxDist) or espMaxDist end
    if (tonumber(espMaxDist) or 0) < 2500 then espMaxDist = 12000 end
    if t.textSize ~= nil then espTextSize = t.textSize end
    if t.glowDepth ~= nil then espGlowDepth = t.glowDepth end
    if t.tracerOrigin ~= nil then espTracerOrigin = t.tracerOrigin end
    if t.utilEsp ~= nil then
        local on = t.utilEsp and true or false
        utilEspEnabled = on
        getgenv().jahvex_utilEspEnabled = on
        if type(getgenv().jahvex_setUtilEsp) == "function" then
            getgenv().jahvex_setUtilEsp(on)
        end
    end
    espColorEnemy = col("enemy", espColorEnemy)
    espColorTeam = col("team", espColorTeam)
    espColorBox = col("box", espColorBox)
    espColorFill = col("fill", espColorFill)
    espColorSkel = col("skel", espColorSkel)
    espColorTracer = col("tracer", espColorTracer)
    espColorHP = col("hp", espColorHP)
    espColorName = col("name", espColorName)
    espColorChams = col("chams", espColorChams)
    espColorGlow = col("glow", espColorGlow)
    espColorHeadDot = col("head", espColorHeadDot)
end

end

end

function skyDiscoverLocal()
    if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return end
    local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, "Yabujin/Cache/Skies")
    if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
        ok, files = pcall(listfiles, "Yabujin\\Cache\\Skies")
    end
    if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then return end

    local existing = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(SKYBOXES) do existing[e.name:lower()] = true end

    local found, names = {}, {}
    for _, path in ipairs(files) do
        local base = path:match("([^/\\]+)$") or path
        if not base:find("%.lnk$") then
            local name, face = base:match("^(.+)_(%a%a)%.tex$")
            local key = face and SKY_FACES[face:lower()]
            if name and key then
                if not found[name] then
                    found[name] = {}
                    table.insert(names, name)
                end
                found[name][key] = path:gsub("\\", "/")
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(names)

    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        if not existing[name:lower()] then
            local set = found[name]
            local complete = true
            for _, key in pairs(SKY_FACES) do
                if not set[key] then complete = false break end
            end
            if complete then
                table.insert(SKYBOXES, {name = name, files = set})
            end
        end
    end
end

task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.4)
    pcall(skyDiscoverLocal)
    pcall(function()
        if not (jahvexUiRefs and jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown and jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown.SetOptions) then return end
        local opts = {{label = "Default (Off)", value = "off"}, {label = "Custom", value = "Custom"}}
        for _, data in ipairs(SKYBOXES) do
            table.insert(opts, {label = data.name, value = data.name})
        end
        jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown:SetOptions(opts, true)
        if type(jahvex_restoreSavedSky) == "function" then
            jahvex_restoreSavedSky(true)
        end
    end)
end)

SKY_NAME = "Sky"
skyData = skyData
skyHideClouds = skyHideClouds ~= false
skyLC = nil

function skyCustomAsset(file)
    if type(file) ~= "string" or file == "" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local tries = { file, (file:gsub("/", "\\")), (file:gsub("\\", "/")) }
    for _, p in ipairs(tries) do
        local ok, id = pcall(getcustomasset, p)
        if ok and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then return id end
        ok, id = pcall(getcustomasset, p, true)
        if ok and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then return id end
    end
    return nil
end

function skyResolve(entry)
    if type(entry) ~= "table" then return false end
    if entry.files then
        local out = {}
        for key, file in pairs(entry.files) do
            local id = skyCustomAsset(file)
            if not id then return false end
            out[key] = id
        end
        for k, v in pairs(out) do
            entry[k] = v
        end
        return type(entry.Bk) == "string"
    end
    return type(entry.Bk) == "string" and entry.Bk ~= ""
end

function skyWriteFaces(sky, d)
    sky.SkyboxBk = d.Bk
    sky.SkyboxDn = d.Dn
    sky.SkyboxFt = d.Ft
    sky.SkyboxLf = d.Lf
    sky.SkyboxRt = d.Rt
    sky.SkyboxUp = d.Up
end

function skyApplyClouds()
    local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
    if not terrain then return end
    local clouds = terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
    if not clouds then return end
    local want = not (skyData ~= nil and skyHideClouds)
    if clouds.Enabled ~= want then
        clouds.Enabled = want
    end
end


function skyApplyReveal()
    if not skyData then return end
    local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atmo then
        if atmo.Density > 0.22 then atmo.Density = 0.12 end
        if atmo.Haze > 0.15 then atmo.Haze = 0 end
        if (atmo.Glare or 0) > 0.25 then atmo.Glare = 0.05 end
    end
    if Lighting.FogEnd < 800 then
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.FogStart = 0
    end
end

function skyPaintInstance(sky)
    if not (sky and skyData) then return end
    skyWriteFaces(sky, skyData)
    pcall(function()
        sky.CelestialBodiesShown = true
        sky.StarCount = 3000
    end)
end

function skyEnforce(force)
    if not skyData then return end

    local ours = nil
    for _, c in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Sky") then
            skyPaintInstance(c)
            if c.Name == SKY_NAME then
                ours = c
            end
        end
    end

    if not ours then
        ours = Instance.new("Sky")
        ours.Name = SKY_NAME
        skyPaintInstance(ours)
        ours.Parent = Lighting
    elseif force then
        pcall(function()
            ours.Parent = nil
            ours.Parent = Lighting
        end)
        skyPaintInstance(ours)
    end

    skyApplyClouds()
    skyApplyReveal()
end

function skyRestoreDefault()
    skyData = nil
    for _, c in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Sky") and c.Name == SKY_NAME then
            local bk = ""
            pcall(function() bk = tostring(c.SkyboxBk) end)
            if bk:find("rbxasset://", 1, true) then
                pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    skyApplyClouds()
    if skyLC then pcall(function() skyLC:_UpdateLighting() end) end
end


function skyVerify(d, label)
    task.spawn(function()
        local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
        local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
        local objs = {}
        for _, key in ipairs({"Bk", "Dn", "Ft", "Lf", "Rt", "Up"}) do
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            img.Image = d[key]
            img.Parent = holder
            table.insert(objs, img)
        end
        local failed = 0
        pcall(function()
            ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(objs, function(_, status)
                if status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                    failed = failed + 1
                end
            end)
        end)
        holder:Destroy()
        if failed > 0 and skyData == d and not tostring(d.Bk or ""):find("rbxasset://", 1, true) then
            setStatus("Skybox " .. label .. ": " .. failed .. "/6 textures failed to load", RED)
        end
    end)
end


Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if not skyData then return end
    if child:IsA("Sky") or child:IsA("Atmosphere") then
        task.defer(skyEnforce, true)
    end
end)

do
    local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
    if terrain then
        terrain.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if skyData and child:IsA("Clouds") then
                task.defer(skyApplyClouds)
            end
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    local ok, LC = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.LightingController)
    if ok and type(LC) == "table" then
        skyLC = LC
        local mt = getmetatable(LC)
        local class = (mt and type(mt.__index) == "table") and mt.__index or LC
        for _, name in ipairs({"SetLighting", "_LoadMapLightingAssets", "_LoadMapLightingModule", "_UpdateLighting"}) do
            local old = rawget(class, name)
            if type(old) ~= "function" then
                local okGet, fn = pcall(function()
                    return LC[name]
                end)
                if okGet then old = fn end
            end
            if type(old) == "function" and not rawget(class, "__jx_sky_" .. name) then
                rawset(class, "__jx_sky_" .. name, true)
                pcall(function()
                    class[name] = function(self, ...)
                        local r = old(self, ...)
                        if skyData then
                            task.defer(skyEnforce, true)
                        end
                        return r
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    while true do
        task.wait(2)
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then break end
        if skyData then skyEnforce(false) end
    end
end)

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if skyData then skyEnforce(false) end
end)

pcall(skyDiscoverLocal)

    table.insert(skyOptions, {label = data.name, value = data.name})

function jahvex_findSkyByName(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or name == "off" then return nil end
    if name == "Custom" then
        return jahvex_parseSkyCustom(tostring(selectedSkyCustomId or ""))
    end
    for _, data in ipairs(SKYBOXES or {}) do
        if data.name == name then return data end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_restoreSavedSky(updateUi)
    local skyName = selectedSkyName
    if type(skyName) ~= "string" or skyName == "" or skyName == "off" then
        if updateUi and jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown then
            pcall(function() jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown:SetDisplay("Default (Off)", nil) end)
        end
        return
    end
    local data = jahvex_findSkyByName(skyName)
    if not data then return end
    if skyName == "Custom" or skyResolve(data) then
        skyData = data
        selectedSkyName = skyName
        skyEnforce(true)
        if activeSkyLbl then
            activeSkyLbl.Text = "Active: " .. skyName
            activeSkyLbl.TextColor3 = GREEN
        end
        if updateUi then
            pcall(function()
                if jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown then
                    jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown:SetByValue(skyName, false)
                end
                if skyName == "Custom" and jahvexUiRefs.skyCustomBox then
                    jahvexUiRefs.skyCustomBox.Text = tostring(selectedSkyCustomId or data.Bk or "")
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

jahvexUiRefs.skyDropdown = makeDropdown(worldPanel, 12, 52, COL_W - 24, "Default (Off)", skyOptions, function(value, label)
    if value == "off" then
        skyRestoreDefault()
        selectedSkyName = "off"
        activeSkyLbl.Text = "Active: Default"
        activeSkyLbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        setStatus("Skybox: default", GREEN)
    elseif value == "Custom" then
        local parsed = jahvex_parseSkyCustom(tostring(selectedSkyCustomId or (jahvexUiRefs.skyCustomBox and jahvexUiRefs.skyCustomBox.Text) or ""))
        if not parsed then
            setStatus("Enter a custom sky ID first", RED)
            return
        end
        skyData = parsed
        selectedSkyName = "Custom"
        selectedSkyCustomId = tostring(parsed.Bk or selectedSkyCustomId or "")
        skyEnforce(true)
        activeSkyLbl.Text = "Active: Custom"
        activeSkyLbl.TextColor3 = GREEN
        setStatus("Skybox: Custom", GREEN)
    else
        local data = jahvex_findSkyByName(tostring(value or label))
        if not data or not skyResolve(data) then
            setStatus("Skybox " .. tostring(label) .. ": texture unreadable", RED)
        else
            skyData = data
            selectedSkyName = data.name or tostring(value or label)
            skyEnforce(true)
            skyVerify(data, label)
            activeSkyLbl.Text = "Active: " .. tostring(label)
            activeSkyLbl.TextColor3 = GREEN
            setStatus("Skybox: " .. tostring(label), GREEN)
        end
    end
    saveConfig()
end)

if selectedSkyCustomId then

end)

local KNOB_W = 12
local volSliderW = COL_W - 24

local function makeSoundVolumeSlider(parent, y, getVol, setVol, valLblName)
    makeLabel(parent, "Volume", 12, y, 60, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local valLbl = makeLabel(parent, "100", 12, y + 13, volSliderW, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size = UDim2.new(0, volSliderW, 0, 4)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 3
    track.Parent = parent
    makeCorner(track, 3)
    makeStroke(track, BORDER, 1)
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 4
    fill.Parent = track
    makeCorner(fill, 3)
    local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, KNOB_W, 0, KNOB_W)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, -KNOB_W / 2, 0.5, -KNOB_W / 2)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Text = ""
    knob.AutoButtonColor = false
    knob.ZIndex = 5
    knob.Parent = track
    makeCorner(knob, KNOB_W / 2)
    makeStroke(knob, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), 1)
    local dragging = false
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
    end)
    knob.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        if not dragging then return end
        if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
        local trackX = track.AbsolutePosition.X
        local trackW = track.AbsoluteSize.X
        local frac = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - trackX) / trackW, 0, 1)
        local v = math.max(1, math.floor(frac * 100))
        setVol(v)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KNOB_W / 2, 0.5, -KNOB_W / 2)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(v)
    end)
    return valLbl
end

qKnob.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        qDragging = false
        saveConfig()
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and qDragging then
        qDragging = false
        saveConfig()
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
    if not qDragging then return end
    if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
    local tx = qTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
    local tw = qTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
    local frac = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - tx) / tw, 0, 1)
    spoofCaseQuantity = math.max(1, math.floor(frac * 99))
    qFill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
    qKnob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -QKNOB_W/2, 0.5, -QKNOB_W/2)
    qtyValLbl.Text = tostring(spoofCaseQuantity)
end)

local addCasesBtn = makeBtn(casePanel, "Add Backpack", 12, 156, COL_W - 24, 26, "accent")

addCasesBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local dc = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.PlayerDataController)
    if not (dc and dc.CurrentData and dc.CurrentData.Data) then
        setStatus("DataController not ready!", RED)
        return
    end
    pcall(jahvex_hookDataReplicate)
    if type(dc.CurrentData.Data.UnclaimedRewards) ~= "table" then
        dc.CurrentData.Data.UnclaimedRewards = {}
    end
    local rewards = dc.CurrentData.Data.UnclaimedRewards
    if originalUnclaimedRewards == nil then
        originalUnclaimedRewards = {}
        for k, v in pairs(rewards) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                originalUnclaimedRewards[k] = {Name = v.Name, Quantity = v.Quantity}
            end
        end
    end


    local foundIndex = nil
    local highestIndex = 0

    for k, v in pairs(rewards) do
        local num = tonumber(k)
        if num and num > highestIndex then highestIndex = num end
        if type(v) == "table" and v.Name == selectedCaseType then
            foundIndex = k
        end
    end

    if foundIndex then
        rewards[foundIndex].Quantity = (tonumber(rewards[foundIndex].Quantity) or 0) + spoofCaseQuantity
    else
        rewards[highestIndex + 1] = {Name = selectedCaseType, Quantity = spoofCaseQuantity}
    end

    jahvex_localDataTouch("UnclaimedRewards")
    setStatus(spoofCaseQuantity.."x "..selectedCaseType.." Added!", GREEN)
end)


fpsSpoofEnabled  = fpsSpoofEnabled and true or false
pingSpoofEnabled = pingSpoofEnabled and true or false
fpsSpoofMode     = fpsSpoofMode or "Static"
pingSpoofMode    = pingSpoofMode or "Static"

fpsSpoofConn     = nil
fpsLabelConns    = {}


_currentSpoofFps  = tonumber(fpsSpoofValue) or 240
_currentSpoofPing = tonumber(pingSpoofValue) or 5
_lastFpsUpdate    = 0
_lastPingUpdate   = 0
FPS_RANDOM_INTERVAL  = 0.8
PING_RANDOM_INTERVAL = 1.2


local function getFpsPingLabels()
    local connLabels = {}
    local regLabels = {}
    local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return connLabels, regLabels end

    pcall(function()
        for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name == "Title" then
                if d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "ServerRegion" then
                    table.insert(regLabels, d)
                elseif d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Connection" then
                    table.insert(connLabels, d)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    if #connLabels == 0 then
        pcall(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                    local t = d.Text
                    if t:match("%d+fps") and t:match("%d+ms") then
                        table.insert(connLabels, d)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    return connLabels, regLabels
end

fpsPingLabels = nil
regionLabelsCache = nil

local _writing = false
local function writeToLabel(lbl, fps, ping)
    if _writing then return end
    _writing = true
    local originalFps = lbl.Text:match("(%d+)fps") or "?"
    local originalPing = lbl.Text:match("(%d+)ms") or "?"
    local newFps = (fpsSpoofEnabled and fps) and tostring(fps) or originalFps
    local newPing = (pingSpoofEnabled and ping) and tostring(ping) or originalPing
    pcall(function() lbl.Text = newFps .. "fps   " .. newPing .. "ms" end)
    _writing = false
end

local function writeToRegionLabel(lbl)
    if _writing then return end
    _writing = true
    if regionSpoofEnabled and regionSpoofValue and regionSpoofValue ~= "" then
        pcall(function() lbl.Text = regionSpoofValue end)
    end
    _writing = false
end


local function safeRand(a, b, fallback)
    a = tonumber(a)
    b = tonumber(b)
    if not a or not b then return fallback end
    a = math.floor(a)
    b = math.floor(b)
    if a > b then a, b = b, a end
    if a == b then return a end
    return math.random(a, b)
end

local function tickRandomValues(now)
    if fpsSpoofEnabled and fpsSpoofMode == "Random" then
        if (now - _lastFpsUpdate) >= FPS_RANDOM_INTERVAL then
            _currentSpoofFps = safeRand(fpsRandomMin, fpsRandomMax, fpsSpoofValue or 240)
            _lastFpsUpdate = now
        end
    end
    if pingSpoofEnabled and pingSpoofMode == "Random" then
        if (now - _lastPingUpdate) >= PING_RANDOM_INTERVAL then
            _currentSpoofPing = safeRand(pingRandomMin, pingRandomMax, pingSpoofValue or 10)
            _lastPingUpdate = now
        end
    end
end

local function getCurrentValues()
    local fps  = fpsSpoofEnabled  and (fpsSpoofMode  == "Static" and fpsSpoofValue  or _currentSpoofFps)  or nil
    local ping = pingSpoofEnabled and (pingSpoofMode == "Static" and pingSpoofValue or _currentSpoofPing) or nil
    return fps, ping
end


local function applyFpsPingSpoof()
    if not fpsPingLabels or #fpsPingLabels == 0 or not regionLabelsCache or #regionLabelsCache == 0 then
        fpsPingLabels, regionLabelsCache = getFpsPingLabels()
    end
    local fps, ping = getCurrentValues()
    if fps or ping then
        if fpsPingLabels then
            for _, lbl in ipairs(fpsPingLabels) do
                if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                    writeToLabel(lbl, fps, ping)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if regionLabelsCache then
        for _, lbl in ipairs(regionLabelsCache) do
            if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                writeToRegionLabel(lbl)
            end
        end
    end
end


local function hookLabelChanges()
    for _, c in ipairs(fpsLabelConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    fpsLabelConns = {}
    if not fpsPingLabels or #fpsPingLabels == 0 or not regionLabelsCache or #regionLabelsCache == 0 then fpsPingLabels, regionLabelsCache = getFpsPingLabels() end
    if fpsPingLabels then
        for _, lbl in ipairs(fpsPingLabels) do
            if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                local conn = lbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    if _writing then return end
                    if not fpsSpoofEnabled and not pingSpoofEnabled then return end
                    local fps, ping = getCurrentValues()
                    if fps or ping then writeToLabel(lbl, fps, ping) end
                end)
                table.insert(fpsLabelConns, conn)
            end
        end
    end
    if regionLabelsCache then
        for _, lbl in ipairs(regionLabelsCache) do
            if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                local conn = lbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    if _writing then return end
                    if not regionSpoofEnabled then return end
                    writeToRegionLabel(lbl)
                end)
                table.insert(fpsLabelConns, conn)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function startFpsPingLoop()

    if fpsSpoofConn then fpsSpoofConn:Disconnect() fpsSpoofConn = nil end
    for _, c in ipairs(fpsLabelConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    fpsLabelConns = {}

    if not fpsSpoofEnabled and not pingSpoofEnabled and not regionSpoofEnabled then return end


    fpsPingLabels, regionLabelsCache = getFpsPingLabels()
    hookLabelChanges()


    local _fpsLoopLast = 0
    local _fpsFrame = 0
    fpsSpoofConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        _fpsFrame = _fpsFrame + 1
        if _fpsFrame % 4 ~= 0 then return end
        local now = tick()
        pcall(tickRandomValues, now)
        if fpsSpoofMode == "Random" or pingSpoofMode == "Random" then
            if now - _fpsLoopLast < 0.15 then return end
            _fpsLoopLast = now
            pcall(applyFpsPingSpoof)
        end
    end)


    applyFpsPingSpoof()
end

            return string.format("%." .. tostring(rounding) .. "f", v) .. (suffix or "")
        end

            local mul = 10 ^ rounding
            return math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) * mul + 0.5) / mul
        end
        local function apply(val)
            val = math.clamp(snap(val), minV, maxV)

            pick(swatch, function()
                return st[key]
            end, function(c)
                st[key] = c
                swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
                saveConfig()
            end)
        end)
        cy = cy + CR
        return swatch
    end

    local togEnable = makeToggle(panel, "Enable Crosshair", 12, cy, rw, function(s)
        st.enabled = s and true or false
        setStatus("Crosshair " .. (s and "ON" or "OFF"), s and GREEN or RED)
        saveConfig()

    togAmmo:Set(true, false)

        st.followHeads = s and true or false
        saveConfig()

    local function destroyDraw()
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_11") end)
        if crossGui then
            pcall(function() crossGui:Destroy() end)
            crossGui = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            local pg = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if pg then
                local old = pg:FindFirstChild("CrosshairGui")
                if old then old:Destroy() end
                local leftover = pg:FindFirstChild("AxisCrossGui")
                if leftover then leftover:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function hideDraw(arms, ammoLbl, tracerF)
        if arms then
            for i = 1, 4 do
                if arms[i] then arms[i].Visible = false end
            end
        end
        if ammoLbl then ammoLbl.Visible = false end
        if tracerF then tracerF.Visible = false end
    end

    local function chHeadIsSky(p)
        if not p then return true end
        local pos = p.Position
        return math.abs(pos.X) > 50000 or math.abs(pos.Y) > 50000 or math.abs(pos.Z) > 50000
    end

    local function chHeadPart(char)
        if not char then return nil end
        local names = { "Head", "HitboxHead", "PhysicalHitboxHead", "HitboxHeadSmall", "HitboxHeadBig" }
        local fallback = nil
        for _, n in ipairs(names) do
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(n) or char:FindFirstChild(n, true)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
                if not chHeadIsSky(p) then return p end
                fallback = fallback or p
            end
        end
        return fallback
    end

    local function chFindEnemyHead(cam, center)
        local vs = cam.ViewportSize
        local bestScreen, bestWorld, bestDist = nil, nil, math.huge
        local saPart = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_part")
        if typeof(saPart) == "Instance" and saPart.Parent and saPart:IsA("BasePart") and not chHeadIsSky(saPart) then
            local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(saPart.Position)
            if sp.Z > 0 then
                return Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y), saPart.Position
            end
        end
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr == lp then continue end
            local char = plr.Character
            if not char then continue end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
            local head = chHeadPart(char)
            if not head then continue end
            local world = head.Position
            local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(world)
            if sp.Z <= 0 then continue end
            if sp.X < -120 or sp.Y < -120 or sp.X > vs.X + 120 or sp.Y > vs.Y + 120 then continue end
            local screen = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
            local d = (screen - center).Magnitude
            if d < bestDist then
                bestDist = d
                bestScreen = screen
                bestWorld = world
            end
        end
        return bestScreen, bestWorld
    end

    local function chMuzzleWorld(cam)
        local fc = FighterController
        local item
        pcall(function()
            item = fc and fc.LocalFighter and fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
            if not item and fc and type(fc.GetFighter) == "function" then
                local f = fc:GetFighter(lp)
                item = f and f.EquippedItem
            end
        end)

        local fpFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels") and workspace.ViewModels:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson")
        if fpFolder and lp then
            for _, vmModel in ipairs(fpFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if string.sub(vmModel.Name, 1, #lp.Name) == lp.Name then
                    local pMuzzle = vmModel:FindFirstChild("_muzzle", true)
                    if pMuzzle and pMuzzle:IsA("Attachment") then
                        return pMuzzle.WorldPosition
                    elseif pMuzzle and pMuzzle:IsA("BasePart") then
                        return pMuzzle.Position
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local vm = item and (item.ViewModel or item.ClientViewModel or item._view_model)
        if vm then
            local ok, pos = pcall(function()
                if type(vm.GetMuzzlePosition) == "function" then
                    return vm:GetMuzzlePosition()
                end
            end)
            if ok and typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then return pos end
            local okAtt, att = pcall(function()
                if type(vm.GetMuzzleAttachment) == "function" then
                    return vm:GetMuzzleAttachment()
                end
            end)
            if okAtt and att then
                if typeof(att) == "Instance" then
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then return att.WorldPosition end
                    if att:IsA("BasePart") then return att.Position end
                elseif typeof(att) == "Vector3" then
                    return att
                end
            end
        end
        if type(jahvex_tracerOrigin) == "function" then
            local ok, pos = pcall(jahvex_tracerOrigin)
            if ok and typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then return pos end
        end
        if cam then
            return (cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.35, -0.22, -1.35)).Position
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function chIsPrimaryOrSecondary()
        local item
        if type(jahvex_getEquippedItem) == "function" then
            item = jahvex_getEquippedItem()
        end
        if not item then
            pcall(function()
                local fc = FighterController
                item = fc and fc.LocalFighter and fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
            end)
        end
        if not item then return false end
        local slot, class, typ
        pcall(function()
            if type(item.Get) == "function" then
                slot = item:Get("Slot")
            end
            local info = item.Info
            if type(info) == "table" then
                class = info.Class
                typ = info.Type
            end
        end)
        slot = tostring(slot or "")
        class = tostring(class or "")
        typ = tostring(typ or "")
        if slot == "Melee" or slot == "Utility" or class == "Melee" or class == "Utility" or typ == "Melee" or typ == "Utility" then
            return false
        end
        if slot == "Primary" or slot == "Secondary" or class == "Primary" or class == "Secondary" then
            return true
        end
        if type(jahvex_weaponAllowsShootSound) == "function" then
            return jahvex_weaponAllowsShootSound(item) and true or false
        end
        return false
    end

    local function readClipAmmo()
        local txt = ""
        pcall(function()
            local fc = FighterController
            if not fc or type(fc.GetFighter) ~= "function" then return end
            local f = fc:GetFighter(lp)
            if not f then return end
            local item
            if type(f._equipped_client_items) == "table" then
                for it, on in pairs(f._equipped_client_items) do
                    if on and typeof(it) == "table" and typeof(it.Get) == "function" then
                        item = it
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not item and type(f.Items) == "table" and type(f.IsItemActive) == "function" then
                for _, it in pairs(f.Items) do
                    local ok, active = pcall(function()
                        return f:IsItemActive(it)
                    end)
                    if ok and active then
                        item = it
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not item or typeof(item.Get) ~= "function" then return end
            local ammo = item:Get("Ammo")
            if typeof(ammo) ~= "number" then return end
            local reserve = item:Get("AmmoReserve")
            if typeof(reserve) == "number" then
                txt = tostring(math.floor(ammo + 0.5)) .. " / " .. tostring(math.floor(reserve + 0.5))
            else
                txt = tostring(math.floor(ammo + 0.5))
            end
        end)
        return txt
    end

    destroyDraw()

    local pg = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    crossGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    crossGui.Name = "CrosshairGui"
    crossGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    crossGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    crossGui.DisplayOrder = 100001
    crossGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    holder.Parent = crossGui

    local arms, strokes = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.Visible = false
        f.ZIndex = 20
        f.Parent = holder
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Enabled = false
        stroke.Thickness = 1
        stroke.Parent = f
        arms[i] = f
        strokes[i] = stroke
    end
    local ammoLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    ammoLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    ammoLbl.TextSize = 14

    ammoLbl.ZIndex = 21
    ammoLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4

    ammoLbl.Parent = holder
    local tracerF = Instance.new("Frame")
    tracerF.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    tracerF.BorderSizePixel = 0

    tracerF.ZIndex = 19

    local tracerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    tracerStroke.Enabled = false
    tracerStroke.Thickness = 1
    tracerStroke.Parent = tracerF

    local function setArm(f, stroke, from, to, thick, col, outlineOn, outCol)
        local delta = to - from
        local len = delta.Magnitude
        if len < 0.5 then
            f.Visible = false
            return
        end
        local mid = (from + to) * 0.5
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, math.max(1, thick))
        f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mid.X, mid.Y)
        f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X))
        f.BackgroundColor3 = col
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        f.Visible = true
        stroke.Enabled = outlineOn and true or false
        stroke.Color = outCol
        stroke.Thickness = 1
    end

    RunService:BindToRenderStep("__rb_11", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function(dt)
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            if not st.enabled then
                hideDraw(arms, ammoLbl, tracerF)
                return
            end
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not camera then
                hideDraw(arms, ammoLbl, tracerF)
                return
            end
            dt = tonumber(dt) or 0
            local cols = {
                st.colRight or Color3.new(0, 1, 0.8),
                st.colUp or Color3.new(0, 1, 0.8),
                st.colLeft or Color3.new(0, 1, 0.8),
                st.colDown or Color3.new(0, 1, 0.8),
            }
            if st.rainbow then
                local rc = Color3.fromHSV((tick() % 3) / 3, 1, 1)
                cols = {rc, rc, rc, rc}
            end
            local outCol = st.outlineColor or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            local offset = st.offset or 4
            local length = st.length or 8
            local thickness = st.thickness or 2
            local lerp = st.lerp or 1
            local rotBase = math.rad(st.rotation or 0)
            local spinSpeed = st.rotationSpeed or 0
            local bounce = st.bounce or 0
            local bounceSpd = st.bounceSpeed or 5
            chAngle = chAngle + spinSpeed * dt * math.pi * 2
            local bounceOff = bounce > 0 and (math.abs(math.sin(tick() * bounceSpd)) * bounce) or 0
            local finalOffset = offset + bounceOff
            local target = camera.ViewportSize / 2
            local center = target
            local headScreen, headWorld = nil, nil
            local muzzleWorld = nil
            local gunSlot = chIsPrimaryOrSecondary()
            if gunSlot then
                if st.followHeads or st.tracers then
                    headScreen, headWorld = chFindEnemyHead(camera, center)
                end
                if st.followGuns or st.tracers then
                    muzzleWorld = chMuzzleWorld(camera)
                end
                if st.followHeads and headScreen then
                    target = headScreen
                elseif st.followGuns and muzzleWorld then
                    local sp = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(muzzleWorld)
                    if sp.Z > 0 then
                        target = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
                    end
                end
            end
            if not chInited then
                chPos = target
                chInited = true
            end
            pcall(function()
                chPos = chPos:Lerp(target, math.min(1, lerp))
            end)
            local origin = Vector2.new(chPos.X, chPos.Y)
            local totalAngle = rotBase + chAngle
            local dirs = {
                Vector2.new(math.cos(totalAngle), math.sin(totalAngle)),
                Vector2.new(-math.sin(totalAngle), math.cos(totalAngle)),
                Vector2.new(-math.cos(totalAngle), -math.sin(totalAngle)),
                Vector2.new(math.sin(totalAngle), -math.cos(totalAngle)),
            }
            for i, dir in ipairs(dirs) do
                local from = origin + dir * finalOffset
                local to = origin + dir * (finalOffset + length)
                setArm(arms[i], strokes[i], from, to, thickness, cols[i], st.outline, outCol)
            end
            if st.showAmmo then
                ammoAcc = ammoAcc + (tonumber(dt) or 0)
                if ammoAcc >= 0.08 then
                    ammoAcc = 0
                    ammoCache = readClipAmmo()
                end
                if ammoCache ~= "" then
                    ammoLbl.Visible = true
                    ammoLbl.Text = ammoCache
                    ammoLbl.TextColor3 = cols[1] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    ammoLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(origin.X - 40, origin.Y + finalOffset + length + 6)
                    ammoLbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 18)
                else
                    ammoLbl.Visible = false
                end
            else
                ammoLbl.Visible = false
            end
            if gunSlot and st.tracers and muzzleWorld and headWorld then
                local msp = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(muzzleWorld)
                local hsp = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(headWorld)
                if msp.Z > 0 and hsp.Z > 0 then
                    setArm(
                        tracerF,
                        tracerStroke,
                        Vector2.new(msp.X, msp.Y),
                        Vector2.new(hsp.X, hsp.Y),
                        math.max(1, thickness),
                        cols[1],
                        st.outline,
                        outCol
                    )
                else
                    tracerF.Visible = false
                end
            else
                tracerF.Visible = false
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            st._err = tostring(err)
        end
    end)

    setStatus("Custom Crosshair ready", TEXT_DIM)

    local function colPack(c)
        c = c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        return {c.R, c.G, c.B}
    end
    local function colUnpack(t, fb)
        if type(t) == "table" and t[1] then return Color3.new(t[1], t[2], t[3]) end
        return fb
    end

    local prevSave = rawget(_G, "jahvex_crossSave")
    _G.jahvex_crossSave = function()
        local t = {}
        if type(prevSave) == "function" then
            local ok, old = pcall(prevSave)
            if ok and type(old) == "table" then t = old end
        end
        t.axis = {
            enabled = st.enabled and true or false,
            outline = st.outline and true or false,
            rainbow = st.rainbow and true or false,
            showAmmo = st.showAmmo and true or false,
            followHeads = st.followHeads and true or false,
            followGuns = st.followGuns and true or false,
            tracers = st.tracers and true or false,
            rotation = st.rotation,
            rotationSpeed = st.rotationSpeed,
            bounce = st.bounce,
            bounceSpeed = st.bounceSpeed,
            offset = st.offset,
            length = st.length,
            thickness = st.thickness,
            lerp = st.lerp,
            colRight = colPack(st.colRight),
            colUp = colPack(st.colUp),
            colLeft = colPack(st.colLeft),
            colDown = colPack(st.colDown),
            outlineColor = colPack(st.outlineColor),
        }
        return t
    end

    local prevLoad = rawget(_G, "jahvex_crossLoad")
    _G.jahvex_crossLoad = function(t)
        if type(prevLoad) == "function" then pcall(prevLoad, t) end
        if type(t) ~= "table" or type(t.axis) ~= "table" then return end
        local a = t.axis
        st.enabled = a.enabled and true or false
        st.outline = a.outline and true or false
        st.rainbow = a.rainbow and true or false
        if a.showAmmo ~= nil then
            st.showAmmo = a.showAmmo and true or false
        else
            st.showAmmo = true
        end
        if a.followHeads ~= nil then st.followHeads = a.followHeads and true or false end
        if a.followGuns ~= nil then st.followGuns = a.followGuns and true or false end
        if a.tracers ~= nil then st.tracers = a.tracers and true or false end
        if a.rotation ~= nil then st.rotation = tonumber(a.rotation) or st.rotation end
        if a.rotationSpeed ~= nil then st.rotationSpeed = tonumber(a.rotationSpeed) or st.rotationSpeed end
        if a.bounce ~= nil then st.bounce = tonumber(a.bounce) or st.bounce end
        if a.bounceSpeed ~= nil then st.bounceSpeed = tonumber(a.bounceSpeed) or st.bounceSpeed end
        if a.offset ~= nil then st.offset = tonumber(a.offset) or st.offset end
        if a.length ~= nil then st.length = tonumber(a.length) or st.length end
        if a.thickness ~= nil then st.thickness = tonumber(a.thickness) or st.thickness end
        if a.lerp ~= nil then st.lerp = tonumber(a.lerp) or st.lerp end
        st.colRight = colUnpack(a.colRight, st.colRight)
        st.colUp = colUnpack(a.colUp, st.colUp)
        st.colLeft = colUnpack(a.colLeft, st.colLeft)
        st.colDown = colUnpack(a.colDown, st.colDown)
        st.outlineColor = colUnpack(a.outlineColor, st.outlineColor)
        togEnable:Set(st.enabled, false)
        togOutline:Set(st.outline, false)
        togRainbow:Set(st.rainbow, false)
        togAmmo:Set(st.showAmmo, false)
        togHeads:Set(st.followHeads, false)
        togGuns:Set(st.followGuns, false)
        togTracer:Set(st.tracers, false)
        setRot(st.rotation)
        setSpin(st.rotationSpeed)
        setBounce(st.bounce)
        setBounceSpd(st.bounceSpeed)
        setOffset(st.offset)
        setLength(st.length)
        setThick(st.thickness)
        setLerp(st.lerp)
        swR.BackgroundColor3 = st.colRight
        swU.BackgroundColor3 = st.colUp
        swL.BackgroundColor3 = st.colLeft
        swD.BackgroundColor3 = st.colDown
        swO.BackgroundColor3 = st.outlineColor
    end

    local prevDestroy = rawget(_G, "jahvex_crossDestroy")
    _G.jahvex_crossDestroy = function()
        if type(prevDestroy) == "function" then pcall(prevDestroy) end
        st.enabled = false
        destroyDraw()
    end
end)()

            local _c6 = "BO" .. "NUS"
            local _c7 = "BO" .. "OST"
            local _c8 = "roblox" .. "_rtc"
            local _codes = {_c1, _c2, _c3, _c4, _c5, _c6, _c7, _c8}
            local _rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

            local _lastClaim = {}
            local _claimCooldown = 60
            while true do

                task.wait(45 + math.random() * 30)
                if getgenv()._jxrw then
                    pcall(function()
                        local _d = _rs.Remotes.Data
                        local _claims = {
                            "Claim" .. "WelcomeBackGift",
                            "Claim" .. "GroupReward",
                            "Claim" .. "LikeReward",
                            "Claim" .. "NotificationsReward",
                            "Claim" .. "FavoriteReward",
                            "Claim" .. "BattlePassReward"
                        }
                        local _now = tick()
                        for _, _cn in ipairs(_claims) do

                            if not _lastClaim[_cn] or (_now - _lastClaim[_cn]) > _claimCooldown then
                                local _ev = _d:FindFirstChild(_cn)
                                if _ev then
                                    _lastClaim[_cn] = _now

                                    task.wait(1 + math.random() * 3)
                                    if _ev:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                                        pcall(function() _ev:FireServer() end)
                                    elseif _ev:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                        task.spawn(function() pcall(function() _ev:InvokeServer() end) end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        local _rc = _d:FindFirstChild("Redeem" .. "Code")
                        if _rc and _rc:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                            for _, _code in ipairs(_codes) do
                                if not getgenv()._jxrw then break end
                                task.wait(3 + math.random() * 5)
                                task.spawn(function()
                                    pcall(function() _rc:InvokeServer(_code) end)
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)()

hitFxFolder = nil
hitFxColor = (typeof(hitFxColor) == "Color3") and hitFxColor or Color3.fromRGB(159, 133, 195)

HIT_FX_PRESETS = {
    {label = "Particles", value = "Particles"},
    {label = "Fortnite", value = "Fortnite"},
