function jahvex_normalizeAssetId(id)
    return jahvex_parseAssetId(id)
end

function jahvex_getHitFxFolder()
    if hitFxFolder and hitFxFolder.Parent then return hitFxFolder end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local parent = cam or workspace
    local f = parent:FindFirstChild("HitFxFolder")
    if not f then
        f = Instance.new("Folder")
        f.Name = "HitFxFolder"
        f.Parent = parent
    end
    hitFxFolder = f
    return f
end

function jahvex_getHitFxPreset(id)
    local key = id or hitFxImage
    for _, p in ipairs(HIT_FX_PRESETS) do
        if p.value == key or p.label == key then
            return p
        end
    end
    return HIT_FX_PRESETS[1]
end

function jahvex_hitFxBlend(base, amount)
    amount = amount or 0.35
    return Color3.new(
        math.clamp(base.R + amount, 0, 1),
        math.clamp(base.G + amount * 0.5, 0, 1),
        math.clamp(base.B + amount * 0.25, 0, 1)
    )
end

function jahvex_hitFxDarken(base, amount)
    amount = amount or 0.45
    return Color3.new(
        math.clamp(base.R - amount, 0, 1),
        math.clamp(base.G - amount, 0, 1),
        math.clamp(base.B - amount * 0.5, 0, 1)
    )
end

function jahvex_hitFxCountPEs()
    local n = 0
    local folder = hitFxFolder
    if not folder then return 0 end
    for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            n = n + 1
        end
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_hitFxRing(part, color, cfg)
    cfg = cfg or {}
    local ring = Instance.new("Part")
    ring.Name = cfg.Name or "HitRing"
    ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Anchored = true
    ring.CanCollide = false
    ring.CanQuery = false
    ring.CanTouch = false
    ring.CastShadow = false
    ring.Material = cfg.Material or Enum.Material.Neon
    ring.Color = color
    ring.Transparency = cfg.StartTransparency or 0.35
    local startSize = cfg.StartSize or 0.35
    ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, startSize, startSize)
    ring.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    ring.Parent = jahvex_getHitFxFolder()
    local endSize = cfg.EndSize or 5
    local duration = cfg.Duration or 0.55
    TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.new(0.05, endSize, endSize),
        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(ring, duration + 0.12)
end

function jahvex_hitFxFlash(part, color, brightness, range, duration)
    duration = duration or 0.35
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Name = "HitFlash"
    light.Color = color
    light.Brightness = brightness or 6
    light.Range = range or 14
    light.Parent = part
    TweenService:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Brightness = 0,
        Range = 0,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(light, duration + 0.08)
end

function jahvex_hitFxEmit(part, cfg)
    if jahvex_hitFxCountPEs() >= 80 then return end
    local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    pe.Name = cfg.Name or "HitEffect"
    pe.Texture = cfg.Texture or "rbxassetid://6603835352"
    if typeof(cfg.Color) == "ColorSequence" then
        pe.Color = cfg.Color
    else
        pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(cfg.Color or hitFxColor)
    end
    pe.LightEmission = cfg.LightEmission or 1
    pcall(function()
        pe.Brightness = cfg.Brightness or 8
    end)
    pe.LightInfluence = cfg.LightInfluence or 0
    pe.Orientation = cfg.Orientation or Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
    pe.LockedToPart = cfg.LockedToPart or false
    pe.Size = cfg.Size or NumberSequence.new(0.12)
    pe.Transparency = cfg.Transparency or NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    pe.Speed = cfg.Speed or NumberRange.new(12, 18)
    pe.SpreadAngle = cfg.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(120, 120)
    pe.EmissionDirection = cfg.EmissionDirection or Enum.NormalId.Top
    pe.Lifetime = cfg.Lifetime or NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
    pe.Drag = cfg.Drag or 2
    pe.Acceleration = cfg.Acceleration or Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    pe.RotSpeed = cfg.RotSpeed or NumberRange.new(0, 0)
    pe.Rate = 0
    pe.Enabled = true
    pe.Parent = part
    pe:Emit(math.min(tonumber(cfg.EmitCount) or 20, 28))
    Debris:AddItem(pe, cfg.Cleanup or 2.2)
end

                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, color),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, jahvex_hitFxDarken(color, 0.2)),
            }),
            EmitCount = 40,
            Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 14),
            SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
            Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4),
            Drag = 0.5,
            Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
            RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-80, 80),
            Brightness = 9,
            Size = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.18),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.04),
            }),
            Cleanup = 1.8,
        })
        jahvex_hitFxRing(part, jahvex_hitFxBlend(color, 0.1), {Name = "CosmicRing", StartSize = 0.2, EndSize = 3.5, Duration = 0.8, StartTransparency = 0.65, Material = Enum.Material.Glass})
    else
        local customTex = jahvex_parseAssetId(style)
        if customTex then
            jahvex_hitFxEmit(part, {
                Texture = customTex,
                Color = color,
                Brightness = 12,
                EmitCount = 42,
                Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 22),
                SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(160, 160),
                Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.9),
                Drag = 2,
                Size = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.12),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.22),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.04),
                }),
                Cleanup = 1.5,
            })
        else
            jahvex_hitFxStyle("Particles", part, color, dmgText)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_spawnHitFx(worldPos, dmgText, adornee)
    local style = hitFxImage or "Particles"
    if style == "Cosmic Shit" then style = "Cosmic" end
    local targetPart = nil
    if adornee then
        if adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
            targetPart = adornee
        elseif adornee:IsA("Attachment") then
            targetPart = adornee.Parent
        elseif adornee:IsA("Model") then
            targetPart = adornee.PrimaryPart
                or adornee:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or adornee:FindFirstChild("Head")
                or adornee:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end
    end
    if targetPart and targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        pcall(jahvex_hitFxStyle, style, targetPart, hitFxColor, dmgText)
        return
    end
    if typeof(worldPos) ~= "Vector3" then return end
    local holder = Instance.new("Part")
    holder.Name = "HitFxPart"
    holder.Anchored = true
    holder.CanCollide = false
    holder.CanQuery = false
    holder.CanTouch = false
    holder.CastShadow = false
    holder.Transparency = 1
    holder.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(worldPos)
    holder.Parent = jahvex_getHitFxFolder()
    pcall(jahvex_hitFxStyle, style, holder, hitFxColor, dmgText)
    Debris:AddItem(holder, 2.2)
end

function jahvex_hideDamageGuiNumbers(gui)
    pcall(function()
        gui.Enabled = false
        for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
                d.Text = ""
                d.Visible = false
                d.TextTransparency = 1
            elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
                d.Transparency = 1
            elseif d.Name == "Absorbed" and d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                d.Visible = false
                d.ImageTransparency = 1
            end
        end
        local mf = gui:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
        if mf and mf:IsA("GuiObject") then
            mf.Visible = false
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_damageGuiWorldPos(gui)
    local adornee = gui.Adornee
    if adornee then
        if adornee:IsA("BasePart") then return adornee.Position end
        if adornee:IsA("Model") then
            local p = adornee:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or adornee.PrimaryPart
                or adornee:FindFirstChild("Head") or adornee:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if p then return p.Position end
        end
        if adornee:IsA("Attachment") then return adornee.WorldPosition end
    end
    local par = gui.Parent
    if par and par:IsA("BasePart") then return par.Position end
    if par and par:IsA("Model") then
        local p = par:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or par.PrimaryPart
            or par:FindFirstChild("Head") or par:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if p then return p.Position end
    end
    return nil
end


_jahvexDmgBbCache = _jahvexDmgBbCache or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function jahvex_getDamageBillboardInfo(obj)
    if not obj or not obj:IsA("BillboardGui") then return nil end
    local cached = _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj]
    if cached ~= nil then
        return cached ~= false and cached or nil
    end
    if obj.Name == "FortniteDamageNumber" then
        _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj] = false
        return nil
    end
    local lbl = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
    if not lbl then
        _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj] = false
        return nil
    end
    local dmg = tonumber(lbl.Text)
    if not (dmg and dmg > 0) then
        _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj] = false
        return nil
    end
    local adornee = obj.Adornee
    if not adornee and obj.Parent and obj.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
        adornee = obj.Parent
    end
    if not adornee then
        _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj] = false
        return nil
    end
    local info = { lbl = lbl, dmg = dmg, adornee = adornee }
    _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj] = info
    return info
end

function jahvex_handleDamageGui(gui)
    if not gui or not gui.Parent then return end
    if notifyHitEnabled and type(jahvex_notifyHitPush) == "function" then
        pcall(jahvex_notifyHitPush, gui)
    end
    if not hitFxEnabled then return end
    local info = jahvex_getDamageBillboardInfo(gui)
    local adornee = info and info.adornee
    local dmgText = info and info.lbl and info.lbl.Text or nil
    if not adornee then
        local pos = nil
        for _ = 1, 2 do
            pos = jahvex_damageGuiWorldPos(gui)
            if pos then break end
            task.wait()
        end
        if not dmgText then
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                    if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and type(d.Text) == "string" and d.Text ~= "" then
                        dmgText = d.Text
                        break
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        jahvex_hideDamageGuiNumbers(gui)
        if pos then
            jahvex_spawnHitFx(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), dmgText, nil)
        end
        return
    end
    jahvex_hideDamageGuiNumbers(gui)
    jahvex_spawnHitFx(nil, dmgText, adornee)
end

function jahvex_isDamageGui(inst)
    return inst and inst:IsA("BillboardGui") and (inst.Name == "DamageGui" or jahvex_getDamageBillboardInfo(inst) ~= nil)
end

_jahvexHitFxWatch = {}
_jahvexHitFxLastKey = ""
_jahvexHitFxLastAt = 0

function jahvex_hitFxUnwatch()
    for _, c in ipairs(_jahvexHitFxWatch) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    _jahvexHitFxWatch = {}
end

function jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(c)
    if not c then return end
    table.insert(_jahvexHitFxWatch, c)
    jahvex_track(c)
end

function jahvex_hitFxOnBillboard(obj)
    if not hitFxEnabled or not obj or not obj:IsA("BillboardGui") then return end
    if obj.Name == "FortniteDamageNumber" then return end
    task.defer(function()
        if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end
        local info = jahvex_getDamageBillboardInfo(obj)
        if not info then
            task.wait()
            _jahvexDmgBbCache[obj] = nil
            info = jahvex_getDamageBillboardInfo(obj)
        end
        if not info then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local key = tostring(info.dmg) .. "|" .. tostring(info.adornee)
        if key == _jahvexHitFxLastKey and (now - _jahvexHitFxLastAt) < 0.05 then
            return
        end
        _jahvexHitFxLastKey = key
        _jahvexHitFxLastAt = now
        jahvex_handleDamageGui(obj)
    end)
end

function jahvex_hitFxBindGui(gui)
    if not gui or not gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then return end
    jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Adornee"):Connect(function()
        if hitFxEnabled and gui.Adornee then
            _jahvexDmgBbCache[gui] = nil
            jahvex_hitFxOnBillboard(gui)
        end
    end))
    jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if hitFxEnabled and gui.Enabled then
            _jahvexDmgBbCache[gui] = nil
            jahvex_hitFxOnBillboard(gui)
        end
    end))
    local val = gui:FindFirstChild("Value", true) or gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
    if val and (val:IsA("TextLabel") or val:IsA("TextButton")) then
        jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(val:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            if hitFxEnabled and tonumber(val.Text) then
                _jahvexDmgBbCache[gui] = nil
                jahvex_hitFxOnBillboard(gui)
            end
        end))
    end
end

function jahvex_hitFxSetWatch(on)
    jahvex_hitFxUnwatch()
    if not on then return end

    jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if not hitFxEnabled then return end
        if obj:IsA("BillboardGui") then
            jahvex_hitFxOnBillboard(obj)
        end
    end))
    pcall(function()
        local ps = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local ui = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("UserInterface")
        if ui then
            local dg = ui:FindFirstChild("DamageGui")
            if dg then jahvex_hitFxBindGui(dg) end
            jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(ui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                if ch.Name == "DamageGui" or ch:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                    task.defer(jahvex_hitFxBindGui, ch)
                end
            end))
        end
    end)
    local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg then
        jahvex_hitFxTrackConn(pg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if hitFxEnabled and obj:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                jahvex_hitFxOnBillboard(obj)
            end
        end))
    end
end
jahvex_track(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
    hitFxFolder = nil
    if hitFxEnabled then
        jahvex_hitFxSetWatch(true)
    end
end))
if hitFxEnabled then
    task.defer(function() jahvex_hitFxSetWatch(true) end)
end

function jahvex_getTracerFolder()
    if tracerFolder and tracerFolder.Parent then return tracerFolder end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local parent = cam or workspace
    local f = parent:FindFirstChild("TracersFolder")
    if not f then
        f = Instance.new("Folder")
        f.Name = "TracersFolder"
        f.Parent = parent
    end
    tracerFolder = f
    return f
end

function jahvex_tracerOrigin()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return nil end
    local best = nil
    for _, d in ipairs(cam:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Attachment") then
            local n = d.Name:lower()
            if n == "muzzle" or n == "muzzleflash" or n == "barrel" or n == "gunfire" then
                best = d.WorldPosition
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if best then return best end
    return (cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.35, -0.22, -1.35)).Position
end

function jahvex_tracerEnd(origin)
    local saPart = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_part")
    if typeof(saPart) == "Instance" and saPart.Parent then
        return saPart.Position
    end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return origin + Vector3.new(0, 0, -50) end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local filter = { cam, jahvex_getTracerFolder() }
    if lp.Character then table.insert(filter, lp.Character) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    local dir = cam.CFrame.LookVector * 600
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, dir, params)
    if hit then return hit.Position end
    return cam.CFrame.Position + dir
end

function jahvex_tracerMakeHolder(origin)
    local holder = Instance.new("Part")
    holder.Name = "TracerPart"
    holder.Anchored = true
    holder.CanCollide = false
    holder.CanQuery = false
    holder.CanTouch = false
    holder.CastShadow = false
    holder.Transparency = 1
    holder.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
    holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
    holder.Parent = jahvex_getTracerFolder()
    return holder
end

function jahvex_tracerWidthScale()
    local s = math.clamp(tonumber(rawget(_G, "jahvex_tracerSize") or tracerSize) or 3, 1, 10)
    if s <= 3 then
        return 0.35 + (s - 1) * 0.325
    end
    return 1 + (s - 3) * (5.5 / 7)
end

function jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, p0, p1, props)
    local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    a0.Position = p0
    a0.Parent = holder
    local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    a1.Position = p1
    a1.Parent = holder
    local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
    beam.Attachment0 = a0
    beam.Attachment1 = a1
    beam.LightEmission = props.LightEmission or 1
    beam.LightInfluence = 0
    beam.FaceCamera = true
    beam.Segments = props.Segments or 1
    local sizeMul = jahvex_tracerWidthScale()
    beam.Width0 = (props.Width0 or 0.12) * sizeMul
    beam.Width1 = (props.Width1 or 0.04) * sizeMul
    beam.Color = props.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
    beam.Transparency = props.Transparency or NumberSequence.new(0.05)
    if props.Texture then
        beam.Texture = props.Texture
        beam.TextureLength = props.TextureLength or 1
        beam.TextureSpeed = props.TextureSpeed or 3
        beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
    end
    beam.Parent = holder
    return beam
end

function jahvex_tracerScaleEmitter(pe)
    if not pe then return end
    local sm = jahvex_tracerWidthScale()
    pcall(function()
        local keys = {}
        for i, kp in ipairs(pe.Size.Keypoints) do
            keys[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, math.max(0.01, kp.Value * sm), kp.Envelope)
        end
        if #keys > 0 then
            pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(keys)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, fadeTime, life)
    local hold = math.clamp(tonumber(tracerLifetime) or 3, 1, 30)
    fadeTime = math.clamp(tonumber(fadeTime) or 0.35, 0.12, 0.6)
    fadeTime = math.min(fadeTime, hold * 0.35)
    pcall(function()
        for _, d in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                d.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(
                    math.clamp(d.Lifetime.Min * (hold / 0.45), 0.15, hold),
                    math.clamp(d.Lifetime.Max * (hold / 0.45), 0.25, hold)
                )
            end
        end
    end)
    local waitHold = math.max(0.05, hold - fadeTime)
    task.delay(waitHold, function()
        pcall(function()
            if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
            for _, b in ipairs(beams) do
                if b and b.Parent then
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0,
                    }):Play()
                end
            end
            if light and light.Parent then
                TweenService:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime * 0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Brightness = 0,
                }):Play()
            end
        end)
    end)
    Debris:AddItem(holder, hold + 0.08)
end

function jahvex_spawnTracer(forcedOrigin, forcedEnd)
    if not tracerEnabled then return end
    local now = tick()
    if now - tracerLastAt < 0.065 then return end
    tracerLastAt = now

    local origin = forcedOrigin or jahvex_tracerOrigin()
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then return end
    local endpoint = forcedEnd or jahvex_tracerEnd(origin)
    if typeof(endpoint) ~= "Vector3" then return end
    local delta = endpoint - origin
    if delta.Magnitude < 1.5 then return end

    local live = rawget(_G, "_jxTracerLive")
    if type(live) ~= "table" then
        live = {}
        _G._jxTracerLive = live
    end
    for i = #live, 1, -1 do
        if not live[i] or not live[i].Parent then
            table.remove(live, i)
        end
    end
    while #live >= 8 do
        local old = table.remove(live, 1)
        pcall(function()
            if old then old:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    local style = tracerStyle or "Lightning"
    local holder = jahvex_tracerMakeHolder(origin)
    table.insert(live, holder)
    local beams = {}
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Brightness = 1.4
    light.Range = 10
    light.Parent = holder
    local col = (typeof(tracerColor) == "Color3") and tracerColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

    local tex
    if style == "Custom" then
        tex = jahvex_parseAssetId(tracerCustomId) or ""
    else
        tex = TRACER_TEX[style]
    end
    if tex ~= nil then
        light.Color = col
        light.Range = 8 + 6 * jahvex_tracerWidthScale()
        local w = (style == "Laser" and 0.14) or (style == "Line" and 0.2) or 0.22
        local props = {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(col),
            Width0 = w,
            Width1 = w,
            Segments = 1,
            LightEmission = 0.8,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0),
        }
        if tex ~= "" then
            props.Texture = tex
            props.TextureLength = 4
            props.TextureSpeed = 1
        end
        table.insert(beams, jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, props))
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.5, 1.8)
        return
    end

    if style == "Rainbow" then
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 255)
        local rainbow = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 40)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.40, Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.60, Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.80, Color3.fromRGB(160, 80, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200)),
        })
        local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = rainbow, Width0 = 0.35, Width1 = 0.12, Segments = 10,
            Texture = "rbxassetid://446111271", TextureLength = 0.6, TextureSpeed = 8,
        })
        table.insert(beams, b)
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.28, 0.45)

    elseif style == "Spark Trail" then
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
        local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100)),
            Width0 = 0.06, Width1 = 0.02, Segments = 1,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.25),
        })
        table.insert(beams, b)
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = holder
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        pe.Texture = "rbxassetid://5833323391"
        pe.LightEmission = 1
        pe.Rate = 0
        pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.35)
        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6)
        pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
        pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
        pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.25),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
        })
        pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1, 1)
        pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40))
        pe.Parent = att
        jahvex_tracerScaleEmitter(pe)

        local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(delta.Magnitude / 12), 3, 8)
        for i = 0, steps do
            att.Position = delta * (i / steps)
            pe:Emit(4)
        end
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.2, 0.4)

    elseif style == "Plasma" then
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 255)
        light.Brightness = 2.2
        light.Range = 14
        local core = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(220, 120, 255)),
            Width0 = 0.22, Width1 = 0.1, Segments = 6,
        })
        local aura = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 60, 255)),
            Width0 = 0.55, Width1 = 0.28, Segments = 6,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.45),
        })
        table.insert(beams, core)
        table.insert(beams, aura)
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.35, 0.55)

    elseif style == "Dash" then

        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        local segs = math.clamp(math.floor(delta.Magnitude / 6), 5, 14)
        for i = 0, segs - 1 do
            if i % 2 == 0 then
                local t0 = i / segs
                local t1 = math.min(1, (i + 0.55) / segs)
                local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, delta * t0, delta * t1, {
                    Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80)),
                    Width0 = 0.2, Width1 = 0.12, Segments = 1,
                })
                table.insert(beams, b)
            end
        end
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.16, 0.3)

    elseif style == "Star Rain" then
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 150)
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = holder
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        pe.Texture = "rbxassetid://5833323391"
        pe.LightEmission = 1
        pe.Rate = 0
        pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.5)
        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2)
        pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 40)
        pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
        pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-90, 90)
        pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.55),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
        })
        pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 1)
        pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80))
        pe.Parent = att
        jahvex_tracerScaleEmitter(pe)
        local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(delta.Magnitude / 7), 5, 12)
        for i = 0, steps do
            att.Position = delta * (i / steps) + Vector3.new(
                (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
                (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
                (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8
            )
            pe:Emit(2)
        end

        local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 180)),
            Width0 = 0.04, Width1 = 0.01, Segments = 1,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.4),
        })
        table.insert(beams, b)
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.25, 0.5)

    elseif style == "Hearts" then

        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 140)
        light.Brightness = 1.8
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = holder
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        pe.Texture = HEART_TEX
        pe.LightEmission = 0.7
        pe.Rate = 0
        pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.28, 0.55)
        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1.8)
        pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(18, 18)
        pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-20, 20)
        pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
        pe.Drag = 1
        pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.7),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
        })
        pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.25),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 170), Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 110))
        pe.Parent = att
        jahvex_tracerScaleEmitter(pe)
        local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(delta.Magnitude / 5.5), 6, 16)
        for i = 0, steps do
            att.Position = delta * (i / steps) + Vector3.new(
                (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
                (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
                (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35
            )
            pe:Emit(1)
        end
        local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 180)),
            Width0 = 0.05, Width1 = 0.015, Segments = 1,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.45),
        })
        table.insert(beams, b)
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.28, 0.55)

    elseif style == "Smoke" then
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
        light.Brightness = 0.4
        local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)),
            Width0 = 0.4, Width1 = 0.7, Segments = 4,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0.75),
            Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",
            TextureLength = 1.5, TextureSpeed = 1.5,
            LightEmission = 0.15,
        })
        table.insert(beams, b)
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = holder
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
        pe.LightEmission = 0
        pe.Rate = 0
        pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.5)
        pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30)
        pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.2),
        })
        pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1)
        pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220))
        pe.Parent = att
        jahvex_tracerScaleEmitter(pe)
        local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(delta.Magnitude / 10), 3, 7)
        for i = 0, steps do
            att.Position = delta * (i / steps)
            pe:Emit(3)
        end
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.4, 0.65)

    else
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
        local b = jahvex_tracerBeam(holder, Vector3.zero, delta, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(160, 240, 255), Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)),
            Width0 = 0.12, Width1 = 0.035, Segments = 1,
            Texture = "rbxassetid://446111271", TextureLength = 1.2, TextureSpeed = 5,
        })
        table.insert(beams, b)
        jahvex_tracerFadeBeams(holder, beams, light, 0.18, 0.3)
    end
end

    tracerEnabled = state
    _G.jahvex_tracer_enabled = state
    setStatus("Bullet Tracer " .. (state and "ON" or "OFF"), state and GREEN or RED)
    saveConfig()
end)

    table.insert(tracerOptions, {label = s.label, value = s.label})
end

    tracerStyle = value
    setStatus("Tracer: " .. label, GREEN)
    saveConfig()
end)
jahvexUiRefs.tracerCustomBox = makeIdBox(tracerPanel, 112, COL_W - 24, "Custom tracer texture ID...")
jahvexUiRefs.tracerCustomBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local id = jahvex_parseAssetId(jahvexUiRefs.tracerCustomBox.Text)
    if not id then
        setStatus("Invalid custom tracer ID", RED)
        return
    end
    tracerCustomId = id
    tracerStyle = "Custom"
    pcall(function()
        jahvexUiRefs.tracerDropdown:SetDisplay("Custom", nil)
    end)
    setStatus("Tracer: Custom", GREEN)
    saveConfig()
end)

do
    local sliderW = COL_W - 24
    local knobW = 12
    local function makeTracerSlider(label, y, minV, maxV, suffix, getV, setV)
        makeLabel(tracerPanel, label, 12, y, 90, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
        local valLbl = makeLabel(tracerPanel, tostring(getV()) .. suffix, 12, y + 13, sliderW, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
        local track = Instance.new("Frame")
        track.Size = UDim2.new(0, sliderW, 0, 4)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
        track.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        track.ZIndex = 3
        track.Parent = tracerPanel
        makeCorner(track, 3)
        makeStroke(track, BORDER, 1)
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.ZIndex = 4
        fill.Parent = track
        makeCorner(fill, 3)
        local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, knobW, 0, knobW)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.Text = ""
        knob.AutoButtonColor = false
        knob.ZIndex = 5
        knob.Parent = track
        makeCorner(knob, knobW / 2)
        makeStroke(knob, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), 1)
        track.Active = true
        knob.Active = true

        local function applyFrac(frac)
            frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
            local v = math.floor(minV + (maxV - minV) * frac + 0.5)
            setV(v)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -knobW / 2, 0.5, -knobW / 2)
            valLbl.Text = tostring(v) .. suffix
        end
        applyFrac((getV() - minV) / (maxV - minV))

        local dragging = false
        local function setFromX()
            local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local trackX = track.AbsolutePosition.X
            local trackW = track.AbsoluteSize.X
            if trackW <= 0 then return end
            applyFrac((mouse.X - trackX) / trackW)
        end
        knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
        end)
        track.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = true
                setFromX()
            end
        end)
        local function endDrag()
            if dragging then
                dragging = false
                saveConfig()
            end
        end
        knob.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then endDrag() end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then endDrag() end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if not dragging then return end
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            setFromX()
        end)

        return {
            Set = function(_, v)
                local num = tonumber(v) or getV()
                local frac = (math.clamp(num, minV, maxV) - minV) / (maxV - minV)
                applyFrac(frac)
            end,
        }
    end

    jahvexUiRefs.tracerSizeSlider = makeTracerSlider("Size", 144, 1, 10, "", function()
        return math.clamp(tonumber(tracerSize) or 3, 1, 10)
    end, function(v)
        tracerSize = v
        _G.jahvex_tracerSize = v
    end)
    jahvexUiRefs.tracerLifeSlider = makeTracerSlider("Lifetime", 182, 1, 30, "s", function()
        return math.clamp(tonumber(tracerLifetime) or 3, 1, 30)
    end, function(v)
        tracerLifetime = v
    end)
end

WEATHER_TYPES = {
    {label = "Rain"},
    {label = "Snow"},
    {label = "Storm"},
    {label = "Hearts"},
    {label = "Stars"},
}

WEATHER_TYPE_REMAP = {
    Lightning = "Storm",
    Hail = "Rain",
    ["Heart Rain"] = "",
}

function jahvex_normWeatherType(t)
    t = WEATHER_TYPE_REMAP[t] or t
    if t ~= "Rain" and t ~= "Snow" and t ~= "Storm" and t ~= "Hearts" and t ~= "Stars" then
        return "Rain"
    end
    return t
end

function jahvex_scaleWeatherEmitter(pe)
    if not pe or not pe.Parent then return end
    local d = math.clamp(tonumber(weatherDensity) or 100, 10, 250) / 100
    local s = math.clamp(tonumber(weatherSpeed) or 100, 10, 250) / 100
    local br = pe:GetAttribute("baseRate") or pe.Rate
    pe.Rate = br * d
    local smin = pe:GetAttribute("baseSpeedMin")
    local smax = pe:GetAttribute("baseSpeedMax")
    if typeof(smin) == "number" and typeof(smax) == "number" then
        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(math.max(0.1, smin * s), math.max(0.2, smax * s))
    end
    local ax = pe:GetAttribute("baseAccX")
    local ay = pe:GetAttribute("baseAccY")
    local az = pe:GetAttribute("baseAccZ")
    if typeof(ax) == "number" and typeof(ay) == "number" and typeof(az) == "number" then
        pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(ax * s, ay * s, az * s)
    end
end

function jahvex_refreshWeatherParams()
    for _, pe in ipairs(weatherEmitters) do
        jahvex_scaleWeatherEmitter(pe)
    end
end

function jahvex_restoreWeatherLighting()
    local saved = weatherLightSaved
    weatherLightSaved = nil
    if not saved then return end
    pcall(function()
        Lighting.ClockTime = saved.ClockTime
        Lighting.Brightness = saved.Brightness
    end)
    local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if weatherAtmoCreated then
        weatherAtmoCreated = false
        if atmo then pcall(function() atmo:Destroy() end) end
        return
    end
    if atmo and saved.Atmo then
        pcall(function()
            atmo.Density = saved.Atmo.Density
            atmo.Haze = saved.Atmo.Haze
            atmo.Glare = saved.Atmo.Glare
            atmo.Color = saved.Atmo.Color
            atmo.Decay = saved.Atmo.Decay
        end)
    end
end

function jahvex_applyWeatherLighting(preset)
    if not weatherLightSaved then
        local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        weatherLightSaved = {
            ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
            Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
            Atmo = atmo and {
                Density = atmo.Density,
                Haze = atmo.Haze,
                Glare = atmo.Glare,
                Color = atmo.Color,
                Decay = atmo.Decay,
            } or nil,
        }
    end
    pcall(function()
        Lighting.ClockTime = 12
        Lighting.Brightness = preset.Brightness or 2
    end)
    local a = preset.Atmo
    if not a then return end
    local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if not atmo then
        atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
        atmo.Name = "WeatherAtmo"
        atmo.Parent = Lighting
        weatherAtmoCreated = true
    end
    pcall(function()
        atmo.Density = a.Density
        atmo.Haze = a.Haze
        atmo.Glare = a.Glare
        atmo.Color = a.Color
        atmo.Decay = a.Decay
    end)
end

function jahvex_clearWeatherBolts()
    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        for _, c in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do
            if c.Name == "WxBolt" then
                c:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_clearWeather()
    weatherFlashToken = weatherFlashToken + 1
    if weatherFollowConn then
        pcall(function() weatherFollowConn:Disconnect() end)
        weatherFollowConn = nil
    end
    weatherEmitters = {}
    if weatherFolder then
        pcall(function() weatherFolder:Destroy() end)
        weatherFolder = nil
    end
    if weatherPart then
        pcall(function() weatherPart:Destroy() end)
        weatherPart = nil
    end
    jahvex_clearWeatherBolts()
    jahvex_restoreWeatherLighting()
    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local old = cam:FindFirstChild("WeatherFolder")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local test = cam:FindFirstChild("WxTest")
            if test then test:Destroy() end
            local oldP = cam:FindFirstChild("WeatherHost")
            if oldP then oldP:Destroy() end
        end
        local wsOld = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeatherFolder")
        if wsOld then wsOld:Destroy() end
        local wsP = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeatherHost")
        if wsP then wsP:Destroy() end
    end)
end

function jahvex_spawnWeatherBolt()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local cf = cam.CFrame
    local segs = math.random(12, 20)
    local x = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 110
    local z = -70 - math.random() * 180
    local y1 = 70 + math.random() * 70
    local y2 = y1 - (50 + math.random() * 90)
    local pts = {}
    for i = 0, segs do
        local t = i / segs
        pts[i + 1] = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
            x + (math.random() * 16 - 8),
            y1 + (y2 - y1) * t,
            z + (math.random() * 16 - 8)
        ))
    end
    for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
        local a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
        local dist = (b - a).Magnitude
        if dist >= 0.08 then
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = "WxBolt"
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            p.Transparency = 0
            p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            local thick = 0.12 + math.random() * 0.14
            p.Size = Vector3.new(dist, thick, thick)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) * 0.5, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
            p.Parent = cam
            Debris:AddItem(p, 0.11 + math.random() * 0.05)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_weatherFlashLoop(token)
    task.spawn(function()
        while weatherEnabled and weatherFlashToken == token and jahvex_isCurrent() do
            task.wait(2.4 + math.random() * 4.2)
            if not weatherEnabled or weatherFlashToken ~= token then break end
            if weatherType ~= "Storm" then break end
            pcall(function()
                local n = math.random(2, 3)
                for _ = 1, n do
                    jahvex_spawnWeatherBolt()
                end
                local oldB = Lighting.Brightness
                Lighting.Brightness = math.max(oldB, 5.5)
                task.wait(0.05)
                if weatherFlashToken ~= token then
                    Lighting.Brightness = oldB
                    return
                end
                Lighting.Brightness = oldB * 0.35
                task.wait(0.05)
                Lighting.Brightness = oldB
            end)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_applyWeather()
    jahvex_clearWeather()
    if not weatherEnabled then return end
    weatherType = jahvex_normWeatherType(weatherType)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local t = weatherType
    local preset = WEATHER_PRESETS[t]
    if not preset then return end

    local HEIGHT = preset.Height or 32
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "WeatherFolder"
    folder.Parent = workspace
    weatherFolder = folder

    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "WeatherHost"
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.CastShadow = false
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.Size = preset.PartSize or Vector3.new(75, 1, 75)
    local p0 = cam.CFrame.Position
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(p0.X, p0.Y + HEIGHT, p0.Z)
    part.Parent = folder
    weatherPart = part

    weatherEmitters = {}
    local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    pe.Texture = preset.Texture
    local baseRate = preset.Rate
    local baseSpeed = preset.Speed
    local baseAcc = preset.Acceleration
    pe.Rate = baseRate
    pe.Lifetime = preset.Lifetime
    pe.Speed = baseSpeed
    pe.SpreadAngle = preset.SpreadAngle
    pe.Rotation = preset.Rotation
    pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
    pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
    pe.Acceleration = baseAcc
    pe.Drag = 0
    pe.LightEmission = preset.LightEmission
    pe.LightInfluence = preset.LightInfluence or 0
    pe.ZOffset = preset.ZOffset or 1
    pe.Size = preset.Size
    pe.Transparency = preset.Transparency
    pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(preset.Color)
    pe.LockedToPart = false
    pe.Enabled = true
    pe:SetAttribute("baseRate", baseRate)
    pe:SetAttribute("baseSpeedMin", baseSpeed.Min)
    pe:SetAttribute("baseSpeedMax", baseSpeed.Max)
    pe:SetAttribute("baseAccX", baseAcc.X)
    pe:SetAttribute("baseAccY", baseAcc.Y)
    pe:SetAttribute("baseAccZ", baseAcc.Z)
    pcall(function()
        pe.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
        pe.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
        pe.ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward
    end)
    pe.Parent = part
    table.insert(weatherEmitters, pe)
    jahvex_scaleWeatherEmitter(pe)

    jahvex_applyWeatherLighting(preset)

    weatherFollowConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        weatherFollowFrame = (weatherFollowFrame or 0) + 1
        if weatherFollowFrame % 3 ~= 0 then return end
        local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not c or not weatherPart or not weatherPart.Parent then return end
        local p = c.CFrame.Position
        weatherPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(p.X, p.Y + HEIGHT, p.Z)
    end)

    if preset.Bolts then
        jahvex_weatherFlashLoop(weatherFlashToken)
    end

    setStatus("Weather: " .. tostring(t), GREEN)
end

if not weatherCamConn then
    weatherCamConn = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        if weatherEnabled then
            task.defer(jahvex_applyWeather)
        end
    end)
end

        jahvex_applyWeather()

do
    local sliderW = COL_W - 24
    local knobW = 12
    local function makeWeatherSlider(label, y, getV, setV)
        makeLabel(weatherPanel, label, 12, y, 80, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
        local valLbl = makeLabel(weatherPanel, tostring(getV()) .. "%", 12, y + 13, sliderW, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
        local track = Instance.new("Frame")
        track.Size = UDim2.new(0, sliderW, 0, 4)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
        track.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        track.ZIndex = 3
        track.Parent = weatherPanel
        makeCorner(track, 3)
        makeStroke(track, BORDER, 1)
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.ZIndex = 4
        fill.Parent = track
        makeCorner(fill, 3)
        local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, knobW, 0, knobW)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.Text = ""
        knob.AutoButtonColor = false
        knob.ZIndex = 5
        knob.Parent = track
        makeCorner(knob, knobW / 2)
        makeStroke(knob, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), 1)

        local minV, maxV = 10, 250
        local function applyFrac(frac)
            frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
            local v = math.floor(minV + (maxV - minV) * frac + 0.5)
            setV(v)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -knobW / 2, 0.5, -knobW / 2)
            valLbl.Text = tostring(v) .. "%"
            if weatherEnabled then
                jahvex_refreshWeatherParams()
            end
        end
        applyFrac((getV() - minV) / (maxV - minV))

        local dragging = false
        local function setFromX(x)
            local trackX = track.AbsolutePosition.X
            local trackW = track.AbsoluteSize.X
            if trackW <= 0 then return end
            applyFrac((x - trackX) / trackW)
        end
        knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
        end)
        track.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = true
                setFromX(inp.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        knob.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if not dragging then return end
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            setFromX(inp.Position.X)
        end)

        return {
            Set = function(_, v)
                local num = tonumber(v) or getV()
                local frac = (math.clamp(num, minV, maxV) - minV) / (maxV - minV)

                applyFrac(frac)
            end,
        }
    end

    jahvexUiRefs.weatherDensitySlider = makeWeatherSlider("Density", 116, function()
        return weatherDensity
    end, function(v)
        weatherDensity = v
    end)
    jahvexUiRefs.weatherSpeedSlider = makeWeatherSlider("Speed", 154, function()
        return weatherSpeed
    end, function(v)
        weatherSpeed = v
    end)
end

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

end)()


do
    local FOV_BIND = "PostCamera"
    local fovSaved = nil
    local litSaved = nil
    local ccSaved = nil
    local ccOwned = false
    local atmoSaved = nil
    local texOrigParts = {}
    local texOrigTextures = {}
    local texConn = nil

    function jahvex_texTintOne(inst)
        if not texTintEnabled then return end
        if inst:IsA("Texture") or inst:IsA("Decal") then
            local p = inst.Parent
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") and not jahvex_worldSkip(p) then
                if texOrigTextures[inst] == nil then
                    texOrigTextures[inst] = inst.Transparency
                end
                pcall(function() inst.Transparency = 1 end)
            end
        elseif inst:IsA("BasePart") and not jahvex_worldSkip(inst) then
            local model = inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
            if model then
                if game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return end
                if model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return end
                local n = tostring(model.Name or "")
                if n:find("Weapon", 1, true) or n:find("Projectile", 1, true) or n:find("Effect", 1, true) then return end
            end
            if inst.Parent and (inst.Parent.Name == "ViewModels" or inst.Parent.Name == "Effects") then return end
            if inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Camera") or inst:FindFirstAncestor("Camera") then return end
            if inst.Transparency >= 0.95 then return end

            if not texOrigParts[inst] then
                texOrigParts[inst] = { Color = inst.Color, Material = inst.Material }
            end
            pcall(function()
                inst.Color = texTintColor
                inst.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            end)
        end
    end

    function jahvex_texTintRefresh()
        if not texTintEnabled then return end
        for inst in pairs(texOrigParts) do
            if inst and inst.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    inst.Color = texTintColor
                    inst.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                end)
            end
        end
        for inst in pairs(texOrigTextures) do
            if inst and inst.Parent then
                pcall(function() inst.Transparency = 1 end)
            end
        end
    end

    function jahvex_texTintApply()
        if not texTintEnabled then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local applied = 0
            for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if not texTintEnabled or not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
                pcall(jahvex_texTintOne, inst)
                applied = applied + 1
                if applied % 120 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    end

    function jahvex_texTintRestore()
        if texConn then
            pcall(function() texConn:Disconnect() end)
            texConn = nil
        end
        for inst, dat in pairs(texOrigParts) do
            if inst and inst.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    inst.Color = dat.Color
                    inst.Material = dat.Material
                end)
            end
            texOrigParts[inst] = nil
        end
        for inst, trans in pairs(texOrigTextures) do
            if inst and inst.Parent then
                pcall(function() inst.Transparency = trans end)
            end
            texOrigTextures[inst] = nil
        end
    end

    local transparentTexOrig = {}
    local transparentTexConn = nil

    local function jahvex_isWorldTransPart(inst)
        if not inst or not inst:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        if inst.Transparency >= 0.95 then return false end
        if type(jahvex_worldSkip) == "function" and jahvex_worldSkip(inst) then return false end
        local model = inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
        if model then
            if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return false end
            if model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
            local n = tostring(model.Name or "")
            if n:find("Weapon", 1, true) or n:find("Projectile", 1, true) or n:find("Effect", 1, true) then
                return false
            end
        end
        if inst.Parent and (inst.Parent.Name == "ViewModels" or inst.Parent.Name == "Effects") then
            return false
        end
        if inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Camera") or inst:FindFirstAncestor("Camera") then
            return false
        end
        return true
    end

    local function jahvex_transparentTarget()
        return math.clamp((tonumber(transparentTexturesStrength) or 60) / 100, 0.05, 0.95)
    end

    function jahvex_transparentOne(inst)
        if not transparentTexturesEnabled then return end
        if not jahvex_isWorldTransPart(inst) then return end
        if transparentTexOrig[inst] ~= nil then
            pcall(function() inst.Transparency = jahvex_transparentTarget() end)
            return
        end
        transparentTexOrig[inst] = inst.Transparency
        pcall(function()
            inst.Transparency = jahvex_transparentTarget()
        end)
    end

    function jahvex_transparentRefresh()
        local t = jahvex_transparentTarget()
        for inst in pairs(transparentTexOrig) do
            if inst and inst.Parent then
                pcall(function() inst.Transparency = t end)
            end
        end
    end

    function jahvex_transparentApply()
        if not transparentTexturesEnabled then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local applied = 0
            for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if not transparentTexturesEnabled or not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
                pcall(jahvex_transparentOne, inst)
                applied = applied + 1
                if applied % 80 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    end

    function jahvex_transparentRestore()
        if transparentTexConn then
            pcall(function() transparentTexConn:Disconnect() end)
            transparentTexConn = nil
        end
        for inst, oldTrans in pairs(transparentTexOrig) do
            if inst and inst.Parent and type(oldTrans) == "number" then
                pcall(function() inst.Transparency = oldTrans end)
            end
            transparentTexOrig[inst] = nil
        end
    end

    function jahvex_setTexTint(on)
        texTintEnabled = on and true or false
        if texTintEnabled then
            if not texConn then
                texConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
                    if not texTintEnabled then return end
                    task.defer(jahvex_texTintOne, inst)
                end)
                if type(jahvex_track) == "function" then
                    pcall(jahvex_track, texConn)
                end
            end
            pcall(jahvex_texTintApply)
        else
            pcall(jahvex_texTintRestore)
        end
    end

    function jahvex_setTransparentTextures(on)
        transparentTexturesEnabled = on and true or false
        if transparentTexturesEnabled then
            if not transparentTexConn then
                transparentTexConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
                    if not transparentTexturesEnabled then return end
                    task.defer(jahvex_transparentOne, inst)
                end)
                if type(jahvex_track) == "function" then
                    pcall(jahvex_track, transparentTexConn)
                end
            end
            pcall(jahvex_transparentApply)
        else
            pcall(jahvex_transparentRestore)
        end
    end

    function jahvex_worldApply()
        local needCC = worldColorEnabled or fullbrightEnabled
        local needAtmo = worldAtmoEnabled or fullbrightEnabled
        local needLit = worldColorEnabled or fullbrightEnabled
        if needLit then captureLit() end
        if needCC then captureCC() end
        if needAtmo then captureAtmo() end

        if needCC then
            local cc, ownedNow = getCC()
            if ownedNow then ccOwned = true end
            cc.Enabled = true
            local b = (worldBright - 50) / 50
            local c = (worldContrast - 50) / 50
            if fullbrightEnabled then
                b = math.clamp(b + 0.32, -1, 1)
            end
            if not worldColorEnabled then
                b = fullbrightEnabled and 0.32 or 0
                c = 0
            end
            cc.Brightness = b
            cc.Contrast = c
            cc.TintColor = worldColorEnabled and worldTint or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        else
            restoreCC()
        end

        if needLit then
            local L = Lighting
            if fullbrightEnabled then
                L.GlobalShadows = false
                L.FogEnd = 100000
                L.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)
                L.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)
                L.Brightness = math.max(L.Brightness, 1.6)
            elseif worldColorEnabled then
                L.GlobalShadows = worldShadow >= 35
                L.ShadowSoftness = math.clamp((100 - worldShadow) / 100, 0, 1)
            end
        else
            restoreLit()
        end

        if worldAtmoEnabled then
            local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atmo then
                atmo.Density = worldAtmoDensity / 100
                atmo.Haze = worldAtmoHaze / 10
                atmo.Color = worldAtmoColor
            end
        elseif fullbrightEnabled then
            local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atmo then
                atmo.Density = 0.06
                atmo.Haze = 0
            end
        elseif atmoSaved ~= nil then
            restoreAtmo()
        end
    end

    function jahvex_worldShutdown()
        pcall(jahvex_texTintRestore)
        pcall(jahvex_transparentRestore)
        texTintEnabled = false
        transparentTexturesEnabled = false
        worldColorEnabled = false
        worldAtmoEnabled = false
        fullbrightEnabled = false
        pcall(restoreCC)
        pcall(restoreAtmo)
        pcall(restoreLit)
    end

    function jahvex_setFullbright(on)
        fullbrightEnabled = on and true or false
        pcall(jahvex_worldApply)
    end

    function jahvex_setWorldColor(on)
        worldColorEnabled = on and true or false
        pcall(jahvex_worldApply)
    end

    function jahvex_setWorldAtmo(on)
        worldAtmoEnabled = on and true or false
        if not worldAtmoEnabled and not fullbrightEnabled then
            pcall(restoreAtmo)
        end
        pcall(jahvex_worldApply)
    end

    function jahvex_camFovTick()
        if not camFovEnabled then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            cam.FieldOfView = camFovValue
        end
    end

    function jahvex_setCamFov(on)
        camFovEnabled = on and true or false
        pcall(function()
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(FOV_BIND)
        end)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camFovEnabled then
            if cam and fovSaved == nil then
                fovSaved = cam.FieldOfView
            end
            pcall(function()
                RunService:BindToRenderStep(FOV_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, jahvex_camFovTick)
            end)
            jahvex_camFovTick()
        else
            if cam then
                cam.FieldOfView = fovSaved or 70
            end
            fovSaved = nil
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(1.2)
            if not jahvex_isCurrent() then break end
            if worldColorEnabled or fullbrightEnabled or worldAtmoEnabled then
                pcall(jahvex_worldApply)
            end
        end
    end)

    local camPanel = makePanel(worldRightPage, 0, 1570, COL_W, 154, "Camera")
    jahvexUiRefs.fullbrightToggle = makeToggle(camPanel, "Fullbright", 12, 34, COL_W - 24, function(state)
        jahvex_setFullbright(state)
        saveConfig()
    end)
    jahvexUiRefs.camFovToggle = makeToggle(camPanel, "Custom FOV", 12, 62, COL_W - 24, function(state)
        jahvex_setCamFov(state)
        saveConfig()
    end)

    do
        local rw = COL_W - 24
        local KW = 12
        local minV, maxV = 50, 120
        makeLabel(camPanel, "FOV", 12, 92, rw - 50, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
        local valLbl = makeLabel(camPanel, tostring(camFovValue), 12, 92 + 13, rw, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
        local tr = Instance.new("Frame")
        tr.Size = UDim2.new(0, rw, 0, 4)
        tr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 110)
        tr.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        tr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        tr.ZIndex = 4
        tr.Parent = camPanel
        makeCorner(tr, 3)
        makeStroke(tr, BORDER, 1)
        local frac0 = math.clamp((camFovValue - minV) / (maxV - minV), 0, 1)
        local fi = Instance.new("Frame")
        fi.Size = UDim2.new(frac0, 0, 1, 0)
        fi.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        fi.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fi.ZIndex = 5
        fi.Parent = tr
        makeCorner(fi, 3)
        local kn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        kn.Size = UDim2.new(0, KW, 0, KW)
        kn.Position = UDim2.new(frac0, -KW / 2, 0.5, -KW / 2)
        kn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        kn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        kn.Text = ""
        kn.AutoButtonColor = false
        kn.ZIndex = 6
        kn.Parent = tr
        makeCorner(kn, KW / 2)
        makeStroke(kn, BORDER, 1)
        local function applyFrac(frac)
            frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
            camFovValue = math.floor(minV + frac * (maxV - minV) + 0.5)
            fi.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            kn.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KW / 2, 0.5, -KW / 2)
            valLbl.Text = tostring(camFovValue)
            if camFovEnabled then jahvex_camFovTick() end
        end
        local drag = false
        kn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true end
        end)
        kn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = false end
        end)
        tr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                drag = true
                applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                if drag then saveConfig() end
                drag = false
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if not drag then return end
            if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
        end)
        jahvexUiRefs.camFovSliderSet = function(v)
            applyFrac((math.clamp(tonumber(v) or camFovValue, minV, maxV) - minV) / (maxV - minV))
        end
    end

    local function worldSlider(parent, label, y, getV, setV)
        local rw = COL_W - 24

        makeLabel(parent, label, 12, y, rw - 50, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
        local valLbl = makeLabel(parent, tostring(getV()), 12, y + 13, rw, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
        local tr = Instance.new("Frame")

        fi.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        fi.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fi.ZIndex = 5
        fi.Parent = tr
        makeCorner(fi, 3)
        local kn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        kn.Size = UDim2.new(0, KW, 0, KW)
        kn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        kn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        kn.Text = ""
        kn.AutoButtonColor = false
        kn.ZIndex = 6
        kn.Parent = tr
        makeCorner(kn, KW / 2)
        makeStroke(kn, BORDER, 1)
        local function applyFrac(frac)
            frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)

            setV(v)
            fi.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            kn.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KW / 2, 0.5, -KW / 2)
            valLbl.Text = tostring(v)
            pcall(jahvex_worldApply)
        end
        applyFrac((getV() - minV) / (maxV - minV))
        local drag = false
        kn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = true end
        end)
        kn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = false end
        end)
        tr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                drag = true
                applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                if drag then saveConfig() end
                drag = false
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if not drag then return end
            if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            applyFrac((i.Position.X - tr.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(tr.AbsoluteSize.X, 1))
        end)
        return function(v)
            applyFrac((math.clamp(tonumber(v) or getV(), minV, maxV) - minV) / (maxV - minV))
        end
    end

appearanceDescCache = nil

appearanceModelCache = nil
appearanceModelCacheId = nil
appearanceIdsCache = nil
appearanceIdsCacheId = nil
appearanceFaceIdsCache = nil
appearanceFaceIdsCacheId = nil
