function jahvex_clearAppearanceCache()
    appearanceCacheId = nil
    appearanceDescCacheId = nil
    appearanceModelCacheId = nil
    appearanceIdsCacheId = nil
    appearanceIdsCache = nil
    appearanceFaceIdsCacheId = nil
    appearanceFaceIdsCache = nil
    if appearanceFaceAccFolder then
        pcall(function() appearanceFaceAccFolder:Destroy() end)
        appearanceFaceAccFolder = nil
    end
    for id, inst in pairs(jahvex_assetInstCache) do
        pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
        jahvex_assetInstCache[id] = nil
    end
    if appearanceCacheModel then
        pcall(function() appearanceCacheModel:Destroy() end)
        appearanceCacheModel = nil
    end
    if appearanceDescCache then
        pcall(function() appearanceDescCache:Destroy() end)
        appearanceDescCache = nil
    end
    if appearanceModelCache then
        pcall(function() appearanceModelCache:Destroy() end)
        appearanceModelCache = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_getHumanoidDescription(userId)
    userId = tonumber(userId)
    if not userId then return nil end
    if appearanceDescCacheId == userId and appearanceDescCache then
        return appearanceDescCache:Clone()
    end
    local desc = nil
    pcall(function()
        desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(userId)
    end)
    if not desc then
        pcall(function()
            if Players.GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync then
                desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(userId)
            end
        end)
    end
    if not desc then return nil end
    if appearanceDescCache then
        pcall(function() appearanceDescCache:Destroy() end)
    end
    appearanceDescCache = desc:Clone()
    appearanceDescCacheId = userId
    return desc:Clone()
end

function jahvex_stowAvatarModel(model)
    if not model then return end
    pcall(function() model:SetAttribute("jxCache", true) end)
    pcall(function()

        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Anchored = true
                p.CanCollide = false
                p.CanQuery = false
                p.CanTouch = false
                p.Transparency = 1
                pcall(function() p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
            end
        end
        local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            pcall(function() hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function() model.Parent = nil end)
end

function jahvex_purgeVisibleAvatarCaches()
    local char = lp.Character
    local function scan(parent)
        if not parent then return end
        for _, v in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if v == char then

            elseif v == appearanceModelCache or v == appearanceCacheModel or v == appearanceFaceAccFolder then
                jahvex_stowAvatarModel(v)
            elseif v:GetAttribute("jxCache") or v.Name == "FullAvatarCache"
                or v.Name == "AppearanceCache" or v.Name == "FaceAccCache" then
                pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    scan(workspace)
    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then scan(cam) end
    end)
    pcall(function() scan(game:GetService("Lighting")) end)
end

function jahvex_copyWrapTargets(src, dst)
    if not src or not dst then return end
    local map = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(dst:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            map[p.Name] = p
        end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local d = map[p.Name]
            if d and not d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapTarget") then
                local wt = p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapTarget")
                if wt then
                    pcall(function() wt:Clone().Parent = d end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_getFullAvatarModel(userId)
    userId = tonumber(userId)
    if not userId then return nil end
    if appearanceModelCacheId == userId and appearanceModelCache then
        local c = appearanceModelCache:Clone()
        jahvex_stowAvatarModel(c)
        return c
    end
    local model = nil
    local desc = jahvex_getHumanoidDescription(userId)
    if desc then
        local rig = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
        pcall(function()
            if lp.Character then
                local h = lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h then rig = h.RigType end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, rig)
            if model then jahvex_stowAvatarModel(model) end
        end)
        if not model then
            pcall(function()
                model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6)
                if model then jahvex_stowAvatarModel(model) end
            end)
        end
    end
    if not model then
        pcall(function()
            model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(userId)
            if model then jahvex_stowAvatarModel(model) end
        end)
    end
    if not model then
        pcall(function()
            if Players.CreateHumanoidModelFromUserIdAsync then
                model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserIdAsync(userId)
                if model then jahvex_stowAvatarModel(model) end
            end
        end)
    end
    if not model then return nil end
    jahvex_stowAvatarModel(model)
    if appearanceModelCache then
        pcall(function() appearanceModelCache:Destroy() end)
    end
    appearanceModelCache = model:Clone()
    appearanceModelCache.Name = "FullAvatarCache"
    appearanceModelCacheId = userId
    jahvex_stowAvatarModel(appearanceModelCache)
    pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
    jahvex_purgeVisibleAvatarCaches()
    local out = appearanceModelCache:Clone()
    jahvex_stowAvatarModel(out)
    return out
end

function jahvex_getAppearanceClone(userId)
    userId = tonumber(userId)
    if not userId then return nil end
    if appearanceCacheId == userId and appearanceCacheModel then
        local c = appearanceCacheModel:Clone()
        jahvex_stowAvatarModel(c)
        return c
    end
    local ok, appearance = pcall(function()
        return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(userId)
    end)
    if not ok or not appearance then return nil end
    if appearanceCacheModel then
        pcall(function() appearanceCacheModel:Destroy() end)
    end
    appearanceCacheModel = Instance.new("Folder")
    appearanceCacheModel.Name = "AppearanceCache"
    for _, ch in ipairs(appearance:GetChildren()) do
        pcall(function() ch:Clone().Parent = appearanceCacheModel end)
    end
    appearanceCacheId = userId
    pcall(function() appearance:Destroy() end)
    jahvex_stowAvatarModel(appearanceCacheModel)
    local out = appearanceCacheModel:Clone()
    jahvex_stowAvatarModel(out)
    return out
end

function jahvex_parseAssetIds(str)
    local ids = {}
    if type(str) ~= "string" or str == "" or str == "0" then return ids end
    for id in string.gmatch(str, "%d+") do
        local n = tonumber(id)
        if n and n > 0 then table.insert(ids, n) end
    end
    return ids
end

function jahvex_unwrapAvatarAsset(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end
    if inst:IsA("Accessory") or inst:IsA("Hat") or inst:IsA("Shirt") or inst:IsA("Pants")
        or inst:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("BodyColors")
        or inst:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
        return inst
    end
    local accCount = 0
    pcall(function()
        for _, ch in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Accessory") or ch:IsA("Hat") then
                accCount = accCount + 1
            end
        end
    end)
    if accCount > 1 then
        return inst
    end
    local acc = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true) or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Hat", true)
    if acc then return acc end
    local cloth = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt", true)
        or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants", true)
        or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ShirtGraphic", true)
    if cloth then return cloth end
    local dec = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
    if dec then return dec end
    return inst
end

function jahvex_loadAssetInstance(assetId)
    assetId = tonumber(assetId)
    if not assetId then return nil end
    local cached = jahvex_assetInstCache[assetId]
    if cached then
        local c = nil
        pcall(function() c = cached:Clone() end)
        if c then return c end
        jahvex_assetInstCache[assetId] = nil
    end
    local inst = nil
    pcall(function()
        local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
        if type(objs) == "table" then
            for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                local u = jahvex_unwrapAvatarAsset(o)
                if u and (u:IsA("Accessory") or u:IsA("Hat") or u:IsA("Decal")
                    or u:IsA("Shirt") or u:IsA("Pants") or u:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
                    or u:IsA("Model") or u:IsA("Folder")) then
                    inst = u
                    break
                end
            end
            if not inst and objs[1] then
                inst = jahvex_unwrapAvatarAsset(objs[1])
            end
        end
    end)
    if not inst then
        pcall(function()
            inst = jahvex_unwrapAvatarAsset(InsertService:LoadLocalAsset("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)))
        end)
    end
    if not inst then
        pcall(function()
            local m = InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId)
            if m then
                inst = jahvex_unwrapAvatarAsset(m)
            end
        end)
    end
    if inst then
        pcall(function() jahvex_assetInstCache[assetId] = inst:Clone() end)
    end
    return inst
end

function jahvex_collectDescAssetIds(desc)
    local ids = {}
    if not desc then return ids end

    local fields = {
        "HatAccessory", "HairAccessory", "FaceAccessory", "NeckAccessory",
        "ShoulderAccessory", "FrontAccessory", "BackAccessory", "WaistAccessory",
        "Face", "Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt",
    }
    for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
        local ok, val = pcall(function() return desc[f] end)
        if ok then
            if type(val) == "number" and val > 0 then
                table.insert(ids, val)
            elseif type(val) == "string" then
                for _, id in ipairs(jahvex_parseAssetIds(val)) do
                    table.insert(ids, id)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return ids
end

function jahvex_isWearableAvatarAssetType(typeName)
    if not typeName then return false end
    local t = string.lower(tostring(typeName))

    if t:find("animation") or t:find("emote") or t:find("walk") or t:find("run")
        or t:find("mood") or t:find("climb") or t:find("fall") or t:find("swim")
        or t:find("jump") or t:find("idle") then
        return false
    end
    if t == "head" or t == "torso" or t == "leftarm" or t == "rightarm"
        or t == "leftleg" or t == "rightleg" or t == "dynamichead" then
        return false
    end
    return t:find("hat") or t:find("hair") or t:find("face") or t:find("neck")
        or t:find("shoulder") or t:find("front") or t:find("back") or t:find("waist")
        or t:find("shirt") or t:find("pants") or t:find("tshirt") or t:find("tee")
        or t:find("jacket") or t:find("sweater") or t:find("eyebrow") or t:find("eyelash")
        or t:find("accessory") or t == "gear" or t == "dynamichead"
end

function jahvex_fetchAvatarAssetIds(userId)
    local ids = {}
    local hatsFirst = {}
    pcall(function()
        local raw = game:HttpGet("https://avatar.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. tostring(userId) .. "/avatar")
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
        if type(data) == "table" and type(data.assets) == "table" then
            for _, a in ipairs(data.assets) do
                local id = tonumber(a.id or a.Id)
                if id then
                    local tname = nil
                    if type(a.assetType) == "table" then
                        tname = a.assetType.name or a.assetType.Name
                    elseif type(a.assetType) == "string" then
                        tname = a.assetType
                    end
                    if jahvex_isWearableAvatarAssetType(tname) then
                        local tl = string.lower(tostring(tname or ""))
                        if tl:find("hat") or tl:find("hair") or tl:find("face") then
                            table.insert(hatsFirst, id)
                        else
                            table.insert(ids, id)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    for i = #hatsFirst, 1, -1 do
        table.insert(ids, 1, hatsFirst[i])
    end
    return ids
end

function jahvex_isAppearancePiece(v)
    if not v then return false end
    return v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") or v:IsA("Accoutrement")
        or v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") or v:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
        or v:IsA("Clothing") or v:IsA("BodyColors") or v:IsA("CharacterMesh")
end

function jahvex_isSpoofOwned(v)
    if not v then return false end
    local ours = false
    pcall(function()
        ours = v:GetAttribute("jxAcc") == true
            or v:GetAttribute("jxFaceAcc") == true
            or v:GetAttribute("jxSpoof") == true
    end)
    return ours
end

function jahvex_markSpoofOwned(v)
    if not v then return end
    pcall(function() v:SetAttribute("jxSpoof", true) end)
    if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
        pcall(function() v:SetAttribute("jxAcc", true) end)
    end
end

function jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
    if not char then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if jahvex_isAppearancePiece(v) and not jahvex_isSpoofOwned(v) then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_stripCharacterAppearance(char)
    if not char then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if jahvex_isAppearancePiece(v) then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        jahvex_stripAllHeadFaces(head)
    end
end

function jahvex_faceHosts(head)
    local list = {}
    if not head then return list end
    table.insert(list, head)
    for _, c in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("BasePart") then
            local n = string.lower(c.Name)
            if n:find("head", 1, true) or n:find("face", 1, true) or n:find("mesh", 1, true) then
                table.insert(list, c)
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

function jahvex_clearFaceLayers(part)
    if not part then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        elseif d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
            local n = string.lower(d.Name)
            local front = false
            pcall(function() front = (d.Face == Enum.NormalId.Front) end)
            if n:find("face", 1, true) or front then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_stripAllHeadFaces(head)
    if not head then return end
    for _, h in ipairs(jahvex_faceHosts(head)) do
        jahvex_clearFaceLayers(h)
    end
end

function jahvex_pickFacePaintTarget(head)
    if not head then return nil end
    local dh = head:FindFirstChild("DefaultHeadMesh")
    if dh and dh:IsA("BasePart") then return dh end
    for _, c in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("BasePart") then
            local n = string.lower(c.Name)
            if n:find("headmesh", 1, true) or n:find("defaulthead", 1, true) then
                return c
            end
        end
    end
    return head
end

function jahvex_isDefaultRobloxFaceTex(tex)
    if type(tex) ~= "string" or tex == "" then return true end
    local l = string.lower(tex)
    if l:find("textures/face", 1, true) then return true end
    if l:find("rbxasset://textures/face", 1, true) then return true end
    return false
end

function jahvex_headFaceTexture(head)
    if not head then return nil end
    local named, anyTex
    for _, h in ipairs(jahvex_faceHosts(head)) do
        for _, d in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                local t = d.Texture
                if type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" and not jahvex_isDefaultRobloxFaceTex(t) then
                    local n = string.lower(d.Name)
                    if n == "face" then
                        named = t
                    elseif not anyTex then
                        anyTex = t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if named then return named end
    if anyTex then return anyTex end
    for _, d in ipairs(head:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
            local t = d.Texture
            if type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" and not jahvex_isDefaultRobloxFaceTex(t) then
                return t
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_paintHeadFace(head, texture)
    if not head or type(texture) ~= "string" or texture == "" then return false end
    _G.jahvex_spoofFaceTexture = texture
    jahvex_stripAllHeadFaces(head)
    local target = jahvex_pickFacePaintTarget(head)
    if not target then return false end
    local dec = Instance.new("Decal")
    dec.Name = "face"
    dec.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
    dec.Texture = texture
    dec.Transparency = 0
    dec.ZIndex = 5
    dec.Parent = target
    return true
end

function jahvex_copyFace(srcHead, dstHead)
    if not srcHead or not dstHead then return end
    local tex = jahvex_headFaceTexture(srcHead)
    if tex then
        jahvex_paintHeadFace(dstHead, tex)
    end
end

function jahvex_enforceSpoofFace(char)
    if not lastSpoofedData then return end
    local tex = rawget(_G, "jahvex_spoofFaceTexture")
    if type(tex) ~= "string" or tex == "" then return end
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    local sawOurs, sawOther = false, false
    for _, h in ipairs(jahvex_faceHosts(head)) do
        for _, d in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                if d.Texture == tex then
                    sawOurs = true
                else
                    sawOther = true
                end
            elseif d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                sawOther = true
            end
        end
    end
    if sawOther or not sawOurs then
        jahvex_paintHeadFace(head, tex)
    end
end

function jahvex_isFaceAccessory(acc)
    if not acc then return false end
    local at = nil
    pcall(function() at = acc.AccessoryType end)
    if at == Enum.AccessoryType.Face
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyebrow
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyelash then
        return true
    end
    local n = string.lower(tostring(acc.Name or ""))
    if n:find("face", 1, true) or n:find("glass", 1, true) or n:find("goggle", 1, true)
        or n:find("nose", 1, true) or n:find("mask", 1, true) or n:find("brow", 1, true)
        or n:find("lash", 1, true) or n:find("eyelid", 1, true) or n:find("beard", 1, true)
        or n:find("mustache", 1, true) or n:find("visor", 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle") or acc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if handle then
        if handle:FindFirstChild("FaceFrontAttachment") then return true end
        if handle:FindFirstChild("FaceCenterAttachment") and not handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")
            and not handle:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment") then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_faceAccFolder()
    if not appearanceFaceAccFolder then
        appearanceFaceAccFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        appearanceFaceAccFolder.Name = "FaceAccCache"
    end
    return appearanceFaceAccFolder
end

function jahvex_cacheFaceAccTemplate(acc)
    if not acc or not (acc:IsA("Accessory") or acc:IsA("Hat")) then return end
    local folder = jahvex_faceAccFolder()
    local key = acc.Name
    if type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then
        key = "acc_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1e9))
    end
    if folder:FindFirstChild(key) then return end
    local c = nil
    pcall(function() c = acc:Clone() end)
    if not c then return end
    c.Name = key
    pcall(function() c:SetAttribute("jxAcc", true) end)
    if jahvex_isFaceAccessory(c) then
        pcall(function() c:SetAttribute("jxFaceAcc", true) end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Weld") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") or d:IsA("Motor6D") or d:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
                d:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end)
    c.Parent = folder
end

function jahvex_expectedFaceAccCount()
    if not appearanceFaceAccFolder then return 0 end
    local n = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(appearanceFaceAccFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
            n = n + 1
        end
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char)
    local n = 0
    if not char then return 0 end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if (v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat")) and (v:GetAttribute("jxAcc") or v:GetAttribute("jxFaceAcc")) then
            n = n + 1
        end
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_rigidizeAccessory(acc)
    if not acc then return end

    pcall(function()
        for _, d in ipairs(acc:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local n = string.lower(d.Name)
                if n:find("cage", 1, true) or n:find("innerwrap", 1, true) or n:find("outerwrap", 1, true) then
                    d.Transparency = 1
                    pcall(function() d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
                    d.CanCollide = false
                    d.CanQuery = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_reweldTaggedFaceAccs(char)
    if not char then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if (v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat")) and (v:GetAttribute("jxAcc") or v:GetAttribute("jxFaceAcc")) then
            local handle = v:FindFirstChild("Handle") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if handle and not jahvex_handleHasWeld(handle) then
                jahvex_weldAccessoryHandle(char, v, handle)
            end
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_claimCharFaceAccs(char)
    if not char then return 0 end
    jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
    return jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char)
end

function jahvex_reapplyCachedFaceAccs(char)
    if not char or not appearanceFaceAccFolder then return 0 end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return 0 end
    local n = 0
    for _, tmpl in ipairs(appearanceFaceAccFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if tmpl:IsA("Accessory") or tmpl:IsA("Hat") then
            if jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, tmpl) then
                n = n + 1
            end
        end
    end
    jahvex_bindFaceAccPersist(char)
    return n
end

function jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
    if not char or not lastSpoofedData then return end
    local gen = (rawget(_G, "jahvex_faceRestoreGen") or 0) + 1
    _G.jahvex_faceRestoreGen = gen
    local delays = {0.05, 0.14, 0.32, 0.6, 1.05, 1.7, 2.6}
    for _, d in ipairs(delays) do
        task.delay(d, function()
            if rawget(_G, "jahvex_faceRestoreGen") ~= gen then return end
            if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not lastSpoofedData then return end
            if not char.Parent then return end
            local expect = jahvex_expectedFaceAccCount()
            local have = jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char)
            if expect > 0 and have >= expect then
                jahvex_reweldTaggedFaceAccs(char)
                return
            end
            if expect > 0 then
                jahvex_reapplyCachedFaceAccs(char)
                jahvex_reweldTaggedFaceAccs(char)
                return
            end
            local now = tick()
            if rawget(_G, "jahvex_faceLookAt") and (now - _G.jahvex_faceLookAt) < 0.45 then
                return
            end
            _G.jahvex_faceLookAt = now
            local uid = lastSpoofedData.id or lastSpoofedData.Id
            local fm = (appearanceModelCacheId == uid) and appearanceModelCache or nil
            local dcache = (appearanceDescCacheId == uid) and appearanceDescCache or nil
            pcall(function()
                jahvex_applyFaceLook(char, uid, dcache, fm, true)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

function jahvex_ensureFaceAccs(char)
    if not lastSpoofedData or not char or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
    local expect = jahvex_expectedFaceAccCount()
    if expect < 1 then return end
    local have = jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char)
    local now = tick()
    local spawnAt = 0
    pcall(function() spawnAt = char:GetAttribute("jxSpawnAt") or 0 end)
    local age = (spawnAt > 0) and (now - spawnAt) or 99
    if have >= expect then
        if age < 5 then
            jahvex_reweldTaggedFaceAccs(char)
        end
        return
    end
    local interval = (age < 5) and 0.2 or 1.0
    if rawget(_G, "jahvex_faceEnsureAt") and (now - _G.jahvex_faceEnsureAt) < interval then
        return
    end
    _G.jahvex_faceEnsureAt = now
    jahvex_reapplyCachedFaceAccs(char)
    jahvex_reweldTaggedFaceAccs(char)
end

function jahvex_stripFaceAccessories(char, keepTagged)
    if not char then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if (v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat")) and jahvex_isFaceAccessory(v) then
            if keepTagged and v:GetAttribute("jxFaceAcc") then

            else
                pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_hasTaggedFaceAcc(char)
    return jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char) > 0
end

function jahvex_copyFaceAccessoriesFrom(char, hum, src)
    if not char or not hum or not src then return 0 end
    local n = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
            jahvex_cacheFaceAccTemplate(v)
            if jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, v) then
                n = n + 1
            end
        end
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Accessory") and v.Parent ~= src then
            jahvex_cacheFaceAccTemplate(v)
            if not char:FindFirstChild(v.Name) then
                if jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, v) then
                    n = n + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_isFaceAccAssetType(t)
    t = string.lower(tostring(t or ""))
    if t == "" then return false end
    if t == "face" then return false end
    if t:find("face accessory", 1, true) or t:gsub(" ", "") == "faceaccessory" then return true end
    if t:find("eyebrow", 1, true) or t:find("eyelash", 1, true) then return true end
    return false
end

function jahvex_collectFaceAccessoryIds(userId, desc)
    userId = tonumber(userId)
    if userId and appearanceFaceIdsCacheId == userId and type(appearanceFaceIdsCache) == "table" then
        return appearanceFaceIdsCache
    end
    local ids, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(id)
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            table.insert(ids, id)
        end
    end
    if desc then
        for _, id in ipairs(jahvex_parseAssetIds(tostring(desc.FaceAccessory or ""))) do add(id) end
        pcall(function()
            local list = desc:GetAccessories(true)
            if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
            for _, a in ipairs(list) do
                local at = a and (a.AccessoryType or a.accessoryType)
                local aid = a and (a.AssetId or a.assetId or a.Id)
                if at == Enum.AccessoryType.Face or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyebrow or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyelash then
                    add(aid)
                elseif type(at) == "string" and jahvex_isFaceAccAssetType(at) then
                    add(aid)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if not userId then return end
        local raw = game:HttpGet("https://avatar.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. tostring(userId) .. "/avatar")
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
        if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.assets) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, a in ipairs(data.assets) do
            local tname = nil
            if type(a.assetType) == "table" then
                tname = a.assetType.name or a.assetType.Name
            elseif type(a.assetType) == "string" then
                tname = a.assetType
            end
            if jahvex_isFaceAccAssetType(tname) then
                add(a.id or a.Id)
            end
        end
    end)
    if userId then
        appearanceFaceIdsCache = ids
        appearanceFaceIdsCacheId = userId
    end
    return ids
end

function jahvex_applyFaceLook(char, userId, desc, srcModel, keepExisting)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if srcModel and head then
        local sh = srcModel:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if sh then jahvex_copyFace(sh, head) end
    end
    if desc then
        local faceId = tonumber(desc.Face)
        if faceId and faceId > 0 then
            jahvex_applyFaceFromId(char, faceId)
        end
    end
    if not hum then return end


    if srcModel then
        for _, v in ipairs(srcModel:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
                jahvex_cacheFaceAccTemplate(v)
            end
        end
        for _, v in ipairs(srcModel:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Accessory") and v.Parent ~= srcModel then
                jahvex_cacheFaceAccTemplate(v)
            end
        end
    end

    jahvex_claimCharFaceAccs(char)

    local expect = jahvex_expectedFaceAccCount()
    local have = jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char)
    if keepExisting and expect > 0 and have >= expect then
        jahvex_bindFaceAccPersist(char)
        jahvex_reweldTaggedFaceAccs(char)
        jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
        return
    end

    local copied = jahvex_reapplyCachedFaceAccs(char)
    if copied < 1 and srcModel then
        copied = jahvex_copyFaceAccessoriesFrom(char, hum, srcModel)
    end
    if jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char) < math.max(expect, 1) then
        if appearanceFaceAccFolder and #appearanceFaceAccFolder:GetChildren() > 0 then
            jahvex_reapplyCachedFaceAccs(char)
        elseif not keepExisting then
            local ids = jahvex_collectAllAvatarAssetIds(userId, desc)
            if type(ids) ~= "table" or #ids < 1 then
                ids = jahvex_collectFaceAccessoryIds(userId, desc)
            end
            if type(ids) == "table" and #ids > 0 then
                jahvex_insertAssetsOntoChar(char, hum, ids)
            end
        end
    end

    jahvex_stripFaceAccessories(char, true)
    jahvex_bindFaceAccPersist(char)
    if not keepExisting then
        jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
    end
end

function jahvex_bindFaceAccPersist(char)
    if not char then return end
    if char:GetAttribute("jxFaceWatch") then
        jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
        return
    end
    pcall(function() char:SetAttribute("jxFaceWatch", true) end)
    jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
    jahvex_track(char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(ch)
        if not lastSpoofedData or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        if not (ch:IsA("Accessory") or ch:IsA("Hat")) then return end
        if not jahvex_isSpoofOwned(ch) then return end
        jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
    end))
    jahvex_track(char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        if not lastSpoofedData or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        if ch.Name == "Head" then
            task.defer(function()
                jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
            end)
            return
        end
        if not jahvex_isAppearancePiece(ch) then return end
        task.defer(function()
            if not (char and char.Parent and lastSpoofedData) then return end
            if ch.Parent ~= char then return end
            if jahvex_isSpoofOwned(ch) then return end
            pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end))
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function()
            if hum.ApplyDescriptionFinished then
                jahvex_track(hum.ApplyDescriptionFinished:Connect(function()
                    jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
                    jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
                end))
            end
        end)
    end
end

function jahvex_findCharAttachment(char, attachName)
    if not char or not attachName or attachName == "" then return nil, nil end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            local a = part:FindFirstChild(attachName)
            if a and a:IsA("Attachment") then
                return a, part
            end
        end
    end
    for _, a in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if a:IsA("Attachment") and a.Name == attachName then
            local p = a.Parent
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
                return a, p
            end
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

function jahvex_guessBodyPartForAccessory(char, acc)
    local name = string.lower(tostring(acc and acc.Name or ""))
    local at = nil
    pcall(function() at = acc.AccessoryType end)
    local want = "Head"
    if at == Enum.AccessoryType.Hat or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Face
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyebrow or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyelash
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Neck then
        want = "Head"
    elseif at == Enum.AccessoryType.Shoulder or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Front
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Back or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Jacket
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Shirt or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Sweater then
        want = "UpperTorso"
    elseif at == Enum.AccessoryType.Waist or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Pants
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Shorts or at == Enum.AccessoryType.DressSkirt then
        want = "LowerTorso"
    elseif name:find("waist") or name:find("belt") then
        want = "LowerTorso"
    elseif name:find("back") or name:find("front") or name:find("shoulder") then
        want = "UpperTorso"
    end
    return char:FindFirstChild(want)
        or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

function jahvex_prepareAccessoryHandle(handle, clearWelds)
    if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    pcall(function()
        handle.Anchored = false
        handle.CanCollide = false
        handle.Massless = true
        handle.CanTouch = false
        handle.CanQuery = false
    end)
    if clearWelds then
        for _, w in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
            if w:IsA("Weld") or w:IsA("WeldConstraint") or w:IsA("Motor6D") or w:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
                pcall(function() w:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_handleHasWeld(handle)
    if not handle then return false end
    for _, w in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
        if w:IsA("Weld") or w:IsA("WeldConstraint") or w:IsA("Motor6D") or w:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
            local p0, p1 = w.Part0, w.Part1

            if p0 and p1 and p0.Parent and p1.Parent then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function jahvex_weldAccessoryHandle(char, clone, handle)
    if not char or not clone or not handle then return false end
    jahvex_prepareAccessoryHandle(handle, true)

    local accAtt = nil
    local faceFirst = clone and jahvex_isFaceAccessory(clone)
    local order = faceFirst
        and { "FaceFrontAttachment", "FaceCenterAttachment", "HatAttachment", "HairAttachment" }
        or { "HatAttachment", "HairAttachment", "FaceFrontAttachment", "FaceCenterAttachment" }
    for _, name in ipairs(order) do
        local a = handle:FindFirstChild(name)
        if a and a:IsA("Attachment") then
            accAtt = a
            break
        end
    end
    if not accAtt then
        accAtt = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
    end
    if not accAtt then
        for _, d in ipairs(handle:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Attachment") then
                accAtt = d
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local bodyAtt, bodyPart = nil, nil
    if accAtt then
        bodyAtt, bodyPart = jahvex_findCharAttachment(char, accAtt.Name)
    end
    if not bodyPart then
        bodyPart = jahvex_guessBodyPartForAccessory(char, clone)
    end
    if not bodyPart then return false end

    if accAtt and not bodyAtt then
        bodyAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
        bodyAtt.Name = accAtt.Name
        local n = accAtt.Name
        if n == "HatAttachment" then
            bodyAtt.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0)
        elseif n == "HairAttachment" then
            bodyAtt.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
        elseif n == "FaceFrontAttachment" then
            bodyAtt.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.05, -0.55)
        elseif n == "FaceCenterAttachment" then
            bodyAtt.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        bodyAtt.Parent = bodyPart
    end

    pcall(function()
        if bodyAtt and accAtt then
            handle.CFrame = bodyAtt.WorldCFrame * accAtt.CFrame:Inverse()
            local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
            weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
            weld.Part0 = bodyPart
            weld.Part1 = handle
            weld.C0 = bodyAtt.CFrame
            weld.C1 = accAtt.CFrame
            weld.Parent = handle
        else
            handle.CFrame = bodyPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
            local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
            weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
            weld.Part0 = bodyPart
            weld.Part1 = handle
            weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
            weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
            weld.Parent = handle
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if not handle:FindFirstChild("WCMark") then
            local wc = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            wc.Name = "WCMark"
            wc.Part0 = bodyPart
            wc.Part1 = handle
            wc.Parent = handle
        end
    end)
    return jahvex_handleHasWeld(handle)
end

function jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, acc)
    if not hum or not acc then return false end
    local char = hum.Parent
    if not char then return false end

    local isFace = jahvex_isFaceAccessory(acc)
    jahvex_cacheFaceAccTemplate(acc)

    local existingOurs = nil
    pcall(function()
        local old = char:FindFirstChild(acc.Name)
        if old and (old:IsA("Accessory") or old:IsA("Hat")) then
            if old:GetAttribute("jxAcc") or old:GetAttribute("jxFaceAcc") then
                existingOurs = old
            else
                old:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end)
    if existingOurs then
        local eh = existingOurs:FindFirstChild("Handle") or existingOurs:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if eh and not jahvex_handleHasWeld(eh) then
            jahvex_weldAccessoryHandle(char, existingOurs, eh)
        end
        return existingOurs.Parent == char
    end

    local clone = acc:Clone()
    clone.Name = acc.Name ~= "" and acc.Name or ("jahvex_acc_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1e9)))
    jahvex_rigidizeAccessory(clone)
    pcall(function() clone:SetAttribute("jxAcc", true) end)
    pcall(function() clone:SetAttribute("jxSpoof", true) end)
    if isFace then
        pcall(function() clone:SetAttribute("jxFaceAcc", true) end)
    end

    local okAdd = pcall(function()
        hum:AddAccessory(clone)
    end)
    if not (okAdd and clone.Parent == char) then
        pcall(function() clone.Parent = char end)
    end
    if clone.Parent ~= char then
        pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end)
        return false
    end

    local handle = clone:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not handle then
        handle = clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end
    if not handle then
        pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end)
        return false
    end

    if not jahvex_handleHasWeld(handle) then
        jahvex_weldAccessoryHandle(char, clone, handle)
    else
        jahvex_prepareAccessoryHandle(handle, false)
    end

    pcall(function()

        if handle.Transparency > 0.9 then handle.Transparency = 0 end
        for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local n = string.lower(d.Name)
                if n:find("cage", 1, true) then
                    d.Transparency = 1
                elseif d.Transparency > 0.9 then
                    d.Transparency = 0
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        clone.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if parent == char then return end
            if not lastSpoofedData or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
            if not char.Parent then return end
            jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
        end)
    end)

    return clone.Parent == char
end

function jahvex_placeInstanceOnChar(char, hum, inst)
    if not inst or not char or not hum then return false end
    local placed = false
    if inst:IsA("Accessory") or inst:IsA("Hat") then
        placed = jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, inst)
    elseif inst:IsA("Shirt") or inst:IsA("Pants") or inst:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or inst:IsA("BodyColors") or inst:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
        local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass(inst.ClassName)
        if old and not jahvex_isSpoofOwned(old) then old:Destroy() end
        local c = inst:Clone()
        jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
        c.Parent = char
        placed = true
    elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
            jahvex_stripAllHeadFaces(head)
            local c = inst:Clone()
            c.Name = "face"
            c.Parent = jahvex_pickFacePaintTarget(head)
            if type(c.Texture) == "string" and c.Texture ~= "" then
                _G.jahvex_spoofFaceTexture = c.Texture
            end
            placed = true
        end
    elseif inst:IsA("Folder") or inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("Configuration") then

        local acc = inst:IsA("Accessory") and inst or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true)
        if acc then
            placed = jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, acc) or placed
        end
        for _, ch in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Accessory") or ch:IsA("Hat") then
                placed = jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, ch) or placed
            end
        end
        local shirt = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt", true)
        local pants = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants", true)
        local graphic = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("ShirtGraphic") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ShirtGraphic", true)
        local colors = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
        if shirt then
            local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local c = shirt:Clone()
            jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
            c.Parent = char
            placed = true
        end
        if pants then
            local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local c = pants:Clone()
            jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
            c.Parent = char
            placed = true
        end
        if graphic then
            local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ShirtGraphic")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local c = graphic:Clone()
            jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
            c.Parent = char
            placed = true
        end
        if colors then
            local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local c = colors:Clone()
            jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
            c.Parent = char
            placed = true
        end
        local dec = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
        if dec and (string.lower(dec.Name):find("face") or not placed) then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head and (string.lower(dec.Name):find("face") or dec.Face == Enum.NormalId.Front) then
                if type(dec.Texture) == "string" and dec.Texture ~= "" then
                    jahvex_paintHeadFace(head, dec.Texture)
                    placed = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return placed
end

function jahvex_transferFromModel(char, hum, srcModel)
    if not srcModel then return false end
    jahvex_copyWrapTargets(srcModel, char)
    local srcHead = srcModel:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local dstHead = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if srcHead and dstHead then
        jahvex_copyFace(srcHead, dstHead)
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(srcModel:GetChildren()) do
        pcall(function()
            if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
                jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, v)
            elseif v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") or v:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or v:IsA("BodyColors") or v:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
                local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass(v.ClassName)
                if old then old:Destroy() end
                local c = v:Clone()
                jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
                c.Parent = char
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, v in ipairs(srcModel:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Accessory") and v.Parent ~= srcModel then
            if not char:FindFirstChild(v.Name) then
                pcall(function() jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, v) end)
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

function jahvex_insertAssetsOntoChar(char, hum, assetIds)
    if type(assetIds) ~= "table" then return 0 end
    local seen = {}
    local count = 0
    local loadedNew = 0
    for _, id in ipairs(assetIds) do
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            local hadCache = jahvex_assetInstCache[id] ~= nil
            local inst = jahvex_loadAssetInstance(id)
            if inst then
                local ok = false
                pcall(function()
                    ok = jahvex_placeInstanceOnChar(char, hum, inst)
                end)
                if ok then count = count + 1 end
                if inst.Parent == nil then
                    pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            if not hadCache then
                loadedNew = loadedNew + 1
                if loadedNew % 4 == 0 then
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return count
end

function jahvex_collectAllAvatarAssetIds(userId, desc)
    userId = tonumber(userId)

    if userId and appearanceIdsCacheId == userId and type(appearanceIdsCache) == "table" then
        return appearanceIdsCache
    end
    local ids = {}
    local seen = {}
    local function add(id)
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            table.insert(ids, id)
        end
    end
    if desc then
        for _, id in ipairs(jahvex_collectDescAssetIds(desc)) do add(id) end
        pcall(function()
            local list = desc:GetAccessories(true)
            if type(list) == "table" then
                for _, a in ipairs(list) do
                    if type(a) == "table" then
                        add(a.AssetId or a.assetId or a.Id)
                    elseif type(a) == "number" then
                        add(a)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(jahvex_fetchAvatarAssetIds(userId)) do add(id) end
    pcall(function()
        local raw = game:HttpGet("https://avatar.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. tostring(userId) .. "/currently-wearing")
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
        if type(data) == "table" and type(data.assetIds) == "table" then
            for _, id in ipairs(data.assetIds) do add(id) end
        end
    end)
    if userId and #ids > 0 then
        appearanceIdsCache = ids
        appearanceIdsCacheId = userId
    end
    return ids
end

function jahvex_applyFaceFromId(char, faceId)
    faceId = tonumber(faceId)
    if not faceId or faceId <= 0 or not char then return false end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return false end
    local faceAsset = jahvex_loadAssetInstance(faceId)
    local placed = false
    local tex
    if faceAsset then
        pcall(function()
            if jahvex_placeInstanceOnChar(char, char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), faceAsset) then
                placed = true
            end
        end)
        local srcHead = nil
        if faceAsset:IsA("MeshPart") or faceAsset:IsA("BasePart") then
            srcHead = faceAsset
        elseif faceAsset:IsA("Model") or faceAsset:IsA("Folder") then
            srcHead = faceAsset:FindFirstChild("Head") or faceAsset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
        end
        if srcHead then
            jahvex_copyFace(srcHead, head)
            placed = true
        end
        local dec = faceAsset:IsA("Decal") and faceAsset or faceAsset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
        if dec and type(dec.Texture) == "string" and dec.Texture ~= "" then
            tex = dec.Texture
        end
        if faceAsset.Parent == nil then
            pcall(function() faceAsset:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    if not tex then
        tex = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(faceId)
    end
    jahvex_paintHeadFace(head, tex)
    return true
end

function jahvex_snapshotHead(char)
    char = char or lp.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    if head.Size.Y > 1.85 then return end
    local snap = { size = head.Size }
    local sm = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
    if sm then snap.smScale = sm.Scale end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hs = hum and hum:FindFirstChild("HeadScale")
    if hs and hs:IsA("NumberValue") then snap.headScale = hs.Value end
    _G.jahvex_headSnap = snap
    _G.jahvex_headSnapChar = char
end

function jahvex_restoreHeadScale(char)
    char = char or lp.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    if _G.jahvex_headSnapChar ~= char then
        jahvex_snapshotHead(char)
    end
    local snap = _G.jahvex_headSnap
    local wantSize = (snap and snap.size) or Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
    if (head.Size - wantSize).Magnitude > 0.04 then
        pcall(function() head.Size = wantSize end)
    end
    local sm = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
    if sm and snap and snap.smScale then
        pcall(function() sm.Scale = snap.smScale end)
    elseif sm and sm.Scale.Magnitude > 3 then
        pcall(function() sm.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) end)
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hs = hum and hum:FindFirstChild("HeadScale")
    if hs and hs:IsA("NumberValue") then
        local want = (snap and snap.headScale) or 1
        if want < 0.7 or want > 1.35 then want = 1 end
        if math.abs(hs.Value - want) > 0.02 then
            hs.Value = want
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_applyHeadless(char)
    char = char or lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    jahvex_restoreHeadScale(char)
    local want = headlessEnabled and true or false
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        head.Transparency = want and 1 or 0
        pcall(function()
            head.LocalTransparencyModifier = want and 1 or 0
        end)
        for _, d in ipairs(head:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                d.Transparency = want and 1 or 0
            end
            if d.Name == "faceGui" then
                pcall(function() d.Enabled = not want end)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, acc in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if acc:IsA("Accessory") then
            local isFace = false
            pcall(function()
                local at = acc.AccessoryType
                if at == Enum.AccessoryType.Face
                    or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyebrow
                    or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyelash
                then
                    isFace = true
                end
            end)
            local n = string.lower(acc.Name)
            if not isFace and (n:find("face") or n:find("eyelid") or n:find("lash") or n:find("brow")) then
                isFace = true
            end
            if isFace then
                for _, p in ipairs(acc:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                        p.Transparency = want and 1 or 0
                        pcall(function()
                            p.LocalTransparencyModifier = want and 1 or 0
                        end)
                    elseif p:IsA("Decal") or p:IsA("Texture") then
                        p.Transparency = want and 1 or 0
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end


if rawget(_G, "jahvex_headless_conn") then
    pcall(function() _G.jahvex_headless_conn:Disconnect() end)
    _G.jahvex_headless_conn = nil
end
do
    local _hlLast = 0
    local _fpLast = nil
    _G.jahvex_headless_conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        if not lastSpoofedData and not headlessEnabled then return end
        local now = tick()
        if now - _hlLast < 0.45 then return end
        _hlLast = now
        local char = lp.Character
        if not char then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        if lastSpoofedData then
            jahvex_updateSpoofFirstPerson(char)
            jahvex_enforceSpoofFace(char)
            jahvex_ensureFaceAccs(char)
        end
        if not headlessEnabled then return end
        if head.Size.Y > 1.7 then
            jahvex_restoreHeadScale(char)
        end
        if head.Transparency < 0.99 then
            jahvex_applyHeadless(char)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_countCharAccessories(char)
    local n = 0
    if not char then return 0 end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
            n = n + 1
        end
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_isHeadCamAccessory(acc)
    if not acc then return false end
    local at = nil
    pcall(function() at = acc.AccessoryType end)
    if at == Enum.AccessoryType.Hat or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Face or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyebrow
        or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Eyelash or at == Enum.AccessoryType.Neck then
        return true
    end
    local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle") or acc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if handle then
        if handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment") or handle:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment")
            or handle:FindFirstChild("FaceFrontAttachment") or handle:FindFirstChild("FaceCenterAttachment")
            or handle:FindFirstChild("NeckAttachment") then
            return true
        end
    end
    return jahvex_isFaceAccessory(acc)
end

function jahvex_updateSpoofFirstPerson(char)
    char = char or lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not head or not cam then return end
    local dist = (cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
    local fp = dist < 3.6
    if _G._jahvex_fpHideState == fp and _G._jahvex_fpHideChar == char then
        return
    end
    _G._jahvex_fpHideState = fp
    _G._jahvex_fpHideChar = char
    local hideHeadAcc = fp
    if not headlessEnabled then
        pcall(function()
            head.LocalTransparencyModifier = fp and 1 or 0
        end)
    end
    for _, acc in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if acc:IsA("Accessory") or acc:IsA("Hat") then
            if jahvex_isHeadCamAccessory(acc) then
                for _, d in ipairs(acc:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hideHeadAcc and 1 or 0
                    elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                        if hideHeadAcc then
                            d.Transparency = 1
                        elseif d.Transparency > 0.95 then
                            d.Transparency = 0
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

if rawget(_G, "jahvex_fpHide_conn") then
    pcall(function() _G.jahvex_fpHide_conn:Disconnect() end)
    _G.jahvex_fpHide_conn = nil
end

function jahvex_applyDescColorsAndFace(char, desc)
    if not char or not desc then return end
    pcall(function()
        local bc = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
        if not bc then
            bc = Instance.new("BodyColors")
            bc.Parent = char
        end
        bc.HeadColor3 = desc.HeadColor
        bc.TorsoColor3 = desc.TorsoColor
        bc.LeftArmColor3 = desc.LeftArmColor
        bc.RightArmColor3 = desc.RightArmColor
        bc.LeftLegColor3 = desc.LeftLegColor
        bc.RightLegColor3 = desc.RightLegColor
        jahvex_markSpoofOwned(bc)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local faceId = tonumber(desc.Face)
        if faceId and faceId > 0 then
            jahvex_applyFaceFromId(char, faceId)
        end
    end)
end


function jahvex_applyAvatarToChar(char, userId, opts)
    userId = tonumber(userId)
    opts = opts or {}
    if not char or not userId or not char.Parent then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
        hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    end
    if not hum then return false end
    jahvex_snapshotHead(char)
    jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)

    local expectAcc = jahvex_expectedFaceAccCount()
    local haveAcc = jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char)
    if opts.skipIfDressed and not opts.strip then
        if expectAcc > 0 and haveAcc >= expectAcc then
            jahvex_updateSpoofFirstPerson(char)
            jahvex_applyHeadless(char)
            return true
        end
        if expectAcc > 0 then
            jahvex_reapplyCachedFaceAccs(char)
            jahvex_updateSpoofFirstPerson(char)
            jahvex_applyHeadless(char)
            if jahvex_countTaggedFaceAcc(char) >= expectAcc then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    local desc = jahvex_getHumanoidDescription(userId)
    if desc then
        pcall(function()
            desc.ClimbAnimation = 0
            desc.FallAnimation = 0
            desc.IdleAnimation = 0
            desc.JumpAnimation = 0
            desc.MoodAnimation = 0
            desc.RunAnimation = 0
            desc.SwimAnimation = 0
            desc.WalkAnimation = 0
            desc.Head = 0
        end)
    end

    local allIds = jahvex_collectAllAvatarAssetIds(userId, desc)
    if opts.strip ~= false then
        jahvex_stripCharacterAppearance(char)
    end

    jahvex_applyDescColorsAndFace(char, desc)

    if #allIds > 0 then
        jahvex_insertAssetsOntoChar(char, hum, allIds)
    end

    local appearance = jahvex_getAppearanceClone(userId)
    if appearance then
        for _, v in ipairs(appearance:GetChildren()) do
            pcall(function()
                if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
                    jahvex_addAccessorySafe(hum, v)
                elseif v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") or v:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or v:IsA("BodyColors") then
                    local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass(v.ClassName)
                    if old then old:Destroy() end
                    local c = v:Clone()
                    jahvex_markSpoofOwned(c)
                    c.Parent = char
                elseif v:IsA("Decal") then
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if head and type(v.Texture) == "string" and v.Texture ~= "" then
                        jahvex_paintHeadFace(head, v.Texture)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        pcall(function() appearance:Destroy() end)
    end

    jahvex_bindFaceAccPersist(char)
    jahvex_scheduleFaceAccRestore(char)
    jahvex_restoreHeadScale(char)
    jahvex_applyHeadless(char)
    jahvex_updateSpoofFirstPerson(char)
    if desc then
        pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
    end
    return jahvex_countCharAccessories(char) > 0
end

function applyIdentityToCharacter(char, data)
    if not char or not data then return end
    local uid = data.id or data.Id
    task.spawn(function()
        if avatarSpoofBusy then
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
        avatarSpoofBusy = true
        pcall(function()
            jahvex_bindFaceAccPersist(char)
            jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
            char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
            task.wait(0.12)
            jahvex_applyAvatarToChar(char, uid, { strip = true })

            task.wait(0.45)
            if char.Parent and lastSpoofedData and (lastSpoofedData.id or lastSpoofedData.Id) == uid then
                jahvex_applyAvatarToChar(char, uid, { strip = false, skipIfDressed = true })
            end
            jahvex_applyHeadless(char)
        end)
        avatarSpoofBusy = false
    end)
end

function jahvex_enforceAvatarSpoof(char, passes)
    if not lastSpoofedData then return end
    local uid = lastSpoofedData.id or lastSpoofedData.Id
    if not uid then return end
    avatarSpoofToken = avatarSpoofToken + 1
    local token = avatarSpoofToken
    passes = math.min(passes or 3, 3)
    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 1, passes do
            if avatarSpoofToken ~= token or not lastSpoofedData then break end
            local c = char or lp.Character
            if c and c.Parent then
                pcall(function()


                    jahvex_applyAvatarToChar(c, uid, { strip = (i == 1), skipIfDressed = (i > 1) })
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.6 + (i * 0.2))
        end
    end)
end

function applyIdentitySpoof(targetID)
    local idNum = tonumber(tostring(targetID):match("%d+"))
    if not idNum or idNum <= 0 then
        setStatus("Enter a valid User ID", RED)
        return
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        setStatus("Loading avatar...", TEXT_DIM)
        local success, data = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(
                game:HttpGet("https://users.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. tostring(idNum))
            )
        end)
        if not (success and data and (data.id or data.Id)) then

            data = {id = idNum, name = tostring(idNum), displayName = tostring(idNum)}
            local probe = jahvex_getHumanoidDescription(idNum)
            if not probe then
                setStatus("Cannot read ID / no avatar", RED)
                return
            end
            pcall(function() probe:Destroy() end)
        end
        spoofedData = data
        local uid = data.id or data.Id or idNum
        jahvex_clearAppearanceCache()
        lastSpoofedData = data
        lastSpoofedData.id = uid
        lastAvatarSpoofId = tostring(uid)

        local char = lp.Character
        if char then
            jahvex_enforceAvatarSpoof(char, 2)
        end
        if nameChangerEnabled then
            pcall(updateNameProperties, currentCustomName)
        else
            pcall(function()
                lp.DisplayName = realDisplayName
            end)
        end
        pcall(jahvex_patchWorldLeaderboardNames)
        setStatus("Avatar: " .. tostring(data.displayName or data.name or uid), GREEN)
        saveConfig()
        pcall(function()
            if jahvexUiRefs.userIDBox then
                jahvexUiRefs.userIDBox.Text = tostring(uid)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

_nameScanLast = 0
function jahvex_wantedBoardName()
    if nameChangerEnabled and currentCustomName and currentCustomName ~= "" then
        return currentCustomName
    end
    return realDisplayName or realName or "jahvex user"
end

function jahvex_patchWorldLeaderboardNames()
    local want = jahvex_wantedBoardName()
    local steal = {}
    if lastSpoofedData then
        if lastSpoofedData.displayName then table.insert(steal, tostring(lastSpoofedData.displayName)) end
        if lastSpoofedData.name then table.insert(steal, tostring(lastSpoofedData.name)) end
    end
    table.insert(steal, realDisplayName)
    table.insert(steal, realName)
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            local t0 = tick()
            for _, gui in ipairs(lp.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
                if gui.Name:find("Leaderboard") or gui:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                    for _, v in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                        if v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton") then
                            local t = v.Text
                            for _, s in ipairs(steal) do
                                if s ~= "" and t == s then
                                    v.Text = want
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if tick() - t0 > 0.015 then task.wait(); t0 = tick() end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function updateNameProperties(customDisp, customUser)
    pcall(function()
        if customDisp and customDisp ~= "" then lp.DisplayName = customDisp end
    end)
    local now = tick()
    if now - _nameScanLast < 5 then
        task.spawn(jahvex_patchWorldLeaderboardNames)
        return
    end
    _nameScanLast = now
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if not pg then return end
            local t0 = tick()
            for _, v in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton") then
                    local t = v.Text
                    if t == realDisplayName and customDisp ~= "" then
                        v.Text = customDisp
                    elseif t == realName and customUser ~= "" then
                        v.Text = customUser
                    elseif lastSpoofedData then
                        if t == tostring(lastSpoofedData.displayName) and customDisp ~= "" then
                            v.Text = customDisp
                        elseif t == tostring(lastSpoofedData.name) and customUser ~= "" then
                            v.Text = customUser
                        end
                    end
                end
                if tick() - t0 > 0.015 then task.wait(); t0 = tick() end
            end
        end)
        pcall(jahvex_patchWorldLeaderboardNames)
    end)
end

function jahvex_realDeviceControls()
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local last = UIS:GetLastInputType()
    if UIS.VREnabled then return "VR" end
    if last == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return "Touch" end
    if last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
        or last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3 or last == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4 then
        return "Gamepad"
    end
    return "MouseKeyboard"
end

_G.jahvex_patchProfilePayload = function(result, target)
    if type(result) ~= "table" or target == nil then
        return result
    end
    local isSelf = false
    local isCe = false
    if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
        isSelf = (target == lp)
        isCe = customEnemyEnabled and customEnemyTarget and (target == customEnemyTarget)
    elseif typeof(target) == "number" then
        isSelf = (target == lp.UserId)
        isCe = customEnemyEnabled and customEnemyTarget and (target == customEnemyTarget.UserId)
    elseif typeof(target) == "string" then
        isSelf = (target == lp.Name or target == tostring(lp.UserId))
        isCe = customEnemyEnabled and customEnemyTarget
            and (target == customEnemyTarget.Name or target == tostring(customEnemyTarget.UserId))
    end
    local function profileElo()
        if charmSpoofEnabled then
            return math.min(tonumber(spoofedCharmElo) or 0, 10000)
        end
        if eloSpoofEnabled then
            return tonumber(spoofedElo) or 0
        end
        return nil
    end
    if isCe then
        result.Level = ceLevel
        result.RankedCurrentELO = ceElo
        result.DisplayELO = ceElo
        return result
    end
    if not isSelf then
        return result
    end
    if levelSpoofEnabled then
        result.Level = spoofedLevel
    end
    local elo = profileElo()
    if elo ~= nil then
        result.RankedCurrentELO = elo
        result.DisplayELO = elo
    end
    if statsSpoofEnabled then
        result.CasualWins = spoofedCasualWins
        result.RankedWins = spoofedRankedWins


        local function winPctToServer(v)
            v = tonumber(v)
            if v == nil then return -1 end
            if v < 0 then return -1 end
            if v > 1 then
                return math.clamp(v / 100, 0, 1)
            end
            return math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
        end
        result.CasualWinPercent = winPctToServer(spoofedCasualWinPercent)
        result.RankedWinPercent = winPctToServer(spoofedRankedWinPercent)
    end
    if profileWeaponsSpoofEnabled then
        local function entry(name, fallback)
            name = tostring(name or "")
            if name == "" then
                if type(fallback) == "table" and type(fallback.Name) == "string" then
                    return fallback
                end
                return nil
            end
            local lvl, xp, prest = 1, 0, 0
            if type(fallback) == "table" then
                lvl = tonumber(fallback.Level) or 1
                xp = tonumber(fallback.XP) or 0
                prest = tonumber(fallback.Prestige) or 0
            end
            return { Name = name, Level = lvl, Prestige = prest, XP = xp }
        end
        local old = result.FavoriteWeapons
        local o1 = type(old) == "table" and old[1] or nil
        local o2 = type(old) == "table" and old[2] or nil
        local o3 = type(old) == "table" and old[3] or nil
        local o4 = type(old) == "table" and old[4] or nil
        local fw = {}
        local e1 = entry(profileWeaponPrimary, o1)
        local e2 = entry(profileWeaponSecondary, o2)
        local e3 = entry(profileWeaponMelee, o3)
        local e4 = entry(profileWeaponUtility, o4)
        if e1 then fw[#fw + 1] = e1 end
        if e2 then fw[#fw + 1] = e2 end
        if e3 then fw[#fw + 1] = e3 end
        if e4 then fw[#fw + 1] = e4 end
        if #fw > 0 then
            result.FavoriteWeapons = fw
        end
    end
    if favoriteMapSpoofEnabled and type(favoriteMapSpoof) == "string" and favoriteMapSpoof ~= "" then
        result.FavoriteMap = favoriteMapSpoof
    end
    return result
end


_G.jahvex_applyProfileRankSpoof = function(page)
    if type(page) ~= "table" then return end
    local plr = page._last_player_object
    if plr ~= lp then return end
    local elo = nil
    if charmSpoofEnabled then
        elo = math.min(tonumber(spoofedCharmElo) or 0, 10000)
    elseif eloSpoofEnabled then
        elo = tonumber(spoofedElo) or 0
    end
    pcall(function()
        if elo ~= nil then
            local seasonLib = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SeasonLibrary)
            local rankName = seasonLib:GetRank(elo, lp.UserId)
            if page.RankText then
                page.RankText.Text = tostring(rankName or "")
            end
            if page._rank_icon then
                pcall(function() page._rank_icon:Destroy() end)
                page._rank_icon = nil
            end
            local RankIcon = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.RankIcon)
            local icon = RankIcon.new(elo, lp.UserId)
            page._rank_icon = icon
            if page.RankContainer then
                icon:SetParent(page.RankContainer)
            end
            if page.RankFrame then
                page.RankFrame.Visible = true
            end
        end
        if favoriteMapSpoofEnabled and type(favoriteMapSpoof) == "string" and favoriteMapSpoof ~= "" and page.MostPlayedMap then
            local DL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.DuelLibrary)
            local info = DL and DL.Maps and DL.Maps[favoriteMapSpoof]
            if type(info) == "table" and type(info.Image) == "string" then
                page.MostPlayedMap.Image = info.Image
            end
        end

        if statsSpoofEnabled then
            local StatisticsLibrary = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.StatisticsLibrary)
            local function winPctToServer(v)
                v = tonumber(v)
                if v == nil or v < 0 then return -1 end
                if v > 1 then return math.clamp(v / 100, 0, 1) end
                return math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
            end
            local cWins = tonumber(spoofedCasualWins) or 0
            local rWins = tonumber(spoofedRankedWins) or 0
            local cPct = winPctToServer(spoofedCasualWinPercent)
            local rPct = winPctToServer(spoofedRankedWinPercent)
            if page.CasualWinsTitle then
                page.CasualWinsTitle.Text = (cWins ~= 1) and "wins" or "win"
            end
            if page.CasualWinsText and StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticDuelsWon then
                page.CasualWinsText.Text = StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticDuelsWon.TostringFunction(cWins)
            end
            if page.CasualWinPercentText and StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticDuelsWinPercent then
                page.CasualWinPercentText.Text = StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticDuelsWinPercent.TostringFunction(cPct)
            end
            if page.RankedWinsTitle then
                page.RankedWinsTitle.Text = (rWins ~= 1) and "wins" or "win"
            end
            if page.RankedWinsText and StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticRankedDuelsWon then
                page.RankedWinsText.Text = StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticRankedDuelsWon.TostringFunction(rWins)
            end
            if page.RankedWinPercentText and StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticRankedDuelsWinPercent then
                page.RankedWinPercentText.Text = StatisticsLibrary.Info.StatisticRankedDuelsWinPercent.TostringFunction(rPct)
            end

            if page.WinsButton then page.WinsButton.Visible = true end
            if page.RankFrame then page.RankFrame.Visible = true end
            if type(page.SwitchWinsTab) == "function" then
                local wantCasual = page._wins_tab_is_casual
                if wantCasual == nil then wantCasual = true end
                page._wins_tab_is_casual = wantCasual and true or false
                page.WinsButtonCasualBackground.BackgroundTransparency = page._wins_tab_is_casual and 0 or 0.75
                page.CasualFrame.Visible = page._wins_tab_is_casual
                page.WinsButtonRankedBackground.BackgroundTransparency = page._wins_tab_is_casual and 0.75 or 0
                page.RankedFrame.Visible = not page._wins_tab_is_casual
            end
        end
    end)
end

    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)

    local requestProfile = misc and misc:WaitForChild("RequestProfile", 10)
