task.spawn(function()
    local ok, viewProfile = pcall(function()
        return require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.Pages:WaitForChild("ViewProfile", 10))
    end)
    if not ok or type(viewProfile) ~= "table" or type(viewProfile.Fetch) ~= "function" then return end
    if viewProfile._jahvexRankHooked then return end
    viewProfile._jahvexRankHooked = true
    local oldFetch = viewProfile.Fetch
    viewProfile.Fetch = function(self, ...)
        local a = table.pack(oldFetch(self, ...))
        local apply = rawget(_G, "jahvex_applyProfileRankSpoof")
        if apply then
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(apply, self)
            end)
        end
        return table.unpack(a, 1, a.n)
    end


    if type(viewProfile.SwitchWinsTab) == "function" then
        local oldSwitch = viewProfile.SwitchWinsTab
        viewProfile.SwitchWinsTab = function(self, isCasual, ...)
            if statsSpoofEnabled and self and self._last_player_object == lp then
                local casual = isCasual and true or false
                self.WinsButton.Visible = true
                if self.RankFrame then self.RankFrame.Visible = true end
                self._wins_tab_is_casual = casual
                if self.WinsButtonCasualBackground then
                    self.WinsButtonCasualBackground.BackgroundTransparency = casual and 0 or 0.75
                end
                if self.CasualFrame then self.CasualFrame.Visible = casual end
                if self.WinsButtonRankedBackground then
                    self.WinsButtonRankedBackground.BackgroundTransparency = casual and 0.75 or 0
                end
                if self.RankedFrame then self.RankedFrame.Visible = not casual end
                return
            end
            return oldSwitch(self, isCasual, ...)
        end
    end
end)

    local ok, RankIcon = pcall(function()
        return require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules:WaitForChild("RankIcon", 10))

    if not ok or type(RankIcon) ~= "table" or type(RankIcon.new) ~= "function" then return end

    RankIcon._jahvexEloHooked = true
    local oldNew = RankIcon.new

        local mp = getgenv().__jx_mp_bar == true

            return oldNew(elo, userId, ranking or (1 / 0), ...)
        end
        local isLocal = (userId == nil)
            or (typeof(userId) == "number" and userId == lp.UserId)
            or (tostring(userId) == tostring(lp.UserId))
        if isLocal then
            if charmSpoofEnabled then
                elo = math.min(tonumber(spoofedCharmElo) or 0, 10000)
            elseif eloSpoofEnabled then
                elo = tonumber(spoofedElo) or elo
            end
        end
        return oldNew(elo, userId, ranking, ...)
    end
end)

        if mp then

        end
        local isLocal = (userId == nil)
            or (typeof(userId) == "number" and userId == lp.UserId)
            or (tostring(userId) == tostring(lp.UserId))
        if isLocal then

            elseif eloSpoofEnabled then

            end
            if rankedLbSpoofEnabled then
                ranking = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spoofedRankedPlacement) or 1), 1, 200)
            end
        end
        return origGetRank(self, elo, userId, ranking, ...)
    end

    local origHighest = seasonLib.GetHighestELOLeaderboardRanking
    if type(origHighest) == "function" then

            local elo, userId = eloOrUserId, userIdOrNil
            local isLocal = (userId == nil and typeof(elo) == "number" and elo == lp.UserId)
                or (typeof(userId) == "number" and userId == lp.UserId)
                or (userId ~= nil and tostring(userId) == tostring(lp.UserId))
                or (userId == nil and elo == nil)
            if isLocal then
                if getgenv().__jx_mp_bar == true then
                    return origHighest(self, eloOrUserId, userIdOrNil, ...)
                end
                if lbSpoofEnabled and lbKind == "elo" then
                    return jahvex_lbPlaceForKind("elo")
                end
                if rankedLbSpoofEnabled then
                    return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spoofedRankedPlacement) or 1), 1, 200)
                end
            end
            return origHighest(self, eloOrUserId, userIdOrNil, ...)
        end
    end
end)


function jahvex_lbPlaceClamp(n)
    return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 1), 1, 999)
end

function jahvex_lbSerialForKind(kind)
    if kind == "level" then return "Highest Level" end
    if kind == "streak" then return "Current Highest Win Streak" end
    if kind == "elo" then return "Highest ELO" end
    if kind == "kill" then return "Most Eliminations" end
    return "Highest Level"
end

function jahvex_lbPlaceForKind(kind)
    local raw
    if kind == "streak" then raw = lbPlaceStreak
    elseif kind == "elo" then raw = lbPlaceElo
    elseif kind == "kill" then raw = lbPlaceKill
    else raw = lbPlaceLevel end
    if raw == nil then return nil end
    return jahvex_lbPlaceClamp(raw)
end

function jahvex_lbValueForKind(kind)
    if kind == "level" then return tonumber(spoofedLevel) or 100 end
    if kind == "streak" then return tonumber(spoofedStreak) or 0 end
    if kind == "kill" then return tonumber(spoofedLbKills) or 0 end
    local eloVal = spoofedElo
    pcall(function()
        if not eloSpoofEnabled then
            eloVal = lp:GetAttribute("DisplayELO") or eloVal
        end
    end)
    return tonumber(eloVal) or 3600
end

_jahvexLbLastUiAt = 0
_jahvexLbUiSerial = nil

function jahvex_lbPatchTargets()
    local LC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.LeaderboardController)
    if not LC or type(LC.LeaderboardSerials) ~= "table" then return nil, false end
    local serials = {
        "Highest Level",
        "Current Highest Win Streak",
        "Highest ELO",
        "Most Eliminations",
    }
    local targets = {}
    local focus = nil
    if lbSpoofEnabled then
        local kind = lbKind or "level"
        focus = jahvex_lbSerialForKind(kind)
        targets[focus] = {
            place = jahvex_lbPlaceForKind(kind),
            value = jahvex_lbValueForKind(kind),
        }
    end
    if rankedLbSpoofEnabled and not (lbSpoofEnabled and lbKind == "elo") then
        targets["Highest ELO"] = {
            place = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spoofedRankedPlacement) or 1), 1, 200),
            value = jahvex_lbValueForKind("elo"),
        }
        if not focus then focus = "Highest ELO" end
    end

    local changed = false
    for _, serial in ipairs(serials) do
        local board = LC.LeaderboardSerials[serial]
        local want = targets[serial]
        if want then
            local curI, curV = jahvex_lbFindSelf(board)
            local maxPlace = ((board and board.Players and #board.Players) or 0) + 1
            local wantPlace = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(want.place) or 1), 1, maxPlace)
            if curI ~= wantPlace or tonumber(curV) ~= tonumber(want.value) then
                jahvex_lbStripSelf(board)
                jahvex_lbInsertSelf(board, want.place, want.value)
                changed = true
            end
        else
            if jahvex_lbFindSelf(board) then
                jahvex_lbStripSelf(board)
                changed = true
            end
        end
    end
    return focus, changed
end


function jahvex_lbFixBlankNames()
    pcall(function()
        local LD = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.LobbyElements.LeaderboardDisplays)
        if not (LD and type(LD.Displays) == "table") then return end
        local uidStr = tostring(lp.UserId)
        local dn = tostring(lp.DisplayName or lp.Name or "?")
        local un = tostring(lp.Name or "")
        local headshot = nil
        pcall(function()
            local CONSTANTS = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CONSTANTS)
            if CONSTANTS and CONSTANTS.HEADSHOT_IMAGE then
                headshot = string.format(CONSTANTS.HEADSHOT_IMAGE, lp.UserId)
            end
        end)
        for _, disp in pairs(LD.Displays) do
            local board = disp and disp._leaderboard_serial
            if type(board) == "table" and type(board.Players) == "table" and type(disp._player_slots) == "table" then
                local myPlace = nil
                for i, e in ipairs(board.Players) do
                    if type(e) == "table" and tostring(e.key) == uidStr then
                        myPlace = i
                        break
                    end
                end
                if myPlace then
                    for _, slot in pairs(disp._player_slots) do
                        if typeof(slot) == "Instance" and slot.LayoutOrder == myPlace then
                            local blank = false
                            pcall(function()
                                local t = slot.Left.DisplayName.Text
                                blank = (t == nil or t == "" or t == "• • •" or t == "..." or t == "Loading...")
                            end)
                            if blank then
                                pcall(function() slot.Left.DisplayName.Text = dn end)
                                pcall(function()
                                    slot.Left.Username.Text = (un ~= "" and ("@" .. un) or "")
                                end)
                                if headshot then
                                    pcall(function() slot.Left.Headshot.Image = headshot end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_lbShowSerial(targetSerial, force)
    if not targetSerial then return end
    local now = tick()
    if not force and _jahvexLbUiSerial == targetSerial and (now - (_jahvexLbLastUiAt or 0)) < 1.25 then
        return
    end
    if not force and (now - (_jahvexLbLastUiAt or 0)) < 0.75 then
        return
    end
    _jahvexLbLastUiAt = now
    _jahvexLbUiSerial = targetSerial
    pcall(function()
        local LD = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.LobbyElements.LeaderboardDisplays)
        if not (LD and type(LD.Displays) == "table") then return end
        for _, disp in pairs(LD.Displays) do
            if type(disp) == "table" then
                pcall(function()
                    if type(disp.SelectLeaderboard) == "function"
                        and type(disp._leaderboard_buttons) == "table"
                        and disp._leaderboard_buttons[targetSerial] then
                        disp:SelectLeaderboard(targetSerial)
                    elseif disp._leaderboard_name == targetSerial and type(disp.Refresh) == "function" then
                        disp:Refresh()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
    task.delay(1.2, jahvex_lbFixBlankNames)
    task.delay(2.5, jahvex_lbFixBlankNames)
end

function jahvex_lbSpoofDirty()
    if not (rankedLbSpoofEnabled or lbSpoofEnabled) then return end

    pcall(function() jahvex_lbPatchTargets() end)
    task.delay(1.0, jahvex_lbFixBlankNames)
end

function jahvex_lbStripSelf(board)
    if type(board) ~= "table" or type(board.Players) ~= "table" then return end
    local uidStr = tostring(lp.UserId)
    for i = #board.Players, 1, -1 do
        local e = board.Players[i]
        if type(e) == "table" and tostring(e.key) == uidStr then
            table.remove(board.Players, i)
        end
    end
end

function jahvex_lbInsertSelf(board, place, value)
    if type(board) ~= "table" or type(board.Players) ~= "table" then return end
    local uidStr = tostring(lp.UserId)
    place = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(place) or 1), 1, #board.Players + 1)
    table.insert(board.Players, place, { key = uidStr, value = tonumber(value) or 0 })
    if type(board.NumPlayers) == "number" then
        board.NumPlayers = #board.Players
    end
    return place
end

function jahvex_lbFindSelf(board)
    if type(board) ~= "table" or type(board.Players) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local uidStr = tostring(lp.UserId)
    for i, e in ipairs(board.Players) do
        if type(e) == "table" and tostring(e.key) == uidStr then
            return i, e.value
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_lbSpoofedRankForSerial(serialName)
    local n = tostring(serialName)
    if lbSpoofEnabled and n == jahvex_lbSerialForKind(lbKind) then
        return jahvex_lbPlaceForKind(lbKind)
    end
    if rankedLbSpoofEnabled and n == "Highest ELO" then
        return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(spoofedRankedPlacement) or 1), 1, 200)
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_applyRankedLeaderboardSpoof(forceRefresh)
    pcall(function()
        local focus, changed = jahvex_lbPatchTargets()
        if forceRefresh or changed then
            if focus then
                jahvex_lbShowSerial(focus, forceRefresh and true or false)
            end
            if rankedLbSpoofEnabled and focus ~= "Highest ELO" and (forceRefresh or changed) then
                jahvex_lbShowSerial("Highest ELO", false)
            end
            pcall(jahvex_patchWorldLeaderboardNames)
        else
            jahvex_lbFixBlankNames()
        end
    end)
end

pcall(function()
    getgenv().jahvex_applyRankedLeaderboardSpoof = jahvex_applyRankedLeaderboardSpoof
    getgenv().jahvex_lbShowSerial = jahvex_lbShowSerial
    getgenv().jahvex_lbFixBlankNames = jahvex_lbFixBlankNames
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local okLC, LC = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Controllers"):WaitForChild("LeaderboardController", 10))
    if not okLC or type(LC) ~= "table" then return end
    local mt = getmetatable(LC)
    local idx = mt and (type(mt.__index) == "table" and mt.__index or mt)
    if type(idx) ~= "table" or type(idx.GetRankingByUserID) ~= "function" then return end
    if not idx._jahvex_ranked_orig then
        idx._jahvex_ranked_orig = idx.GetRankingByUserID
    end
    local origGetRanking = idx._jahvex_ranked_orig
    idx._jahvex_ranked_hooked = true
    idx.GetRankingByUserID = function(self, name, userId, ...)
        local uid = tonumber(userId) or userId
        if tonumber(uid) == lp.UserId or tostring(uid) == tostring(lp.UserId) then
            local spoofed = jahvex_lbSpoofedRankForSerial(name)
            if spoofed then return spoofed end
        end
        return origGetRanking(self, name, userId, ...)
    end
    if not idx._jahvex_lb_sig_hooked then
        idx._jahvex_lb_sig_hooked = true
        local serials = {
            "Highest ELO",
            "Highest Level",
            "Current Highest Win Streak",
            "Most Eliminations",
        }
        for _, serial in ipairs(serials) do
            pcall(function()
                local sig = LC:GetLeaderboardRefreshedSignal(serial)
                if sig and type(sig.Connect) == "function" then
                    jahvex_track(sig:Connect(function()
                        jahvex_lbSpoofDirty()
                    end))
                end
            end)
        end
        pcall(function()
            if LC.Refreshed and type(LC.Refreshed.Connect) == "function" then
                jahvex_track(LC.Refreshed:Connect(function()
                    jahvex_lbSpoofDirty()
                end))
            end
        end)
    end
end)


task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(3)
        if lbSpoofEnabled or rankedLbSpoofEnabled then
            pcall(function()
                local focus, changed = jahvex_lbPatchTargets()
                if changed and focus then
                    jahvex_lbShowSerial(focus, false)
                else
                    jahvex_lbFixBlankNames()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

end

jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not lastSpoofedData or not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
    if avatarSpoofBusy then return end
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local now = tick()
    if not rawget(_G, "_jahvex_avatar_last_strip") then
        _G._jahvex_avatar_last_strip = 0
    end
    if now - _G._jahvex_avatar_last_strip >= 1.6 then
        _G._jahvex_avatar_last_strip = now
        jahvex_stripForeignAppearance(char)
    end
    if not rawget(_G, "_jahvex_avatar_last_enforce") then
        _G._jahvex_avatar_last_enforce = 0
    end
    if now - _G._jahvex_avatar_last_enforce < 6.0 then return end
    _G._jahvex_avatar_last_enforce = now
    local accCount = 0
    local hasClothes = false
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if (v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat")) and jahvex_isSpoofOwned(v) then
            accCount = accCount + 1
        elseif (v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") or v:IsA("ShirtGraphic")) and jahvex_isSpoofOwned(v) then
            hasClothes = true
        end
    end
    if accCount == 0 and not hasClothes then
        jahvex_enforceAvatarSpoof(char, 2)
    end
end))

local JX_SOLARA_IDS = {
    "rbxassetid://86806707642727",
    "rbxassetid://118493257042591",
    "rbxassetid://110835852737455",
}

currentAnimTrack = nil
currentAnimTracks = {}
animConnection = nil


pcall(function()
    local m = jahvexConfigExtra and jahvexConfigExtra.misc
    if type(m) == "table" then
        if m.emoteEnabled ~= nil then emoteEnabled = m.emoteEnabled and true or false end
        if m.currentEmoteId ~= nil then currentEmoteId = m.currentEmoteId end
    end
end)

function stopEmoteAnim()
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_12") end)
    if _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn then
        pcall(function() _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn = nil
    end
    if _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn then
        pcall(function() _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn = nil
    end
    if currentAnimTrack then
        pcall(function() currentAnimTrack:Stop(0.05) end)
        currentAnimTrack = nil
    end
    for _, t in pairs(currentAnimTracks) do
        pcall(function()
            t:Stop(0.05)
        end)
    end
    currentAnimTracks = {}
    if animConnection then
        pcall(function() animConnection:Disconnect() end)
        animConnection = nil
    end
    if headlessEnabled then
        task.defer(function()
            jahvex_applyHeadless(lp.Character)
        end)
    end
end

local function jahvex_emoteLoader(hum)
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    return function(id)
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = id
        if animator then
            return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        end
        return hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
    end
end

function playEmoteById(emoteId)
    stopEmoteAnim()
    if not emoteEnabled or not emoteId then return end

    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    local loadAnim = jahvex_emoteLoader(hum)
    local function playTrack(id, looped, speed, weight)
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            local t = loadAnim(id)
            t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            t.Looped = looped and true or false
            t:Play(0)
            t:AdjustWeight(weight or 1, 0)
            t:AdjustSpeed(speed or 1)
            return t
        end)
        if ok and track then
            table.insert(currentAnimTracks, track)
            return track
        end
        return nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        if tostring(emoteId) == "solara" then
            for i, id in ipairs(JX_SOLARA_IDS) do
                playTrack(id, true, i == 1 and 1.29 or 2.8, i == 1 and 1 or 0)
            end
            currentAnimTrack = currentAnimTracks[1]
            for _, track in ipairs(currentAnimTracks) do
                pcall(function()
                    track.Ended:Connect(function()
                        if emoteEnabled and currentEmoteId == "solara" and lp.Character == char then
                            pcall(function()
                                track:Play(0)
                            end)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            return
        end

        local animId = tostring(emoteId)
        if not animId:find("rbxassetid://") then
            animId = "rbxassetid://" .. animId
        end
        currentAnimTrack = playTrack(animId, true, 1, 1)
        if currentAnimTrack then
            animConnection = currentAnimTrack.Ended:Connect(function()
                if emoteEnabled and lp.Character == char and currentEmoteId == emoteId then
                    playEmoteById(emoteId)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    jahvex_emoteBindHold(char)
end

function jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying()
    if not emoteEnabled or not currentEmoteId then return end
    for i, t in ipairs(currentAnimTracks) do
        pcall(function()
            t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            t.Looped = true
            if not t.IsPlaying then
                t:Play(0)
            end
            local w = 1
            if tostring(currentEmoteId) == "solara" and i > 1 then
                w = 0
            end
            t:AdjustWeight(w, 0)
        end)
    end
    if currentAnimTrack then
        pcall(function()
            currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            if not currentAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
                currentAnimTrack:Play(0)
            end
            currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(1, 0)
        end)
    end
end

function jahvex_emoteBindHold(char)
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("__rb_12") end)
    if _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn then
        pcall(function() _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn = nil
    end
    if _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn then
        pcall(function() _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn = nil
    end
    if not emoteEnabled or not currentEmoteId then return end
    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("__rb_12", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 8, function()
            if not getgenv().jahvex_alive or not emoteEnabled then return end
            jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying()
        end)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local FC = FighterController or FighterController2
        if not FC then
            FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end
        local lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
        if lf and lf.GetDataChangedSignal then
            local sig = lf:GetDataChangedSignal("IsCrouching")
            if sig then
                _G.JahvexEmoteCrouchConn = sig:Connect(function()
                    task.defer(jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying)
                    task.delay(0.05, jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying)
                    task.delay(0.15, jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        local refresh = animate and animate:FindFirstChild("Refresh")
        if refresh and refresh:IsA("BindableEvent") then
            _G.JahvexEmoteRefreshConn = refresh.Event:Connect(function()
                task.defer(jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying)
                task.delay(0.03, jahvex_emoteKeepPlaying)
            end)
        end
    end)
end

    if not id then
        setStatus("Invalid custom emote ID", RED)
        return
    end
    currentEmoteId = id:gsub("rbxassetid://", "")
    selectedEmoteIndex = nil
    for _, b in pairs(emoteButtons or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            b.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
            b.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        end)
    end
    if emoteEnabled then
        playEmoteById(currentEmoteId)
    end
    setStatus("Emote: Custom", GREEN)
    saveConfig()
end)

    btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = emote.name
    btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM

    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.ZIndex = 4
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    makeCorner(btn, 4)
    makeStroke(btn, BORDER, 1)

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if btn.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65) then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_HOV
        end
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if selectedEmoteIndex == i then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        end
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if selectedEmoteIndex then
            local prevBtn = emoteButtons[selectedEmoteIndex]
            if prevBtn then
                prevBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
                prevBtn.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            end
        end
        selectedEmoteIndex = i
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
        btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_W

        currentEmoteId = emote.id
        if emoteEnabled then
            playEmoteById(currentEmoteId)
        end
        saveConfig()
    end)

    emoteButtons[i] = btn
end

function applyStatsSpoofToData()
    if not statsSpoofEnabled then return end
    pcall(function()
        if not (DataController and DataController.CurrentData and DataController.CurrentData.Data) then return end
        local d = DataController.CurrentData.Data
        local keys = {
            "StatisticDuelsWon",
            "StatisticDuelsLost",
            "StatisticDuelsPlayed",
            "StatisticEliminations",
            "StatisticDeaths",
            "StatisticAssists",
            "StatisticDuelsWinStreak",
            "StatisticDuelsWinStreakHighest",
        }
        for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
            if _originalStats[k] == nil and type(d[k]) == "number" then
                _originalStats[k] = d[k]
            end
            jahvex_localDataTouch(k)
        end
    end)
end

function restoreStatsSpoofData()
    pcall(function()
        if not (DataController and DataController.CurrentData and DataController.CurrentData.Data) then return end
        for k, _ in pairs(_originalStats) do
            jahvex_localDataTouch(k)
        end
    end)
end

function makeStatBox(parent, label, y, getVal, setVal)
    makeLabel(parent, label, 12, y, COL_W - 24, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(0, COL_W - 24, 0, 22)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.Text = jahvex_boxText(getVal())
    box.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    box.PlaceholderText = label
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.ZIndex = 3
    box.Parent = parent
    makeCorner(box, 6)
    makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local n = tonumber(box.Text)
        if n and n >= 0 then
            setVal(math.floor(n))
            box.Text = jahvex_boxText(getVal())
            if statsSpoofEnabled then
                applyStatsSpoofToData()
                setStatus(label .. ": " .. tostring(getVal()), GREEN)
            end
            saveConfig()
        else
            box.Text = jahvex_boxText(getVal())
        end
    end)
    return box
end

    if state then

        setStatus("Stats spoof on", GREEN)
        saveConfig()
    else
        restoreStatsSpoofData()
        saveConfig()
        setStatus("Stats spoof off.", RED)
    end
end)

function jahvex_layoutSpooferLeft()
    if not lbPanel then return end
    local gap = 10
    local nextY = lbPanel.Position.Y.Offset + lbPanel.Size.Y.Offset + gap
    local sws = jahvexUiRefs.swsPanel
    if sws then
        sws.Position = UDim2.new(0, sws.Position.X.Offset, 0, nextY)
        nextY = nextY + sws.Size.Y.Offset + gap
    end
    local dh = jahvexUiRefs.dhPanel
    if dh then
        dh.Position = UDim2.new(0, dh.Position.X.Offset, 0, nextY)
    end
    jahvex_refreshColumnCanvas(spooferPage)
end

function jahvex_refreshLbKindUi()
    local btns = jahvexUiRefs.lbKindBtns
    if type(btns) == "table" then
        for id, btn in pairs(btns) do
            if btn then
                local on = (id == lbKind)
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(48, 72, 54) or ELEM_BG
                btn.TextColor3 = on and GREEN or TEXT_W
            end
        end
    end
    local isKill = (lbKind == "kill")
    if jahvexUiRefs.lbKillLabel then jahvexUiRefs.lbKillLabel.Visible = isKill end
    if jahvexUiRefs.lbKillBox then jahvexUiRefs.lbKillBox.Visible = isKill end
    if jahvexUiRefs.lbPlaceBox then
        jahvexUiRefs.lbPlaceBox.Text = jahvex_boxText(jahvex_lbPlaceForKind(lbKind))
    end
    if jahvexUiRefs.lbKillBox then
        jahvexUiRefs.lbKillBox.Text = jahvex_boxText(spoofedLbKills)
    end
    if lbPanel then
        lbPanelH = isKill and lbPanelHKill or lbPanelHCompact
        lbPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, lbPanel.Size.X.Offset, 0, lbPanelH)
    end
    jahvex_layoutSpooferLeft()
end

local function ceBuildPlayerOptions()
    local opts = { { label = "None", value = "None" } }
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp then
            table.insert(opts, {
                label = tostring(p.DisplayName) .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")",
                value = p,
            })
        end
    end
    return opts
end

local function ceUnbindChar()
    if _ceCharConn then
        pcall(function() _ceCharConn:Disconnect() end)
        _ceCharConn = nil
    end
end

function jahvex_ceEnforceStats(force)
    local plr = customEnemyTarget
    if not customEnemyEnabled or not plr or not plr.Parent then return end
    local now = tick()
    if not force and now - _ceLastEnforce < 0.75 then return end
    _ceLastEnforce = now
    if ceName and ceName ~= "" then
        pcall(function()
            local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum.DisplayName = ceName end
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        local ls = plr:FindFirstChild("CustomLeaderstats") or plr:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        if not ls then return end
        local function setIv(name, val)
            local iv = ls:FindFirstChild(name)
            if iv and iv:IsA("IntValue") then iv.Value = val end
        end
        setIv("Level", ceLevel)
        setIv("WinStreak", ceStreak)
        setIv("StatisticDuelsWinStreak", ceStreak)
        setIv("ELO", ceElo)
        setIv("DisplayELO", ceElo)
        setIv("RankedCurrentELO", ceElo)
    end)
end

function jahvex_ceApplyAvatar(force)
    local plr = customEnemyTarget
    if not customEnemyEnabled or not plr or not plr.Parent then return end
    local uid = tonumber(ceAvatarId)
    if not uid or uid <= 0 then return end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    local now = tick()
    if not force and now - _ceLastAvatarApply < 2.0 then return end
    _ceLastAvatarApply = now
    task.spawn(function()
        if customEnemyTarget ~= plr or not customEnemyEnabled then return end
        jahvex_applyAvatarToChar(char, uid, { force = true, skipIfDressed = false, strip = true })
        jahvex_ceEnforceStats(true)
    end)
end

function jahvex_ceBindTarget(plr)
    ceUnbindChar()
    if plr == nil or plr == "None" or plr == lp then
        customEnemyTarget = nil
        return
    end
    customEnemyTarget = plr
    _ceCharConn = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        if not customEnemyEnabled or customEnemyTarget ~= plr then return end
        task.delay(0.4, function()
            if customEnemyTarget == plr and customEnemyEnabled then
                jahvex_ceApplyAvatar(true)
                jahvex_ceEnforceStats(true)
            end
        end)
    end)
    if customEnemyEnabled then
        jahvex_ceApplyAvatar(true)
        jahvex_ceEnforceStats(true)
    end
end

function jahvex_ceRefreshPlayerDropdown(resetIfGone)
    local drop = jahvexUiRefs and jahvexUiRefs.cePlayerDropdown
    if not drop or not drop.SetOptions then return end
    local cur = customEnemyTarget
    drop:SetOptions(ceBuildPlayerOptions(), true)
    if cur and cur.Parent and cur ~= lp then
        drop:SetByValue(cur, false)
    elseif resetIfGone then
        customEnemyTarget = nil
        if drop.SetDisplay then
            drop:SetDisplay("None", nil)
        end
    end
end

local _ceHbFrame = 0
jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    if not customEnemyEnabled or not customEnemyTarget then return end
    _ceHbFrame = _ceHbFrame + 1
    if _ceHbFrame % 3 ~= 0 then return end
    if not customEnemyTarget.Parent then
        jahvex_ceBindTarget(nil)
        jahvex_ceRefreshPlayerDropdown(true)
        return
    end
    jahvex_ceEnforceStats(false)
end))

jahvex_track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
    task.defer(function() jahvex_ceRefreshPlayerDropdown(false) end)
end))
jahvex_track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if customEnemyTarget == p then
        jahvex_ceBindTarget(nil)
        task.defer(function()
            jahvex_ceRefreshPlayerDropdown(true)
            local drop = jahvexUiRefs and jahvexUiRefs.cePlayerDropdown
            if drop and drop.SetDisplay then drop:SetDisplay("None", nil) end
        end)
    else
        task.defer(function() jahvex_ceRefreshPlayerDropdown(false) end)
    end
end))

customEnemyPanel = makePanel(spooferRightPage, 0, 0, COL_W, CE_PANEL_H, "Custom Enemy")

makeLabel(customEnemyPanel, "Player", 12, 32, COL_W - 24, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
jahvexUiRefs.cePlayerDropdown = makeDropdown(customEnemyPanel, 12, 48, COL_W - 24, "None", ceBuildPlayerOptions(), function(value)
    if value == nil or value == "None" then
        jahvex_ceBindTarget(nil)
        setStatus("Custom Enemy: None", RED)
    else
        jahvex_ceBindTarget(value)
        setStatus("Custom Enemy: " .. tostring(value.DisplayName or value.Name), GREEN)

local function makeRandomDeviceSlider(parent, y)
    makeLabel(parent, "Random Interval", 12, y, 90, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local valLbl = makeLabel(parent, "1.0s", 12, y + 13, COL_W - 24, 14, 11, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center); valLbl.ZIndex = 10; makeStroke(valLbl, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1.2)
    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size = UDim2.new(0, COL_W - 24, 0, 4)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 18)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 3
    track.Parent = parent
    makeCorner(track, 3)
    makeStroke(track, BORDER, 1)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.1837, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 4
    fill.Parent = track
    makeCorner(fill, 3)

    local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
    local KNOB_W = 12
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, KNOB_W, 0, KNOB_W)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.1837, -KNOB_W/2, 0.5, -KNOB_W/2)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Text = ""
    knob.AutoButtonColor = false
    knob.ZIndex = 5
    knob.Parent = track
    makeCorner(knob, KNOB_W/2)
    makeStroke(knob, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), 1)

    local dragging = false
    local function update(input)
        local dx = input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X
        local frac = math.clamp(dx / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KNOB_W/2, 0.5, -KNOB_W/2)
        local val = 0.1 + (4.9 * frac)
        randomDeviceSpoofInterval = val
        valLbl.Text = string.format("%.1fs", val)
    end
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
        end
    end)
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end)
    game:GetService("UserInputService").InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    return {
        Set = function(v)
            v = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1.0, 0.1, 5.0)
            local frac = (v - 0.1) / 4.9
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(frac, -KNOB_W/2, 0.5, -KNOB_W/2)
            randomDeviceSpoofInterval = v
            valLbl.Text = string.format("%.1fs", v)
        end
    }
end

randomDeviceSpoofInterval = 1.0
jahvexUiRefs.randomDeviceSlider = makeRandomDeviceSlider(devicePanel, 150)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if randomDeviceEnabled and deviceSpoofEnabled then
            local devs = {"Mobile", "PC", "Controller", "VR"}
            local currentIdx = table.find(devs, currentDeviceType) or 1
            local nextIdx = currentIdx
            while nextIdx == currentIdx do
                nextIdx = math.random(1, #devs)
            end
            local dev = devs[nextIdx]

            currentDeviceType = dev
            getgenv().currentDeviceType = dev
            getgenv().deviceSpoofEnabled = false
            applyDeviceSpoof()

            setStatus("Random Device: " .. dev, GREEN)
        end
        task.wait(randomDeviceSpoofInterval or 1.0)
    end
end)

_keyPrettyCache = nil
_keyPrettyValue = nil
_keyUiCache = nil
_keyUiCacheAt = 0
_originalWeaponKeys = nil

function restoreKeySpoofUi()
    local realKeys = _originalWeaponKeys
    if realKeys == nil then
        pcall(function()
            realKeys = DataController:Get("WeaponKeys")
        end)
        if type(realKeys) ~= "number" then realKeys = 0 end
    end
    local pretty = tostring(realKeys)
    pcall(function()
        local Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
        if Utility and Utility.PrettyNumber then
            pretty = Utility:PrettyNumber(realKeys)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local cont = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGui")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby:FindFirstChild("Currency")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby.Currency:FindFirstChild("Container")
        if not cont then return end
        local keyImg = "17495953455"
        local keyImg2 = "17860673529"
        for _, slot in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
            if not slot:IsA("GuiObject") then continue end
            local title = slot:FindFirstChild("Title")
            if not (title and title:IsA("TextLabel")) then continue end
            local isKey = (slot.LayoutOrder == 1)
            if not isKey then
                local icon = slot:FindFirstChild("Icon")
                if icon then
                    local img = ""
                    pcall(function() img = tostring(icon.Image or "") end)
                    if img:find(keyImg) or img:find(keyImg2) then
                        isKey = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if isKey then
                title.Text = pretty
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if DataController and DataController.CurrentData then
            jahvex_localDataTouch("WeaponKeys")
        end
    end)
end

function applyKeySpoofToUi()
    if not keySpoofEnabled then return end
    pcall(function()
        if DataController and DataController.CurrentData and DataController.CurrentData.Data then
            if _originalWeaponKeys == nil then
                local cur = DataController.CurrentData.Data.WeaponKeys
                if type(cur) == "number" then _originalWeaponKeys = cur end
            end
        end
    end)
    local pretty = tostring(spoofedWeaponKeys)
    if _keyPrettyValue ~= spoofedWeaponKeys then
        _keyPrettyValue = spoofedWeaponKeys
        _keyPrettyCache = pretty
        pcall(function()
            local Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
            if Utility and Utility.PrettyNumber then
                _keyPrettyCache = Utility:PrettyNumber(spoofedWeaponKeys)
            end
        end)
        pretty = _keyPrettyCache
    else
        pretty = _keyPrettyCache or pretty
    end
    pcall(function()
        local now = tick()
        local cont = _keyUiCache
        if (not cont) or (not cont.Parent) or (now - _keyUiCacheAt > 2) then
            cont = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGui")
                and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
                and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
                and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby:FindFirstChild("Currency")
                and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby.Currency:FindFirstChild("Container")
            _keyUiCache = cont
            _keyUiCacheAt = now
        end
        if not cont then return end
        local keyImg = "17495953455"
        local keyImg2 = "17860673529"
        for _, slot in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
            if not slot:IsA("GuiObject") then continue end
            local title = slot:FindFirstChild("Title")
            if not (title and title:IsA("TextLabel")) then continue end
            local isKey = (slot.LayoutOrder == 1)
            if not isKey then
                local icon = slot:FindFirstChild("Icon")
                if icon then
                    local img = ""
                    pcall(function() img = tostring(icon.Image or "") end)
                    if img:find(keyImg) or img:find(keyImg2) then
                        isKey = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if isKey and title.Text ~= pretty then
                title.Text = pretty
            end
        end
    end)
end

  local originalItemHud = {}
  local originalCosmeticHud = {}

  function jahvex_applyHudSpoof()
      local ok1, IL = pcall(require, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.ItemLibrary)
      if ok1 and IL and IL.Items then
          for key, data in pairs(IL.Items) do
              if type(data) == "table" and (data.Type == "Gun" or data.Type == "Melee" or data.Type == "Utility") then
                  if not originalItemHud[key] then
                      originalItemHud[key] = { Status = data.Status, Name = data.Name, DisplayName = data.DisplayName }
                  end
                  if hudSpoofStyle == "Prime" then data.Status = "Prime"
                  elseif hudSpoofStyle == "Contraband" then data.Status = "Contraband"
                  else data.Status = originalItemHud[key].Status end
                  local cName = ""
                  if data.Class == "Primary" then cName = hudSpoofPrimary
                  elseif data.Class == "Secondary" then cName = hudSpoofSecondary
                  elseif data.Class == "Melee" then cName = hudSpoofMelee
                  elseif data.Class == "Utility" then cName = hudSpoofUtility end
                  if cName and cName ~= "" then
                      data.DisplayName = cName
                  else
                      data.DisplayName = originalItemHud[key].DisplayName or originalItemHud[key].Name
                  end
              end
          end
      end
      local ok2, CL = pcall(require, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
      if ok2 and CL and CL.Cosmetics then
          for key, data in pairs(CL.Cosmetics) do
              if type(data) == "table" and data.Type == "Skin" then
                  if not originalCosmeticHud[key] then
                      originalCosmeticHud[key] = { Rarity = data.Rarity, Name = data.Name, DisplayName = data.DisplayName }
                  end
                  if hudSpoofStyle == "Prime" then data.Rarity = "Prime"
                  elseif hudSpoofStyle == "Contraband" then data.Rarity = "Contraband"
                  else data.Rarity = originalCosmeticHud[key].Rarity end
                  local cName = ""
                  local wName = data.ItemName
                  if wName and ok1 and IL and IL.Items and IL.Items[wName] then
                      local cls = IL.Items[wName].Class
                      if cls == "Primary" then cName = hudSpoofPrimary
                      elseif cls == "Secondary" then cName = hudSpoofSecondary
                      elseif cls == "Melee" then cName = hudSpoofMelee
                      elseif cls == "Utility" then cName = hudSpoofUtility end
                  end
                  if cName and cName ~= "" then
                      data.DisplayName = cName
                  else
                      data.DisplayName = originalCosmeticHud[key].DisplayName or originalCosmeticHud[key].Name
                  end
              end
          end
      end
  end

  local function makeTextBox(parent, label, x, y, w, default, callback)
      local lbl = makeLabel(parent, label, x, y, w - 100, 24, 12, TEXT_W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
      local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
      box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 24)
      box.Position = UDim2.new(0, x + w - 90, 0, y)
      box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
      box.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
      box.Text = tostring(default or "")
      box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
      box.TextSize = 12
      box.Parent = parent
      makeCorner(box, 4)
      makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)
      pcall(function() box:SetAttribute("uiRole", "text") end)
      box.FocusLost:Connect(function() callback(box.Text) end)
      return box
  end

  local function jahvex_hookWeaponTitle()
      local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
      if not lp then return end
      local pgui = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
      if not pgui then return end

      local function setupTitle(title)
          if title:GetAttribute("JahvexHooked") then return end
          title:SetAttribute("JahvexHooked", true)
          title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
              local orig = title.Text
              if orig == "" or orig == hudSpoofPrimary or orig == hudSpoofSecondary or orig == hudSpoofMelee or orig == hudSpoofUtility then return end
              local matchClass = nil
              local ok, IL = pcall(require, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.ItemLibrary)
              if ok and IL and IL.Items then
                  for k, v in pairs(IL.Items) do
                      if v.Name == orig or k == orig or v.DisplayName == orig then
                          matchClass = v.Class
                          break
                      end
                  end
              end
              if not matchClass then
                  local ok2, CL = pcall(require, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
                  if ok2 and CL and CL.Cosmetics then
                      for k, v in pairs(CL.Cosmetics) do
                          if v.Name == orig or k == orig or v.DisplayName == orig then
                              if v.ItemName and IL and IL.Items[v.ItemName] then
                                  matchClass = IL.Items[v.ItemName].Class
                              end
                              break
                          end
                      end
                  end
              end
              if matchClass then
                  if matchClass == "Primary" and hudSpoofPrimary ~= "" then title.Text = hudSpoofPrimary
                  elseif matchClass == "Secondary" and hudSpoofSecondary ~= "" then title.Text = hudSpoofSecondary
                  elseif matchClass == "Melee" and hudSpoofMelee ~= "" then title.Text = hudSpoofMelee
                  elseif matchClass == "Utility" and hudSpoofUtility ~= "" then title.Text = hudSpoofUtility
                  end
              end
          end)

          local orig = title.Text
          title.Text = orig .. " "
          title.Text = orig
      end

      pgui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
          if desc.Name == "Title" and desc.Parent and desc.Parent.Name == "NameContainer" then
              setupTitle(desc)
          end
      end)
      for _, desc in ipairs(pgui:GetDescendants()) do
          if desc.Name == "Title" and desc.Parent and desc.Parent.Name == "NameContainer" then
              setupTitle(desc)
          end
      end
  end
  task.spawn(jahvex_hookWeaponTitle)

_currencyUiCache = nil
_currencyUiCacheAt = 0

function getLobbyCurrencyContainer()
    local now = tick()
    local cont = _currencyUiCache
    if (not cont) or (not cont.Parent) or (now - _currencyUiCacheAt > 2) then
        cont = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGui")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby:FindFirstChild("Currency")
            and lp.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby.Currency:FindFirstChild("Container")
        _currencyUiCache = cont
        _currencyUiCacheAt = now
    end
    return cont
end

function prettyCurrencyNumber(n)
    local pretty = tostring(n)
    pcall(function()
        local Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
        if Utility and Utility.PrettyNumber then
            pretty = Utility:PrettyNumber(n)
        end
    end)
    return pretty
end

function setCurrencyDataValue(dataKey, value, rememberOriginal)
    pcall(function()
        if not (DataController and DataController.CurrentData and DataController.CurrentData.Data) then return end
        local d = DataController.CurrentData.Data
        if rememberOriginal and _originalCurrencies[dataKey] == nil then
            local cur = d[dataKey]
            if type(cur) == "number" then _originalCurrencies[dataKey] = cur end
        end

    end)
    pcall(function()
        jahvex_localDataTouch(dataKey)
    end)
end

function setCurrencySlotTitle(layoutOrder, value)
    local cont = getLobbyCurrencyContainer()
    if not cont then return end
    local pretty = prettyCurrencyNumber(value)
    for _, slot in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
        if slot:IsA("GuiObject") and slot.LayoutOrder == layoutOrder then
            local title = slot:FindFirstChild("Title")
            if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") and title.Text ~= pretty then
                title.Text = pretty
            end
            break
        end
    end
end

function applyCurrencySpoofsToUi()
    if glorySpoofEnabled then
        setCurrencyDataValue("Glory", spoofedGlory, true)
        setCurrencySlotTitle(4, spoofedGlory)
    end
    if pearlSpoofEnabled then
        setCurrencyDataValue("EventCurrency", spoofedPearl, true)
        setCurrencySlotTitle(3, spoofedPearl)
    end
    if skinTicketsSpoofEnabled then
        setCurrencyDataValue("SkinTickets", spoofedSkinTickets, true)
        setCurrencySlotTitle(5, spoofedSkinTickets)
    end
    if unlockTokensSpoofEnabled then
        setCurrencyDataValue("UnlockTokens", spoofedUnlockTokens, true)
        setCurrencySlotTitle(2, spoofedUnlockTokens)
    end
end

function restoreOneCurrency(dataKey, layoutOrder)
    local real = _originalCurrencies[dataKey]
    if real == nil then
        pcall(function()
            real = DataController:Get(dataKey)
        end)
        if type(real) ~= "number" then real = 0 end
    end
    setCurrencySlotTitle(layoutOrder, real)
    pcall(function()
        if DataController and DataController.CurrentData then
            jahvex_localDataTouch(dataKey)
        end
    end)
end

function makeCurrencySpoofRow(parent, y, label, getEnabled, setEnabled, getVal, setVal, dataKey, layoutOrder)
    local tog = makeToggle(parent, "Enable " .. label, 12, y, COL_W - 24, function(state)
        setEnabled(state)
        if state then
            applyCurrencySpoofsToUi()
            setStatus(label .. ": " .. tostring(getVal()), GREEN)
        else
            restoreOneCurrency(dataKey, layoutOrder)
            setStatus(label .. " spoof off.", RED)
        end
        saveConfig()
    end)
    makeLabel(parent, label .. " value", 12, y + 26, COL_W - 24, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(0, COL_W - 24, 0, 22)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 48)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.Text = jahvex_boxText(getVal())
    box.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    box.PlaceholderText = label .. "..."
    box.PlaceholderColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.ZIndex = 3
    box.Parent = parent
    makeCorner(box, 6)
    makeStroke(box, BORDER, 1)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local n = tonumber(box.Text)
        if n and n >= 0 then
            setVal(math.floor(n))
            box.Text = jahvex_boxText(getVal())
            if getEnabled() then
                applyCurrencySpoofsToUi()
                setStatus(label .. ": " .. tostring(getVal()), GREEN)
            end
            saveConfig()
        else
            box.Text = jahvex_boxText(getVal())
        end
    end)
    jahvexUiRefs["curToggle_" .. tostring(dataKey)] = tog
    jahvexUiRefs["curBox_" .. tostring(dataKey)] = box
    return y + 76
end

streakEndVictimName = (type(streakEndVictimName) == "string") and streakEndVictimName or ""
if streakEndAmount ~= nil then
    streakEndAmount = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(streakEndAmount) or 0))
end

function jahvex_formatCommaNumber(n)
    n = math.floor(math.abs(tonumber(n) or 0))
    local s = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        s, k = string.gsub(s, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return s
end

function jahvex_sendStreakEndChat()
    local victim = tostring(streakEndVictimName or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if victim == "" then
        setStatus("Streak end: enter a name", RED)
        return false
    end
    if streakEndAmount == nil then
        setStatus("Streak end: enter winstreak", RED)
        return false
    end
    local amount = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(streakEndAmount) or 0))
    local byDisp = tostring(realDisplayName or lp.DisplayName or lp.Name or "Player")
    local byUser = tostring(realName or lp.Name or "Player")
    local text = "[SERVER] " .. victim .. "'s " .. jahvex_formatCommaNumber(amount)
        .. " win streak was ended by " .. byDisp .. " (@" .. byUser .. ")!"

    local col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 40)
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local SendChat = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.Functions.SendChat)
        if type(SendChat) == "function" then
            SendChat({
                Text = text,
                Color = col,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
            })
            ok = true
        end
    end)
    if ok then
        setStatus("Streak end message sent", GREEN)
    else
        setStatus("Streak end message fail", RED)
    end
    return ok
end

    else
        streakEndAmtBox.Text = jahvex_boxText(streakEndAmount)
    end
end)

notifSpoofMode = (type(notifSpoofMode) == "string" and notifSpoofMode ~= "") and notifSpoofMode or "Gift"
notifSpoofTitle = (type(notifSpoofTitle) == "string") and notifSpoofTitle or ""
notifSpoofDesc = (type(notifSpoofDesc) == "string") and notifSpoofDesc or ""
notifSpoofItem = (type(notifSpoofItem) == "string") and notifSpoofItem or ""
local JX_GIFT_NOTIF_ICON = "rbxassetid://127400882945494"
local _jxNotifCatalog = nil
local _jxNotifPickerGui = nil

function jahvex_notifItemImage(itemName)
    local img = nil
    pcall(function()
        local CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local cos = CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics[itemName]
        if cos then
            img = cos.ImageHighResolution or cos.Image
        end
        if (not img or img == "") and CL and CL.Rewards and CL.Rewards[itemName] then
            local r = CL.Rewards[itemName]
            img = r.ImageHighResolution or r.Image
        end
        if (not img or img == "") and type(jahvex_getCosmeticImage) == "function" then
            img = jahvex_getCosmeticImage(itemName)
        end
    end)
    if type(img) ~= "string" or img == "" then return nil end
    return img
end

function jahvex_buildNotifCatalog()
    if type(_jxNotifCatalog) == "table" and #_jxNotifCatalog > 0 then
        return _jxNotifCatalog
    end
    local list = {}
    local seen = {}
    pcall(function()
        local CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        if CL and type(CL.Cosmetics) == "table" then
            for name, cos in pairs(CL.Cosmetics) do
                if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" and not seen[name] then
                    seen[name] = true
                    table.insert(list, {
                        name = name,
                        kind = tostring((cos and cos.Type) or "Cosmetic"),
                        src = "cosmetic",
                    })
                end
            end
        end
        if CL and type(CL.Rewards) == "table" then
            for name, rew in pairs(CL.Rewards) do
                if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" and not seen[name] then
                    seen[name] = true
                    table.insert(list, {
                        name = name,
                        kind = tostring((rew and rew.Type) or "Reward"),
                        src = "reward",
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return tostring(a.name):lower() < tostring(b.name):lower()
    end)
    _jxNotifCatalog = list
    return list
end

function jahvex_buildNotifReward(itemName)
    itemName = tostring(itemName or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if itemName == "" then return nil end
    local reward = { Name = itemName }
    pcall(function()
        local CL = CosmeticLibrary or require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
        local cos = CL and CL.Cosmetics and CL.Cosmetics[itemName]
        if cos then
            local w = cos.ItemName or cos.Weapon
            if type(w) == "string" and w ~= "" and w ~= "IsUniversal" and w ~= "IsRandom" then
                reward.Weapon = w
            end
        end
    end)
    return reward
end

function jahvex_playNotifSpoof()
    local mode = tostring(notifSpoofMode or "Gift")
    local item = tostring(notifSpoofItem or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local title = tostring(notifSpoofTitle or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local desc = tostring(notifSpoofDesc or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if item == "" then
        setStatus("Notification: select an item", RED)
        return false
    end
    if title == "" then
        title = (mode == "Gift") and "Gift Received" or "Reward"
    end
    if desc == "" then
        desc = (mode == "Gift") and ("You received " .. item .. "!") or ("You won " .. item .. "!")
    end
    local reward = jahvex_buildNotifReward(item)
    if not reward then
        setStatus("Notification: invalid item", RED)
        return false
    end
    local firstIcon = (mode == "Gift") and JX_GIFT_NOTIF_ICON or nil
    local secondIcon = reward
    local ok = false

    pcall(function()
        local SlotMod = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.NotificationSlot)
        local UILib = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.UILibrary)
        local frame = UILib:GetTo("MainFrame", "Notifications")
        local slot = SlotMod.new(title, desc, firstIcon, secondIcon)
        slot:SetParent(frame.Container)
        pcall(function() slot:PlaySize(1, nil) end)
        pcall(function() slot:PlaySound() end)
        pcall(function() slot:PlayGlow() end)
        task.delay(4, function()
            pcall(function()
                if slot and type(slot.Destroy) == "function" then
                    slot:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local BD = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BetterDebris)
            if BD and type(BD.AddItem) == "function" then
                BD:AddItem(slot, 4.2)
            end
        end)
        ok = true
    end)
    if ok then
        setStatus("Notification sent: " .. item, GREEN)
    else
        setStatus("Notification fail", RED)
    end
    return ok
end


_jxNotifGrantToken = 0
function jahvex_scheduleNotifGrant10()
    local item = tostring(notifSpoofItem or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if item == "" then
        setStatus("Notification: select an item", RED)
        return false
    end
    local reward = jahvex_buildNotifReward(item)
    if not reward then
        setStatus("Notification: invalid item", RED)
        return false
    end
    _jxNotifGrantToken = (_jxNotifGrantToken or 0) + 1
    local token = _jxNotifGrantToken
    setStatus("Reward in 10s: " .. item, GREEN)
    task.delay(10, function()
        if _jxNotifGrantToken ~= token then return end
        pcall(jahvex_grantCosmeticLocal, reward)
        jahvex_playNotifSpoof()
        setStatus("Reward granted: " .. item, GREEN)
    end)
    return true
end

function jahvex_matchPointRankElo(rankName)
    rankName = tostring(rankName or "Nemesis")
    local elo = 3600
    pcall(function()
        local SL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SeasonLibrary)
        local ranks = SL and SL.RankProfiles and SL.RankProfiles.ranks_version1 and SL.RankProfiles.ranks_version1.Ranks
        local info = ranks and ranks[rankName]
        if type(info) == "table" and tonumber(info.RequiredELO) then
            elo = tonumber(info.RequiredELO)
        end
    end)
    if elo < 0 then elo = 0 end
    return elo
end

function jahvex_matchPointResolvedElo()
    local custom = tonumber(matchPointElo)
    if custom ~= nil then return math.max(0, math.floor(custom)) end
    return jahvex_matchPointRankElo(matchPointRank)
end

function jahvex_matchPointOn()
    local on = matchPointEnabled
    if on == nil then on = getgenv().matchPointEnabled end
    return on and true or false
end

function jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails(details)
    if not jahvex_matchPointOn() then return details end
    if type(details) ~= "table" then
        details = {}
    end
    local prev = jahvex_matchPointResolvedElo()
    local delta = math.floor(tonumber(matchPointDelta) or 5)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(details) do
        copy[k] = v
    end
    copy.SummaryType = "RankedELOChanged"
    copy.PreviousELO = prev
    copy.CurrentELO = prev + delta
    copy.ELOSaved = nil
    return copy
end

function jahvex_matchPointBarElo()
    local prev = jahvex_matchPointResolvedElo()
    local delta = math.floor(tonumber(matchPointDelta) or 5)
    return math.max(0, prev + delta)
end

function jahvex_installMatchPointHooks()
    getgenv().jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails = jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails
    getgenv().jahvex_matchPointBarElo = jahvex_matchPointBarElo
    getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn = jahvex_matchPointOn
    pcall(function()
        local PDC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.PlayerDataController)
        if type(PDC) == "table" and type(PDC.Get) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_mp_pdc then
            getgenv().__jx_mp_pdc = true
            local old = PDC.Get
            PDC.Get = function(self, key, ...)
                local res = old(self, key, ...)
                if key ~= "Seasons" or not getgenv().__jx_mp_bar then
                    return res
                end
                if type(res) ~= "table" then
                    res = {}
                end
                local SL = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SeasonLibrary)
                local sname = SL.CurrentSeason and SL.CurrentSeason.Name
                local uni = SL.UNIVERSAL_ELO_NAME or "ranked"
                local copy = {}
                for k, v in pairs(res) do
                    copy[k] = v
                end
                local season = copy[sname]
                if type(season) ~= "table" then
                    season = {}
                else
                    local s2 = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(season) do
                        s2[k] = v
                    end
                    season = s2
                end
                copy[sname] = season
                local rp = season.RankedPerformances
                if type(rp) ~= "table" then
                    rp = {}
                else
                    local rp2 = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(rp) do
                        rp2[k] = v
                    end
                    rp = rp2
                end
                season.RankedPerformances = rp
                local ranked = {}
                if type(rp[uni]) == "table" then
                    for k, v in pairs(rp[uni]) do
                        ranked[k] = v
                    end
                end
                ranked.CurrentELO = getgenv().jahvex_matchPointBarElo()
                ranked.DuelsPlayed = 99
                rp[uni] = ranked
                return copy
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local Summary = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientDuel.DuelInterface.FinalResults.Summary)
        if type(Summary) == "table" and type(Summary.DisplaySummaryDetails) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_mp_ds then
            getgenv().__jx_mp_ds = true
            local old = Summary.DisplaySummaryDetails
            Summary.DisplaySummaryDetails = function(self, ...)
                if getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn and getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn() then
                    self._summary_details = getgenv().jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails(self._summary_details or {})
                    getgenv().__jx_mp_bar = true
                end
                local ok, err = pcall(old, self, ...)
                getgenv().__jx_mp_bar = false
                if not ok then error(err) end
            end
        end
        if type(Summary) == "table" and type(Summary.SetDetails) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_mp_sd then
            getgenv().__jx_mp_sd = true
            local oldSd = Summary.SetDetails
            Summary.SetDetails = function(self, details, ...)
                return oldSd(self, getgenv().jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails(details), ...)
            end
        end
        if type(Summary) == "table" and type(Summary.SetVisible) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_mp_sv then
            getgenv().__jx_mp_sv = true
            local oldSv = Summary.SetVisible
            Summary.SetVisible = function(self, vis, ...)
                if vis and getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn and getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn() then
                    self._summary_details = getgenv().jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails(self._summary_details or {})
                end
                return oldSv(self, vis, ...)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local FR = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientDuel.DuelInterface.FinalResults)
        if type(FR) == "table" and type(FR.Play) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_mp_fr then
            getgenv().__jx_mp_fr = true
            local oldPlay = FR.Play
            FR.Play = function(self, ...)
                if getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn and getgenv().jahvex_matchPointOn() then
                    pcall(function()
                        self.Summary:SetDetails(getgenv().jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails({}))
                    end)
                end
                return oldPlay(self, ...)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local CD = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientDueler)
        if type(CD) == "table" and type(CD.ReplicateFromServer) == "function" and not getgenv().__jx_mp_cd then
            getgenv().__jx_mp_cd = true
            local old = CD.ReplicateFromServer
            CD.ReplicateFromServer = function(self, key, ...)
                if key == "SummaryDetails" then
                    local a = table.pack(...)
                    if a.n >= 1 then
                        a[1] = getgenv().jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails(a[1])
                    end
                    return old(self, key, table.unpack(a, 1, a.n))
                end
                return old(self, key, ...)
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_matchPointPreview()
    matchPointEnabled = true
    getgenv().matchPointEnabled = true
    pcall(function()
        if jahvexUiRefs.matchPointToggle then
            jahvexUiRefs.matchPointToggle:Set(true, false)
        end
    end)
    pcall(jahvex_installMatchPointHooks)
    local details = jahvex_matchPointPatchDetails({
        SummaryType = "RankedELOChanged",
        PreviousELO = 0,
        CurrentELO = 0,
    })
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local SC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.SpectateController)
        local d = SC and SC.CurrentDuelSubject
        local fr = d and d.DuelInterface and d.DuelInterface.FinalResults
        if not fr then return end
        getgenv().__jx_mp_bar = true
        fr.Summary:SetDetails(details)
        fr._is_active = true
        pcall(function()
            fr.Activated:Fire()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            fr:SetPage("Summary")
        end)
        pcall(function()
            fr:UpdateVisibility()
        end)
        ok = true
    end)
    getgenv().__jx_mp_bar = false
    if ok then
        setStatus("Match Point: " .. tostring(matchPointRank) .. " " .. tostring(jahvex_matchPointBarElo()), GREEN)
    else
        setStatus("Lobbyde yok — ranked maci bitir", RED)
    end
end

    pcall(jahvex_installMatchPointHooks)
end)

customServerMsg = (type(customServerMsg) == "string") and customServerMsg or ""
if typeof(customServerMsgColor) ~= "Color3" then
    customServerMsgColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 50)
end

function jahvex_sendCustomServerChat()
    local msg = tostring(customServerMsg or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if msg == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a custom message", RED)
        return false
    end
    if not string.find(msg, "^%[SERVER%]") then
        msg = "[SERVER] " .. msg
    end
    local col = (typeof(customServerMsgColor) == "Color3") and customServerMsgColor or Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 50)
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local SendChat = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.Functions.SendChat)
        if type(SendChat) == "function" then
            SendChat({
                Text = msg,
                Color = col,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
            })
            ok = true
        end
    end)
    if ok then
        setStatus("Custom server message sent", GREEN)
    else
        setStatus("Custom message fail", RED)
    end
    return ok
end

do
    local _lp_sws  = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _RS_sws  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local _PDC_sws = require(_lp_sws.PlayerScripts.Controllers:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController"))
    local _LL_sws  = require(_RS_sws.Modules.LootLibrary)


    local _swsDefVal = 4
    local _swsDefBuy = 5
    pcall(function()
        local st = _PDC_sws:Get("StoredStreaks")
        if st and #st > 0 then
            _swsDefVal = tonumber(st[1].Value) or 4
            _swsDefBuy = _LL_sws:GetRecoverStreakCost(st[1].ConsecutiveRecoveries or 0)
        end
    end)

    local _swsOn     = false
    local _swsStreak = _swsDefVal
    local _swsBuy    = _swsDefBuy
    local _swsHooked = false


    local function _swsCostToRec(cost)
        for i = 0, 20 do
            if _LL_sws:GetRecoverStreakCost(i) >= cost then return i end
        end
        return 0
    end


    local function _swsRecoverSlot()
        local ok, list = pcall(function()
            return _lp_sws.PlayerGui.MainGui.MainFrame.Lobby.Buttons.Container.List
        end)
        if not ok or not list then return nil end
        for _, ch in pairs(list:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Frame") then
                for _, c in pairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                    if c:IsA("TextLabel") and c.Text == "Recover" then return ch end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end


    local function _swsFireSignal()
        pcall(function()
            local sig = _PDC_sws:GetDataChangedSignal("StoredStreaks")
            if sig then
                if type(sig.Fire) == "function" then sig:Fire()
                elseif type(sig.fire) == "function" then sig:fire() end
            end
        end)
    end


    local function _swsApply()
        _swsOn = true
        if not _swsHooked then
            local _nc   = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
            local _orig = _PDC_sws.Get


            _PDC_sws.Get = _nc(function(self, key, ...)
                if _swsOn and key == "StoredStreaks" then
                    return {
                        {
                            Value                 = _swsStreak,
                            ConsecutiveRecoveries = _swsCostToRec(_swsBuy),
                            ExpirationTime        = nil,
                        }
                    }
                end
                return _orig(self, key, ...)
            end)

            local _origCost = _LL_sws.GetRecoverStreakCost
            if type(_origCost) == "function" then
                _LL_sws.GetRecoverStreakCost = _nc(function(self, ...)
                    if _swsOn then
                        return _swsBuy
                    end
                    return _origCost(self, ...)
                end)
            end

            _swsHooked = true
        end
        local slot = _swsRecoverSlot()
        if slot then slot.Visible = true end
        _swsFireSignal()
        setStatus("Save WinStreak on", GREEN)
        saveConfig()
    end


    local function _swsRemove()
        _swsOn = false
        local slot = _swsRecoverSlot()
        if slot then slot.Visible = false end
        _swsFireSignal()
        setStatus("Save WinStreak removed.", RED)
        saveConfig()
    end


    local _swsPanelH = 182
    local _swsPanelY = lbPanelY + lbPanelH + 10
    local _swsPanel  = makePanel(spooferPage, 0, _swsPanelY, COL_W, _swsPanelH, "Save WinStreak")
    jahvexUiRefs.swsPanel = _swsPanel


    makeLabel(_swsPanel, "Win Streak Value", 12, 32, COL_W - 24, 14, 11, TEXT_DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
    local _swsValBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    _swsValBox.Size              = UDim2.new(0, COL_W - 24, 0, 26)
    _swsValBox.Position          = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 48)
    _swsValBox.BackgroundColor3  = ELEM_BG
    _swsValBox.BorderSizePixel   = 0
    _swsValBox.Text              = tostring(_swsDefVal)
    _swsValBox.TextColor3        = TEXT_W
    _swsValBox.PlaceholderText   = "4"
    _swsValBox.PlaceholderColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    _swsValBox.Font              = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    _swsValBox.TextSize          = 12
    _swsValBox.ClearTextOnFocus  = false
    _swsValBox.ZIndex            = 3
    _swsValBox.Parent            = _swsPanel
    makeCorner(_swsValBox, 6)
    makeStroke(_swsValBox, BORDER, 1)
    pcall(function() _swsValBox:SetAttribute("uiRole", "elem") end)
    _swsValBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()

        local n = tonumber(_swsValBox.Text)

        if n and n >= 0 then _swsStreak = math.floor(n)

        else _swsValBox.Text = tostring(_swsStreak) end

    end)
