local function makeAccordion(parent, titleText, bgColor)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    container.Parent = parent

    local top = Instance.new("TextButton")
    top.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    top.BackgroundColor3 = bgColor or ELEM_BG
    top.Text = "  " .. titleText
    top.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    top.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    top.TextSize = 12
    top.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    top.AutoButtonColor = false
    top.Parent = container
    makeCorner(top, 6)
    makeStroke(top, BORDER, 1)

    local content = Instance.new("Frame")
    content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
    content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    content.Visible = false
    content.ClipsDescendants = true
    content.Parent = container

    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    list.Parent = content

    local isOpen = false
    local function updateHeight()
        if isOpen then
            content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, list.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36 + list.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
        else
            content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        end
    end
    list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(updateHeight)

    top.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isOpen = not isOpen
        content.Visible = isOpen
        updateHeight()
    end)

    return container, content, top, updateHeight
end

local function buildPlayerStats(parent, title)
    local acc, content, topBtn, updateHeight = makeAccordion(parent, title, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 50))
    local overrideFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    overrideFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)

    overrideFrame.Parent = content
    local ovState = false
    makeToggle(overrideFrame, "Override Yourself", 0, 0, COL_W - 24, function(state) ovState = state end)

    local uidBox = makeInput(content, "UserID", "1")
    local dnameBox = makeInput(content, "Display Name", "")
    local unameBox = makeInput(content, "Username", "")
    local kBox = makeInput(content, "Eliminations", "0")
    local dBox = makeInput(content, "Deaths", "0")
    local aBox = makeInput(content, "Assists", "0")
    local dmgBox = makeInput(content, "Damage", "0")

    local mvpFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    mvpFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
    mvpFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    mvpFrame.Parent = content
    local mvpState = false
    makeToggle(mvpFrame, "MVP", 0, 0, COL_W - 24, function(state) mvpState = state end)

    return {
        getData = function()
            return {
                Override = ovState,
                UserID = tonumber(uidBox.Text) or 1,
                DisplayName = dnameBox.Text,

function jahvex_panic()
    pcall(function()
        if type(rbSetActive) == "function" then rbSetActive(false) end
    end)
    pcall(function() ragebotEnabled = false end)
    pcall(function() aimEnabled = false end)
    pcall(function()
        saEnabled = false
        _G.jahvex_sa2_enabled = false
    end)
    pcall(function() espEnabled = false end)
    pcall(function()
        fullAutoEnabled = false
        if type(jahvex_fullAutoApply) == "function" then jahvex_fullAutoApply(false) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(jahvex_aaSetLoop) == "function" then jahvex_aaSetLoop(false) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        playerFlyEnabled = false
        if type(jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop) == "function" then jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(jahvex_undergroundSetLoop) == "function" then jahvex_undergroundSetLoop(false) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(jahvex_syncGuiFromState) == "function" then jahvex_syncGuiFromState() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(setInsetOverlayHostOpen) == "function" then
            setInsetOverlayHostOpen(false)
        elseif mainFrame then
            mainFrame.Visible = false
        end
    end)
    pcall(setStatus, "PANIC — combat off, GUI hidden", RED)
end
_G.jahvex_panic = jahvex_panic

jahvex_track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    if input.KeyCode == panicKeyCode then
        jahvex_panic()
    end
end))

task.spawn(function()
    local ok, Requests = pcall(function()
        return require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.UserInterface.Lobby.Requests)
    end)
    if not ok or type(Requests) ~= "table" then return end
    if Requests._jahvexAutoHooked then return end
    Requests._jahvexAutoHooked = true
    local oldChallenge = Requests.ChallengeRequest
    local oldParty = Requests.PartyRequest
    if type(oldChallenge) == "function" then
        Requests.ChallengeRequest = function(self, fromPlayer, duration, ...)
            if autoAcceptChallenge and fromPlayer then
                pcall(function()
                    ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Misc.AcceptChallengeRequest:FireServer(fromPlayer)
                end)
                return
            end
            return oldChallenge(self, fromPlayer, duration, ...)
        end
    end
    if type(oldParty) == "function" then
        Requests.PartyRequest = function(self, fromPlayer, duration, ...)
            if autoAcceptParty and fromPlayer then
                pcall(function()
                    ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Matchmaking.AcceptPartyInvite:FireServer(fromPlayer)
                end)
                return
            end
            return oldParty(self, fromPlayer, duration, ...)
        end
    end
end)

function jahvex_getSpectatorSnapshot()
    local count, names = 0, {}
    pcall(function()
        local FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        local lf = FC and FC.LocalFighter
        if lf and type(lf.Get) == "function" then
            count = tonumber(lf:Get("NumSpectators")) or 0
        end
        local myEnv = lp:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= lp then
                local sameEnv = (myEnv ~= nil and plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") == myEnv)
                local f = FC and FC:GetFighter(plr)
                local isSpec = false
                if f and type(f.Get) == "function" then
                    isSpec = f:Get("IsSpectating") == true
                end
                if isSpec then
                    names[#names + 1] = tostring(plr.DisplayName or plr.Name)
                elseif sameEnv and count > 0 and #names < count then
                    local inDuel = f and f:Get("IsInDuel")
                    if not inDuel then
                        names[#names + 1] = tostring(plr.DisplayName or plr.Name) .. "?"
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    return count, names
end

_spectatorHud = nil
function jahvex_refreshSpectatorHud()
    if not spectatorListEnabled then
        if _spectatorHud then
            pcall(function() _spectatorHud:Destroy() end)
            _spectatorHud = nil
        end
        return
    end
    local host = screenGui
    if not (host and host.Parent) then return end
    if not _spectatorHud then
        local fr = Instance.new("Frame")
        fr.Name = "__spec_overlay"
        fr.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 120)
        fr.Position = UDim2.new(1, -196, 0, 80)
        fr.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG or Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19)
        fr.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fr.ZIndex = 80
        fr.Parent = host
        makeCorner(fr, 8)
        makeStroke(fr, BORDER, 1)
        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Name = "Title"
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 20)
        title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 4)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.TextSize = 12
        title.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Text = "Spectators"
        title.ZIndex = 81
        title.Parent = fr
        local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        body.Name = "Body"
        body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -28)
        body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 24)
        body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        body.TextSize = 11
        body.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        body.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        body.TextWrapped = true
        body.ZIndex = 81
        body.Parent = fr
        _spectatorHud = fr
    end
    local count, names = jahvex_getSpectatorSnapshot()
    local body = _spectatorHud:FindFirstChild("Body")
    local title = _spectatorHud:FindFirstChild("Title")
    if title then title.Text = "Spectators (" .. tostring(count) .. ")" end
    if body then
        if #names == 0 then
            body.Text = count > 0 and ("Count: " .. tostring(count) .. "\n(names unknown)") or "None"
        else
            body.Text = table.concat(names, "\n")
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while getgenv().jahvex_alive do
        pcall(jahvex_refreshSpectatorHud)
        task.wait(1.25)
    end
end)

function jahvex_playFakeKillFeed(kind)
    local ok = false
    pcall(function()
        local DC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.DuelController)
        local duel = DC and DC:GetDuel(lp)
        local feed = duel and duel.DuelInterface and duel.DuelInterface.EliminationFeed
        if not (feed and type(feed.PlayRaw) == "function") then return end
        local me = lp.DisplayName or lp.Name
        local killer = (killFeedKiller ~= "" and killFeedKiller) or me
        local victim = (killFeedVictim ~= "" and killFeedVictim) or "Enemy"
        local weapon = (killFeedWeapon ~= "" and killFeedWeapon) or "Assault Rifle"
        if kind == "death" then
            feed:PlayRaw({
                State = "LocalDeath",
                EliminatorText = victim,
                VictimText = killer,
                ViewModelName = weapon,
            })
        else
            feed:PlayRaw({
                State = "LocalElimination",
                EliminatorText = killer,
                VictimText = victim,
                ViewModelName = weapon,
                IsCritical = killFeedCrit and true or false,
            })
        end
        ok = true
    end)
    return ok
end
_G.jahvex_playFakeKillFeed = jahvex_playFakeKillFeed

function jahvex_aeQueueFn()
    local cands = {
        rawget(getgenv(), "queue_on_teleport"),
        rawget(getgenv(), "queueonteleport"),
        rawget(getgenv(), "queue_on_teleport"),
        syn and syn.queue_on_teleport,
        fluxus and fluxus.queue_on_teleport,
        krnl and krnl.queue_on_teleport,
        queue_on_teleport,
        queueonteleport,
        queueteleport,
    }
    for i = 1, #cands do
        if type(cands[i]) == "function" then
            return cands[i]
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_aeIsSrc(s)
    return type(s) == "string" and #s > 40000 and string.find(s, "JAHVEX_BUILD", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function jahvex_aeBuildOf(s)
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return 0 end
    return tonumber(string.match(s, "JAHVEX_BUILD%s*=%s*(%d+)")) or 0
end

function jahvex_aeScore(s)
    if not jahvex_aeIsSrc(s) then return 0 end
    local b = jahvex_aeBuildOf(s)
    local cur = tonumber(JAHVEX_BUILD) or 0
    if cur > 0 and b < cur then
        return 0
    end
    local n = b * 10000 + math.min(#s, 9999)
    if b == cur then
        n = n + 1000000000
    end
    return n
end

function jahvex_aeMkDir()
    pcall(function()
        if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then return end
        if isfolder and not isfolder("jx") then makefolder("jx") end
        if isfolder and not isfolder("autoexec") then makefolder("autoexec") end
    end)
end

function jahvex_aeRead(p)
    if type(p) ~= "string" or p == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if jahvex_aeIsSrc(p) then
        return p
    end
    if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    p = string.gsub(p, "^@", "")
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        if isfile(p) then
            return readfile(p)
        end
    end)
    if ok then
        return data
    end
    return nil
end

function jahvex_aeFindSrc()
    local best, bestScore = nil, 0
    local function take(s)
        local sc = jahvex_aeScore(s)
        if sc > bestScore then
            best = s
            bestScore = sc
        end
    end
    take(getgenv().jahvex_src)
    for i = 1, 8 do
        pcall(function()
            take(jahvex_aeRead(debug.info(i, "s")))
        end)
    end
    local paths = {
        "jhvxneeww.txt",
        "jx/jahvex.lua",
        [[C:\Users\meowl\Scripts\jahvex\jhvxneeww.txt]],
        [[C:/Users/meowl/Scripts/jahvex/jhvxneeww.txt]],
    }
    for i = 1, #paths do
        take(jahvex_aeRead(paths[i]))
    end
    if best then
        getgenv().jahvex_src = best
    end
    return best
end

function jahvex_aeSavedOk()
    return jahvex_aeIsSrc(jahvex_aeRead("jhvxneeww.txt"))
        or jahvex_aeIsSrc(jahvex_aeRead("jx/jahvex.lua"))
end

function jahvex_aeSaveSrc(src)
    if not jahvex_aeIsSrc(src) then return false end
    getgenv().jahvex_src = src
    jahvex_aeMkDir()
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end
    local a = pcall(writefile, "jhvxneeww.txt", src)
    local b = pcall(writefile, "jx/jahvex.lua", src)
    return (a == true or b == true) and jahvex_aeSavedOk()
end

function jahvex_aeBootSrc()
    return [=[
task.spawn(function()
    local g = getgenv()
    if g.jahvex_ae_waiting == true then return end
    g.jahvex_ae_waiting = true
    local function flagOn()
        if g.jahvex_ae == false then return false end
        local ok, flag = pcall(function()
            return isfile and isfile("jx/ae.flag") and readfile("jx/ae.flag")
        end)
        if ok and type(flag) == "string" and string.sub(flag, 1, 1) == "0" then
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    if not flagOn() then
        g.jahvex_ae_waiting = nil
        return
    end
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local t0 = tick()
    while tick() - t0 < 90 do
        if game:IsLoaded() and Players.LocalPlayer then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    if not Players.LocalPlayer then
        g.jahvex_ae_waiting = nil
        return
    end
    task.wait(6)
    if not flagOn() then
        g.jahvex_ae_waiting = nil
        return
    end
    local function buildOf(s)
        return tonumber(string.match(s or "", "JAHVEX_BUILD%s*=%s*(%d+)")) or 0
    end
    local src, bestB = nil, -1
    local function take(s)
        if type(s) ~= "string" or #s < 40000 then return end
        if not string.find(s, "JAHVEX_BUILD", 1, true) then return end
        local b = buildOf(s)
        if b > bestB then
            src, bestB = s, b
        end
    end
    take(g.jahvex_src)
    local paths = { "jhvxneeww.txt", "jx/jahvex.lua" }
    for i = 1, #paths do
        pcall(function()
            local p = paths[i]
            if isfile and isfile(p) and readfile then
                take(readfile(p))
            end
        end)
    end
    g.jahvex_ae_waiting = nil
    if type(src) ~= "string" or #src < 40000 then return end
    g.jahvex_ae = true
    g.jahvex_from_autoexec = true
    g.jahvex_loaded = false
    g.jahvex_booting_lock = false
    g.jahvex_alive = false
    local ok, fn = pcall(loadstring, src)
    if ok and type(fn) == "function" then
        pcall(fn)
    end
end)
]=]
end

function jahvex_aePushQueue(code)
    local q = jahvex_aeQueueFn()
    if type(q) ~= "function" or type(code) ~= "string" or #code < 8 then
        return false
    end
    local ok = pcall(q, code)
    return ok and true or false
end

function jahvex_aeOff()
    autoExecuteEnabled = false
    getgenv().jahvex_ae = false
    jahvex_aeMkDir()
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then writefile("jx/ae.flag", "0") end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then writefile("autoexec/jx_boot.lua", "return\n") end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if delfile then
            pcall(delfile, "autoexec/jx_jahvex.lua")
        end
    end)
    jahvex_aePushQueue("getgenv().jahvex_ae=false\npcall(function() if writefile then writefile('jx/ae.flag','0') end end)")
    return true
end

function jahvex_aeOn()
    local src = jahvex_aeFindSrc()
    if not jahvex_aeSaveSrc(src) then
        return false, "no_src"
    end
    autoExecuteEnabled = true
    getgenv().jahvex_ae = true
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then writefile("jx/ae.flag", "1") end
    end)
    local boot = jahvex_aeBootSrc()
    pcall(function()
        if not writefile then return end
        writefile("autoexec/jx_boot.lua", boot)
        writefile("jx/ae_boot.lua", boot)
    end)
    local queued = jahvex_aePushQueue(boot)
    if not queued then
        queued = jahvex_aePushQueue(src)
    end
    if queued then
        return true, "ok"
    end
    local bootFile = false
    pcall(function()
        bootFile = isfile and isfile("autoexec/jx_boot.lua")
            and ((isfile("jhvxneeww.txt") or isfile("jx/jahvex.lua")))
    end)
    if bootFile then
        return true, "ok"
    end
    return false, "queue_fail"
end

function jahvex_applyGuiTheme()
    if not screenGui then return end
    pcall(function()
        if mainFrame then
            mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = WINDOW_BG
            pcall(function() mainFrame:SetAttribute("uiRole", "window") end)
        end
        if headerDiv then
            headerDiv.BackgroundColor3 = BORDER
        end
        if badge then
            badge.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
        end

        for _, d in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
            local role = nil
            pcall(function() role = d:GetAttribute("uiRole") end)

            if role == "window" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                d.BackgroundColor3 = WINDOW_BG
            elseif role == "panel" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                d.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
            elseif role == "elem" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                d.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM_BG
            elseif role == "list" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                d.BackgroundColor3 = LIST_BG
            elseif role == "text" and (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) then

                local tc = d.TextColor3
                local isSpecial = (tc == RED or tc == GREEN)
                if not isSpecial then
                    d.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
                end
            elseif role == "textDim" and (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) then
                d.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            elseif role == "border" and d:IsA("UIStroke") then
                d.Color = BORDER
            elseif role == "accentBar" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                d.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
            elseif role == "accentText" and (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) then
                d.TextColor3 = WHITE_ACC
            elseif role == "toggleBox" or role == "toggleLbl" then

            elseif role == "tabIcon" and d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                d.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            elseif not role and d:IsA("UIStroke") and d.Thickness <= 1.5 then
                d.Color = BORDER
            end


            if d:IsA("TextButton") then
                local tr = nil
                pcall(function() tr = d:GetAttribute("jxText") end)
                if tr == "text" then
                    d.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
                end
            end

            if d.Name == "TabIcon" and d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                d.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end

            if GUI_FONT and (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) then

                if d.Font ~= Enum.Font.GothamBold and d.Font ~= Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
                    and d.Font ~= Enum.Font.MontserratBold then
                    d.Font = GUI_FONT
                end
            end
        end


        if type(jahvexThemeRefreshers) == "table" then
            for i = #jahvexThemeRefreshers, 1, -1 do
                local fn = jahvexThemeRefreshers[i]
                local ok = pcall(fn)
                if not ok then
                    table.remove(jahvexThemeRefreshers, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_setThemeColors(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
    if t.WINDOW_BG then WINDOW_BG = t.WINDOW_BG end
    if t.PANEL_BG then PANEL_BG = t.PANEL_BG end
    if t.ELEM_BG then ELEM_BG = t.ELEM_BG end
    if t.ELEM_HOV then ELEM_HOV = t.ELEM_HOV end
    if t.LIST_BG then LIST_BG = t.LIST_BG end
    if t.BORDER then BORDER = t.BORDER end
    if t.TEXT_W then TEXT_W = t.TEXT_W end
    if t.TEXT_DIM then TEXT_DIM = t.TEXT_DIM end
    if t.WHITE_ACC then WHITE_ACC = t.WHITE_ACC end
    jahvex_applyGuiTheme()
    if type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_refreshThemeSwatches")) == "function" then
        _G.jahvex_refreshThemeSwatches()
    end
    saveConfig()
end

        _G[k] = nil
    end

    getgenv().jahvex_loaded = false

function jahvex_soundLabelForId(id)
    if jahvex_soundIsOff(id) then return "None" end
    if not id or not SOUNDS then return nil end
    for _, snd in ipairs(SOUNDS) do
        if snd.id == id then return snd.name end
    end
    if jahvex_parseAssetId(tostring(id)) then return "Custom" end
    return nil
end

    local feat = jahvexConfigExtra

    end
    if type(feat) ~= "table" then

        feat = {}
    end

    if feat.unlockAllSkins or unlockAllSkinsEnabled then
        unlockAllSkinsEnabled = true
        jahvex_applyUnlockAllSkins(true)
        pcall(function()
            if jahvexUiRefs.unlockSkinsToggle then
                jahvexUiRefs.unlockSkinsToggle:Set(true, false)
            end
        end)
    elseif next(unlockedTypes) then
        unlockAllSkinsEnabled = true

            if jahvexUiRefs.unlockSkinsToggle then

            end
        end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()

        local t0 = tick()
        while tick() - t0 < 12 do
            local ok = pcall(function()
                return DataController and DataController.CurrentData and DataController.CurrentData.Data
                    and DataController.CurrentData.Data.WeaponInventory
            end)
            if ok then break end
            task.wait(0.25)
        end

        if unlockAllGunsEnabled or feat.unlockAllGuns then
            unlockAllGunsEnabled = true
            jahvex_applyUnlockAllGuns(true)

                    jahvexUiRefs.unlockGunsToggle:Set(true, false)
                end

        end)

            if ce.enabled ~= nil then customEnemyEnabled = ce.enabled and true or false end
            if ce.avatarId ~= nil then ceAvatarId = tonumber(ce.avatarId) or 0 end
            if ce.name ~= nil then ceName = tostring(ce.name) end
            if ce.level ~= nil then ceLevel = tonumber(ce.level) or ceLevel end
            if ce.streak ~= nil then ceStreak = tonumber(ce.streak) or ceStreak end
            if ce.elo ~= nil then ceElo = tonumber(ce.elo) or ceElo end
            if ce.deviceType ~= nil and tostring(ce.deviceType) ~= "" then
                ceDeviceType = tostring(ce.deviceType)
            end

            customEnemyTarget = nil
        end
        if s.lastIdentityId then
            lastAvatarSpoofId = tostring(s.lastIdentityId):match("%d+") or tostring(s.lastIdentityId)
        end
        local aid = lastAvatarSpoofId
        if aid and tostring(aid) ~= "" then
            task.defer(function()
                applyIdentitySpoof(tostring(aid))
            end)
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if type(jahvex_applyNameStatusEffects) == "function" then
                jahvex_applyNameStatusEffects()
            end
        end)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if type(feat.esp) == "table" and type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_espLoad")) == "function" then
            _G.jahvex_espLoad(feat.esp)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(feat.cross) == "table" and type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_crossLoad")) == "function" then
            _G.jahvex_crossLoad(feat.cross)
        elseif type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_crossLoad")) == "function" then

            _G.jahvex_crossLoad({ axis = { enabled = false, showAmmo = true } })
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(feat.combat) == "table" and type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_combatLoad")) == "function" then
            _G.jahvex_combatLoad(feat.combat)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(feat.cfo) == "table" and type(getgenv().jahvex_cfoLoad) == "function" then
            getgenv().jahvex_cfoLoad(feat.cfo)
        end
    end)
    pcall(jahvex_applyGuiTheme)

    task.defer(jahvex_syncGuiFromState)
end

function jahvex_setToggle(ref, on)
    pcall(function()
        if ref and ref.Set then ref:Set(on and true or false, false) end
    end)
end

function jahvex_setDrop(ref, valueOrLabel)
    pcall(function()
        if not ref then return end
        if ref.SetByValue and valueOrLabel ~= nil then
            if ref:SetByValue(valueOrLabel, false) then return end
        end
        if ref.SetDisplay and valueOrLabel ~= nil then
            ref:SetDisplay(tostring(valueOrLabel), nil)
        end
    end)
end

function jahvex_setBox(ref, text)
    pcall(function()
        if ref then ref.Text = jahvex_boxText(text) end
    end)
end

        if type(jahvex_unlimitedJumpHook) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_unlimitedJumpHook) end
        if type(jahvex_slideBoostHook) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_slideBoostHook) end
        if type(jahvex_playerMoveHook) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_playerMoveHook) end
        if type(jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_playerMoveSetLoop) end
        if type(jahvex_undergroundSetLoop) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_undergroundSetLoop, playerUndergroundEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_thirdPersonSet) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_thirdPersonSet, thirdPersonEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_aaSetLoop) == "function" then pcall(jahvex_aaSetLoop, aaEnabled or aaSpinEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_fullAutoApply) == "function" then jahvex_fullAutoApply(fullAutoEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_setFullbright) == "function" then jahvex_setFullbright(fullbrightEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_setCamFov) == "function" then jahvex_setCamFov(camFovEnabled) end
        if type(jahvexUiRefs.camFovSliderSet) == "function" then jahvexUiRefs.camFovSliderSet(camFovValue) end
        if type(jahvex_setWorldColor) == "function" then jahvex_setWorldColor(worldColorEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_setWorldAtmo) == "function" then jahvex_setWorldAtmo(worldAtmoEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_setTexTint) == "function" then jahvex_setTexTint(texTintEnabled) end
        if type(jahvex_setTransparentTextures) == "function" then jahvex_setTransparentTextures(transparentTexturesEnabled) end
    end)
end


do
    local overlayRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
    overlayRoot.Name = "OverlayRoot"
    overlayRoot.Parent = screenGui

    local function makeOverlayCard(name, xScale, xOff, yOff, w, h)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Name = name
        card.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
        card.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, xOff, 0, yOff)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.Visible = false
        card.ZIndex = 40
        card.Parent = overlayRoot
        pcall(function() card:SetAttribute("uiRole", "panel") end)
        makeCorner(card, 10)
        local stroke = makeStroke(card, BORDER, 1)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.2

        local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
        accent.Name = "AccentBar"
        accent.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -12)
        accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
        accent.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
        accent.ZIndex = 41
        accent.Parent = card
        pcall(function() accent:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentBar") end)
        makeCorner(accent, 2)

        local inner = Instance.new("Frame")
        inner.Name = "Inner"
        inner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -12)
        inner.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
        inner.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        inner.ZIndex = 41
        inner.Parent = card
        return card, inner, accent, stroke
    end

    local wmCard, wmInner, wmAccent = makeOverlayCard("Watermark", 0, watermarkPosX or 14, watermarkPosY or 14, 168, 64)
    local wmTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    wmTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    wmTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    wmTitle.Text = "jahvex"
    wmTitle.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    wmTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    wmTitle.TextSize = 15
    wmTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    wmTitle.ZIndex = 42
    wmTitle.Parent = wmInner
    pcall(function() wmTitle:SetAttribute("uiRole", "text") end)

    local wmSub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    wmSub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    wmSub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
    wmSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    wmSub.Text = "FPS  --   PING  --"
    wmSub.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
    wmSub.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    wmSub.TextSize = 11
    wmSub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    wmSub.ZIndex = 42
    wmSub.Parent = wmInner
    pcall(function() wmSub:SetAttribute("uiRole", "textDim") end)

    local wmVer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    wmVer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
    wmVer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
    wmVer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    wmVer.Text = "0.1"
    wmVer.TextColor3 = WHITE_ACC
    wmVer.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    wmVer.TextSize = 10
    wmVer.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    wmVer.ZIndex = 42
    wmVer.Parent = wmInner
    pcall(function() wmVer:SetAttribute("uiRole", "accentText") end)

    local kbCard, kbInner, kbAccent = makeOverlayCard("Keybinds", 0, keybindPosX or 14, keybindPosY or 88, 186, 98)
    local kbTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    kbTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
    kbTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    kbTitle.Text = "Keybinds"
    kbTitle.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
    kbTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    kbTitle.TextSize = 13
    kbTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    kbTitle.ZIndex = 42
    kbTitle.Parent = kbInner
    pcall(function() kbTitle:SetAttribute("uiRole", "text") end)

    local kbLines = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
        row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20 + (i - 1) * 20)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.Text = ""
        row.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        row.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        row.TextSize = 11
        row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        row.ZIndex = 42
        row.Parent = kbInner
        pcall(function() row:SetAttribute("uiRole", "textDim") end)
        kbLines[i] = row
    end

    local function applyOverlayPos(card, x, y)
        if not card then return end
        card.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(tonumber(x) or 14), 0, math.floor(tonumber(y) or 14))
    end

    local function makeOverlayDraggable(card, which)
        if not card then return end
        card.Active = true
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        card.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = card.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End and dragging then
                    dragging = false
                    local px = card.Position.X.Offset
                    local py = card.Position.Y.Offset
                    if which == "wm" then
                        watermarkPosX, watermarkPosY = px, py
                    else
                        keybindPosX, keybindPosY = px, py
                    end
                    saveConfig()
                end
            end)
        end)
        jahvex_track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            local nx = startPos.X.Offset + d.X
            local ny = startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vs = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
            local maxX = math.max(0, vs.X - card.AbsoluteSize.X - 4)
            local maxY = math.max(0, vs.Y - card.AbsoluteSize.Y - 4)
            nx = math.clamp(nx, 0, maxX)
            ny = math.clamp(ny, 0, maxY)
            card.Position = UDim2.new(0, nx, 0, ny)
        end))
    end

    makeOverlayDraggable(wmCard, "wm")
    makeOverlayDraggable(kbCard, "kb")
    applyOverlayPos(wmCard, watermarkPosX, watermarkPosY)
    applyOverlayPos(kbCard, keybindPosX, keybindPosY)

    local function applyOverlayTheme()
        for _, card in ipairs({wmCard, kbCard}) do
            card.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
            local st = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then st.Color = BORDER end
            local acc = card:FindFirstChild("AccentBar")
            if acc then acc.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE_ACC end
        end
        wmTitle.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        wmTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        wmSub.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
        wmSub.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        wmVer.TextColor3 = WHITE_ACC
        wmVer.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        kbTitle.TextColor3 = TEXT_W
        for _, row in ipairs(kbLines) do
            row.TextColor3 = TEXT_DIM
            row.Font = GUI_FONT or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        end
    end

    local function getPingMs()
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function()
            ping = math.floor((lp:GetNetworkPing() or 0) * 1000 + 0.5)
        end)
        if ping <= 0 then
            pcall(function()
                local stats = game:GetService("Stats")
                local item = stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
                if item then ping = math.floor(item:GetValue() or 0) end
            end)
        end
        return math.max(0, ping)
    end

    local fpsAccum, fpsFrames, fpsShow = 0, 0, 0
    local function refreshWatermark(dt)
        if not watermarkEnabled then
            wmCard.Visible = false
            return
        end
        wmCard.Visible = true
        dt = tonumber(dt) or 0.016
        fpsAccum = fpsAccum + dt
        fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
        if fpsAccum >= 0.25 then
            fpsShow = math.floor(fpsFrames / fpsAccum + 0.5)
            fpsAccum = 0
            fpsFrames = 0
        end
        local ping = getPingMs()
        wmSub.Text = string.format("FPS  %d   PING  %d", fpsShow, ping)
    end

    local function refreshKeybinds()
        if not keybindListEnabled then
            kbCard.Visible = false
            return
        end
        kbCard.Visible = true
        local guiKey = tostring(guiKeyCode or Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "")
        local aimOn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_aim_enabled") and true or false
        local aimMode = type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_aim_mode")) == "function" and _G.jahvex_aim_mode() or "Hold"
        local aimBind = type(rawget(_G, "jahvex_aim_bind_text")) == "function" and _G.jahvex_aim_bind_text() or "-"
        local saOn = rawget(_G, "jahvex_sa2_enabled") and true or false

        local function onOff(v) return v and "ON" or "OFF" end
        kbLines[1].Text = string.format("GUI        [%s]", guiKey)
        kbLines[2].Text = string.format("Aimbot   %s  %s/%s", onOff(aimOn), tostring(aimMode), tostring(aimBind))
        kbLines[3].Text = string.format("Silent     %s", onOff(saOn))


        kbLines[2].TextColor3 = aimOn and TEXT_W or TEXT_DIM
        kbLines[3].TextColor3 = saOn and TEXT_W or TEXT_DIM
        pcall(function()
            kbLines[2]:SetAttribute("uiRole", aimOn and "text" or "textDim")
            kbLines[3]:SetAttribute("uiRole", saOn and "text" or "textDim")
        end)
    end

    local function updateOverlays(forceTheme)
        if forceTheme then applyOverlayTheme() end
        applyOverlayPos(wmCard, watermarkPosX, watermarkPosY)
        applyOverlayPos(kbCard, keybindPosX, keybindPosY)
        refreshWatermark(0)
        refreshKeybinds()
    end

    _G.jahvex_updateOverlays = updateOverlays
    _G.jahvex_applyOverlayTheme = applyOverlayTheme

    jahvexThemeRefreshers = jahvexThemeRefreshers or {}
    table.insert(jahvexThemeRefreshers, function()
        applyOverlayTheme()
    end)

    local _ovLast = 0
    jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not getgenv().jahvex_alive then return end
        dt = tonumber(dt) or 0.016

        if watermarkEnabled then
            fpsAccum = fpsAccum + dt
            fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
        end
        local now = tick()
        if now - _ovLast < 0.25 then return end
        _ovLast = now
        if watermarkEnabled then
            if fpsAccum > 0 then
                fpsShow = math.floor(fpsFrames / fpsAccum + 0.5)
                fpsAccum = 0
                fpsFrames = 0
            end
            wmCard.Visible = true
            wmSub.Text = string.format("FPS  %d   PING  %d", fpsShow, getPingMs())
        elseif wmCard.Visible then
            wmCard.Visible = false
        end
        if keybindListEnabled then
            refreshKeybinds()
        elseif kbCard.Visible then
            kbCard.Visible = false
        end
    end))


    _G.jahvex_destroyOverlays = function()
        watermarkEnabled = false
        keybindListEnabled = false
        pcall(function() overlayRoot:Destroy() end)
    end

    task.defer(function()
        updateOverlays(true)
    end)
end


do
    local _armCache = {}

    local function jahvex_isArmName(name)
        if type(name) ~= "string" then return false end
        local n = string.lower((name:gsub("%s+", "")))
        if n:find("charm", 1, true) or n:find("handle", 1, true) or n:find("harm", 1, true) then
            return false
        end
        return n == "leftarm" or n == "rightarm" or n == "lefthand" or n == "righthand"
            or n == "leftupperarm" or n == "rightupperarm"
            or n == "leftlowerarm" or n == "rightlowerarm"
            or n == "larm" or n == "rarm"
    end

    local function jahvex_underLocalViewModel(obj)
        local p = obj
        for _ = 1, 16 do
            if not p then return false end
            if p.Name == "ViewModels" then
                return p.Parent == workspace or p.Parent == workspace.CurrentCamera
            end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function jahvex_underLocalChar(obj)
        local char = lp.Character
        if not char then return false end
        return obj == char or obj:IsDescendantOf(char)
    end

    local function jahvex_skipNoArms(obj)
        if not obj then return true end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local p = obj
        for _ = 1, 16 do
            if not p then break end
            if cam and p == cam then return true end
            local n = p.Name
            if n == "ItemVisual" or n == "RightItem" or n == "LeftItem" or n == "Mesh" then
                return true
            end
            if p.Archivable == false then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function jahvex_hideArmVisual(obj)
        if not obj or jahvex_skipNoArms(obj) then return end
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            if _armCache[obj] == nil then
                _armCache[obj] = { t = obj.Transparency, l = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier }
            end
            obj.Transparency = 1
            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
        elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
            if _armCache[obj] == nil then
                _armCache[obj] = { t = obj.Transparency }
            end
            obj.Transparency = 1
        end
    end

    local function jahvex_hideArmTree(root)
        if not root or jahvex_skipNoArms(root) then return end
        jahvex_hideArmVisual(root)
        local ok, desc = pcall(function()
            return root:GetDescendants()
        end)
        if not ok or type(desc) ~= "table" then return end
        for i = 1, #desc do
            local d = desc[i]
            if d and not jahvex_skipNoArms(d) then
                jahvex_hideArmVisual(d)
            end
        end
    end

    local function jahvex_armRoot(obj)
        local p = obj
        for _ = 1, 12 do
            if not p then return nil end
            if jahvex_isArmName(p.Name) then return p end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function jahvex_handleArm(obj)
        if not noArmsEnabled or not obj then return end
        if obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then return end
        local root = jahvex_armRoot(obj)
        if not root then return end
        if jahvex_underLocalViewModel(root) or jahvex_underLocalChar(root) then
            jahvex_hideArmTree(root)
        end
    end

    local function jahvex_noArmsSweep(root)
        if not root then return end
        for _, name in ipairs({ "LeftArm", "RightArm", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "LeftHand", "RightHand", "Left Hand", "Right Hand" }) do
            local arm = root:FindFirstChild(name)
            if arm then pcall(jahvex_hideArmTree, arm) end
        end
        local n = 0
        local ok, desc = pcall(function()
            return root:GetDescendants()
        end)
        if not ok or type(desc) ~= "table" then return end
        for i = 1, #desc do
            n = n + 1
            if n % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
            local obj = desc[i]
            if obj and jahvex_isArmName(obj.Name) then
                pcall(jahvex_hideArmTree, obj)
            end
        end
    end

    local function jahvex_noArmsSweepViewModels()
        local vm = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
        local fp = vm and vm:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson")
        if not fp then return end
        for _, model in ipairs(fp:GetChildren()) do
            for _, name in ipairs({ "LeftArm", "RightArm" }) do
                local arm = model:FindFirstChild(name)
                if arm then jahvex_hideArmTree(arm) end
            end
        end
    end

    local function jahvex_restoreArms()
        for inst, rec in pairs(_armCache) do
            pcall(function()
                if inst and inst.Parent and rec then
                    if rec.t ~= nil then inst.Transparency = rec.t end
                    if rec.l ~= nil and inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                        inst.LocalTransparencyModifier = rec.l
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        _armCache = {}
    end

    local _wsVisConn = nil
    function jahvex_syncWsVisWatch()
        local need = noTexturesEnabled or noArmsEnabled
        if need then
            if _wsVisConn then return end

            _wsVisConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
                if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
                local skipWorld = type(jahvex_worldSkip) == "function" and jahvex_worldSkip(inst)
                if noTexturesEnabled and not skipWorld then
                    pcall(jahvex_texStripOne, inst)
                end
                if noArmsEnabled then
                    pcall(jahvex_handleArm, inst)
                end
            end)
            jahvex_track(_wsVisConn)
        elseif _wsVisConn then
            pcall(function() _wsVisConn:Disconnect() end)
            _wsVisConn = nil
        end
    end

    function jahvex_applyNoArms(on)
        noArmsEnabled = on and true or false
        pcall(function()
            local c = getgenv()._jxNoArmsLiveConn
            if c then
                c:Disconnect()
                getgenv()._jxNoArmsLiveConn = nil
            end
        end)
        jahvex_syncWsVisWatch()
        if not noArmsEnabled then
            jahvex_restoreArms()
            return
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            jahvex_noArmsSweep(lp.Character)
            jahvex_noArmsSweepViewModels()
        end)
    end

    function jahvex_applyHideTasks(on)
        hideTasksEnabled = on and true or false
        if hideHudEnabled then return end
        local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local mf = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MainGui")
        mf = mf and mf:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
        local st = mf and mf:FindFirstChild("SideTasks")
        if st then
            st.Visible = not hideTasksEnabled
        end
    end

    local _hudSaved = {}
    function jahvex_applyHideHud(on)
        hideHudEnabled = on and true or false
        local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return end
        if hideHudEnabled then
            for _, name in ipairs({"MainGui", "InsetGui"}) do
                local g = pg:FindFirstChild(name)
                if g and g:IsA("LayerCollector") then
                    if _hudSaved[name] == nil then
                        _hudSaved[name] = g.Enabled
                    end
                    g.Enabled = false
                end
            end
        else
            for name, en in pairs(_hudSaved) do
                local g = pg:FindFirstChild(name)
                if g and g:IsA("LayerCollector") then
                    g.Enabled = en and true or false
                end
            end
            _hudSaved = {}
            if hideTasksEnabled then
                jahvex_applyHideTasks(true)
            end
        end
    end

    function jahvex_texSkip(inst)
        if not inst or inst == workspace then return true end
        if type(jahvex_worldSkip) == "function" and jahvex_worldSkip(inst) then return true end
        local n = inst.Name
        if n == "Terrain" or n == "Camera" or n == "ViewModels" or n == "Characters" or n == "ShootingRangeEntities" then return true end
        if inst:IsA("Camera") or inst:IsA("Terrain") then return true end
        return false
    end

    function jahvex_texStripOne(inst)
        if not inst or jahvex_texSkip(inst) then return end
        if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
            if _texCache[inst] == nil then _texCache[inst] = { k = "tex", v = inst.TextureID } end
            if inst.TextureID ~= "" then inst.TextureID = "" end
        elseif inst:IsA("Texture") or inst:IsA("Decal") then
            if _texCache[inst] == nil then _texCache[inst] = { k = "tr", v = inst.Transparency } end
            inst.Transparency = 1
        end
    end

    function jahvex_applyNoTextures(on)
        noTexturesEnabled = on and true or false
        jahvex_syncWsVisWatch()
        if not noTexturesEnabled then
            for inst, rec in pairs(_texCache) do
                pcall(function()
                    if inst and inst.Parent and rec then
                        if rec.k == "tex" and inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
                            inst.TextureID = rec.v
                        elseif rec.k == "tr" and (inst:IsA("Texture") or inst:IsA("Decal")) then
                            inst.Transparency = rec.v
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            _texCache = {}
            return
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            local step = jahvex_arcadeBusy() and 30 or 80
            for _, ch in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if not noTexturesEnabled or not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
                if not jahvex_texSkip(ch) then
                    pcall(jahvex_texStripOne, ch)
                    local okd, desc = pcall(function()
                        return ch:GetDescendants()
                    end)
                    if okd and type(desc) == "table" then
                        for i = 1, #desc do
                            if not noTexturesEnabled or not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
                            local inst = desc[i]
                            if inst and not jahvex_texSkip(inst) then
                                pcall(jahvex_texStripOne, inst)
                                n = n + 1
                                if n % step == 0 then task.wait() end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function jahvex_isInsetOverlayHost(inst)
        local p = inst
        while p do
            if p.Name == "InsetOverlayHost" or p.Name == "ContentLoadProbe" then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function jahvex_captureGameFontOrig(d)
        if not d or jahvex_isInsetOverlayHost(d) then return end
        if d:GetAttribute("jxOrigFontFamily") or d:GetAttribute("jxOrigFont") then return end
        pcall(function()
            local ff = d.FontFace
            if ff and ff.Family then
                d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFontFamily", tostring(ff.Family))
                d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFontWeight", ff.Weight and ff.Weight.Name or "Regular")
                d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFontStyle", ff.Style and ff.Style.Name or "Normal")
            end
            d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFont", d.Font.Name)
        end)
    end

    local function jahvex_restoreGameFontOne(d)
        local family = d:GetAttribute("jxOrigFontFamily")
        local orig = d:GetAttribute("jxOrigFont")
        pcall(function()
            if type(family) == "string" and family ~= "" then
                local w = d:GetAttribute("jxOrigFontWeight")
                local s = d:GetAttribute("jxOrigFontStyle")
                local weight = (type(w) == "string" and Enum.FontWeight[w]) or Enum.FontWeight.Regular
                local style = (type(s) == "string" and Enum.FontStyle[s]) or Enum.FontStyle.Normal
                d.FontFace = Font.new(family, weight, style)
            elseif type(orig) == "string" and Enum.Font[orig] then
                local f = Enum.Font[orig]
                d.Font = f
                if Font and Font.fromEnum then
                    d.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(f)
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFont", nil)
            d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFontFamily", nil)
            d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFontWeight", nil)
            d:SetAttribute("jxOrigFontStyle", nil)
        end)
        _gameFontOrig[d] = nil
    end

    _gameFontToken = 0
    function jahvex_applyGameFont()
        _gameFontToken = (_gameFontToken or 0) + 1
        local token = _gameFontToken
        local want = tostring(gameFontName or "off")
        if want == "Default (Off)" or want == "Default" or want == "" then
            want = "off"
            gameFontName = "off"
        end
        local font = (want ~= "off") and Enum.Font[want] or nil
        local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return end
        if not font then
            local has = false
            for _ in pairs(_gameFontOrig) do
                has = true
                break
            end
            if not has then return end
        end
        local n = 0
        local step = jahvex_arcadeBusy() and 40 or 80
        for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
            if token ~= _gameFontToken then return end
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
                if not jahvex_isInsetOverlayHost(d) then
                    if font then
                        jahvex_captureGameFontOrig(d)
                        d.Font = font
                        pcall(function()
                            if Font and Font.fromEnum then d.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(font) end
                        end)
                    else
                        jahvex_restoreGameFontOne(d)
                    end
                    n = n + 1
                    if n % step == 0 then task.wait() end
                end
            end
        end
        if not font then _gameFontOrig = {} end
    end

    local _visLast = 0
    jahvex_track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        if not (hideTasksEnabled or hideHudEnabled) then return end
        local now = tick()
        if now - _visLast < 0.35 then return end
        _visLast = now
        if hideHudEnabled then jahvex_applyHideHud(true) end
        if hideTasksEnabled then jahvex_applyHideTasks(true) end
    end))

    jahvex_track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() or not noArmsEnabled then return end
        pcall(jahvex_noArmsSweepViewModels)
        local char = lp.Character
        if not char then return end
        for _, name in ipairs({ "LeftArm", "RightArm", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "LeftHand", "RightHand" }) do
            local arm = char:FindFirstChild(name)
            if arm then jahvex_hideArmTree(arm) end
        end
    end))

    jahvex_track(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if not noArmsEnabled then return end
        task.delay(0.5, function()
            if noArmsEnabled and jahvex_isCurrent() then
                jahvex_noArmsSweep(char)
                jahvex_noArmsSweepViewModels()
            end
        end)
    end))

    pcall(function()
        jahvex_track(lp.PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
            if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
            local fontOn = type(gameFontName) == "string" and gameFontName ~= "off" and gameFontName ~= "" and gameFontName ~= "Default (Off)"
            if not fontOn and not hideTasksEnabled then return end
            if hideTasksEnabled and inst.Name == "SideTasks" then
                task.defer(function() if hideTasksEnabled then inst.Visible = false end end)
            end
            if not fontOn then return end
            if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextBox") then
                if not jahvex_isInsetOverlayHost(inst) then
                    local font = Enum.Font[gameFontName]
                    if font then
                        jahvex_captureGameFontOrig(inst)
                        inst.Font = font
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
    end)
end

    if state == Enum.TeleportState.Failed then
        return
    end
    if not autoExecuteEnabled then
        return
    end

        saveDirty = false
        saveScheduled = false
        jahvex_writeConfigFile(true)
    end)
    jahvex_aeOn()
end))

function jahvex_bootStatus(_text)

end


do
    if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
    local steps = {
        jahvex_bootHooks,
        jahvex_bootModules,
        jahvex_unlockCos,
        jahvex_unlockData,
        jahvex_unlockClient,
        jahvex_bootCamera,
        jahvex_chunk2,
        jahvex_chunk3,
        jahvex_chunk4,
        jahvex_chunk4esp,
        jahvex_chunk4world,
        jahvex_chunk5,
    }
    for i = 1, #steps do
        if not jahvex_isCurrent() then return end
        local fn = steps[i]
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            pcall(fn)
        end

        if type(jahvex_paceStep) == "function" then
            pcall(jahvex_paceStep)
        else
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
            end)
        end
    end
    pcall(jahvex_bootFinished)
    pcall(jahvex_dismissBoot)
    if interfaceLbl then
        pcall(function() interfaceLbl.Text = "Interface" end)
    end
    pcall(jahvex_applySilentExecute)
end
