task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local function checkMod(player)
        if not modDetectEnabled then return end
        if player == lp then return end
        local lowerName = player.Name:lower()
        local lowerDisplay = player.DisplayName:lower()
        for _, n in ipairs(_HARDCODED_MOD_NICKS) do
            local clean = n:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
            if clean ~= "" and (string.find(lowerName, clean, 1, true) or string.find(lowerDisplay, clean, 1, true)) then
                                pcall(function() setStatus("MOD DETECTED: " .. player.Name .. "! LEAVING...", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)) end)
                pcall(function() lp:Kick("Mod detected: " .. player.Name .. " (" .. player.DisplayName .. ")! Stay safe.") end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game:GetService("CoreGui") or lp.PlayerGui)
                    local bg = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
                    bg.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                    bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                    local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
                    txt.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                    txt.Text = "MOD DETECTED! GAME FROZEN FOR SAFETY."
                    txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
                    txt.TextScaled = true
                    while true do end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(checkMod)
    while task.wait(2) do
        if modDetectEnabled then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                checkMod(p)
            end
        end
    end
end)


task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(3)
    pcall(function()

    local lp  = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local CS  = game:GetService("CollectionService")
    local WC  = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.WrapController)

    local _eqT = nil
    local function findEq()
        local ok, gc = pcall(getgc, true)
        if not ok then return nil end
        for _, v in ipairs(gc) do
            if type(v) == "table" then
                for _, wn in ipairs({"Jump Pad","Freeze Ray","Smoke Grenade","Molotov","Subspace Tripmine","Spear","Trowel","Warper","Distortion","Warpstone","Flare Gun","Flamethrower","War Horn","Katana"}) do
                    local wp = rawget(v, wn)
                    if type(wp)=="table" then
                        local sk = rawget(wp,"Skin")
                        if type(sk)=="table" and rawget(sk,"Name") then return v end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function getSkin(wn)
        _eqT = _eqT or findEq()
        if not _eqT then return nil end
        local wp   = rawget(_eqT, wn)
        local skin = type(wp)=="table" and rawget(wp,"Skin")
        return type(skin)=="table" and rawget(skin,"Name") or nil
    end
    local function getWrap(wn)
        _eqT = _eqT or findEq()
        if not _eqT then return nil end
        local wp   = rawget(_eqT, wn)
        local wrap = type(wp)=="table" and rawget(wp,"Wrap")
        return type(wrap)=="table" and wrap or nil
    end
    local function tempSkin(wn)
        local s
        pcall(function()
            local temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Temp.ViewModels
            for _, c in ipairs(temp:GetChildren()) do
                local w, sk = c.Name:match("^.- %- (.+) %- (.+)$")
                if w == wn and sk and sk ~= "" then s = sk end
            end
        end)
        return s
    end
    local function resolveSkin(wn)
        local s = getSkin(wn)
        if type(s) == "string" and s ~= "" and s ~= "Default" and s ~= wn then return s end
        s = tempSkin(wn)
        if type(s) == "string" and s ~= "" and s ~= "Default" and s ~= wn then return s end
        return nil
    end
    local function origOf(key, tbl, field)
        if type(tbl) ~= "table" or type(field) ~= "string" or type(tbl[field]) ~= "function" then return nil end
        jahvex_saveMod(key, tbl, field)
        local orig = tbl[field]
        local saved = getgenv().jahvex_restore and getgenv().jahvex_restore[key]
        if saved and saved.fn then orig = saved.fn end
        return orig
    end
    local function isLocalItem(self)
        local f = self and (self.ClientFighter or (self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter))
        if not f then return false end
        if f.IsLocalPlayer == true then return true end
        return f.Player == lp
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, JM = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.GameComponents.JumpPads)
        if not ok or not JM or not JM._ObjectAdded then return end
        jahvex_saveMod("JumpPads_ObjectAdded", JM, "_ObjectAdded")
        local orig = JM._ObjectAdded
        do
            local saved = getgenv().jahvex_restore and getgenv().jahvex_restore.JumpPads_ObjectAdded
            if saved and saved.fn then orig = saved.fn end
        end
        JM._ObjectAdded = function(self, hitbox)
            pcall(function()
                local s = getSkin("Jump Pad")
                if s and s ~= "" then hitbox:SetAttribute("ViewModelName", s) end
            end)
            return orig(self, hitbox)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, FH = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.GameComponents.FireHitboxes)
        if not ok or not FH then return end
        local FHAssets = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Misc.FireHitboxes
        CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("FireHitbox"):Connect(function(inst)
            task.wait()
            pcall(function()
                local entry = FH._fire_hitboxes and FH._fire_hitboxes[inst]
                if not entry or entry.Destroyed then return end
                local skin = getSkin("Molotov") or getSkin("Flamethrower")
                if not (skin and skin ~= "") then return end
                if entry.Visual and entry.Visual.Name == skin then return end
                local skinModel = FHAssets:FindFirstChild(skin)
                if not skinModel then return end
                local oldVis = entry.Visual
                local newVis = skinModel:Clone()
                newVis.PrimaryPart = newVis.Primary
                newVis.Primary.Size = inst.Size
                newVis:PivotTo(inst.CFrame)
                newVis.Parent = workspace
                pcall(function() if entry.Sound1 then entry.Sound1.Parent = newVis.Primary end end)
                pcall(function() if entry.Sound2 then entry.Sound2.Parent = newVis.Primary end end)
                entry.Visual = newVis
                if oldVis then pcall(function() oldVis:Destroy() end) end
            end)
        end)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, SM = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.GameComponents.SmokeClouds)
        if not ok or not SM or not SM._ObjectAdded then return end
        local SmokeAssets = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Misc.SmokeClouds
        local orig = SM._ObjectAdded
        SM._ObjectAdded = function(self, inst)
            local renamedModel, originalName = nil, nil
            pcall(function()
                local instName = inst.Name
                local wn = instName:lower():find("flash") and "Flashbang" or "Smoke Grenade"
                local skin = getSkin(wn)
                if not (skin and skin ~= "" and skin ~= instName) then return end
                local skinModel = SmokeAssets:FindFirstChild(skin)
                if not skinModel then return end
                local existingInstModel = SmokeAssets:FindFirstChild(instName)
                if existingInstModel then existingInstModel.Name = "__jhvx_temp__" end
                renamedModel = skinModel
                originalName = skinModel.Name
                skinModel.Name = instName
            end)
            orig(self, inst)
            pcall(function()
                if renamedModel and originalName then renamedModel.Name = originalName end
                local temp = SmokeAssets:FindFirstChild("__jhvx_temp__")
                if temp then temp.Name = inst.Name end
            end)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, CE = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientEntity)
        if not ok or not CE or not CE._FreezeEffect then return end
        local FEFolder = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Misc.FreezeEffects
        local function toFEName(s)
            if not s then return nil end
            if FEFolder:FindFirstChild(s) then return s end
            local t = s:match("^(.+)%s+Ray$") or s:match("^(.+)%s+Freeze%s*Ray$")
            if t and FEFolder:FindFirstChild(t) then return t end
            local fw = s:match("^(%a+)")
            if fw and FEFolder:FindFirstChild(fw) then return fw end
            return nil
        end
        local orig = origOf("CE_FreezeEffect", CE, "_FreezeEffect")
        if not orig then return end
        CE._FreezeEffect = function(self, duration, skinName)
            pcall(function()
                if type(skinName) == "string" and skinName == "SandBucket" then
                    return
                end
                local eqName = ""
                pcall(function()
                    local eq = type(jahvex_getEquippedItem) == "function" and jahvex_getEquippedItem()
                    eqName = eq and tostring(eq.Name or "") or ""
                end)
                if eqName ~= "Freeze Ray" then
                    return
                end
                local m = toFEName(getSkin("Freeze Ray") or tempSkin("Freeze Ray"))
                if m then skinName = m end
            end)
            return orig(self, duration, skinName)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
        local function findSkinModel(skinName)
            if not (skinName and skinName ~= "" and skinName ~= "Default") then return nil end
            local vmFolder = lp.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Assets")
            vmFolder = vmFolder and vmFolder:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
            if not vmFolder then return nil end
            local src = nil
            for _, d in ipairs(vmFolder:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == skinName then
                    src = d
                    break
                end
            end
            return src
        end
        local function hideDefault(inst)
            local skinM = inst:FindFirstChild("jhvxTMSkin")
            local hitbox = inst:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
            for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                    if skinM and d:IsDescendantOf(skinM) then
                        d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    elseif d ~= hitbox then
                        d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                            d.Transparency = 1
                        elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                            d.Transparency = 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function applyTMSkin(inst)
            if not inst or inst:GetAttribute("jhvxTMSkinOn") then return end
            local byUser = inst:GetAttribute("PlacedByUserID")
            if byUser ~= lp.UserId then return end
            local skin = getSkin("Subspace Tripmine")
            if not (skin and skin ~= "" and skin ~= "Default") then
                pcall(function()
                    local temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Temp.ViewModels
                    for _, c in ipairs(temp:GetChildren()) do
                        local name = c.Name
                        if name:find("Subspace Tripmine") then
                            skin = name:match("Subspace Tripmine %- (.+)$") or skin
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not (skin and skin ~= "" and skin ~= "Default") then return end
            local src = findSkinModel(skin)
            if not src then
                pcall(function()
                    local temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Temp.ViewModels
                    for _, c in ipairs(temp:GetChildren()) do
                        if c.Name:find("Subspace Tripmine", 1, true) then
                            src = c:FindFirstChild("ItemVisual") or c:FindFirstChild("Body") or c
                            if not (skin and skin ~= "" and skin ~= "Default") then
                                skin = c.Name:match("Subspace Tripmine %- (.+)$") or skin
                            end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local hitbox = inst:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or inst:WaitForChild("Hitbox", 2)
            if not hitbox then return end
            inst:SetAttribute("jhvxTMSkinOn", true)
            local oldArch = src.Archivable
            src.Archivable = true
            local clone = src:Clone()
            src.Archivable = oldArch
            if not clone then return end
            for _, n in ipairs({ "HumanoidRootPart", "LeftArm", "RightArm", "LeftItem", "RightItem", "Camera", "AnimationController" }) do
                local x = clone:FindFirstChild(n)
                if x then x:Destroy() end
            end
            local body = clone:FindFirstChild("Body") or clone:FindFirstChild("ItemVisual") or clone
            body.Name = "jhvxTMSkin"
            body.Parent = inst
            if clone ~= body then
                pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                body:PivotTo(hitbox.CFrame)
            end)
            for _, p in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    p.Anchored = false
                    p.CanCollide = false
                    p.CanQuery = false
                    p.Massless = true
                    p.CastShadow = false
                    p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    pcall(function()
                        p.Transparency = 0
                    end)
                    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    w.Part0 = hitbox
                    w.Part1 = p
                    w.Parent = p
                end
            end
            hideDefault(inst)
            local wrap = getWrap("Subspace Tripmine")
            if wrap then
                pcall(function()
                    WC:ApplyWrap(WC:RecordOriginalWrapProperties(body), wrap, true)
                end)
            end
            local conn
            local _tmHideN = 0
            conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not inst.Parent then
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    return
                end
                _tmHideN = _tmHideN + 1
                if _tmHideN % 8 ~= 0 then return end
                hideDefault(inst)
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            local STM = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.GameComponents.SubspaceTripmines)
            if STM and STM._ObjectAdded then
                jahvex_saveMod("STM_ObjectAdded", STM, "_ObjectAdded")
                local orig = STM._ObjectAdded
                do
                    local saved = getgenv().jahvex_restore and getgenv().jahvex_restore.STM_ObjectAdded
                    if saved and saved.fn then orig = saved.fn end
                end
                STM._ObjectAdded = function(self, mine)
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(applyTMSkin, mine)
                    end)
                    return orig(self, mine)
                end
            end
        end)

        CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("SubspaceTripmine"):Connect(function(inst)
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(applyTMSkin, inst)
            end)
        end)
        for _, inst in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("SubspaceTripmine")) do
            pcall(applyTMSkin, inst)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, Tightrope = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.Tightrope)
        if not ok or type(Tightrope) ~= "table" or type(Tightrope.new) ~= "function" then return end
        jahvex_saveMod("Tightrope_new", Tightrope, "new")
        local orig = Tightrope.new
        do
            local saved = getgenv().jahvex_restore and getgenv().jahvex_restore.Tightrope_new
            if saved and saved.fn then orig = saved.fn end
        end
        if orig == Tightrope.__jx_new then return end
        local function spearSkinName()
            local s = getSkin("Spear")
            if s and s ~= "" and s ~= "Default" and s ~= "Spear" then return s end
            pcall(function()
                local temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Temp.ViewModels
                for _, c in ipairs(temp:GetChildren()) do
                    local m = c.Name:match("Spear %- (.+)$")
                    if m then s = m end
                end
            end)
            return s
        end
        local function isLocalSpear(part)
            local mine = false
            pcall(function()
                local oid = part:GetAttribute("ObjectID")
                local FC = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
                local lf = FC.LocalFighter
                if lf and oid and type(lf.GetItem) == "function" and lf:GetItem(oid) then
                    mine = true
                end
            end)
            if mine then return true end
            local vm = part:GetAttribute("ViewModelName")
            if vm and vm ~= "" and vm ~= "Spear" and vm ~= "Default" then
                return false
            end
            local holding = false
            pcall(function()
                local temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Temp.ViewModels
                for _, c in ipairs(temp:GetChildren()) do
                    if c.Name:find("Spear", 1, true) then holding = true end
                end
            end)
            return holding
        end
        function Tightrope.new(ctrl, part)
            pcall(function()
                if not part or not part:GetAttribute("IsSpear") then return end
                if not isLocalSpear(part) then return end
                local skin = spearSkinName()
                if not (skin and skin ~= "") then return end
                local folder = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets:FindFirstChild("SpearTightropes")
                if not (folder and folder:FindFirstChild(skin)) then return end
                part:SetAttribute("ViewModelName", skin)
            end)
            return orig(ctrl, part)
        end
        Tightrope.__jx_new = orig
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local function trowelSkinName()
            local s = getSkin("Trowel")
            if s and s ~= "" and s ~= "Default" and s ~= "Trowel" then return s end
            pcall(function()
                local temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Assets.Temp.ViewModels
                for _, c in ipairs(temp:GetChildren()) do
                    local m = c.Name:match("Trowel %- (.+)$")
                    if m then s = m end
                end
            end)
            return s
        end
        local MAT_OVERRIDE = {
            ["Garden Shovel"] = Enum.Material.Ground,
            ["Snow Shovel"] = Enum.Material.Snow,
            ["Glorious Trowel"] = Enum.Material.Neon,
        }
        local COL_OVERRIDE = {
            ["Snow Shovel"] = Color3.fromRGB(240, 248, 255),
        }
        local LOOK = {}
        do
            local vm = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
            if vm then
                for _, d in ipairs(vm:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Model") then
                        local bestSat, bestCol, bestMat = -1, nil, nil
                        for _, m in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                            if m:IsA("BasePart") then
                                local _, s = m.Color:ToHSV()
                                if s > bestSat then
                                    bestSat = s
                                    bestCol = m.Color
                                    bestMat = m.Material
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if bestCol then
                            LOOK[d.Name] = {
                                mat = MAT_OVERRIDE[d.Name] or bestMat,
                                col = COL_OVERRIDE[d.Name] or bestCol,
                                trans = 0.14,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function wallLook(skin)
            return LOOK[skin] or { mat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, col = Color3.fromRGB(206, 103, 6), trans = 0.14 }
        end
        local function paintBrick(p, look)
            if not (p and p:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
            p.Color = look.col
            p.Material = look.mat
            p.Transparency = look.trans
        end
        local function applyTrowelWall(inst)
            if not inst then return end
            local wall = inst
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Parent and inst.Parent.Name == "TrowelWall" then
                wall = inst.Parent
            end
            local isBrick = inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst:HasTag("TrowelBrick")
            if wall.Name ~= "TrowelWall" and not isBrick then return end
            local skin = trowelSkinName()
            if not (skin and skin ~= "") then return end
            local look = wallLook(skin)
            if isBrick then
                paintBrick(inst, look)
            end
            if wall.Name ~= "TrowelWall" then return end
            if wall:GetAttribute("jhvxTrowelWatch") then return end
            wall:SetAttribute("jhvxTrowelWatch", true)
            for _, p in ipairs(wall:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then paintBrick(p, look) end
            end
            wall.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                if ch:IsA("BasePart") then paintBrick(ch, look) end
            end)
        end
        CS:GetInstanceAddedSignal("TrowelBrick"):Connect(function(part)
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(applyTrowelWall, part)
            end)
        end)
        workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
            if ch.Name == "TrowelWall" then
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(applyTrowelWall, ch)
                end)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("TrowelBrick")) do
                applyTrowelWall(p)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrowelWall")
            if w then applyTrowelWall(w) end
        end)
    end)

        local ok, VM = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.GameComponents.Vortexes)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, CE = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientEntity)

    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, Gun = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun)
        if not ok or not Gun or not Gun._ProjectileEffect then return end
        local Projectiles = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets:FindFirstChild("Projectiles")
        if not Projectiles then return end
        local orig = origOf("Gun_ProjectileEffect", Gun, "_ProjectileEffect")
        if not orig then return end
        local function copyProjColors(dst, src)
            if not (dst and src) then return end
            local map = {}
            for _, s in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
                map[s.ClassName .. "\0" .. s.Name] = s
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(dst:GetDescendants()) do
                local s = map[d.ClassName .. "\0" .. d.Name]
                if s then
                    if s:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or s:IsA("Trail") or s:IsA("Beam") then
                        d.Color = s.Color
                    elseif s:IsA("Light") then
                        d.Color = s.Color
                    elseif s:IsA("BasePart") then
                        d.Color = s.Color
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        d:SetAttribute("IgnoreRecolor", true)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        Gun._ProjectileEffect = function(self, part, extra)
            local extra2 = extra
            local oldVM
            local skinName
            local f = self and self.ClientFighter
            local localShot = (not f) or (f.IsLocalPlayer == true) or (f.Player == lp)
            if localShot then
                local s = resolveSkin(self.Name) or resolveSkin("Flare Gun")
                local vm = self.ViewModel
                if (not s) and vm and type(vm.Name) == "string" then
                    local vn = vm.Name
                    if vn ~= "" and vn ~= self.Name and Projectiles:FindFirstChild(vn) then
                        s = vn
                    end
                end
                if s and Projectiles:FindFirstChild(s) then
                    skinName = s
                    if type(extra) == "table" then
                        extra.ProjectileNameOverride = s
                        extra2 = extra
                    else
                        extra2 = { ProjectileNameOverride = s }
                    end
                    if vm then
                        oldVM = vm.Name
                        vm.Name = s
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, d in ipairs(Projectiles[s]:GetDescendants()) do
                            d:SetAttribute("IgnoreRecolor", true)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            local a, b, c = orig(self, part, extra2)
            if oldVM and self.ViewModel then
                self.ViewModel.Name = oldVM
            end
            if skinName and self.Name == "Flare Gun" then
                pcall(function()
                    local live = self._projectile_part_to_model and self._projectile_part_to_model[part]
                    local tmpl = Projectiles:FindFirstChild(skinName)
                    copyProjColors(live, tmpl)
                    task.defer(copyProjColors, live, tmpl)
                end)
            end
            return a, b, c
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, Molotov = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ViewModels.Molotov)
        if not ok or not Molotov or not Molotov.ExplosionEffect then return end
        local folder = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Misc:FindFirstChild("MolotovExplosionEffects")
        local orig = origOf("Molotov_ExplosionEffect", Molotov, "ExplosionEffect")
        if not orig then return end
        Molotov.ExplosionEffect = function(self, p5, p6, ...)
            local old = self.Name
            pcall(function()
                if not isLocalItem(self) then return end
                local s = resolveSkin("Molotov") or resolveSkin("Flamethrower")
                if s and folder and folder:FindFirstChild(s) then self.Name = s end
            end)
            local a, b, c = orig(self, p5, p6, ...)
            self.Name = old
            return a, b, c
        end
    end)

    local function wrapVMName(key, path, weapon, field, miscFolder)
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, mod = pcall(require, path)
            if not ok or type(mod) ~= "table" or type(mod[field]) ~= "function" then return end
            local orig = origOf(key, mod, field)
            if not orig then return end
            local folder = miscFolder and lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Misc:FindFirstChild(miscFolder)
            mod[field] = function(self, ...)
                local old = self.Name
                if isLocalItem(self) then
                    local s = resolveSkin(weapon)
                    if s and (not folder or folder:FindFirstChild(s)) then
                        self.Name = s
                    end
                end
                local a, b, c, d = orig(self, ...)
                self.Name = old
                return a, b, c, d
            end
        end)
    end
    wrapVMName("FT_Setup", lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ViewModels.Flamethrower, "Flamethrower", "_Setup", "FlamethrowerFlames")
    wrapVMName("FT_Airblast", lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ViewModels.Flamethrower, "Flamethrower", "AirblastEffect", "FlamethrowerAirblasts")
    wrapVMName("WH_Setup", lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ViewModels["War Horn"], "War Horn", "_Setup", "WarHornEffects")
    wrapVMName("Katana_Setup", lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ViewModels.Katana, "Katana", "_Setup", "DeflectHitEffects")

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, SB = pcall(require, lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientFighterCharacter.Snowball)
        if not ok or type(SB) ~= "table" then return end
        local folder = lp.PlayerScripts.Assets.Misc:FindFirstChild("Snowballs")
        local function snowSkin()
            local s = resolveSkin("Snowball")
            if s and folder and folder:FindFirstChild(s) then return s end
            return nil
        end
        if type(SB._GrabSnowball) == "function" then
            local orig = origOf("SB_Grab", SB, "_GrabSnowball")
            if orig then
                SB._GrabSnowball = function(self, kind)
                    local s = snowSkin()
                    if s then kind = s end
                    return orig(self, kind)
                end
            end
        end
        if type(SB._ThrowSnowball) == "function" then
            local orig = origOf("SB_Throw", SB, "_ThrowSnowball")
            if orig then
                SB._ThrowSnowball = function(self, pos, kind, ...)
                    local s = snowSkin()
                    if s then kind = s end
                    return orig(self, pos, kind, ...)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    end)
end)
